notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.8 #3
notes.content:
10-Year Interactive Timeline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8595bc6024c1469578a8699a6681a863ea9cdf2.jpg
Happy anniversary, Captains! This week marks 10 years since World of Warships was released on September 17, 2015. 

Take a look at the interactive timeline page we've prepared for the occasion—you'll be flooded with memories from all of our good times together!

Click Here 

Anniversary YouTube Marathon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8c0fd4892049da455acfbbe18e3d81688ee6f121.jpg
Tune in to the World of Warships YouTube channel this Saturday for a 10-hour marathon of videos that we’ve published over the years. Naval Legends, Armada, Ship Comparison… You can watch all the classics and get rewarded while doing so!

Every hour of the marathon, we'll share 10 bonus codes, and the fastest viewers to redeem them will enjoy rewards like a Special Ship X container, Rare Bonuses container, or "Like and Subscribe" permanent camouflage. If your knowledge of naval history is sharp enough, you could even win a lifetime subscription to the MagellanTV documentary streaming service! 

Check out our article for more details:

Click Here 

Anniversary Activities and Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/596ccba3633281d09f15635199d4420ef80e1a05.jpg
Just because the anniversary date has passed, it doesn't mean the celebrations are over—far from it! Get the most out of the ongoing Update 14.8 by taking part in a wide range of in-game activities that you can read all about in our dedicated article:

Click Here 

Asymmetric Battles, Brawls, and Blast From the Past!

Asymmetric Battles—the battle type where a group of players faces off against a numerically superior but lower-tier bot force—has returned to the game this week, and it's here to stay until Update 15.2!

Also be sure to partake in the weekly Brawl session, which adopts a 2v2 format with Tier IX ships this week.

To round it all off, Update 14.8's unique callback to the game's history in the form of a battle type—Blast From the Past—is still available to play. Experience it while you still can!

Dev Blog Review
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0c1560bc1539b35c19b8197d6d34d04622c12cb4.jpg
The past few weeks have seen some interesting Development Blog posts published about upcoming ships, map rebalancing, and a new map that's currently in the works. 

Please note: The Development Blog is published only in English.

Final Testing of a New Map 

Existing Maps Rebalanced 

New Ships Announced

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.8 #2
notes.content:
Get Early Access to New German Cruisers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/345cd70dbbc38ae26f51099c8805d5df1abad4d0.jpg
A new Tech Tree branch of German cruisers is making its debut in our waters ahead of their full release in Update 14.10. Don't miss the boat—find out how to take part and become one of the first Captains to sail these behemoths into battle.

Deutschland (Tier VI), Admiral Scheer (Tier VII), Knesebeck (Tier VIII), Manteuffel (Tier IX), and Prinz Adalbert (Tier X) have as their main distinguishing feature the ability to assume manual control of their secondary battery—a useful tool to brandish when the ships' large-caliber main guns are in the process of reloading.

You'll find all the information you need—about the Early Access event, how these newcomers perform in battle, and the best tactics to utilize aboard them—in a dedicated article. Click the link to find out more!
EU NA ASIA

The Grand Voyage Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6ec28fc7083813f5a475ee154c208b5e2c9bdfc0.jpg
Update 14.7 launched the multi-update Grand Voyage event. Spanning several months and ultimately set to lead us into the New Year, the event includes a variety of long-term activities, special missions, and valuable rewards.

Update 14.8 gives you the opportunity to continue your journey toward rewards like U.S. Premium destroyer GQ Johnny and Voyage Tokens. During the event, you can exchange up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens at a 1:1 rate for Doubloons or Steel!

Learn more on the event page:

Brawls

The first Brawl session of Update 14.8 goes live this weekend. Format:

3v3; Tier X ships
No more than 1 destroyer per team
No aircraft carriers or submarines allowed
Divisions of up to 3 players

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.9. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Captains!

Our 10th Anniversary update is finally here, but our development team are also already steaming ahead with more new content to come in Update 14.9. It's time for a sneak peek!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.9:

Liberty Harbor: In honor of the 250th birthday of the U.S. Navy, we invite you to build your own Naval Base—Liberty Harbor. Each structure serves a specific purpose, so choose your build order carefully. Complete combat missions, and once the whole base is finished, you can claim new U.S. cruiser Bridgeport for free, in addition to Commander David Farragut for assembling a dedicated collection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b3fcb30842b20c91e19d9128331dbdf710814f0b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ad9c31eae42f3bafdac95ac4a7d6da0b40ed0563.jpg
Dockyard: Lüshun B: We're starting Black Friday early this year! You'll soon be able to build the black version of Pan-Asian destroyer Lüshun—a ship that first graced the Dockyard in the form of her standard version in Update 12.7. Complete 35 shipbuilding phases—30 of which can be finished via combat missions—to unlock this rapid-firing, deepwater torpedo-launching machine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b815c9d816f2bf32fe7e1b4849d7ca8c612d88bc.jpg

German Reunification Event Pass: Our Event Pass this update is dedicated to the reunification of East and West Germany, a historical event that's celebrated every year in October. The first progression line will net you, among others, statuesque Commander Goldelse. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4ca024ab2f163e816334dad407dbb4d03c5283bb.png

The second progression line offers rewards such as the Infernal permanent camouflage for Tier VIII and X ships, and Commander Delphius Ora-cle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/78031a7a41f541f215020ba9195a1aef043693ca.png


If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

EU NA ASIA

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.8 #1
notes.content:
Welcome to Our 10th Anniversary Update!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f6301ea1f341e0367b79402519fdcaf8f753c99b.jpg

In Update 14.8, we're celebrating World of Warships' 10th Anniversary! Before you dig in to the feast of celebratory activities, consider having a look through our update article for the full change log. You'll find info about:


Various Anniversary activities, including special login rewards, Festive Rewards for activating Battle Performance Bonuses, and an interactive new Port.
The Early Access event for a new branch of German cruisers with manually controlled secondary guns.
The return of Asymmetric Battles and the introduction of a nostalgia-inducing new temporary battle type—Blast From the Past!
Gameplay changes, including a rework of how ship modules take damage and the introduction of submarines to Operations.
And more!




EU

Relive the Old Days in Blast From the Past!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17d8201031c125c5350a38b6870bc86f0c91a306.jpg

For our 10th Anniversary, we're harking back to a simpler time when the virtual seas were populated only by battleships, cruisers, and destroyers—no carriers or subs!

The battle type is structured into six chapters, with the first five themed around specific years in the game's life. Each chapter restricts gameplay to only the ships and maps available up to that particular year. 

The final chapter features the current full selection of maps and nearly all available ships, but a new layer of restrictions specifically targets ships possessing advanced mechanics.

For more info, check out this dedicated article:
EU

Anniversary Activities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ef269e09b1bdf8e74e580f4d63b20a24f608aaa3.jpg

Activities—and rewards—abound in Update 14.8! You can get started by simply logging in to claim your daily bonus, which may be a Supercontainer, Coal, days of Warships Premium Account, or Festive Tokens!

What are Festive Tokens? They're an Armory currency you can use to unlock Festive Rewards, which include new Japanese cruiser Kushiro, up to 130 Supercontainers, and the This Is Fine enemy destruction effect.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0f2b2f794ba2850e47790ba248762c048a61803f.png

You can earn a large number of Festive Tokens by activating Battle Performance Bonuses, and to do that, you'll need to earn cumulative Base XP on each of your ships, with the amount needed depending on the ship tier.

And finally, be sure to check out the Decade Dock Port—plenty of Easter eggs and interactive elements are waiting to be discovered!

You'll find more info about these and other 10th Anniversary activities in a dedicated article:
EU

Recruiting Station Anniversary Blowout!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ecb32ac76d95f080c26586f3f9df2c8202ac6450.jpg

What better time to invite your friends to play World of Warships than during our gift-laden 10th Anniversary update!

Recruiting Station Changes
Thanks to brand-new changes to the Recruiting Station mechanics, it's now easier than ever to invite new and former players to become your Shipmates. Now, every player with fewer than 100 battles on record is eligible for recruitment!

On top of that, all the first-time rewards you get as a Recruiter have been reset! That means seasoned Recruiters can once again claim rewards for performing these simple actions:


First login to the Recruiting Station
First invite link share
Three invite link shares
First Shipmate


Recruiting Surge Event

Take advantage of these quality-of-life changes to accumulate Expedition Tokens in the new Recruiting Surge event, which offers guaranteed rewards for completing simple Recruiting Station actions. Get involved and celebrate the game's 10th Anniversary in-battle with your Shipmates to earn even more! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/294f87365561382f74996b86f1b90718f1e639d7.jpg

More info is available in a dedicated article:
EU

Take the 14.8 Survey!

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 14.8? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

Take Survey

notes.title: Update 14.8 | A Decade at Sea, New German Cruisers, and Anniversary Celebrations
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a4ac12ceb46233b6fadd46b3ec00aa506089ee46.jpg

[previewyoutube=h4vpGT6nS9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.8. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU NA ASIA

A Decade at Sea
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a60e4e0bbc60f19779cd2e9f04be1a4643fce841.jpg

Celebrate World of Warships' 10th Anniversary with an event packed with rewards!


Battle Performance Bonuses return, giving you the chance to earn Festive Tokens or Steel (for superships).
Festive Tokens can be exchanged for new Japanese Tier X cruiser Kushiro, bonus packages for Tier X ships, Supercontainers, the "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect, and containers from historic collections that unlock unique Commanders.
Log in during Update 14.8 for a guaranteed Tenth Anniversary Gift container, which drops a Tier VI Premium ship.
Updated Honorable Service: Players with 5 years in the game receive a Premium Ship VIII Elite container, and those with 10 years receive a Special Ship X Elite container (minimum 25 battles required).
Exclusive thank-you rewards for Alpha and Beta Testers.


Decade Dock Port & Update Navigator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fe8e55a40aee3d4dc7ab14ecc9fb8e7b03ccbb21.jpg

Jump into the anniversary celebrations!


Explore the interactive Decade Dock Port, offering tons of Easter eggs and a 10-year commemorative journal.
The brand-new Update Navigator feature provides a digest of current update content.
Your Battle Record appears in the Navigator, showing personalized stats like battles played, most-used ships, and combat performance, with a shareable link.
Available until Update 14.11.


The Grand Voyage Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6ec28fc7083813f5a475ee154c208b5e2c9bdfc0.jpg

The multi-update journey goes on!


Earn Voyage Tokens to exchange for Doubloons and Steel.
Continue progressing toward unlocking GQ Johnny for free.
The Grand Voyage runs until January 1, 2026.


Tenth Anniversary Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ef269e09b1bdf8e74e580f4d63b20a24f608aaa3.jpg

Packed with anniversary rewards across two progression lines.


First progression line: Earn the "A Decade at Sea" flag, Blue Explosion enemy destruction effect, Commander Mikhail Orlov, and a Premium Ship VII container.
Second progression line (2,500 Doubloons): Unlocks Commander Doktor von Roth immediately. Rewards include the "Blazing Ray" and "Cold Ray" camouflages, new Italian Tier VII cruiser Optio, and "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect.
Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).


Blast From the Past
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/73063ca79d0e83bfa45f1eda8bcf2b052b58d073.jpg

Relive the history of World of Warships in a special battle type!


Six chapters recreate different eras of the game's development: 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2022, and a final modern-restriction chapter.
Surface ships only: No submarines or carriers.
12v12 Domination and Standard battles with year-based restrictions on maps and ships.


New German Cruisers: Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/77a79fcb7c8689d9f5ba413af9a11ae092e4eeb4.jpg

A brand-new cruiser branch arrives!


Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert join Early Access.
Brawling playstyle with large-caliber, short-range guns and manually controlled secondaries.
Heavy armor and improved Hydroacoustic Search, but low agility.
Permanent camouflages available for Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert.
Sequential bundles unlock in the second week of Update 14.8.


Asymmetric Battles Return
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/42604f81a2f933f320424f85eab562f2d1efd862.jpg

Back and here for longer than ever!


Available from mid-September through Update 15.2 (five months).
Classic format: 5 human players vs. 12 AI-controlled ships, two tiers lower.
Playable on Tier VI–X ships and superships.
Expanded map pool that includes over 25 maps.


"In the Name of Tomorrow" Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/67af33044ccbadb75298a884dd7e0a23ea3bd33e.jpg

Narrative Operations return for two more weeks.


Participate in Arctic Convoy, Tokyo Express, and Pacific Offensive Operations (Tier VII–IX ships).
Earn Stars through tasks to progress the campaign of U.S. Navy officer Robert Adams.
Final reward: Tier VIII San Diego.


Gameplay Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e30f70131f93f3a373873a590f25e86cafbb93b5.jpg

Polished mechanics and new options.


Module Damage Rework: Modules can no longer be permanently destroyed. Instead, they enter a new "Critically Damaged" state before automatically recovering. Reloads now pause instead of resetting.
Submarines are now playable in Operations, with increased mobility, Call Patrol Bomber support, and enabled torpedo shotgunning.
Clan Battles Season 31 "Mahi-Mahi" begins, plus Ranked Battles and three new Brawls across September and October.


The Laffey Dockyard Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg

Build the iconic destroyer!


20 Dockyard phases (18 via missions, 2 with Doubloons). 
Available until the start of Update 14.9.


10th Anniversary Wishing Wharf
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/eddf7bb5b98a5ce52e89e991c99eb571170ee38f.jpg

Try your luck in a limited-time Armory event!


Spend Tries to roll from a large pool of rewards. 
Available throughout the anniversary celebrations.


This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.8 and celebrate a decade of World of Warships! Read the full update article here:

EU NA ASIA

Take the Update 14.8 Survey!

Enjoying the new features? Let us know your thoughts via the survey link below!

Night Battles: In the Name of Tomorrow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03edf68c956198a287544dafa6563aa0e1f90b8c.jpg


A new Operation—Tokyo Express—is now available to play as part of the "In the Name of Tomorrow" narrative event. In this scenario, you must sail into the black of night aboard U.S., Dutch, or Commonwealth Tier VII–VIII ships to eliminate enemy destroyers carrying vital cargo for their ground forces.

[previewyoutube=A_JHA_dcmEg;full][/previewyoutube]

Detectability is significantly reduced due to the night conditions, but illumination from flares and burning ship wreckage will expose the positions of any nearby ships.

Disrupt the enemy supply attempt and earn rewards like Victory Tokens and the Triumphant permanent camouflage for Iowa!

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.7 #1
notes.content:
Update 14.7 Is a Go!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0b2d736fbf9571edaa8136b0250346c1204124e.jpg

The arrival of Update 14.7 promises an August full of new content, fun events, new ships, and improvements. Let's get into it…


The "In the Name of Tomorrow" event, which encompasses historically inspired Operations, a narrative campaign, and a new collection.
Unsinkable USS Laffey, now available for construction at the Dockyard.
10th Anniversary: Grand Voyage—a multi-update celebration bringing Doubloons, Steel, and a free GQ Johnny for our 10th Anniversary and all the way through to the New Year!
Changes to aircraft carriers and general aviation gameplay, including changes to detectability ranges.


EU

In the Name of Tomorrow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4473cd835d7ffee09e657d405f87c86ba973d45.jpg

80 years ago this month, World War II came to an end. We're commemorating it with an update-long event where you can follow a narrative-driven campaign about a U.S. naval officer who experiences the war from its sudden beginning to its hard-won end.

Take part in weekly Operations inspired by chronologically unfolding events of the war, and earn Stars to progress through the story's stages. You can earn up to 70 Victory Tokens—enough to purchase up to seven of the new War Is Over containers, which can drop historical Premium ships like new Barfleur, Arkhangelsk, and Royal Sovereign. 

Completing all the campaign stages will bring you cruiser San Diego herself as the final reward. This historically celebrated vessel was the first Allied ship to enter Tokyo Bay after the end of hostilities. 

More info:
EU

10th Anniversary: Grand Voyage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ca89a16f863a69a0b95b884c194f4815cfebd14c.jpg

[previewyoutube=ZpNL5y6jMkc;full][/previewyoutube]

Update 14.7 marks the beginning of the massive Grand Voyage event in World of Warships! Join us for a multi-update celebration that will allow you to earn destroyer GQ Johnny and up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens that can be exchanged for Doubloons or Steel at a 1:1 rate.

The event starts with three different activities:


Welcome Bonus: Just log in to activate a special series of missions that simply require you to fight one battle per day to earn 350 Voyage Tokens each day. The mission can be completed up to 24 times, and you'll earn a bonus reward of 1,600 Voyage Tokens for doing that! 
Daily Reward: A battle a day will earn you 150 Voyage Tokens, and the more days you play, the more rewards you'll get—up to a total of 22,000 Voyage Tokens just for fighting a single battle daily until the event ends.
Free GQ Johnny: Fight three battles per day to get 1 GQ Johnny Token, and then fight two more battles on that day to get another Token. Fill the event progress bar with 180 GQ Johnny Tokens, and you'll obtain the ship herself!


More info:
EU

Dockyard: Laffey
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg

Update 14.7 lays the keel of a new ship at the Dockyard—you can add U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey to your fleet by building her!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2aa9f3b6d7f8bfda6a02003530c5f11eab4a446a.png

To build your Laffey, you need to progress through 20 Dockyard phases. Of these, 18 can be completed via dedicated combat missions that offer additional valuable rewards, including the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect.

More info:
EU

notes.title: 10th Anniversary Celebration Imminent: Everything You Need to Know!
notes.content:
Captains,

It’s a big year for World of Warships because this September, we're celebrating our 10th Anniversary afloat!

notes.title: Update 14.7 | In the Name of Tomorrow, Laffey Dockyard, and Grand Voyage!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0b2d736fbf9571edaa8136b0250346c1204124e.jpg

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.7. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[previewyoutube=a4WtG-x72dE;full][/previewyoutube]

EU NA ASIA

In the Name of Tomorrow: Special Operations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4473cd835d7ffee09e657d405f87c86ba973d45.jpg

Take part in three cinematic, historically inspired Operations with unique rewards and gameplay!


Each Operation runs for a week, with all returning to rotation after 3 weeks.
Seven-player teams fight waves of bots; no submarines.
Tier and nation restrictions apply; rentals available.
Earn Stars by completing main and secondary objectives.
Unlock a narrative campaign featuring Commander Robert Adams, historical story videos, and themed rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/982ae8357622fe319a2651b695f0bdf3b939d46f.jpg
Grand prize: Tier VIII Premium cruiser San Diego; compensation in Doubloons if already owned.
Complete the campaign to unlock discounted Missouri bundles in the Armory and her Festive permanent camouflage.


80 Years Since Victory: Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03edf68c956198a287544dafa6563aa0e1f90b8c.jpg

Two progression lines with WWII-themed rewards.


First progression line: 2x War Is Over containers, the 80 Years Since Victory flag, and the Stormy Sky permanent camouflage for Nebraska.
Second progression line (2,500 Doubloons): Offers the Traditions of the North permanent camouflage for Skåne, De Grasse with Port slot, the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect, 2x War Is Over Premium containers, and finishes with the Traditions of the North camo for Östergötland.
Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).
Full compensation is provided in Credits if you already own any of the key rewards.


Dockyard: Laffey
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg

Construct U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey—"The Ship That Would Not Die."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2aa9f3b6d7f8bfda6a02003530c5f11eab4a446a.png
20 construction phases; 18 can be completed via missions.
Starter Packs (2 and 6 phases) available for Doubloons early on.
Laffey is a gun-focused destroyer with Burst Fire, strong concealment, a unique Smoke Generator, and an enhanced Specialized Repair Teams consumable.
Includes the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect.
Dockyard ends with the release of Update 14.9.


Grand Voyage: 10th Anniversary Begins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ca89a16f863a69a0b95b884c194f4815cfebd14c.jpg

Celebrate the WoWS 10th Anniversary with our long-term event!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e44834bc6629e186fa955e9d75bcaac1dedc8d7f.jpg
Play daily to earn up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens—exchangeable 1:1 for Doubloons or Steel.
Earn iconic ship GQ Johnny (USS Johnston with battle damage) by fighting daily battles.
Missed days won't ruin progress—complete at your own pace.
Special missions and milestones, including Welcome Bonus and Daily Rewards.
Voyage Token exchange available in the Armory and on the event web page.


Aircraft Carrier & Aviation Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7151f253d0bd019b22079ba5440d6c188e2588a1.jpg

Refinements to detection, fire mechanics, and secondary battery controls.


Fires on ships now increase air detectability by 2 km (was 3 km)
All aircraft now share detectability of 10 km; spotting range increased to 20 km.
Manual control added for carrier secondaries with adjusted stats.
Standardization of air detectability and spotting across ship types.
Fires on carriers burn longer but deal less damage; Damage Control Party cooldown reduced.
HP lost to aircraft and submarine torpedoes can now be restored by the same amount regardless of hit location.


Ongoing Early Access: American Destroyers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f61b94715366724568bba99c191c2f2ce604215.jpg

American Token bundles return with artillery–focused destroyers.


Obtain Hughes, Osborne, Christopher, and Burrows via sequential bundles.
American Tokens are available in Doubloon bundles.
Includes permanent camos: "The Righteous" (Christopher) and "The Wanted" (Burrows).
Unused Tokens will be converted into Credits (1:15,000) in Update 14.8.


Brawls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3baebf40ccad6ac9b3880670c5e341a63145fb20.jpg

Three new Brawls with unique formats!


Brawl #1: 3v3; Tier VII; no destroyers, max 2 cruisers per team.
Brawl #2: 3v3; Tier IX; mixed teams, max 2 of each ship type.
Brawl #3: 2v2; Tier X; max 1 battleship + 1 cruiser per team, no carriers or submarines.


Armory Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg

New additions and major expansion of the content rarity system.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5ee302c4aaa3d106b21ed7875c72ad47b3214f51.jpg
New ship: Amiral Lartigue (31,000 Steel)—French hybrid with accurate guns and skip bombers.
Content rarity system expanded to Armory items, Captain's Logbook, and Container Barge rewards.
Filter by rarity added for easier browsing.


This is just the beginning—dive into Update 14.7 and explore it all! Read the full update article here:

EU NA ASIA

notes.title: Update 14.6 | American Destroyers, Event Pass, and Major Improvements!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/366c1cd1c943d93a9452436287ed2b3bed9dfd64.jpg
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.6. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU NA ASIA

[previewyoutube=5Iu9qQDj-84;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access: American Destroyers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f202711b794b4cc244a205a4168eb0b51e1a1590.png

Welcome a new line of American destroyers with a focus on main battery firepower!


Tier VII Hughes, Tier VIII Osborne, Tier IX Christopher, and Tier X Burrows feature HE and SAP shells.
Starting from Tier VIII, they carry high-DPM 137 mm guns and have larger HP pools.
Minimal torpedo armament, low concealment capacity. These ships favor mid- to long-range engagements.
Unique toggleable Smoke Generator mechanic adds tactical flexibility.
Available via sequential bundles for American Tokens and Doubloons during Early Access.


Event Pass: American & French Flair
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/47da375a601b833620f80bf78f7e75695003a1ed.jpg

Collect new content through this classic two-line Event Pass!


First progression line: 400 American Tokens, 3 days of Premium Account, 2x French Squadron containers, and the "Go Navy!" permanent camouflage for Cleveland.
Second progression line (2,500 Doubloons): West Virginia permanent camouflage (immediate), West Virginia '41 herself, 4x French Squadron containers, 1x Journey to the West Premium container, and the French Navy permanent camouflage for Le Fantasque..
Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).


Personal Challenges Return
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg

Back as part of Early Access for destroyers!


Runs until Update 14.7, in two sprints of two weeks each.
Earn American Tokens through Base XP milestones.


Massive Graphics & Interface Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b59be0c5ae79ef70925fe3a679606e12ccd8860.jpg

Enjoy a smoother, cleaner look!


WG Temporal Super Sampling (TSS) enhances anti-aliasing and image stability.
Container barge now features:
Faster access to container lists from the main screen.
Reward previews with drop chances.
Guaranteed reward counter.
New options for mass opening with safety confirmations.
Barge animations can now be disabled.


Content Rarity System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/75ca9533865fe7076b2a107f08cebd22874b3ac6.jpg

Understand exclusivity at a glance!


Ships, camouflages, and effects now show rarity grades: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary.
Pricing across the game aligns with these categories.
Clarifies effort vs. accessibility, but does not indicate power level.


Ship Rotation System

Streamlining the Armory and Premium Shop.


Popular ships stay available; others rotate on a scheduled basis.
First rotation: Brisbane, Almirante Grau, Nottingham, and Numancia (for Doubloons); Nottingham also for Coal.
San Diego and Leone removed, but San Diego returns in Update 14.7’s event collection; Leone remains in the Italian Destroyers collection.


Final Update: Experimental Ships & Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8961a02e85d40d36971b3188e86d7eb22e315332.jpg

Closing chapters on temporary mechanics.


Operations with Flagships and experimental ships end with Update 14.6.
Classified Documents now upgradeable to Level 11.
Complete experimental ship research now for final rewards in Update 14.7.
Leaderboards are live, so check your standings!


Blue Archive Collaboration: Chapter Two
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19ac4a07d4dd0ca0b921891ccb91fe9db82d75b7.jpg

Class is back in session on the high seas!


Four new Blue Archive ships and exclusive camouflages.
Four new themed commanders with individual voiceovers.
Sail in style with Kivotos-themed flair and charm!


Grand Trial – Public Test Challenge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg

The summer phase continues!


Earn rewards by completing tasks across test phases of Updates 14.6–14.8.
Main reward for Update 14.6: 1x Soviet Era container and 1x Soviet Era Premium container.
Complete all seasonal phases for the ultimate annual prize.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.6 Round 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.6. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Hey, Captains!

With Update 14.5 in full swing, it's now time to cast our eyes forward and take a sneak peek at the fun new features Update 14.6 will be delivering in just a few short weeks!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new additions:

New U.S. destroyers: Ships of the new branch are great gunslingers and have a unique new feature—a Smoke Generator that can be toggled on or off!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e9b9b328109a58063fa135d66a665e0120260605.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f90f4a467e11d3802be6f996f34699552cea2acd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94bee02adb33ad945ee8102099fd32710af9f862.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6633fe4402792831778b19f72f597c910fb5b8c.jpg
Graphical improvements: Enabling the WG Temporal Super Sampling setting in your game client will deliver sharper visuals and smoother edges without significantly impacting performance.
Rarity system: It'll soon be a lot more intuitive to understand just how unique in-game content is thanks to a new system of visual rarity for ships, camos, and beyond. This improvement goes hand-in-hand with a standardized pricing model for direct sales based on this system.
Container Barge improvements: This package of changes aims to improve your experience on the container-opening screen, with the introduction of an animation skip, better container content breakdowns, more flexible options for bulk opening, and an integrated guaranteed drop counter!


If you want the full and detailed breakdown, check out a dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

EU NA ASIA

notes.content:
Update 14.5 Changelog
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/541fd50598417a7f28b0518642e4cdfae54d77a7.jpg

A new update has just been rolled out, Captains! Be sure to take the time to give our changelog publication a once-over to learn all about the new features, ships, battle types, and events that you can interact with in the weeks to come. You'll find it in all its glory via this link:

EU

New Experimental Ships & Oregon Leaderboard Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f829226eb663a579228db76b774dcc91ab326343.jpg

New experimental ships Protector, Hotaka, and Varese have splashed into the game, joining the first round of ships—Metz, Vyazma, and Oregon—introduced earlier this year. The newcomers stand out for their close-range specialty that's complemented by their unique experimental feature: their secondary battery firing range and reload time improve relative to the damage they take.

Compete to Win Destroyer Johnston

A new 1-week Leaderboard event has begun! Climb aboard experimental ship Oregon and try your best to inflict the most damage possible in a single battle. The top 25 players will win U.S. Premium destroyer Johnston, and the next 75 players will receive bundles of Coal.

Everything you need to know about the new experimental ships and Oregon leaderboard is available via this link:
EU

Familiar Battle Types Return!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0dbb5b6909294382e39900c18ec37a3ef1ac5170.jpg

Two familiar temporary battle types have entered the game for Update 14.5—have a go at both this weekend!


Asymmetric Battles: The tried-and-true battle type that pits a smaller team of players against a larger team of lower-tier bots.
Unbreakable Line: A more recent addition to the roster of temporary battle types. The main feature of these player vs. player confrontations is that when you're destroyed, you respawn!


Team League X Tournament Streams
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6b08249eb18924d10922fddece187b87dd4013f0.jpg

It's back—the popular community tournament where World of Warships Twitch streamers create their own teams from pools of players of all skill levels, then pit them against each other!

Tune in for some fun shenanigans by watching any of the 12 participating streamers' channels to get unique views of all the action and take part in giveaways. There's also a dedicated Twitch Drop going on during the tournament, so keep an eye out!

More info and the full list of streamers can be found via this link:
EU NA ASIA

Steam-O-Rama
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ea0a40bc0095e590f3931aa3b5c3deed74b0e30d.jpg

Gear up for 3 weeks of high-profile raffles, featuring rewards such as a bundle with German Steam-chan, Premium ship containers, and lots of other goods! Simply opt in and complete weekly combat missions, and don't miss out on the special Flag-o-Rama event to gain access to the largest raffle of them all!

Join the event via this link:
Participate

World Ocean Day Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/37f383cc74d1800b83e8e578cf08e7decca3b2bf.jpg

We're raising awareness this June for the noble cause of ocean conservation, together with our partners Bunq and Fisher Space Pen, as well as the non-profit organization, FORCE BLUE.

Take part in an in-game Base XP earning contest and multiple raffles for a chance to win Amazon vouchers, high quality pens, and valuable in-game goodies.

Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.5. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU

Summer Festival Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/aaafcf2f1fbdff0959710455955ea3f70d276025.jpg

Dive into summer with our vibrant new Event Pass!


First line rewards: 3 days of Premium Account, the "Boom!" enemy destruction effect, and Commander Marina Carmen Fernández with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover.
Unlock the second line for 2,500 Doubloons to instantly receive the Pin-Up Summer permanent camouflage.
Earn Italian Tier VI Premium cruiser Duca d’Aosta and 150 Summer Tokens to spend in the Armory event.
Extra levels award More Signals containers (first line) and Rare Bonuses containers (second line).


Asymmetric Battles Return
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99db0738249dcbd9e2e9a31d8256dde07b24638c.jpg

Take on a team of bots in this fan-favorite battle mode!


5-player teams face off against 12 bots, with a one-tier difference limit.
Playable with Tier VI–X ships and superships.
Bots are two tiers lower than player ships (excluding submarines).
Form Divisions with up to 5 players. Limited to 1 aircraft carrier, 2 battleships, 2 cruisers, 2 destroyers, and 1 submarine.


Unbreakable Line Returns – Now With Tier X!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e1297f9fe36a4246e6c344ad7cdacf38b05d90c5.jpg

The action-packed respawn mode is back with changes!


7v7 battles with Tier IX–X cruisers, battleships, and destroyers.
12-minute battles on smaller maps with respawns 15 seconds after destruction.
Victory by reaching 1,000 points or finishing the battle in the lead. No points are lost for ships sinking!
Temporary buffs on respawn; consumables do not refresh.
Expanded map pool: Big Race, Hotspot, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Loop, Sleeping Giant, and Greece.


Second Group of Experimental Ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6f5d16f8ee65d83b084298c6989cf1c250e788f.jpg

Three new close-range brawlers enter testing!


Protector – U.S. Tier VIII cruiser
Hotaka – Japanese Tier IX battleship
Varese – Italian Tier X cruiser
Powerful secondaries gain range and firing rate as HP decreases.
Find out how to unlock the newcomers in a dedicated article on our website.


Clan Battles: Man o’ War and Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/de4677f5f5ae1881984af289a106682a6a50db19.jpg

The new Clan Battle season introduces a tactical edge!


Classified Documents grant specific advantages against enemy ships.
Select up to 2 per ship before battle (fewer for overperforming ships).
Aims to improve balance without banning popular ships.


Updated Operations with Flagships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0c4f6056dfddc4ef2a78be44af49e9e87a711bbe.jpg

More power, more upgrades!


Classified Documents can now be upgraded to Level 8.
Earn Intel Tokens from various battle types to level up.
Be more effective against powerful flagship enemies.


Armory Highlights
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg

Big updates and returning favorites!


Battle of Paso de Patria containers now available for Coal—get Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa!
Trade-In event lets you exchange Premium ships for Doubloon discounts.
Get Johnston and her damaged replica, GQ Johnny, via bundles or direct purchase.
Complete the Still Standing collection for Commander Ernest E. Evans and more.


Star Trek Collaboration Returns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e4e95ffeba3913dfa6eb3ef651528460be50058c.jpg

Beam aboard new and returning items!


Earn "To Boldly Go" or Assimilated camouflages, a Star Trek Port, and Premium containers.
Complete missions and browse the Armory and Premium Shop for themed rewards.


Grand Trial – Public Test Challenge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg

Take part in this year-long Public Test event!


Complete seasonal tasks for rewards across four phases.
The Spring Phase (14.3–14.5) offers the Grand Trial flag and patch.
Main reward for Update 14.5: 1x German Squadron container and 1x German Squadron Premium container.
Finish all four phases to earn a Premium Ship VIII Elite container!

notes.content:

Check out this short overview of the planned features for Update 14.5. For more information, visit the link for your region:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! This update is still being tested. The information in this article reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication and is subject to change. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[previewyoutube=iqHUGJ1SmZA;full][/previewyoutube]

Asymmetric Battles

This fan-favorite battle type is returning in Update 14.5! Asymmetric Battles pit 12 lower-tier bots against a 5-player team of higher-tier ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/38c086a8e738187cac0360dcfa942bad7a54a273.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/09c74b6a95a3a1041f2c9fd7fb1bb551e93c4726.jpg

In these battles, five players take on twelve bots, with the following setup:

You can play Tier VI–X ships and superships.
Bot teams consist of ships that are two tiers lower than each tier in the players' team, with exclusion of submarines.


New Experimental Ships

New Experimental Ships Protector, Hotaka, and Varese are entering the game—the second group of these ships, following Metz, Vyazma, and Oregon that dropped anchor in our game earlier this year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/69b79633093b4ec9c2790b47b38049912ec35b26.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/204fd8fb8791cd74de1f7fc841456f568b6f34fa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/961384c41eeeee3315d3d54571da42323899e692.jpg

These newcomers are built for close to medium-range brawls with strong secondary battery performance. As they lose HP, their secondary guns gain an improved rate of fire and range.

Summer Festival Event Pass

In Update 14.5, get ready to dive into the spirit of the season with the Summer Festival Event Pass! Celebrate under the sun with exclusive new rewards that capture all the fun and energy of summer.


In the first progression line, you’ll find rewards such as 3 days of Warships Premium Account, the "Boom!” enemy destruction effect, and Commander Marina Carmen Fernández with an individual voiceover.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8383f9ecd72a791fa6839b1af497c9911cc3b41.png
Unlocking the second progression line brings the Pin-Up Summer permanent camouflage, cruiser Duca d’Aosta, and a total of 150 Summer Tokens that can be used to progress through the dedicated event in the Armory.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c4d5b376cbbc5cc7017727347ad02ddf414743d5.png


And More!

To read more about everything planned for Update 14.5 in World of Warships, check out our dedicated article, where you can learn about the next updates to Operations with Flagships, a new season of Clan Battles, and more:

EU NA ASIA

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bed3071754475d3e553a646fb17ebe56631f62ce.jpg
The fifth annual Longest Night of Museums historical megastream is set to go live this weekend, Captains! Tune in for hours upon hours of live tours made of naval and maritime museums around the world, including special guest appearances, fun activities, and—of course—rewards for viewers!

Take a look at the full schedule via the link:
EU NA ASIA

Travel a Perilous Route!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e826139d2a753f8a3413e15c58854005a8f6f2e6.jpg
A new temporary battle type titled Perilous Route has appeared in our waters! Inspired by the Convoy battles that you may remember from past updates, you'll be tasked with escorting a damaged command ship across the map to its destination. 

But it's not as simple as that—along the way, the command ship will make stops for repairs, during which time, you and your team will be tasked with completing any one of several randomly-chosen sub-objectives. Once the command ship is fully operational, you'll face off against the bot team in a final standoff!

For more details, check out our dedicated article:
EU NA ASIA

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/02f4ec04e544818fd23be680b17f99c9f6cbaabd.jpg
Update 14.4's Event Pass is themed around Operation Dynamo—commonly known as the Dunkirk evacuation.


The first progression line offers rewards such as 5x Operation Dynamo containers, the Monochrome enemy destruction effect, the British Coastal permanent camouflage, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, and the Industrial permanent camouflage for Duncan (the final reward).
The second progression line, which you can unlock with Doubloons, grants the Industrial permanent camouflage for Hawke, British cruiser London, and 3x Operation Dynamo Premium containers, among other rewards. The final reward of the line is the Industrial permanent camouflage for St. Vincent.

Check out our dedicated article and click the link to choose which one you want to enlist!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bc10d7bd5f14ae8ec7226ec2647e70a45022f0cf.jpg

This time, the prettiest fleet on the high seas is joined by four ships—AL Hindenburg, AL Kearsarge, AL Bismarck, and AL Gorizia—each with her own commemorative flag. Four new themed permanent camouflages for Zara, Colorado, Scharnhorst, and Admiral Graf Spee, as well as the Azur Lane patch, have also been added!

Take a look at what's on offer here:

notes.title: Update 14.4 | Perilous Route, Operation Dynamo & More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c340b43975e6d74b8a71842d76947b8d4bcd104c.jpg
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.4. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU

[previewyoutube=U5p26gxmdQA;full][/previewyoutube]

Perilous Route – A New Temporary Battle Type
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e826139d2a753f8a3413e15c58854005a8f6f2e6.jpg

In this thrilling new battle type, your mission is to escort a damaged Command Ship along a perilous path while defending it from AI attackers. As the Command Ship is repaired, prepare for an epic final showdown!


Battle type supports 7 players per team in Tier VIII–IX ships.
All ship types except submarines are allowed.
Each match features two mandatory tasks of scouting, capturing, or engaging enemies. Plus randomized secondary objectives.
Activate the new “Coordinated Fleet Support” consumable to restore allied HP, with stacking effects if used by multiple players. 
Join solo or as a Division of up to 7 players.


Operations with Flagships – More Dangerous Than Ever
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bd4a10666b18a80697cd5cf256061a09bbcac39b.jpg

Flagships are tougher than ever, and each ship type now boasts special powers! For example, battleship flagships summon waves of torpedo boats when spotted.


New strategic layer: act fast before reinforcements arrive or return!
Classified Documents can now be upgraded using Tokens earned via Combat Missions.
Expect a separate article detailing all upgrades and strategies.


Operation Dynamo Event Pass – Commemorate Dunkirk
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/02f4ec04e544818fd23be680b17f99c9f6cbaabd.jpg

Two rewarding progression lines honor the legendary evacuation:


First line rewards: 5 Operation Dynamo containers, British Coastal camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, the Monochrome destruction effect, and an Industrial camouflage for Tier IX battleship Duncan.
Extra levels award More Signals containers.
Unlock the second line for 2,500 Doubloons and receive: Industrial camo for Tier VIII Hawke, Tier VI Premium cruiser London, 3 Operation Dynamo Premium containers, and the final prize the Industrial camouflage for Tier X St. Vincent.
Advance via combat missions or pay 750 Doubloons per level. Extra levels give Rare Bonuses containers.


Dunkirk 1940 – Strategic Port Activity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7ca43ebd52d785958bd9c71bb1c744702280e63b.jpg

Play through a tactical card-based event inspired by Operation Dynamo and earn epic rewards!


Use ship cards to overcome enemy cards in strategic battles.
Advance through multiple missions of increasing difficulty.
Earn Credits, Dynamo containers, and ultimately the Tier VI Royal Navy destroyer Gallant.
30 ship cards total, with the first 4 unlocked at the start and more available via mission completion.
Apply card effects, buffs, and modifiers to outplay your opponents!


Azur Lane – Wave 7 Has Arrived!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bc10d7bd5f14ae8ec7226ec2647e70a45022f0cf.jpg

4 dazzling new shipgirls and 5 unique Commanders take the seas by storm:


Exclusive voiceovers, themed camouflages, flags, and a patch.
Available in the Armory and Premium Shop.


Warhammer 40,000 – The Warp Opens Once Again
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6ff89b77fc06f7c8b5c9a29b92fe77381c635e8.jpg

Fan favorites return with epic flair:


Ships: Cross of Dorn, Ship Smasha, Ragnarok, and Ignis Purgatio.
Commanders: Augustin Riegerwald, Grotmaz Smart, Arthas Roqthar the Cold, and Justinian Lyons XIII.
Bundles include themed camouflages, flags, and patches.


This is just the tip of the iceberg! Dive into Update 14.4 and explore everything it has to offer. Read the full update article here:

EU

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.4 Round 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.4. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Perilous Route: A New PvE Experience 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/406bc2ba2faea46b99e71c5dee961b2fb999f1bf.jpg

A new temporary battle type hits the Live Servers in Update 14.4! Inspired by the Convoy battle type from past updates, Perilous Route sees you and your team escort a damaged command ship across the map as it slowly repairs itself.

Along the way, the command ship will make two stops, where your team will receive randomized objectives to complete before continuing the journey.

Stay alert—along the way, you'll encounter hostile bot ships eager to hamper your progress! To aid in your fight against them, you'll have access to the Coordinated Fleet Support consumable, which restores a portion of all allied ships' HP when activated.

Dunkirk 1940: A Strategic Card Game Steeped in History
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d7e96ca8084d03f255dd0dd209542be046dce74c.jpg

As we near the anniversary of one of the most remarkable events of World War II—Operation Dynamo—we invite you to step into the shoes of a fleet commander, managing not just a single ship but an entire fleet of warships and civilian vessels in a new card game that will be available to play in World of Warships.

Advance through the event by completing key missions and fulfilling the operation's objectives. Each mission can be thought of as a puzzle that you need to solve using the available cards. Each card represents a ship under your command, while enemy cards represent different obstacles like aircraft or coastal artillery.

The activity offers rewards like Credits, Operation Dynamo containers, and British Premium destroyer Gallant (the final reward).

And More!

Take a moment to read more about what we have planned for Update 14.4 in our dedicated article. It has all the details on coming changes to Operations with Flagships, details on the Operation Dynamo Event Pass, and more:

EU NA ASIA

notes.title: Update 14.3 | Dockyard, Unbreakable Line. & More!
notes.content:
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.3. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU 

[previewyoutube=hsEhjpWMdQs;full][/previewyoutube]

Blücher Dockyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03892ff00170416d370c4351331ae40b695ee230.jpg

Build mighty German Tier IX cruiser Blücher! Complete 20 Dockyard phases, 18 of which you can finish via combat missions, and earn powerful Commonwealth Tier VII cruiser Gambia along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/402045c3e77aad62eb235d82cd2764e193615c1a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b274d331e1ccf582e6ac2290e194c4c2884bdc7c.jpg


Blücher boasts fearsome guns with improved dispersion, enhanced AP shell performance, and devastating HE shells.
Gambia, Fiji’s sister ship, features AP and HE shells plus Short Burst Smoke Generator to evade enemies and strike back.
Two Starter Pack options are available to accelerate progress.
The Dockyard will stay open throughout Update 14.4 but close its doors with the release of Update 14.5.


[previewyoutube=rVeMY3t-uT8;full][/previewyoutube]

Two Event Passes: Operation Ten-Go & Golden Month
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/534806e7f48e33d66159bb46f57c4244f5800d22.jpg

For the first time since Wonders of the Arctic, we’re bringing two consecutive Event Passes! You can earn up to 1,170 Points via daily and weekly missions, and it takes 450 Points to complete one Pass, 900 to complete both. Any remaining Points will go to finishing extra levels!

Operation Ten-Go

Celebrate the 80th anniversary of this historic battle!


First line rewards: Splinters permanent camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, and the stunning Final Voyage camouflage for Yamato.
Unlock the second line for 2,000 Doubloons to receive new historical Commander Seiichi Itō with enhanced skills and an individual voiceover.
Claim Tier V Premium cruiser Yahagi and the historic Defender of the Pacific Ocean camouflage for Essex as ultimate rewards.


Golden Month

Inspired by Japan’s Golden Week holidays, this pass offers vibrant rewards:


First line rewards: Splinters permanent camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, and the stunning Final Voyage camouflage for Yamato.
Final reward: The breathtaking Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō.
Unlock the second line for 2,000 Doubloons to instantly receive the Golden Week permanent camouflage for Mogami.
Earn the Silver Ray enemy destruction effect and British Tier V Premium battleship Agincourt as the final reward.


Unbreakable Line – A New Battle Type!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/775d5fa8d4f3223f70560ff29bda90e3ef82ebe2.jpg

Love intense action? In this new 7v7 clash, ships respawn after destruction, keeping the fight going!


15-minute battles featuring Tier VIII–IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers.
Domination-style capture points—reach 1,000 points or sink enough enemies to win!
Ships respawn with fully reloaded armaments (excluding torpedoes) but retained cooldowns on consumables.
Temporary buffs to speed, maneuverability, and concealment will help you quickly rejoin the fight.


Efficiency Badges—Show Off Your Skills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a036c54d88e16cd07c6dcac92d7a3ea329a38a29.jpg

Earn Efficiency Badges to prove your battle prowess!


Available for all Tier V and above ships in Random Battles.
Badges are awarded based on Base XP performance compared to global averages.
Four Badge tiers: Expert (Top 1%), 1st Grade (Top 5%), 2nd Grade (Top 20%), 3rd Grade (Top 50%).
Earned Badges cannot be lost!
View Badges on player profiles and the post-battle statistics screen.


Transformers Return!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a51f16284ddf12bbb9ee33be2db17395d3b4eb07.jpg

Autobots and Decepticons roll out once again! Expect themed camouflages, Commanders, containers, and more as part of this exciting World of Warships x Transformers collaboration! 

This is just the tip of the iceberg! Dive into Update 14.3 and explore everything it has to offer. Read the full update article here:

EU

7v7
Tier VIII and IX; battleships, cruisers, and destroyers
Maximum battle duration: 15 minutes
Battles take place on maps of reduced size


Blücher at the Dockyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d2c679389bf20236f4b4292fd9d6b79d97980e0.jpg

Historical German cruiser Blücher will soon be available to construct at the Dockyard! The ship stands out for her deadly accuracy and strong AP shell performance, which together help her tear through enemy broadsides like a can opener.

The ship's construction consists of 20 Dockyard phases; 18 of these will be completable through in-game combat missions. Individual phases can be purchased for Doubloons, and as usual, there are two starter pack options to get a head start.

At Phase 8, you'll pick up Commonwealth cruiser Gambia as an intermediate reward. Unlike her sister ship Fiji, Gambia has access to HE shells and Short-Burst Smoke Generator, making her a brutal combatant against enemy battleships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cb1d22eb0ce8ed1366652c95fa23eb9f27de63b1.jpg

Efficiency Badges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17128fcc2a59fd3af73a25f6bbad11bf40b45acd.jpg

With Update 14.3, you'll be able to earn Efficiency Badges as a mark of personal pride for your performance aboard individual ships. After each Random Battle you finish, the Base XP you earned is tracked and compared against the recent average performance of other players globally aboard the same ship that you just played. Depending on how well you performed in comparison to your fellow players, you can receive an Efficiency Badge with one of four ranks.

You can view the Efficiency Badges for each of your ships in your profile summary, as well as on the post-battle statistics screen for the ship you sailed into battle. Only the highest-ranked badge for each of your ships will be displayed, meaning that if you upgrade a badge, it will replace the old one.

For more information about these and more features, check out our dedicated article:

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.2 #1
notes.content:
Read the Update 14.2 Changelog
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f34a81976c74400ce5eb30170e033872972a0fa2.jpg

This week saw the launch of a game update so packed with content that you'll be spoiled for choice on how to spend your time on the waves this weekend and the coming ones!

From new experimental ships to a new branch of Soviet submarines in Early Access, plus the return of Operations with Flagships and a pirate-themed Bounty Hunt, Update 14.2 truly has something for everyone.

Get a comprehensive breakdown of all the new features and changes in our dedicated article:
EU 

Experiment With New Experimental Ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a2f0a022212304637214881c09af2ca639a04ab.jpg

From now until August 2025, you'll have free rein to play around with some quirky new ships subject to quirky new mechanics. For now, in Update 14.2, you can unlock and play cruisers Metz, Oregon, and Vyazma.

These three ships have access to what we're calling "Fight or Flight"—a mechanic where your ship becomes stronger the more damage it takes. The trio also has access to a limited stockpile of AP shells with improved characteristics that can be fired using Burst Fire mode.

You can unlock experimental ships by researching their components in exchange for a combination of Credits and Action Reports, the latter of which are obtainable via special combat missions.

For more information about experimental ships, see our dedicated article:
EU 

Dive Back Into Operations with Flagships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a4802c0204dd8b84e967d1d08433363cbd8805a8.jpg

Back by popular demand, Operations with Flagships have received a few tweaks in Update 14.2 to make them that much more engaging.

Now, three enemy bot flagships of two different types with different effects and vulnerabilities await you on the battlefield. The flagships will be randomly selected, and you'll see which ones you'll be up against at the start of the battle.

You can now also equip one Classified Document per battle to customize your ship's capabilities against certain ship types, working both against ordinary bots and the flagships themselves. This special mechanic will make your ship more effective in encounters with specific enemies.

All details about the tweaks to this battle type can be found via this link:
EU

Discover a New Branch of Soviet Submarines in Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/25fc410079f68b8f608ffdc298b5b128c1e7fb88.jpg

Three new submarines—S-1, L-20, and K-1—make up the latest branch of the Soviet Tech Tree, which is now available to play in Early Access.

These subs make use of capable unguided torpedoes to deal the bulk of their damage.
They enjoy good surface speed but lack the agility and dive capacity for frequent underwater escapades.
The trio can be of great help to their allies, as they have access to the Submarine Surveillance consumable with a long range.

All three submarines are available in sequential bundles in the Armory, purchasable for Soviet Tokens. You can obtain the Tokens by completing combat missions or purchasing random bundles. 

[previewyoutube=bBPAx7sG6mQ;full][/previewyoutube]

All relevant details are available in a dedicated article:
EU 

Paint and Submit a Design for Our Camouflage Contest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7b67dcd3d424aff8ccb20b6facc2d0de0dfef453.png

We've just announced a new community camouflage design contest for battleship Montana on the occasion of the 250th anniversary of the U.S. Navy. If you're feeling creative, don't hesitate to submit your work—we would love to include it in the game!

Learn how to take part here:
EU

notes.title: Update 14.2 | New Mechanics, Experimental Ships, and Soviet Submarines!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sfVW6wPJvq0;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.2. Be sure to check out the detailed article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

Experimental Ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8637aac21c2f5c2aae641bf464491730bf4e72ff.jpg

Three new ships with unique mechanics are sailing out on our seas! Designed for bold Captains, these vessels bring high-risk, high-reward gameplay:


These experimental ships start each battle with reduced HP but can heal over time. Where it gets very interesting is that their main battery accuracy and rate of fire improve as their HP decreases. Will you choose the security of HP or the risky but satisfying firepower route?
Armed with a limited stock of AP shells with improved characteristics and Burst Fire mode.
They have no module upgrades, their economic earnings are similar to same-tier Tech Tree ships, and Commanders assigned to experimental ships do not require retraining.


You can unlock experimental ships by researching components with Credits and Action Reports from combat missions, and get a special mission chain that offers Coal as a reward.

These ships will be removed with Update 14.7, and commemorative rewards will be bestowed on players who successfully unlock all three.

Operations with Flagships & Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6bc02d11d8bf491aa338e2fab05395d2aa63cb43.jpg

Operations with Flagships return with reworked mechanics, introducing varied flagship encounters and greater strategic diversity.

New mechanics have been integrated to enhance combat effectiveness in specific scenarios:


Equip one Classified Document in Operations with Flagships for survivability and damage boosts.
All Classified Documents have been added to player accounts automatically and can be selected before each battle, with a limited time for changes.


Soviet Submarines & Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b0ef47b6e230dc0aa8e4c254517644a898d624b.jpg

Comrades, the Red Fleet is growing mightier! The arrival of submarines S-1, L-20, and K-1 introduces a new Soviet playstyle:


Powerful, fast, and long-range unguided torpedoes, plus homing torpedoes with low damage, speed, and range.
Fast surface speed but limited dive capacity. They are also equipped with long-range Submarine Surveillance and Fast Damage Control Team.


Celebrate the Soviet expansion with the Soviet Navy Event Pass!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fb627d56136b4cc04a6a5b895eee0f9d9b645e8c.jpg


The first progression line features 5x Soviet Era containers, Commander Aleksey Statsenko, and a Soviet permanent camouflage for Tallinn.
Unlock the second progression line for 2,500 Doubloons to earn additional rewards, including Soviet permanent camouflages for Riga and Petropavlovsk, 10x Soviet Era containers, and cruiser Molotov. Captains who already own these items will be compensated in Credits.


Pirate-Themed Bounty Hunt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a1b1212c2b0875b556472dfdd67d1120d1ad291.jpg

Hoist the black flag and engage in thrilling Random Battles:


Play as a Hunter (Tier V–X ships) or Bounty (Tier VI–X battleships, cruisers, and destroyers) to earn Bounty Tokens for themed Commanders and permanent camouflages.
The Bounty status is available for free in the Armory and lasts 24 hours or until the main mission (sink 5 enemy ships) is completed.
Random bundles hold new ship Monmouth, with direct purchase options available until the release of Update 14.3.


That's just a glimpse of what's new in this fresh update! Read our full article linked below to learn more.

EU NA ASIA

Captains!

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Strategy" and "Co-Operative" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

How to Take Part

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your  web browser or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "Strategy" and "Co-Operative" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. If you don't see these tags on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, 24 hours of Warships Premium Account* will be applied to your account.

World of Warships Account System Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d63e6d0e772067a16be672ef3e68ef5cd7bb6a9d.jpg

Last year, we announced changes to how the account system worked. These were aimed at helping players manage their accounts while providing greater flexibility for future technical improvements by our developers.

In case you missed it, that first update enabled players with multiple accounts across different regions to use a single set of credentials to log in, play, and manage all of their linked Wargaming accounts.

These changes only affect account management, and don't provide any regional crossplay functionality or affect your accounts' in-game progress.

Players affected by these changes first began receiving notices in late October 2024, prompting them to resolve detected account conflicts, as our system had identified other owned accounts with overlapping credentials.

As outlined in our initial article, these prompts were not mandatory initially, but they will become so later, when the next system update is deployed in the first half of February 2025. We took this approach to give affected players time to be notified, then identify and resolve any conflicts with their accounts.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.1 Round 2.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6aa57ee0b76275e624e0f94820e310f8afc4362.jpg

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.1. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU 

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

“Remembrance of Ming's Past” Adventure

The Seven Voyages of Zheng He are famous across China. Sent by the Ming dynasty to improve relations with foreign powers and bolster trade, Zheng He commanded huge fleets loaded with expensive gifts and trade goods to such far places as Hormuz in the Persian Gulf and Mogadishu in Africa. We are honoring this famous explorer in a new adventure that will run through Updates 14.1 and 14.2 and will provide many opportunities to earn your own World of Warships riches along the way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/15ae6951bde38a9509c4e8c636605ac6add6abe1.jpg

During this adventure, completing missions will earn you the new "The Ming Legacy" flag and Zheng He's Voyages patch, as well as some Adventure Tokens that you can spend on various containers in the Armory. Alternatively, you can exchange them for Ming's Voyage Tokens that you can use to obtain thematic rewards: new IX Taihang
, the Chinese Treasure Ship permanent camouflage for her, and Commander Zheng He himself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a442e238f1e0c580480532411a82a388f27bc1f.jpg

"The Finest Hour" Collection and a New Unique Dutch Commander

Conrad Helfrich was a lieutenant admiral of the Royal Netherlands Navy and overall commander of the Dutch naval forces in Southeast Asia during World War II. In the first stages of the Pacific War, he was one of the most successful Allied commanders in that theater. We honor this military juggernaut with a special collection dedicated to his memory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d79fe6a5c993339fc5c8aebd86867853686f3bbd.jpg

You can get collection elements from the "The Finest Hour" standard containers, which you can obtain in exchange for Adventure Tokens earned from adventure missions. It’s possible to earn enough Adventure Tokens to complete the collection in its entirety.

Note that you must make a choice to either get the unique Dutch Commander for Adventure Tokens or save them and spend on IX Taihang
after the Adventure ends. Tokens obtainable from missions and bundles for resources in the Armory can’t cover both rewards.

notes.title: Update 14.0: Dutch Cruisers
notes.content:
You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website: 

EU NA ASIA

[previewyoutube=5hBdPFluC2g;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access to Dutch Cruisers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/490e7cece3ca4faa2579dfe1b7d682a46e2f336a.jpg

Early Access to a new line of Dutch light cruisers begins with the start of Update 14.0.
Branch highlights

This line features 128 mm main battery guns with good range and ballistics.
For this caliber, their AP shells can deal good damage, while their HE shells have good penetration capabilities but leave much to be desired in terms of damage and fire-starting chances.
The ships are also armed with a signature Dutch Airstrike with a fast cooldown, long range, and the ability to reach the target relatively quickly. On the flip side, the squadron size is only small.
The line boasts good concealment and strong AA defenses, and the ships also come equipped with Engine Boost and a Repair Party with a short cooldown.
As for their weaknesses, ships of the line have small HP pools and weak armor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/109b5f888178138c9b8a0a33a6d6aeef03868d1c.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d3278e610a2efc54496b38ae43fb201a0daf86fc.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6036535977907ecb8fc8340621a3bdfb251f6c7a.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f459a5bea762d8bf16b14d04c1e52a3bdafbfa4.jpg

Dutch Cruisers Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1fa4f38386fa874e9eb080ba47e25a4e88c3b777.jpg

To celebrate the arrival of these three beauties in our virtual seas, we've prepared a Dutch-themed Event Pass for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ac8e69c1a7bc9bbb027bc1ca07855c4ff810dc20.jpg
The first progression line offers rewards like the Flying Dutchman permanent camouflage, Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for 
VII Eendracht, VIII Haarlem, and newcomer cruiser VIII Jaarsveld as the final reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1390405db95395f0718db3cdd26a1e8a7d984f99.jpg
Unlocking the second progression line for 2,500 Doubloons will allow you to claim even more themed items. You’ll immediately receive the Lion's Heart permanent camouflage for 
VIII Jaarsveld, and progressing down the line will bring you Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for IX Johan de Witt and X Gouden Leeuw.

Operations with Flagships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a1b586a4b769f94a38c9dfe4c974cd738d264a30.jpg

Throughout Update 14.0, you can participate in Operations with flagships, available as a separate battle type. There are three types of flagships—Incendiary Specialist, Torpedo Master, and Iron Fist—all boasting increased HP and provide bots in the nearby area with particular effects.
Taking down these formidable flagships will require you to take advantage of the knowledge that each of them is particularly vulnerable to a certain type of damage. Make sure to choose which ship to deploy in each battle carefully, based on the enemy's weaknesses. When making your choices, keep in mind that you'll only face flagships of a specific type per week for the first 3 weeks. Your most versatile ships will be best suited for the battles of the fourth week, as you'll face all three types of flagships!

And Much, Much More!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/51522235f0406d37c62ca7b5d08fc3c0466e4ff2.jpg

This is not even close to all of the new features added in this update. Read our full update article via the link below to learn about:

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.0 Round 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6aa57ee0b76275e624e0f94820e310f8afc4362.jpg

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.0. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Operations With Flagships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/28a585b7fdea98aae1a2b8c8fa8973ab40245ff0.jpg

After a great year for Operations, get ready for a 2025 with even more exciting additions to the battle type!

Throughout Update 14.0, you can experience special versions of six Operations, now for high-tier ships. They feature new enemies known as "Flagships", with increased hit points and the ability to influence nearby allies. You'll find these formidable units difficult to take down unless you identify and focus on their specific vulnerabilities.

Three Flagships, each with distinct mechanics, will individually set sail on the virtual seas, one per week, during the first 3 weeks of the update. In the fourth week, things will really heat up when you face all three!

New Dutch Cruisers in the Tech Tree

Update 14.0 ushers a new branch of ships into Early Access! Welcome Dutch light cruisers Jaarsveld (Tier VIII), Menno van Coehoorn (Tier IX), and Utrecht  (Tier X).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/53e2e568d1809fa8584540a5af4e7b351354eb9f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cd81b135e4cc8303e8e3d8d08a6201e895ab9a2e.jpg

Features:

Numerous low-caliber main battery guns with good range and ballistics
Improved HE shell penetration and great AP shell damage
Access to small Airstrike squadrons with long range, fast cooldown, and relatively fast bomb arrival time
Access to Engine Boost and a fast-cooling Repair Party
Weak armor and a small hit point pool 


Adventure of Bjorn Stormbreaker

A new adventure awaits you with the release of Update 14.0. Travel with famed adventurer Bjorn Stormbreaker as he battles six powerful fantastical sea creatures!

Stay tuned for more information about how you can earn Bjorn as a Commander, as well as our new Forsaken Chest containers.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg

Captains!

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Simulation" and "Massively Multiplayer" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

How to Take Part

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your  web browser or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "Simulation" and "Massively Multiplayer" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. If you don't see these tags on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, 24 hours of Warships Premium Account* will be applied to your account. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0cad5a84859b10b161c71d928028e74cfa2c7e2e.gif
