notes.title: Update 13.11 | Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d24f978565fa7c2c8dd9e6dd3ee0ce968f928ec7.jpg
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.11. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

Claim Your Free Ship: Expedition to the North Pole
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4cbef8cfa309186cfee851c654c8256683abedf2.jpg

Destination reached, Captain! With the arrival of December comes the end of the Expedition to the North Pole event. The next step is claiming your gift! 

If you've actively participated in the Expedition this autumn, you can receive a Tier X Tech Tree ship along with some extra rewards; and if you're only just hearing about it now and haven't earned any Expedition Tokens at all, you can still claim a Tier VIII Tech Tree ship—guaranteed!

To claim it, just log in to the game from December 1. If you choose a ship that you already have in your Port, you'll receive Free XP as compensation instead.

Wonders of the Arctic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bdf377c7066b45021f140680ec27479f56fe1c48.jpg

We’ve prepared a special celebration as another year comes to a close, so you can be sure that Update 13.11 will bring lots of gifts and activities.


Nordlyshavn Port: a magical new Port will light your way through the new update. Keep an eye out for interactive elements, including a Christmas Tree that you can decorate by completing a set number of battles each day. Hang enough ornaments, and you'll even earn a Santa's Gift container!
Advent Calendar: From December 1 through 25, you can open one of the Calendar’s cards each day and claim the gift it hides. 
Festive Rewards: A holiday tradition in World of Warships, you can now once again collect rewards for earning Base XP on your Tier V and higher ships. The rewards include Festive Certificates, which you can exchange for both types of Santa's Gifts containers in the Armory!
Update to Santa's containers: Only two types of containers are available this year—Santa’s Gift and Santa’s Mega Gift. We’ve removed 23 older ships from the drop list and added 18 new ones. They can also drop a special new Golden Gift container, which holds ships Chikuma II, Prins van Oranje, and Georg Hoffmann, as well as their golden versions!
Niord and Kalmar Dockyard: The construction of European battleship Niord has commenced at the Hamburg Dockyard! This year, you can also unlock new European destroyer Kalmar as an intermediate reward at the 8th shipbuilding phase of the Dockyard!


Event Pass: East and West
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/55852736bb5109723645738e76601481dbf1d451.jpg

Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters dedicated to our two explorers, Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren. Each chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels, and functions as a standalone Event Pass.


Chapter 1: In the first progression line, you'll find Commander Li Wei with a unique voiceover, along with the Butterfly Kaleidoscope enemy destruction effect, the Avid Explorer patch, and some Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Adventure's Call flag, the Eastbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and Pan-Asian Tier VII battleship Teng She with a festive permanent camouflage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65487271619233b611ebac360f8aa7afb32b5053.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e125092c7d2baca1819270369436d1e5bd444b8f.jpg
Chapter 2: The first progression line will reward you with the Polar Pursuit patch, Commander Olaf Lundgren with an individual voiceover, the Avalanche enemy destruction effect, and Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Echoes of the Past flag, the Westbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and European Tier VII battleship Lugdunum with an icy permanent camouflage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d15b456553c5605f94f49b86eb2cbb523a6e5711.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94482bd0a9d44a8a3dc0a2287f9130c8871343e8.jpg



STAR TREK: Final Operation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e472c1e7f95ab3343eb2e9534e6020b7d5492d26.jpg

The final of the three STAR TREK Operations is unfolding during the first two weeks of Update 13.11. 

The invasion is intensifying and the Vulcans are in imminent danger—only through the combined efforts of Starfleet's finest can we ensure their survival. Ready your ships by raising shields and going to red alert, and rally your crews to join the fight and protect Vulcan from assimilation!

If her drone minions fail, the Borg Queen herself will join the battle to crush the united forces of the Federation, Klingons, Romulans, and Vulcans. Will you emerge victorious in the face of her wrath?

And Much, Much More!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/30c4d268034f7405a72659f455799b6af0c58bc2.jpg

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.11 Round 3
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.11. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Wonders of the Arctic

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/e2c0a9f1177b397881e83c01a5dd1f5cdf5a300a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/fe3aba1ac3ec10454a6f269989f8dcc1047a8856.jpg

13.11 is our New Year update, so we've naturally prepared a festive atmosphere for you to enjoy both in your Port and on the battlefield.


You'll visit the new Port of Nordlyshavn, where you can decorate your very own Christmas Tree with ornaments that can be unlocked by completing missions.
A special Advent Calendar will replace the standard daily rewards from December 1 through 25.
You can earn Festive Rewards for all the Tier V+ ships in your Port!
Unwrap Santa's Gift containers, streamlined to two types—Santa's Gift and Santa's Mega Gift—both stuffed with a new rotation of ships!
Light your enemies up like a Christmas Tree with three new holiday-themed enemy destruction effects.


Removal of Magazine Detonation

Based on player feedback, we've decided to change our stance on the magazine detonation mechanic and are going to remove it from the game entirely starting with Update 13.11

This change goes hand-in-hand with another series of changes, including the removal of the Juliet Charlie signal, which will be replaced with the new Charlie Kilo signal, increasing ship HP and squadron HP by +5% and +2.5%, respectively. The Magazine Modification 1 upgrade will be removed entirely, and all of its owners will automatically receive full compensation in Credits.

Event Pass

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/b66b3c58dbff74de76ffc1ebfd692921ca1fa06b.jpg

Our heroes Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren are nearing the end of their expedition to the North Pole! Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters, each dedicated to an explorer you’ve already met in a previous update.

Advancing through the Event Pass levels will bring you Commanders Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren, plus various awesome rewards like ships!

Each Event Pass chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels and functions as a standalone Pass. This means that once the first chapter ends, you won’t be able to complete it retroactively!

Star Trek Operation—Queen's Rage

The final chapter of our STAR TREK Operations unfolds in Update 13.11. At the beginning of the Operation, you must defend three control points at risk of falling to the Borg. You’ll face three enemy waves, each led by a powerful minion.

If you successfully defeat all the Borg Queen's minions, she'll have no choice but to join the fight herself…

The third phase of the Star Trek Operation reward track offers Steel, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, special and rare economic bonuses, signals, Star Tokens, and collection items.

Dockyard: Niord

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/c89af567bd662a85c1412ae40394510b9165266e.jpg

Construction of European Tier IX battleship Niord is commencing at the Hamburg Dockyard. The ship features eight accurate 380 mm main battery guns with a fast reload. She also boasts 20 torpedo tubes with a tight spread, fast speed, and long range.

One of the intermediate rewards is European Tier V destroyer Kalmar, which can be found at the 8th shipbuilding phase.

The Dockyard construction process consists of 20 phases, 18 of which you can advance through via combat missions, while the rest can be purchased for Doubloons. Each shipbuilding phase costs 3,000 Doubloons. Starter packs of two and six phases can be purchased for 5,000 and 12,600 Doubloons, respectively. 

Asymmetric Battles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1c29a1317b724297d090ffd56bc1edb663e12453.jpg

The beloved battle type where you fight as a team of five against superior bot-controlled forces has returned!


You can play Tier VI–X ships and superships
Five ships to a team on the player side
Maximum difference of one tier between the ships
You can play any ship type


Clan Patrols

Update 13.11 also delivers a temporary new activity—Clan Patrols—available for all Clan members. Inside the special Patrol window under the Clan tab, you can choose a battle type for Patrols and receive extra rewards just by playing it!

notes.title: Tag Barrage: Earn Free Premium Account in Just a Few Seconds!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg

Captains!

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Simulation" and "Massively Multiplayer" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

How to Take Part

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your  web browser or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "Simulation" and "Massively Multiplayer" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. If you don't see these tags on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, 24 hours of Warships Premium Account* will be applied to your account. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0cad5a84859b10b161c71d928028e74cfa2c7e2e.gif

*Please note that this reward can only be granted once per month, per player.

Stay tuned for more activities and good luck in battle, Captains!

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.10
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.10. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

STAR TREK Operations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a303b0dbeaf3be74514e86791d1b15c05256218b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5a459e3bf720b927b8e22e0dd164fab0cb84a522.jpg

In the second wave of our collaboration with STAR TREK, you can dive into three exciting Operations, each lasting 2 weeks, spanning Updates 13.10 and 13.11.

The Operations unfold on the planet Vulcan during an attack from the Borg Collective. You must take control of ships representing the Federation,  the Federation, Vulcan, Klingon Empire, and Romulan Star Empire factions.

In the new STAR TREK Port, you can follow your reward track progress, upgrade your ships, and explore a themed collection. Iconic STAR TREK memorabilia will grace your Captain's quarters, and collecting its elements will provide battle bonuses for the event's Operations.

New weapons and shield mechanics are available, with phasers, pulse phasers, and photon torpedoes. The event introduces a unique system for upgrading your ships, with the use of unlockable modules affecting primary weapons, secondary weapons, hulls, and shields. Combining the different modules in various ways will change the configuration of ship stats, armaments, and consumables; or even unlock Combat Instructions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ac8a6d1a0ab3b6b8d4b2aabd0908e8bf686693b3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9c0b6a745713a0ef4701a492264d53e5e45e325.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1911aa6e459553377401f07da27b1d43af9f4113.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c3184f2b267f749ee72f49ce5e21890ff17154c7.jpg

Black Friday Event Pass

It's getting to that time of the year! This year, we've got even more ships, containers, Coal, Steel, and a new custom enemy destruction effect—Monochrome!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cbc13e3f7be2d6af45b743e518841349c8e8948b.jpg


The first progression line brings Black Friday 2024 Premium and standard containers, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, economic rewards, and a new enemy destruction effect.
The second progression line brings French battleship Dunkerque B, French Commander Jeremie Noel with 10 skill points, even more Black Friday 2024 Premium and standard containers, and other valuable rewards.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/deb0e1190480fae978e9541d3ad305cf948d2233.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3a9edc7b29fef44b0d3ecdfa05ecc4085b36ece3.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2fbf6df5c9623e82faa1e4797807545e6b4d11aa.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8ba56319c9d532a429e558cc75ff489b0f2c03a9.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c972a52532f130908442bf4bca2c4850e7c2e6f5.jpg

Arena

A new high-stakes Brawl event is coming your way! During the first week of the event, a special mission chain will become purchasable in the Armory for 10,000 Coal. After making the purchase, you can proceed to 3v3 Brawls playing Tier IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers. Every victory will earn you rewards!


You must win seven times to complete the mission chain.
You can lose an occasional battle, but no more than three battles in total.
Completing the chain will bring you the final reward—500 Steel.
If you lose more than three times, the chain will break, you'll be rewarded with 3x More Coal containers, and you'll have to start from scratch by purchasing another mission chain.

notes.title: Update 13.9: Red October
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b699c4debf5f98d5060751143f30bf8edb037366.jpg
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.9. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU 

Mode Shuffle 2.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/738b2620f8c34ae176c0ce639d456af2667aaeae.jpg

The dynamic battle type that randomly places you in one of three different game modes has returned for Update 13.9, with some interesting changes. Alongside Convoy and Airship Escort, you could land in a game of Epicenter, which has had a fair few tweaks to its points system, and that is taking the place of Arms Race from our previous iteration of Mode Shuffle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9691b8b5ebf6123b31c3fa4d3066974db9e6f5ce.jpg


German-Themed Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7841152ad1bcaf5220b04f197b96820bb113a25f.jpg

Update 13.9's event pass, titled "Unity, Justice, Freedom" pays homage to Germany's Reunification Day both in name and in content:


The first progression line includes "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, the German Navy permanent camouflage for Prinz Heinrich, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Prinz Rupprecht
The second progression line can be unlocked with 2,500 Doubloons, and grants tier VI destroyer Karl von Schönberg immediately, followed by the German Navy permanent camouflage for Zieten, Commander Willie Neumann, 1x German Squadron Premium container, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Schlieffen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fac4d1f1139f9cfa451fce7645262af2cd46e2cb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e4701616d59ef035b35162533f2586aba78cbf70.jpg


Red October Bounty Hunt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3edad7fc65c1ad9fcfa79b2064cb612f75ab6311.jpg

Will you sign up to be a Bounty, or will you be a dedicated hunter? Either way, you can take home some Soviet-themed rewards for taking part in our latest Bounty Hunt event!

The Bounty status can be purchased up to 80 times from the Armory for 100,000 Credits, with the first three purchases being free. You lose the Bounty status when your ship gets destroyed or the event ends.

You can get a temporary currency called Red Tokens if you earn special achievements, as well as for destroying ships while having the Bounty status active. You can spend Red Tokens on variety of rewards including Soviet Era containers, which can drop new Soviet cruiser Kozma Minin among other things!

Red October Leaderboard

During the first week of the event, we'll be tracking progress on a leaderboard—sink as many Bounties as possible to claim valuable rewards, depending on your final ranking:


1-10: tier VIII submarine S-189
11-25: get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers
26-50: 1,000 Steel


The Battle of Leyte Gulf
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/daa15ad7b70d55b997164f5ed739b82da5969550.jpg

We're marking the 80th anniversary of the largest naval encounter of World War II with an interactive adventure and opportunities to get legendary Tier VIII carrier Enterprise and new tier VIII battleship Tennessee!

As you advance through the adventure, you will learn the history of this battle as you complete missions and earn new Leyte Gulf containers and Leyte tokens, the latter of which you can exchange for containers guaranteed to drop Tier VI–IX Premium ships, the "I Shall Return" permanent camouflage for Tennessee, the Ghost of the Pacific permanent camouflage for Enterprise, as well as eight 10-skill-point historical Commanders, and more

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.9 Round 2
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.9. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU 

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Mode Shuffle Returns!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/334e888541e11741efff86f61e822be428fc9646.jpg

You may remember the Mode Shuffle temporary battle type that randomly placed you in either an Airship Escort, Convoy, or Arms Race battle back in Update 13.6. Well, it's returning in 13.9, but with one important change—Arms Race will be removed from the rotation in favor of the Epicenter mode, which we last saw on the Live Server back in Update 0.11.4!

Not only is Epicenter making a reappearance, but its team point-earning system has been updated to better reward risk takers who venture into the inner Key Areas, as well as make the endgame more interesting.

German Unification Day in the Event Pass

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/670e3a324c79e48b46cb86b656abf9a2f4fc20cc.jpg

Update 13.9's Event Pass is dedicated to an important German holiday that celebrates the reunification of East and West Germany after the end of the Cold War.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f6a76637cba4c759be6d8626c8612a179569f7e1.jpg


The first progression line rewards "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, along with the German Navy permanent camouflage for P. Heinrich and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for P. Rupprecht.
Unlocking the second progression line will let you get your hands on Premium destroyer Karl von Schönberg, the German Navy permanent camouflage for Zieten, the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Schlieffen, German Commander Willie Neumann, and a German Squadron Premium container.


"Red October" Bounty Hunt

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9068aef89fcb35239192e703856de6bfec46dab5.jpg

The dynamic Bounty Hunt experience is returning to the seas of World of Warships, this time with a Soviet-themed coat of paint.

The goal is to sink Bounty ships or earn the Bounty achievement in Random Battles. If you choose to take on the Bounty status for yourself, your goal will be to sink ships and earn achievements.

You can get the Bounty status in the Armory in exchange for 100,000 Credits, and each player can purchase up to 80 Bounty statuses during the event, with the first three being free. The Bounty status will be removed once your ship is destroyed or the event ends.

Rewards include Soviet Era containers, Victory Banner permanent camouflages for several Soviet ships, Victory permanent camouflages, and Coal. 

During the first week of the event, you'll be able to track the total number of Bounties destroyed and earn various goodies in the exciting and rewarding Leaderboard competition. The top 10 players in each region will receive Premium Tier VIII submarine S-189, or 5,000 Steel if they already have this ship in their fleet. The top 11–25 will get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers, and the top 26–50 players will get 1,000 Steel.

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 13.8 #1
notes.content:
Patch Notes: Update 13.8
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1ad1f972c991649ae243ab2566191c2fc451b246.png
The World of Warships Anniversary Update begins here! Before you dive head-first into battle, be sure to give our dedicated Update publication a quick look to get the read on all the in-game celebrations and new features you can expect.

Read Patch Notes:

EU NA ASIA

Unlock Festive Rewards Through Battle Performance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/95a5586c65cfefdbfad282a83dbddc5ab90ca052.jpg
Celebrate World of Warships' 9th anniversary with Festive Rewards! Throughout the update, you can unlock special rewards for achieving certain Base XP thresholds aboard any and all Tier V+ ships in your Port. And this year, we've made it easier than ever!

These rewards consist of Festive Tokens—a currency that you can exchange in the Armory for Tier VIII American cruiser Rochester, Battle of Paso de Patria containers, the Stellar Pioneer permanent camo for Benson, Supercontainers, and much, much more!

More info:

EU NA ASIA

Unlock Pan-American Battleships in Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b481018abe679670823d977cc432ac3655be8cda.jpg
Pan-American Tech Tree Battleships Ipiranga, Los Andes, and Libertad have been unleashed on our virtual battlefields in Early Access! If your idea of a battleship involves guns, guns, and more guns, then these bad boys will be right up your alley. A key feature of these ships is their access to Combat Instructions, which improves the range, damage, and reload time of the secondary battery when activated.


Ipiranga is the final reward in the first progression line of the Update 13.8 Event Pass.
Los Andes is available in a sequential bundle in the Armory that can be unlocked with Pan-American Tokens.
Libertad can be obtained at the end of the sequential bundles in exchange for Doubloons.


As part of this event, you'll also be able to unlock permanent camouflages for each of these ships, inspired by the ship's country of origin.

For more information about the new ships, camouflages, and Pan-American Tokens, see our dedicated article below:

EU NA ASIA

Battle of Paso de Patria Collection and Joaquim Marques Lisboa
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9537e7375f9c136ee7d5f38ccea02ce5b9e004a.jpg
With the release of the new Pan-American line, there's no better time to introduce a themed collection with a unique Commander for the in-game nation. Joaquim Marques Lisboa, a historical 19th-century commander of the Brazilian Navy, comes with the enhanced Survivability Expert skill when sailing destroyers, cruisers, and aircraft carriers, as well as the enhanced Brisk skill for battleships. 

He can also activate two unique talents in battle:

Relentless Firing:

Condition: Hit enemy ships 175 times with main/secondary battery shells.
Bonus: Reduces the reload time of the main battery, secondary battery, and torpedo tubes.


Master and Commander:

Condition: Use Combat Instructions twice.
Bonus: Raises the minimum Combat Instructions progress and increases ship speed.


To obtain the new Сommander, you must complete the new Battle of Paso de Patria puzzle collection. There are 60 elements in total and you can get them from Battle of Paso de Patria standard and Premium containers.

For more information about the collection and Commander, see our dedicated anniversary article:

EU NA ASIA

Take the 13.8 Survey!

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 13.8? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

Take Survey

notes.title: Update 13.8: World of Warships Anniversary!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10ad804367ef903b961dc1150efa0c4b6983a8db.jpg
This is a short overview of some of the content that is introduced in Update 13.8. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU

Anniversary Celebrations!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8d3289d7c9af6ccf906556d23d76c76b6181a95.jpg

World of Warships will be turning 9 years old this month! In our usual fashion, we are throwing an all-out party full of Festive Rewards and events for our players!

Festive Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/95a5586c65cfefdbfad282a83dbddc5ab90ca052.jpg

As is tradition, throughout our Anniversary update you can unlock special rewards for achieving certain Base XP thresholds aboard any and all Tier V+ ships in your Port. And this year, we've made it easier than ever!

Your rewards will consist of Festive Tokens, a currency that can be exchanged in the Armory for Tier VIII American cruiser Rochester, Battle of Paso de Patria containers, the Stellar Pioneer permanent camouflage for Benson, Supercontainers, and much, much more!

New Collection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9537e7375f9c136ee7d5f38ccea02ce5b9e004a.jpg

It's been a long time coming and now it's finally here! To celebrate our anniversary, we have a brand-new in-game puzzle collection for you to complete! 

There are 60 elements in total, which you can get from Battle of Paso de Patria standard and Premium containers. The final reward for completing the collection will be new unique Pan-American Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa.

Aquatica Fair
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0979855bfaabab52d50be520ad8a86f4388fb6e1.jpg

A new event has entered the Armory! In the Aquatica Fair event, you'll spend Tries to earn items from a large reward pool that includes new Tier IX Spanish battleship Victoria, Tier IX European battleship Karl XIV Johan, Tier VIII German battleship Anhalt, the Galactic Wanderer permanent camouflage for Victoria, and other anniversary-themed permanent camouflages from past years. 

Pan-American Battleships in Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b481018abe679670823d977cc432ac3655be8cda.jpg

Be the first to try out the first Pan-American line of battleships in the game with our latest Early Access event! Battleships Ipiranga, Los Andes, and Libertad are awaiting your command, each with a large number of guns they can bring to bear. 

To complement this setup, the ships have access to a Combat Instructions mechanic that, when activated, improves the range, damage, and reload time of their secondary batteries. To charge the Combat Instructions meter, you must either score hits with your main battery guns or accumulate potential damage.

In addition, the Pan-American battleships have access to an enhanced Repair Party consumable that restores a higher amount of HP.

As for downsides, gun-for-gun, their main batteries have lower range and firepower than the equivalent ships of other nations, and their citadels are vulnerable to enemy shells when the ships' broadsides are exposed.

Operations Battle Type Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2a1ada51a9193d27d8e7236ed6de6c7aa6d9dcf7.jpg

Update 13.8 will introduce changes to Operations. These changes will affect Naval Station Newport, Raptor Rescue, The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, Aegis, and Cherry Blossom. We have expanded the range of tiers that can participate in these 6 Operations, allowing you to bring your Tier VI–X ships and superships into battle.

More Novelties and Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/db3ae586646e34d26b052961542d6c4606ce7cc6.jpg


New Season of Ranked Battles: Season 19 begins this week with the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Leagues in a 6 vs. 6 format on Tiers VI and VII, VIII and IX, and X and superships, respectively.
New Clan Battles Season: Codenamed "Asp," the new season of this competitive battle type will be played in a 7 vs. 7 format aboard Tier VIII battleships, destroyers, and cruisers.
Expedition to the North Pole: The road to the New Year begins here! Leading up to December, complete special combat mission chains during each update, then collect rewards such as ships and Santa's Gift containers as you progress.
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Get ready to welcome new Commanders, totally rad permanent camouflages, Pizza Time Premium containers, and more themed content later in Update 13.8. Stay tuned for more information!
System Requirements Update: We've updated the system requirements for World of Warships based on our latest performance tests to provide our players with the most optimal hardware configurations. Game client performance should not change for current users.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.8
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.8. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Celebrate 9 Years of World of Warships!

Update 13.8 marks the 9th Anniversary of our game, so—as has become tradition—we're going all out with the celebration for our players!

Claim Anniversary Rewards

Throughout the update, you'll be able to claim special Anniversary rewards by exchanging Festive Tokens (more on those a little further down) in the Armory. Among the rewards, you'll find:


Rochester (U.S. Tier VIII Premium cruiser)
The Stellar Pioneer permanent camouflage for Benson
Supercontainers
Battle of Paso de Patria containers
And more!
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3669a44a1342542a7d643c11ac7b913a81225ea7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bfc243d7af9f4d9f2617e4500423f15210e8e3b7.jpg

Earn Festive Tokens With Battle Performance Bonuses

The beloved Battle Performance Bonuses have returned for the Anniversary update! With this mechanic, all you have to do is achieve specific combat results playing your Tier V+ ships to earn Festive Tokens.

You can receive several rewards simultaneously without having to play each individual ship, and you'll now obtain Battle Performance Bonuses for your selected ship by earning cumulative Base XP. 

You can also trigger additional Battle Performance Bonuses for different ships while playing the same ship multiple times. So you can play your favorite ship and activate Battle Performance Bonuses for as many other ships in your Port as you like. 

Festive Event Pass

Event Pass 13.8 incorporates UI improvements highlighting important rewards, as well as general visual improvements.

Among the rewards of the first progression line, you'll be able to obtain Festive Tokens, Battle of Paso de Patria containers, and Ipiranga (Pan-American Tier VIII battleship) as the final reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e2150b129c7bd449d37f9c50dc36af1687f4c3ec.jpg
The second progression line, unlockable for Doubloons, will provide you with a Battle of Paso de Patria Premium container as a bonus level reward; a bonus package for Tier VIII ships; and various permanent camouflages, including the Ordem e Progresso permanent camouflage for Ipiranga as the final reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/660b17b79fa68776e28bcaffc85e1853b11db095.jpg
Battle of Paso de Patria Collection

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e17b3f5d766ebde9db7bbad72f1b96264d941dcd.jpg
Our all-new in-game collection is themed around new Pan-American unique Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa, who is the final reward for its completion.

We're also adding the new "Collection Token" system to in-game collections as a whole, which will streamline the use of duplicate collection items to complete collections. 

Operations Update

With the release of Update 13.8, Operations Defense of Naval Station Newport, Raptor Rescue, "The Ultimate Frontier," Hermes, Aegis, and Cherry Blossom will have their tier requirements expanded, allowing Tier VI–X ships and superships to participate.

Operations enthusiasts rejoice!

notes.title: Update 13.7: Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard
notes.content:
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.7. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ae0f870c51b17cf87c551c68b20a99e93212f6ab.jpg

Starting in Update 13.7, you can assemble new Spanish Tier IX cruiser Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7c0bde122c26c21ff7bd14f156c6fffcf479aa88.jpg

Ship features:

A powerful main battery with access to an alternate firing mode that, when activated, improves shell dispersion at the cost of a higher reload time.
High speed but a relatively vulnerable citadel.


The shipbuilding process consists of 20 phases, 18 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions. When you reach Phase 11, you'll be rewarded with German Tier VI cruiser Leipzig. If she's already in your fleet, you'll receive two Dockyard phases instead; so with that and completing enough combat missions, you can earn Almirante Oquendo completely free!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/52903a0ec062250c1352e163248ef12f8f072a8d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e133377df6bcd3fdefa66094dd60071cbe38149a.jpg

The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during Updates 13.7 and 13.8, while the Dockyard will remain available until the start of Update 13.10.

Colorful Regatta Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cdebc6111e59d8ff505d68fb7acdb1b5193e763f.jpg

The seas are awash with vivid colors in celebration of the Colorful Regatta Event Pass!


The first progression line includes rewards such as the Colorful Regatta Premium container and flag, plus Coal, Steel, and more. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/09f3497f9547f02a25feed7b9525e12ff17c597f.jpg
Unlock the second progression line to gain access to some more colorful goodies: even more Colorful Tokens, the Fields of Tuscany permanent camouflage, more Coal, and more Steel!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ee5889d4111a0340fc1f62eb26edbe46a90dd7c7.jpg



Colorful Tokens, which can also be obtained from Colorful Regatta containers, can be used to unlock colorful ships in the Armory, including new Zaō CLR, plus Kléber CLR, Roon CLR, and North Carolina CLR.


Labyrinths of History Web Adventure
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c20ffab073ff2391eaf0ed04102c417e70da8047.jpg

Become the protagonist of an exciting narrative adventure through an alternate history timeline of Great Britain, with new British aircraft carrier Theseus taking center stage!

In this "Choose your own adventure" style event available starting in the third week of Update 13.7, you'll be able to decide how the story unfolds by completing special combat missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/39f6296f86440499ee5661e9357228dd7de57a0d.jpg

Finish the adventure to earn Commander William Taylor with 6 skill points, as well as Heart of Oak containers and Britannia Tokens. You can use those Tokens in the Armory to purchase Tier VIII carrier Theseus and other desirable themed rewards!

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.7. Round 2.
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.7. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Dockyard: Almirante Oquendo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f66c1a8a15ad0d02391a841ba33340e8c05fc0b3.jpg

The construction of a new Tier IX Spanish cruiser—Almirante Oquendo—begins in Update 13.7!

Armed with twelve 203 mm barrels, this ship comes equipped with an alternative fire mode—Modified Shells—that makes her guns 20% more accurate at the cost of longer reload times when activated.

Building Almirante Oquendo at the Dockyard involves 20 construction phases. Most of these phases can be advanced through by completing combat missions, but you'll need to finish any two phases by other means if you want to build the ship. If you already own Tier VI German cruiser Leipzig—which we're giving away as an intermediate reward in the construction process—you'll be granted those additional two phases instead of the ship when you reach this reward on the progression line! Otherwise, as usual, you can also purchase phases for Doubloons to make progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/258c544f3d2a38541c0791f35a383a7f13d4638f.jpg

The current Dockyard event runs until the start of Update 13.10, and the combat missions will continue to be available until the end of Update 13.8. Once 13.9 rolls around, you'll only be able to progress further in the Dockyard by purchasing phases for Doubloons.

Colorful Regatta Event Pass

For Update 13.7's Event Pass, we're basking in summer's vibrant colors. 

Our first progression line will paint your summer with Colorful Tokens, the Colorful Regatta flag, a Colorful Regatta Premium container, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, and other valuable rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6183dbc45000a62993162daf3620977bfdaee12f.jpg

You can unlock the second progression line for Doubloons, and enjoy the mosaic of Fields of Tuscany permanent camouflage, more Colorful Tokens, a healthy dose of Coal, Steel, and other valuable rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1f43785e439f619510752ff3d2ff8c570cafc6d1.jpg

Web Adventure With Theseus

An exciting new narrative adventure awaits you on our website in Update 13.7! The story explores the "what if...?" of an alternate history from the perspective of the United Kingdom, centered around our latest addition to the game, British Tier VIII aircraft carrier Theseus.

During the adventure, you'll decide how the story unfolds. All of your choices, aside from the first one, will activate special missions that you must complete to progress the story further. Once you've made all of your choices and finished all the missions, the story will end and 6-skill-point Commander William Taylor will join your roster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/09f923c5108d1cdbe148475f7573c19f8fc27064.jpg

The Armory is teeming with special bundles offering you Heart of Oak Premium containers, plus bundles that hold Theseus, a permanent camouflage for Tier X British battleship Thunderer, and more!

French Destroyers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b732c726757a11e209c200999147cbdd5d978c70.jpg

An all-new branch is springing out of the French Navy Tech Tree! Newcomer French destroyers L'Adroit, Duchaffault, Le Hardi, L'Aventurier, Orage, and Cassard take on the role of close-range torpedo boats.

We at World of Warships would like to extend our gratitude to our partners, without whom this important project would have been far out of reach. 

FORCE BLUE
Established as a nonprofit organization in 2016, FORCE BLUE seeks to address two seemingly unrelated problems—the rapidly declining health of our planet’s marine resources and the difficulty that returning combat veterans have in adjusting to civilian life—through one, mission-focused program.

National Navy SEAL museum
The National Navy SEAL Museum is the only museum dedicated solely to preserving the history of the United States Navy SEALs and their predecessors. Located in Fort Pierce, Florida, the museum resides on the training grounds of the original navy combat divers, the frogmen.

notes.title: USS Wisconsin Turret Restoration
notes.content:
Captain!

We've already unveiled the new Dockyard with battleship X WISCONSIN, but what if we told you that besides constructing the virtual ship, you can also contribute to restoring her in real life?

Two DLC packs with Stars 'n' Stripes permanent camouflages are now available in the World of Warships Store. By purchasing them, you'll be supporting the restoration of the second main battery turret of iconic battleship USS Wisconsin!

The DLC will be available until July 9, 2024.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3053350/World_of_Warships__Wisconsin_Turret_Restoration_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3053360/World_of_Warships__Wisconsin_Turret_Restoration_Mega_Pack/

[previewyoutube=tM6MP6scTMY;full][/previewyoutube]

USS Wisconsin is one of a few legendary U.S. Navy battleships. She served for almost half a century and is currently part of the museum exhibition at Nauticus in Norfolk, Virginia.
This April, the battleship celebrates her 80th anniversary since her commissioning. On this occasion, together with the Nauticus Foundation, we're launching a charity fundraiser for the restoration of the battleship's second main battery turret.

How to Participate
Purchase one of the Wisconsin Turret Restoration DLC packs. 100% of the proceeds*, raised from the sale of this DLC will be transferred to the Nauticus Foundation for the restoration process.

The campaign runs until July 9, 2024, at which point, sales of the DLC will cease.
What Are the Campaign Goals?
Our goal is to raise US$50,000. This amount is sufficient for the restoration of the turret. If the campaign is successful, restoration work will begin on the turret to turn it into a new museum exhibit, open to visitors of USS Wisconsin.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.5 Round 3
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.5. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and would like to read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

D-Day Operations

Update 13.5 will play host to two new D-Day Operations—each available to play for 2 weeks. As with the first Operation taking place in the current Update (13.4), you will be able to unlock Classified Documents by opening Intelligence Folders earned while playing the Operations. These Classified Documents come in three secrecy levels and grant different buffs against certain enemy types.

Atlantic Wall Defense
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a5acef3d6168c930f745f13831581351bf59deee.jpg

The first Operation of Update 13.5 will place you in the boots of a German Captain leading a desperate defense of the beaches and coastal batteries from the onslaught of Allied forces.

You can play the Operation aboard Tier V–VII German destroyers; if you don't own one, a rental vessel will be provided to you. All destroyers in this Operation come equipped with the new Drop Minefield consumable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5960fd8e44cb5b76681eda080aa3a62cffc2e3f5.jpg

Your main goal is to place as many minefields as possible in the way of the attackers, with the bonus tasks being to save as many coastal guns as possible and destroy the Allied destroyers, battleships, and aircraft carrier while surviving until Axis reinforcements arrive. Lastly, if one of your teammates is destroyed, a buff will be activated for your team so you can continue the fight.

Omaha Beach Assault
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c83ce9f4d63421c42d0201e100261bed10d68e3e.jpg

The final D-day scenario will put you back on the Allied side on the same map from the previous Operation.

Your team can consist of Tier V–VII battleships, cruisers, and destroyers from Great Britain; the U.S.A.; the Commonwealth; France; and the Netherlands, as well as select European ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/40be56daab0a4509e079ea78d90ae2c9acaaa278.jpg

This time, your mission is to rescue the crews of the damaged vessels and then destroy the very same coastal batteries you were defending in the prior Operation. Other tasks include destroying all the Schnellboots, escorting the attacking force, defeating the remaining destroyers, and having half of your team still standing at the end of it all.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.4 Round 3
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.4. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU 

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

80th Anniversary of D-Day

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/26383e173507b71ebf5ccf13aec8cceb4e642d29.jpg

On the morning of June 6, 1944, the full force of the Western Allied powers was brought to bear against Germany's Atlantic Wall on the beaches of Normandy, in what amounted to the largest amphibious invasion in History.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7886355c06078a0941b7dd78308e0c3c20dee45c.jpg

80 years on, we're commemorating it in World of Warships with three brand-new event Operations spread across Updates 13.4 and 13.5:

[olist]
Clear the way for landing craft at Utah Beach by suppressing German defenses.
Take command of German destroyers and delay the arrival of Allied forces at Omaha Beach.
Mount a daring rescue operation at Omaha Beach as an Allied ship.
[/olist]

Each Operation will be available for 2 weeks, and you'll be able to participate in Divisions of up to 6 players helming Tier V–VII destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/44a817e6edcbc4b6f9a94f3a5e5232cd35bb7c2f.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d836127db6eb2ed6f5ac28348a73811e9f7bc58.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/365bb03e7e8f7bfc32bed9e215edc69d6ed9e337.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fd9423f4cc86d2a931971c71b8b23c67c838b776.jpg

The D-Day Operations only have a single difficulty level, and completing the primary objective will not be the hardest part. There will, however, be a series of secondary objectives that will grant you Stars and increase the overall difficulty of the Operation. The Stars will progress you through a special reward track, giving you the opportunity to earn new Classified Document options.

New Mechanic: Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/775feeb0bcde9046e63a593340da6834e463b026.jpg

A special mechanic, Classified Documents, will be available in these Operations and can be activated against certain enemy groups for additional bonuses. Each Document has three levels: "Confidential," "Secret," and "Top Secret." Each new level grants an additional bonus to the existing Classified Document option.

There are twelve options in total—six Allied and six Axis—and players receive one option per side at the start of the event. Only three can be brought into an Operation at a time. You can either choose them in the Port manually before battle or during a short window of time after the Operation begins.

Clan Battles 25: Support Consumables

Clan Battles Season 25, codenamed "Polar Bear," will be shorter than usual due to its experimental nature—we're adding some of the support consumables you may be familiar with from the recent Piñata Hunt event. These special consumables will provide advantages to you and your team.

To keep teams balanced with these support consumables active, there will be restrictions on the number of consumables that can be taken into battle per Division, as well as restrictions on which types can equip certain consumables.

notes.title: Update 13.3: Wisconsin at the Dockyard
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.3. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website.

EU NA ASIA

Dockyard: Wisconsin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ef364293a6bc8d5ada89b48e7f04864d2b93e3a.jpg

Build the historic American battleship in Update 13.3! 

Ship features:

"Immediate Systems Reload" Combat Instructions that reduce your consumable preparation/cooldown time.
Accurate guns that inflict relatively low damage.
High speed and good concealment, but relatively weak armor.


The shipbuilding process consists of 30 phases, 28 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions. When you reach shipbuilding phase 20, you'll also be rewarded with West Virginia '44. If you already have her in your fleet, you'll receive three Dockyard phases instead; so, with that and completing enough combat missions, you can earn Wisconsin completely free!

The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during Updates 13.3 and 13.4, while the Dockyard will remain available until the start of Update 13.6.

Golden Week Festivities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e6753837edff1754bc47bf106e29b9e8e3feb0e4.jpg

The new update welcomes a new Event Pass dedicated to the special holiday celebrated in Japan and East Asian countries!

The Event Pass consists of two 20-level progression lines.


Among the rewards of the first progression line, you'll find Romanian Commander Andrei Teodorescu, permanent camouflages, a permanent bonus package for Tier VII ships, and Golden Tokens.
For the second progression line, you can expect the Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō, the Dawn Harmony permanent camouflage for Shimanto and Takahashi, a permanent bonus package for a Tier VIII ship, new Japanese Commander Ashikaga Teru, and Doubloons.


Golden Tokens can be spent at the Wishing Wharf event in the Armory.

Wishing Wharf
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/01df299422d76f424a4d95fd41141bf3fd838157.jpg

During the Wishing Wharf event, you can spend Golden Tokens to try to get random rewards. Each Try will cost you 100 Golden Tokens.

The event rewards are separated into three categories based on their rarity:


Common rewards: Special and rare economic bonuses, Free and Elite Commander XP, Credits, and signals.
Rare rewards: Hyūga, Maya, new hybrid cruiser Chikuma II, and Hayate, as well as themed permanent camouflages for Hyūga, Maya, Mogami, Hayate, and Yamato.
Supreme reward: Chikuma II Golden with characteristics similar to Chikuma II but a unique appearance.


Asymmetric Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c4c1780b25e915cf7b20737d40c77d42bd43fbec.jpg

Here's some good news for PvE fans—we've decided to bring Asymmetric Battles back for the entire duration of Update 13.3!

The rules haven't changed since the last iteration, and as for the bots, they'll continue to be a 12-ship team two tiers lower than each tier represented in the player team.

Leaderboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/017a09980250a0ff1100fd1064f71e3721a50f6c.jpg

A new Armory activity starts in May! Join the competition and earn cumulative Base XP in all battle types. You'll be able to track your progress, as your position will be updated hourly.
The top 5 players in each realm will be rewarded with Tsurugi, while the top 6 to 50 players will get a discount coupon for the purchase of Tsurugi. All participants who earn at least 3,000 Base XP during the event will get 500 Community Tokens as a reward.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.3
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.3. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Wisconsin at the Dockyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2150f445060a7fa3c5f0d26b8e961e5c125fc2fa.jpg

Wisconsin is coming to the Dockyard! The construction process consists of 30 phases, 28 of which can be completed via combat mission groups. If you complete all the Dockyard missions, you'll only need to purchase two phases to get the new ship!

Completing phase 20 will award you with Tier VII Premium battleship West Virginia '44! If you already own her, you'll instead get three construction phases, potentially allowing you to earn Wisconsin for free!

Asymmetric Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fee7b9d0dee509e8a337d3ae11c4d65d940d47da.jpg

The fan-favorite PvE battle type is returning! Battles will be fought in a 5 vs. 12 format and feature Tier VI–X ships, including superships. While human players will be able to select any ship type, submarines won't be an option for the bot-controlled team.

For the player team, the maximum tier difference between ships will be limited to one, while bots will control ships up to two tiers lower.

Golden Week Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7aa770542ca9e3b4d8d4b1f165795a8e34366c90.jpg

The Event Pass for Update 13.3 is themed around Japan's Golden Week holidays.

The first progression line holds Asian Lantern and Golden Week permanent camouflages, a permanent economic package for a Tier VII ship, Golden Tokens, and more!

The second progression line holds the Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō, the Dawn Harmony permanent camouflage for Shimanto or Takahashi, a permanent economic package for a Tier VIII ship, new Japanese Commander Ashikaga Teru, and Doubloons.

Custom Destruction Animation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99210682e517299b061238cf7965e3ef9000514f.gif

We're testing a new concept in Update 13.3 – a permanent camouflage that adds a custom destruction animation to ships you destroy instead of the standard explosion.

You can get one of these camouflages for free during Update 13.3 and can purchase three additional ones for Credits.

notes.title: Update 13.2: Piñata Hunt
notes.content:
EU NA ASIA

Piñata Hunt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/43e491a8e803ecd8aad5d54999e43edbf4fd0e1c.png

Update 13.2 brings the Piñata Hunt event! You'll be able to hunt a special Piñata ship during the event to gain an advantage over your opponents. Available as a separate battle type, this year’s event features the specially decorated Colorful Islands map.

Details

Battles with Tier VIII–IX ships of all types; 7 players per team.
When the Piñata is taken down, a shrinking control point will spawn on the spot where it sinks.


The Piñata Hunt also introduces a new mechanic—support consumables. There are eight unique support consumables in total, with each ship type having access to five of them. One consumable for each ship type will be unlocked at the start, while up to four others can be attained by completing missions or by purchasing them with Credits in the Armory. You'll be able to select only one support consumable per battle.

During the Piñata Hunt event, you can obtain Piñata Tokens by completing combat missions. You can exchange these Tokens for rewards in the Armory.

Early Access to Commonwealth Cruisers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/85b27abea5aef1475e167d647258bdcd5adc59d1.png

The long-awaited Commonwealth cruisers enter Early Access in Update 13.2!

To celebrate their arrival, the following themed permanent camouflages are being added to the game: Indian Tiger for Delhi, New Zealand Fern for Auckland, and Australian Ornament for Cerberus. Additionally, historical Commanders Harold Farncomb and Leonard Murray, the Commonwealth Rockfish patch, the Commonwealth Team commemorative flag, and Commonwealth Team Premium containers are being added to the game.

Keep your eyes glued to our website for the special article covering these new cruisers!

Commonwealth Team Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4fe64ed6fa67a8bc8551a936d9ea6ec58e06b10b.png

Update 13.2 brings a new thematic Event Pass! You can participate in it and journey through two progression lines that offer loads of rewards. Each line comprises a total of 20 levels—complete them to earn all the main rewards and gain access to additional rewards for completing extra levels.

You'll be able to obtain historical Commander Harold Farncomb with 6 skill points, the Commonwealth Team commemorative flag, the Indian Tiger permanent camouflage for Delhi, and Commonwealth Tokens in the first progression line, as well as other valuable rewards for free. After completing the initial 20 levels, you'll receive 2x More Signals containers as a reward for completing each extra level.

The second progression line, unlockable for Doubloons, holds Mysore as the most prized reward. Among the other rewards, you'll be able to obtain permanent camouflages like Gregale, Canada Day, Indian Tricolor, and Blue Lagoon, as well as Commonwealth Tokens and other valuable items. After completing the initial 20 levels, you'll earn Commonwealth Tokens as rewards for completing extra levels.

Submarine Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f55c7f3d8a87fc41a3a5f24b0616e0f62fa43713.png

Multiple new features and improvements for submarines are going to be implemented with Update 13.2. This will affect not only their gameplay but also upgrades and balance.

Upon the release of Update 13.2, all players will be granted a 100% discount on demounting upgrades during the following week. The affected upgrades that are mounted on submarines at the moment of the update release will be demounted at no cost and removed from players' accounts. Compensation will be issued according to their full prices.

More information about these changes, as well as the compensation rules, will be available in a separate article.

U.S. Aircraft Carriers Leave Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/12872366b0a8c069f577ff1a1a763e8cdf7e5f56.png

Early Access to Independence, Yorktown, and Essex ends with the release of Update 13.2.

The new aircraft carriers only have access to one standard torpedo bomber squadron, which is supplemented with two tactical squadrons consisting of attack and dive bomber aircraft.

Starting from Tier VIII, the tactical squadrons are equipped with the new Smoke Curtain Generator consumable.

More information will be available in a separate article.

Ranked Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d9dbc28534215eeb219ccec155f735734980e913.png

Update 13.2 brings Ranked Battles Season 16.

Bronze League battles will utilize a 6 vs. 6 format with Tier VIII ships; players will helm Tier X ships and superships in both the Silver and Gold Leagues.

For the Bronze and Silver Leagues, no more than one submarine, four battleships, and four destroyers are allowed per team; for the Gold League—no more than one submarine, three battleships, and four destroyers per team.

More information will be available in the game client.

Brawls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d534d40f1d970887b4cdd30d5acc4963d747330a.png

Update 13.2 will see four Brawls unleashed in different formats. The first Brawl will utilize a 5 vs. 5 format with Tier VIII battleships, aircraft carriers, and submarines. notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.2
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.2. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, visit the dedicated article on our website.

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/style]

April Fools' Day Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b5274c9daa51da2519ab548a2e0bb924a53b97e5.jpg
We've created a brand-new battle type and special map for Update 13.2. Piñata Hunt pits two teams of seven Tier VIII–IX ships against one another while also tasking them to compete in sinking a special Piñata ship.

Sinking the Piñata will spawn a control point that shrinks over time for the two teams to compete over.

Upon entering battle, one of 14 event-themed camouflages will be randomly applied to your ship. A brand-new custom explosion animation will play for any ships that get sunk during the hunt.

We're also introducing a new feature—support consumables—for this game mode; they will aid you and your team in sinking the Piñata ship. Each ship can pick one consumable to take into battle, and it can be recharged for everyone on your team up to three times during each battle by entering three interactive zones that will spawn as the Piñata takes damage.

By participating in the event, you can obtain Piñata Tokens that are redeemable for candy-themed permanent camouflages.

Submarine Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c2ed3d4ee485b36df1f4f20b50d135895c822fbd.png

We're introducing more changes in Update 13.2 to further combat "shotgunning" by submarines while maintaining the same level of effectiveness for the class. Submarine torpedoes are also being adjusted to deal different amounts of damage based on the distance from the launch point to their target.

Early Access to Commonwealth Cruisers

Update 13.2 welcomes a new line of Commonwealth cruisers and their entirely new Tech Tree to Early Access. These are the new ships: Sutlej, Port Jackson, Caradoc, Dunedin, Delhi, Hobart, Uganda, Auckland, Encounter, and Cerberus.

These ships deal decent damage per minute, but their drawbacks include relatively poor ballistics and slow-traversing turrets. At Tier VII, their torpedoes become long range to the extent that they can even be launched from stealth.

Ships of the line feature Hydroacoustic Search, available in its own slot at Tier IV and sharing a slot with Defensive AA Fire at later tiers. Starting from Tier V, they gain access to the signature Commonwealth Crawling Smoke Generator, and from Tier VIII, they have Repair Party.

Starting from Tier V, Commonwealth cruisers also have access to an enhanced variant of the Submarine Surveillance consumable with an improved range, and their Depth Charge Airstrike characteristics also improve.

Other Changes and Additions


Clan interface improvements: We've improved the Clan interface by including two additional windows: one displaying Clan bonuses and the other displaying the Clan description and info. We've also added the ability to include a clickable Discord link in the Clan description.
Commonwealth Commanders: New portraits and voiceovers for standard Commonwealth Commanders are being added to reflect India, New Zealand, Australia, and Canada.

notes.title: Update 13.1: Lunar New Year
notes.content:
Changes to submarines and ASW, Lunar New Year celebrations, exterior system update, collaborations with popular YouTubers, the return of Airship Escort, and more!
This is a short overview of Update 13.1. You'll find more information in dedicated articles on our website.
EU NA ASIA
Submarine and ASW Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c2ed3d4ee485b36df1f4f20b50d135895c822fbd.png
As we announced previously, we're working on solving major problems with submarine interactions, and we're now ready to present some changes to submarines and ASW. With these changes, we're aiming to create more consistent interactions between submarines and surface ships while still maintaining the current level of combat effectiveness of submarines.
Changes to the Exterior System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bccd557feb1628dc47cd446cda21166645dce5db.png
Starting with Update 13.1, most expendable camouflages available in the game will get their permanent versions. New permanent camouflages will operate similarly to already existing permanent camouflages, such as New Year, Epoch, or Made of Steel; however, you'll be able to mount them on ships of any tier. These camouflages can either be purchased or earned through various activities, events, and missions.
Lunar New Year
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ee9c2bbe8b786c64ab9c50170e851f3fbc2bc3a.png
Participate in our themed Event Pass for the occasion and journey through two progression lines that offer a plethora of rewards! Each line comprises a total of 20 levels – complete them to earn all the main rewards and gain access to additional rewards by completing extra levels.
As part of the Lunar New Year celebrations, the New Year Beast patch, Lunar Demon permanent camouflage for Hsienyang, and Commander Nian with an individual voiceover have been added to the game. The Dragon Port has also been updated for the occasion.
Airship Escort
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b42cbbe33da9a37eac25a6cabfc9d46de62c5720.png
Airship Escort returns as a separate temporary game type in the third week of Update 13.1!
As always, your goal is to help the allied airship to reach its destination while protecting it from opponents. Alternatively, you can achieve victory by destroying all enemy ships.
Format

12 vs. 12
Tier VIII–X ships
All ship types

Early Access to U.S. Aircraft Carriers Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ebdae273f8e8ae717a23c5d1e0fd6c502b0955f5.png
Early Access to the new U.S. aircraft carrier line is ongoing! You can still earn American Tokens from random bundles available for Doubloons and then exchange them for rewards in the Armory: Essex with a 10-skill-points Commander and Port slot, the Hero of Midway permanent camouflage for Yorktown, the Defender of the Pacific Ocean permanent camouflage for Essex, up to 10x Wings of Freedom Premium containers, and Credits.
With the release of Update 13.2, this branch will become available for all players in the Tech Tree.
Clan Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/110858f649cc2682d28c5d041f553f5efa5564a9.png
A week after Update 13.1 is out, Clan Battles Season 24—dubbed "Sea Dragon"—commences.
Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here but also general progress. Fight alongside your allies and rise to the top!
Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards, such as Steel, Oil, days of Warships Premium Account, and combat signals, as well as rare and unique expendable economic bonuses. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn!
Armory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3f6b16c708adf398cda749ad24e88aab26ef1c3c.png
Sicilia in the Research Bureau
Welcome a new addition to the Armory: with the release of Update 13.1, Sicilia will become available to purchase for 60,000 Research Points.
Battleship Sicilia takes her name from the famous island in southern Italy, as well as the swift and mighty ironclad of the same name which served in the Regia Marina at the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries.
Battle of the Java Sea
An event dedicated to the Battle of the Java Sea, one of the famous naval battles of the Pacific campaign of World War II, starts in the second week of Update 13.1.
We've prepared a special mission chain that can bring you various rewards, including Java Sea Tokens; one of two new historical Commanders, Takeo Kurita or Karel Doorman; Battle of the Java Sea containers; and a Battle of the Java Sea Premium container. Java Sea Tokens will also be available in special bundles in the Armory for Doubloons.
The Creatorverse! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9ecc8a4ea15f030c058a4a8e1ec6ea73c288d773.png
We've partnered with five major content creators to bring their unique content to World of Warships! CouRageJD, MoistCr1TiKaL, Ludwig, Nadeshot, and Sapnap are preparing to sail out on our virtual seas. Their respective Commanders—CouRage, CHUCK BLAST, Stonebeard, Nadeshot, and Sapnap—are voiced by the famous YouTubers themselves!
But that's not all: we've also prepared thematic commemorative flags representing each of them, as well as permanent camouflages carefully crafted with their input—Pride of the CouRageous for Leander, BLAST MASTER for Bayern, Stonewash for Normandie, Thief's Future for Pensacola, and Fire Carrier for Fubuki.
YouTube Memberships
We've updated the benefits of our YouTube membership program. Complete special combat missions in Update 13.1 to earn Community Tokens, along with Journey to the West containers and Lunar New Year containers!
We're expanding this program to the channels of our contributors so that more Captains can support the content they like. This means that, in addition to the three levels of membership on our official channel, you can now purchase the WoWS Commander membership level from our contributors. Check all the details here.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin and Public Test 13.1
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.1. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, check out the dedicated article on our website.

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/style]

Changes to Submarines and ASW
Starting with Update 13.1, we aim to make submarine and surface ship interactions more consistent and intuitive.

Changes to ASW


The Venezia and Hindenburg lines, as well as Prinz Eugen and Admiral Schröder, are going to be equipped with Depth Charge Airstrike instead of Depth Charges.
Tier V–VIII battleships are getting an increase in their Depth Charge Airstrike range.
Depth Charge Airstrike on Tier V–VIII battleships and cruisers is going to have a shorter cooldown, but its bomb damage will be slightly reduced. 
Ships that currently have special ASW settings are not receiving any changes unless specifically noted.
Depth Charge Airstrike range is going to be increased for Ohio, Thunderer, Jean Bart, and Jean Bart B. It will become similar to the ranges for other battleships at their tiers.
Venezia, Zaō, and Yodo lines will receive the Submarine Surveillance consumable in a separate slot. It was previously available only for submarines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3317806aa65a138825fef7066464b097211c746b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/dbc8246e88986d60687b2b0210ad5a92ae81eb23.gif
Changes to Submarines
The Hydrophone consumable is going to work differently:

The consumable will allow submarines to immediately spot ships in range, regardless of terrain (similar to Hydroacoustic Search and Surveillance Radar).
The consumable can be activated in any state, but it will only detect ships while at periscope depth or on the surface.
When submarines use Hydrophone to detect ships above them and in their line of sight, static silhouettes of these ships will appear for a short period (about 6 seconds) and then disappear. Ships behind terrain will be displayed as a short flash without a silhouette.


A collision warning message will now appear for submerged submarines when there is another submarine underwater within 2 kilometers. 

To balance out the changes to ASW, all submarines are going to have an improved turning circle radius. On average, it will improve by around 20%, providing submarines more opportunities to maneuver and reposition.

To accommodate the changes, the Sierra Bravo and X-Ray Papa Unaone signals will also receive submarine-specific changes.

Exterior System Update
With the release of Update 13.1, the majority of expendable camouflages available in the game will get their permanent versions. The new permanent camouflages will operate similarly to already existing permanent camouflages, such as New Year, Epoch, or Made of Steel; however, you'll be able to mount them on ships of any tier. These camouflages can be either purchased or obtained through various activities, events, and missions.

Once you obtain a standard, single-colored, abstract, or thematic camouflage (expendable or permanent) on your account, you can purchase its permanent version for all of your ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d1a0d84964e06e8f6121eb318ae9bed080b8b11.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/100820edd8ef291529179f2569af55f8dad82b31.jpg

You can purchase permanent camouflages of the aforementioned types for Credits or Doubloons under the Exterior tab. 

Lunar New Year
As part of the Lunar New Year celebrations, the Dragon Port has been updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7bef32f54bf1d0a2beb0ff3b2f20cb6cb953df0e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3c24891104e06a46089e4ebb82845b8dd473f58c.jpg

Airship Escort
The Airship Escort temporary battle type is returning for Update 13.1! The battles will utilize a 12 vs. 12 format with Tier VIII–X ships of all types.

notes.title: Update 13.0: New U.S. Aircraft Carriers
notes.content:
This is a short overview of Update 13.0. You can find more information in dedicated articles on our website.
EU NA ASIA
Early Access to U.S. Aircraft Carriers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d4dae8bb57570d7d8781a0e7a13c4f60e6c2d9b.png
Early Access to the upcoming U.S. aircraft carrier line begins in Update 13.0. The three ships being added are Independence, Yorktown, and Essex. In addition to these three historical vessels, camouflages for Yorktown and Essex, as well as a commemorative flag, are being added to mark the event.
U.S. Aircraft Carriers Event Pass
Update 13.0 delivers an event comprising 20 levels that you can progress through by completing a series of daily and weekly missions. Tier VI aircraft carrier Independence stands as the most prized reward in the first progression line.
During this event, you'll have the option to unlock the second progression line for Doubloons. Much like the first progression line, this line also comprises a total of 20 levels, but where it stands out is in the rewards if offers: Tier VIII aircraft carrier Yorktown, a bonus package for Yorktown, Commander Statue of Liberty with 6 skill points and an individual voiceover, the Freedom permanent camouflage for Tier X Des Moines, and more!
American Tokens
You can exchange your American Tokens for Essex with a 10-skill-point Commander and Port slot, permanent camouflages for Yorktown and Essex, Wings of Freedom Premium containers, and Credits. Obtain them either via random bundles for Doubloons or by completing extra levels of the second progression line of the U.S. Aircraft Carriers Event Pass.
Besides American Tokens, the random bundles also hold special and rare economic bonuses of all types, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, Credits, and American battleship Rhode Island, which can only be obtained via this route. The option to purchase the new battleship will become available in a future updates.
Sestri-Ponente Dockyard Continues
The construction of cruiser Michelangelo continues at the Sestri Ponente Dockyard in Update 13.0.
During the first 3 weeks of the new update, players will be able to complete combat missions and advance through Dockyard construction phases to obtain the main reward—Michelangelo herself.

The construction process comprises 32 phases, 27 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups.
You can also complete shipbuilding phases by spending 1,750 Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 10,000 Doubloons and 5 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 6,000 Doubloons.

The Dockyard will remain in your Port until the release of Update 13.1.
Bounty Hunt Event
Update 13.0 also includes a new iteration of the Bounty Hunt event together with changes that were previously announced in Update 12.8. The Bounty Hunt event will be available in Random Battles, and when taking on the Bounty role, players need to helm Tier VI–X battleships, cruisers, or destroyers in battle.
Both players with Bounty role and regular players will be able to earn Star Tokens, which they will be able to spend in the Star Emissaries Armory category. The main rewards are Bionic permanent camouflages for Des Moines, Buffalo, and Baltimore. Players will also be able to obtain Coal, common bonuses containers, and signals.
Star Emissaries
Besides the previously mentioned Bounty event and rewards, more goods can be found in the Star Emissaries Armory category!
As part of the event, you can use Doubloons to buy random bundles that hold STAR Kitakaze, STAR Edinburgh, Commanders Andromeda and Triangulum with 10 skill points and individual voiceovers, expendable economic bonuses, and other valuable rewards. 
The main feature of these ships is their permanent camouflages, which dynamically change their appearance in the midst of battle depending on whether the ship is detected.

Ship Parameters Display in Battle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2f273d5a582cdd857fb39c439f5bd36e4cd7396b.png
We've added a feature that enables players to see various ship parameters while in battle! Essentially, players will be able to click on opposing and allied ships in the Team window before or during a battle (press/hold the Tab key to access this window). A tooltip will appear providing information on the selected ship, such as hit points, armament ranges, movement speed, and possible consumables, among other parameters.
This feature also allows players to hover their mouse over attributes such as shells, torpedoes, and consumables in-battle and check the data for those items, similar to the functionality in Port.

Armory
With the release of Update 13.0, Halford will become available in the Armory for 228,000 Coal.
Halford is the first hybrid destroyer in our game, and the ship carries an attack aircraft tactical squadron equipped with the Engine Cooling consumable. The aircraft are armed with powerful Tiny Tim rockets with high damage and armor penetration characteristics. 
Unique Upgrades
In Update 13.0, two ships will receive new unique upgrades: German Tier X destroyer Elbing and Dutch Tier X cruiser Gouden Leeuw are each getting a unique upgrade that can be mounted in Modification Slot 6.

Hololive Collaboration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f734e2bb7971dea3a6f4ab9b179560bc094265f4.png
Update 13.0 brings back the heroes of hololive production. Popular Japanese VTubers are ready to fill the ranks of Commanders and plunge into the heat of naval battles back-to-back with players! Welcome back the hololive commanders with individual voiceovers! Players can also obtain hololive production expendable camouflages and a memorable flag during the event.

But that's not all! Players can also complete combat missions to choose between Commander Fubuki Shirakami, with six skill points trained for I Hashidate
, or Commander Moona Hoshinova, with six skill points trained for I Chengan
as the final reward.

Ⓒ 2016 COVER Corp.
Ranked battles and Brawls
Update 13.0 delivers Ranked Battles Season 15 and unleashes three Brawls in different formats.
For a complete list of changes, please refer to Player Support
