notes.title: Transfer Opportunities for Players from CIS to the EU Realm
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bee625891f031b9badab94a5b487827d4fc31764.jpg
Dear players!

On April 4, we announced that Wargaming projects including World of Warships, will be operated by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus. This was the first step, followed by months of hard work. The result is the complete structural and financial division of the two companies. Today, World of Warships and other products are operated by two independent companies: by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus, and by Wargaming in all other countries.

The next big step is to launch a special transfer campaign for CIS players who wish to stay with Wargaming and continue playing on Steam.

Transfer is a crucial activity where every player from CIS realm will need to decide on how to continue playing the game. Below you can find the key points about this procedure:
[olist]In September, CIS servers will be turned off for Steam players.
If you already have an account on CIS region, you will have an opportunity to transfer your CIS account to EU region and continue playing on Steam.
If you don’t want to transfer your account to EU region, unfortunately, you will not be able to continue playing on Steam.[/olist]
Providing high quality service and ensuring the comfort of our players will always remain our priority. We will keep your account progress and all applicable terms and conditions, including pricing principles, as well as the core set of services you are used to, no matter where you continue playing.

We understand that this is a big and serious decision for our players, and we will do our best to make it a smooth and easy experience for everyone.

Additional Questions
[expand][olist]Q: Do I need to perform any actions now?
A: If you wish to transfer your account, make sure that you have completed your registration by adding an email and a password. Other than that, you do not have to do anything now, this is just an announcement to make sure you stay up to date with our latest plans. We will make an additional publication when the transfer is ready with all details about the procedure.
Q: How long will the transfer option be available?
A: The transfer campaign doesn’t have any planned end date. We want to make sure that all our players get a chance to move to EU region, including those who decided to take a break from the game at the moment. If this changes sometime in the future, we will let you know in advance.
Q: Can I transfer my EU, NA, ASIA account to another server during this transfer campaign?
A: No, this transfer campaign will be aimed specifically at CIS-region players. Other regions remain without any changes.
Q: Can players transfer their clan to the EU?
A: Yes, if requested by the Clan Commander.
Q: Will my progress, stats, purchases and resources be transferred as well?
A: Yes, of course. Your progress, stats, purchases, resources etc. will be transferred to a new account on EU region with only a couple of exceptions. Game progress will not be saved, the ability to complete already started regional game events will be disabled.
Q: I play from Belarus or Russia and I want to transfer my account to EU region. Will I be able to make purchases in the game after the transfer?
A: We will continue to accept all payment methods available in Steam. Therefore, you will be able to make purchases on EU region using payment methods that are available in Steam in your country.
Q: What if I don’t want to transfer my account to EU region?
A: Unfortunately, in that case you will not be able to play World of Warships via Steam on your CIS-region account.[/olist][/expand]
We understand that you might have more questions about the transfer procedure. We will share the full transfer conditions and technical details for Steam players closer to the transfer launch which is currently planned for the middle of September. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.

Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

[table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary
Warship Strike
Reworked Operations
Changes to the Reload Mechanics[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
World of Warships Anniversary
This year, World of Warships is celebrating its seventh birthday! We've prepared various activities for our players in honor of the occasion.

Seven Seas Collection
An important new feature that's also part of our birthday celebrations is the Seven Seas collection dedicated to historic ports that have been recreated in our game. The Seven Seas collection will let you take a fresh look at familiar locations from a new perspective and get to know some curious facts from the history of as many as 16 famous ports.

The collection elements can only be obtained from dedicated same-name containers. You can earn these containers by progressing through special chains of combat missions and also find them in free daily bundles in the Armory. Rest assured that those containers will be quite enough to complete the entire collection. The collection consists of four pages, with four elements on each.

Reward for completing a page: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Warships Premium Account.
Reward for completing the collection: bonus package for a Tier VII ship. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d29aed54-1c90-11ed-8872-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Note: The new collection will not be available on the Public Test Server.

Festive Rewards
To celebrate the Seventh Anniversary of World of Warships, we're bringing back gift bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. This time, however, we've added an important enhancement—the ability to receive several gifts for a single battle!

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34c44aba-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34cfef3c-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35f26caa-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3640f672-1c92-11ed-ad59-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35055c94-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
If a player has 100 or more ships, they will be able to receive a standard gift for a battle played with a ship, as well as extra bonus gifts that depend on the amount of Base XP earned. The old rule that you can't get gifts a second time playing the same ship applies as well.

Extra bonus gifts can be applied toward any other ship they have not been applied to, so you can "score" a gift for that ship without the need to actually hit the seas for battle at her helm.

The bonus gift rewards depend on your ship tier:
For Tier V–VII ships, it's 1x Special Bonuses container
For Tier VIII–IX ships, it's 1x Rare Bonuses container and 1x Special Bonuses container
For Tier X ships and superships, it's 1x Supercontainer
The number of bonus gifts you receive after a battle depends on the number of ships you have in your Port and the amount of Base XP earned in that battle. For example, a player with a Port fleet exceeding 300 ships will be able to earn four gifts in one battle: one gift for entering battle with a ship and three gifts for effective action in battle.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/02f79758-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The new Special Bonuses container drops Level 2 economic bonuses. 5x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits +40%," "Ship XP +200%," "Commander XP +200%," "Free XP +600%."

The new Rare Bonuses container drops Level 3 economic bonuses. 3x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits +160%," "Ship XP +800%," "Commander XP +800%," "Free XP +2,400%."
[hr][/hr]
Warship Strike
One of the fresh activities that's getting released with Update 0.11.8 involves challenging AI in a new game codenamed "Warship Strike," inspired by a classic naval combat game. You can access the game via the Armory. You'll need a special resource—a Strike Pass—to unlock access to it and play. Strike Passes can be earned by completing special combat missions.

You can pause any ongoing battle at any time and return to it later, and your progress will be saved. Battles can also be completed automatically. In that case, the AI completes the battle for you. The battle results will simply appear on the screen, and you'll receive all due rewards in the form of Festive Tokens. These are issued for sinking enemy ships and winning battles.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64b9c772-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/649ba008-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
You can exchange these Tokens in the Armory for the option that suits your needs best:
Permanent camouflages
Bonus packages for ships
Economic bonuses
Containers with signals and resources
Credits [hr][/hr]
Reworked Operations
In Update 0.11.8, we've reworked all Operations in the game. The purpose of these changes is to give you the opportunity to participate in Operations playing more of your favorite ships and earn valuable rewards along the way.

Now, Tier VI to VIII ships can be matched in battle at the same time, and the final team lineup will have an effect on the strength of the bots and post-battle earnings. The "fee" for re-entering battle with the same ship will be removed.

The economy in effect in Operations will change as well. Previously, players earned Stars for completing an Operation, and the rewards could only be obtained once. We've removed Stars altogether, and the rewards can now be earned by progressing through dedicated daily and weekly combat missions specifically designed for Operations. The rewards are Community Tokens.

The Operation of the Week won't be available in Update 0.11.8. When playing on a team where your allies are selected automatically, an Operation will be picked at random. You will still be able to select an Operation of your liking when you are part of a Division.

Update 0.11.8 brings back the following three Operations for the revamped game mode: The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and Cherry Blossom.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85ea4502-1c92-11ed-9180-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8680b76c-1c92-11ed-a853-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/867fda04-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2490a30-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a248fce8-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a24937da-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fcba64-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fb9e72-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3719ef2-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Changes to the Reload Mechanics
We've changed the gun reload mechanics that are applied when switching shell type.

With the "Gun Feeder" Commander skill active, the shell type will now switch faster even if not all main battery guns are completely reloaded after a salvo (which was required prior to the change for the skill to take effect).

Shells now have a new parameter—"shell-type switching time."
If the current gun reload time exceeds the shell-type switching time, shell switching will not affect the gun reload time.
If the current gun reload time is shorter than the shell-type switching time, the gun reload time when switching shell types is equal to the shell-type switching time.
The Gun Feeder skill bonus applied to shell-type switching time has been changed from –50% to –40%. For example, if the standard gun reload time is 30 seconds, the shell-type switching time with the Gun Feeder skill activated will be 18 seconds, but the following should be kept in mind:
If the remaining gun reload time is 20 seconds and you switch shell type, the reload time will still be 20 seconds.
If only 5 seconds are left for the guns to reload, switching shell type will increase the gun reload time to 18 seconds.
The new mechanics apply to each turret individually. Shell-type switching time will be shown in a ship's tech specs.
Additionally, all researchable Italian battleships will have the "–30% to shell-type switching time" bonus applied by default, which means that it will apply even when the Gun Feeder skill is inactive. Activating the skill will further increase this bonus.

Speaking of Italian battleships, switching between shell types frequently is an important gameplay component. The extra bonus will emphasize this feature and increase the effectiveness of using the Gun Feeder skill compared to battleships of other nations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1b3cbd1dea298c0a33e29bdb727fd5cdef22fe11.jpg
Commanders!

Update 0.11.7. kicks off Season 18 of Clan Battles. It's named "Sirenidae." Sirenidae, or "sirens," are amphibious predators found in the Southeastern United States. They hunt for mollusks, prawns, and small fish. As opposed to other salamanders, which is the order they belong to, sirens can emit sounds. They're named after creatures from Greek mythology who lured sailors to a certain death.

Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here but also general progress. Fight alongside your brothers-in-arms and rise to the top!

Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards such as Steel, Oil, days of Warships Premium Account, combat signals, Level 4 expendable bonuses, and a Clan Token. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn.

notes.title: Dockyard: Building Puerto Rico
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4914110d1decfd7046aa4fb43f05049f27887f41.jpg
Throughout Updates 0.11.7 – 0.11.9, the buzz and frenzy at the Dockyard will be all about building Puerto Rico. This ship is based on an American design developed during World War II.

The expiration of the Washington Naval Treaty in 1936 gave American designers free rein to come up with whatever they thought expedient to meet the needs of the Navy. By the end of the 1930s, a stringent situation had emerged in the Pacific, exposing the United States' need for heavy cruisers to effectively protect communication lines and aircraft carrier formations. Simply said, the country needed a strong ship with great firepower, high speed, and effective armor. By the year 1940, several projects had been created. The CA-2D design was the largest of them in terms of size and outnumbered all the other ones in main battery guns. This is the very project we used as a prototype for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico in our game.

She’s armed with twelve 305 mm guns placed in four main battery turrets. The cruiser's AP shells have good damage-dealing capabilities and enhanced ricochet angles. The ship also has a large HP pool and solid armor protection. The cruiser is best suited for duels at medium to long ranges, but at the same time, she’s no less effective in supporting allies with her good AA defenses to repel enemy air attacks. Her Surveillance Radar is a must-have when capturing Key Areas.

[table][tr][th]Event Rules
Combat Missions
Rewards

Event Rules
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 40 phases.
The combat missions span Updates 0.11.7; 0.11.8; and the first 3 weeks of 0.11.9. The Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.10.
In total, you can progress through 34 out of 40 shipbuilding phases by completing combat missions.
You can advance through shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard missions or spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 Doubloons to pass through each phase.
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: 12 phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png12,000 Doubloons and six phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png7,500 Doubloons. However, these packs will only be available to purchase prior to the point in time when you complete four shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d124215a-1887-11ed-af0c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Go to Armory

Note: If you want to purchase something with Coal, we recommend choosing Steel as your reward and taking advantage of the Steel-to-Coal conversion on the Armory purchase screen. The new game event tasks you with completing 90 combat missions spread across 10 groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.11.7, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Completing the first six groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases each—two phases for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group. Completing each of the remaining four combat mission groups will progress you through four shipbuilding phases—three for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group.

Completing Construction of the Ship
To complete the shipbuilding process entirely, in addition to progressing through all the combat mission groups, you'll need to spend Doubloons to finish any six shipbuilding phases.

notes.title: Two vs. Two Playing Tier VII
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0782c81589ab35b8138fcbf35f1e301287f43855.jpg
Two Brawls, both utilizing a 2 vs. 2 format, await you in Update 0.11.6. The first stage sees Tier X ships go head-to-head, and the second one puts Tier VII ships in the heat of action.

Team up with your friends and achieve more victories—this is a great opportunity to earn Coal, economic bonuses, signals, and Elite Commander XP in a short time!

Brawls are characterized by short seasons and small teams. The clashes are fast and dynamic, and players are matched by their skill level. You can participate in a Division, and you don't need to be a member of a Clan.

Participation in the Public Test will allow you to earn containers with Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items. All information on how to join the Public Test is available on a dedicated page of the official website.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867
Update 0.11.7 brings the Puerto Rico Dockyard, improvements to the battle camera, and changes to submarines. Take a look at the Developer Bulletin, and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3376028523035695564

Round 2 Schedule {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 28 Jul. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Tue. 02 Aug. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.7! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Removed settings "Fly around the ship before battle starts" and "Airstrike alternative controls".
Updated a number of UI interaction sounds and added some new ones.
Minor visual improvements to the Port of London.
Changed the camera angle in Port and in battle.
Changed camera pathing during the pre-battle countdown.
Fixed the incorrect display of some ships' torpedo arming distance.
Fixed a bug that caused the aiming reticle to shift while on the move.
Fixed bug that caused https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66da2bf0a3d0736ade533118e5131aab9b4f7c9367cbb0392c621e6888c23fe1.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngX Halland's torpedo damage to be 11,467 instead of the intended 10,700.
Fixed a bug that would cause shipbuilding sounds from the Dockyard interface to play in Port and in battle.
Fixed a bug that would prevent the sounds of submarines submerging and surfacing from playing.
Fixed a bug that could cause the game interface to freeze when switching quickly from the Clans tab to Port and back.
Fixed a bug that caused ships to not be able to move in some situations when autopilot was active.
Fixed the incorrect behavior of the overview camera for ship modules when changing Port.
Combat Missions and Rewards
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including containers with Premium ships, rare permanent camouflages, and other in-game items.

The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

notes.title: British DLC and Collection Giveaway!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/de887233512b595e7910f9125b79b284df14b9e4.jpg

Commanders!

This week, we're giving away the Long Live the King DLC ​​for free to celebrate the British Battleships event!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954810/World_of_Warships__Long_Live_the_King/

What's more—if you add the DLC to your library, then log in to the game before July 31, you will receive a container that unlocks access to the Royal Navy Destroyers collection and provides an additional day of Warships Premium Account! 

The collection is dedicated to the appearance of British destroyers in the game and reveals the history of the Royal Navy's development in the 20th century. Once you've started gathering the collection, its elements can be obtained from daily containers by activating the subscription (you can turn it on under the Collection tab).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a77b71a11e71123a255de40682fd36025338c133.png

Each Royal Navy Destroyers container includes:

 Two elements of the Royal Navy Destroyers collection — 100%
 One item from this list:

 5x «Credits +20%» expendable bonuses — 20%
 5x «Ship XP +100%» expendable bonuses — 20%
 5x «Commander XP +100%» expendable bonuses — 20%
 5x «Free XP +300%» expendable bonuses — 20%
 1,500x Free XP — 20%


The percentage indicates the drop chances of each group of items from one container.

notes.content:

Captains!

An exciting journey awaits you with Ship's Log today. Keep a sharp eye—the program is quite packed! We'll start in Belgium, then travel to the coasts of Colombia and Peru, and end up in Ecuador. Ship's Log will reward diligent captains with a lot of souvenirs for completing special combat missions. Welcome aboard, Captain! We're heading out!

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]Dockyard
Camera Improvements
Submarine Improvements
British Battleships: Part 2
Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Dockyard
Update 0.11.7 kicks off the construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico at the Dockyard. The ship is armed with twelve 305 mm guns placed in four main battery turrets. The cruiser's AP shells have good damage-dealing capabilities and enhanced ricochet angles. The ship also has a large HP pool and good armor protection.

Rules
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 40 phases. These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through Dockyard combat missions or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 Doubloons to pass through each phase. The combat missions span Update 0.11.7, 0.11.8, and the first three weeks of 0.11.9. The Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.10.

In total, you can progress through 34 out of 40 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions. Completing the 25th phase will reward you with https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVII Huron with a 6-skill-point Commander and a Port slot. The final reward is https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico with the Ceremonial permanent camouflage, a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.
If you already have https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico and upon construction completion, you'll obtain a Puerto Rico Certificate, which can be exchanged in a special section of the Armory for one of the following rewards: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png35,000 Doubloons, 33,000 Steel, or 63,000 Research Points. Thus, you'll be able to purchase any other available Tier X ship for completing shipbuilding phases at the Dockyard. If you do not exchange your Puerto Rico Certificate for one of the resources before the release of Update 0.11.10, you will automatically receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png35,000 Doubloons when the update goes live.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0aee92-0767-11ed-9ad0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e074c74-0767-11ed-88b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0e3a52-0767-11ed-937a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Camera Improvements
The battle camera will be improved in Update 0.11.7 to make gameplay experience more comfortable.
The base default view angle will be changed.
The camera performance when using Spotting Aircraft will be improved: Now, a player has two camera positions to choose from to make aiming while using Spotting Aircraft more comfortable.

Lower position, similar to the camera position without Spotting Aircraft.
Upper position, similar to the current camera position when using Spotting Aircraft.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6caa5666-0745-11ed-990b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ca0df28-0745-11ed-96e8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
New settings will be added.

Field of view: The setting allows players to set the angle of view themselves. The setting does not affect the Binocular mode.
Camera height: This allows you to raise and zoom out the camera from a ship.
Airstrike alternative controls: Enables dynamic camera zoom based on distance when using Airstrike.
When switching to Airstrike mode, the position of the main battery and torpedo launchers will be fixed.
The camera view angle in the torpedo launcher view is similar to that in the main battery view.
Improved camera performance when tracking flying shells and in replays. [hr][/hr]
Submarine Improvements
Submarines will receive a number of improvements in Update 0.11.7.

The Hydrophone consumable will be split into two—Echo-Ranging Set and Low-Frequency Hydrophone.
Echo-Ranging Set shows the position of surface ships and highlights the bottom topography.
Low-Frequency Hydrophone allows you to detect submerged submarines.
Hydrophone combines two different tasks and is often used to perform only one, while the second is performed in vain. Splitting the consumable will make playing submarines more comfortable by enabling you to activate exactly the equipment you need at a given time.

Both consumables will be available on all submarines. The settings of the new consumable types will change from the current version of Hydrophone.

Disabled guaranteed detection for submarines in submerged position.
Due to interaction specifics, it is common for submarines to accidentally detect each other. Because of this, they come under an airstrike and are forced into a duel with no possibility of safely disengaging. Disabling guaranteed detection will make playing submarines more comfortable, and in case players want to attack an enemy submarine, they will be able to use Low-Frequency Hydrophone.

The visual effect above a submarine when using sonar will also be displayed for the submarine herself.
The change will make playing submarines clearer and help players better understand enemy submarine interaction.
[hr][/hr]
British Battleships: Part 2
The Port of London has been updated as part of the continuation of Early Access to British battleships.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57bad4a-0745-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57ef054-0745-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b582065e-0745-11ed-b5c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Other Changes
Visual Improvements
Improved in-game shadow rendering for all presets. Added a new shadow quality preset—Very High. Increased detail level for High and Maximum presets.

Improved buoys. Increased model quality and added soft lamp flashing.

The minimum system requirements have been increased to require full support for DX 11 SHADER MODEL 5_0. The minimum required graphics cards are now GeForce GTX 460/Radeon HD 5770/Intel HD Graphics 4000. It will not be possible to run the game client on older graphics cards.

Other Changes
The Port of Rio de Janeiro has been added to the game to celebrate the 200th anniversary of Brazil's independence.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acc10a-0746-11ed-be95-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82a8e6ca-0746-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82ac13a4-0746-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acd6d6-0746-11ed-bf91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Updated the drop rates of items from the "Two Titans—One King" Premium container. The containers that players have on their accounts will be changed accordingly with the release of the Update:
Chances of dropping expendable camouflages reduced from 29% to 21%.
Chances of dropping permanent camouflages increased from 7% to 12%.
Chances of dropping Commanders increased from 14% to 15%.

Today, we're bringing you a chain of hot combat missions dedicated to the summer season, telling you about a combat mission for superships, and showing you how to get submarines for rent.

The Hottest Time
The ancient civilizations of Europe dubbed the unbearably hot summer days “dog days.” This was attributed to the Greek belief about the brightest star in the sky—Sirius—which is part of the Canis Major constellation. Nowadays, however, this name is much more often associated with pets spreadeagled on the ground, weary of the heat. To help you cope with the high temperatures, we've prepared some special rewards and a special combat mission chain.

You can complete several missions with several Clanmates in a single Division per battle.

Winning a battle.

notes.title: Industry Titans and British Battleships in Early Access
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d154b40b0368e79d008995a7a587264827ffa5b2.jpg
Every update injects more variety into World of Warships.

Update 0.11.6 sees a new branch of British battleships arriving in the Early Access and the introduction of the Industry Titans temporary event.

[table][tr][th]British Battleships
Industry Titans[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=jHdPxfWJmL0;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
British Battleships
The new British battleships are medium- and close-range fighters. They're equipped with guns with a short firing range, and they are also armed with torpedoes. Their efficient Repair Party consumable can restore a significant amount of any damage dealt to them.

The battleships' HE shells have standard penetration characteristics and average accuracy. Their AP shells have a typically British short fuse time. These shells are more efficient against lightly armored targets as they suffer from fewer overpenetrating hits. The guns have a solid caliber—up to 457 mm at Tier X.

Starting from Tier V, the ships are equipped with Engine Boost; from Tier VI—with Defensive AA Fire; and from Tier IX, Repair Party is replaced with Specialized Repair Teams.

Event Rules
The event will run until the release of Update 0.11.7 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week. Before starting each stage, you can choose one of three teams named after the British shipyards.
Chatham team. The shipyard in Chatham built more than 500 ships for the British Navy throughout its history.
Elswick team. The shipyard in Elswick built entire fleets for various countries and was especially famous for its cruisers.
Clydebank team. The shipyard in Clydebank was famous for its warships of all types, ranging from destroyers to battleships.
During the day, event participants will receive special missions that can be completed in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles playing Tier V ships and higher.

Completing the missions will advance you through the personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards. Your personal and team progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each new stage.

Missions
During the day, each player is issued combat missions once every 40 minutes; the time to complete each of them is limited to 120 minutes. Players can carry out only three missions simultaneously.

After a mission expires, the next mission becomes available. A total of 31 missions are available throughout each day. Battles that end after a mission expires are counted toward the next mission. The only exceptions are the last missions of the day. The time for counting the results of these missions is extended by 20 minutes.

The missions are only available during a certain time period each day. This period is extended to 22 hours. More details are available in the game client.

Personal and Team Progress
Completing the missions will earn you Points for both personal and team progress. When you reach certain personal and team milestones, you'll receive rewards.
The reward for reaching each stage of personal progress is credited immediately.
The reward for team progress is credited if your personal progress is equal to or higher than the team progress.
During each stage, you can obtain up to 10 rewards—five for personal progress and five for team progress. To obtain all 10 rewards, you need to earn 1,500 Personal Progress Points and 150,000 Team Progress Points during the week.
Earning Points
Each mission has four completion marks.
Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points.
In total, you can earn 80 Points per mission.
If you complete missions more efficiently than other players, then after completing the mission, you’ll receive from 10 to 25 additional Points, as well as see your position in the overall player standings.

The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings. A team is awarded 700; 900; or 1,200 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.

Rewards
Advancing through the personal and team progress bars can earn you themed British Commanders with 6 skill points; a researchable Tier V British ship (https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Hawkins, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Emerald, or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngV Acasta); a special reward; and a new temporary resource—British Tokens.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/22e8b6a6-028d-11ed-9783-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can collect all the unique rewards by selecting a new team each week. The ships come with all of their modules researched. The first time you earn a unique reward from any team, you'll also receive the Industry Titans achievement.

The unique reward from each team can be obtained several times if you select this team again at the beginning of a new stage and reach a certain mark in terms of personal progress. You can have an unlimited number of the themed British Commanders simultaneously.

If you already have the mentioned ships in your Port, then upon reaching a certain mark on the personal progress bar, you'll receive compensation in Credits equal to the cost of the ship with all of her modules researched.

British Tokens
You can obtain as many as 1,010 British Tokens for free. This will be enough to grab https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngVII Rooke and a special camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngVIII Hawke.
760 Tokens for participating in the Industry Titans event
50 Tokens in free daily bundles
200 Tokens in exchange for Community Tokens https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/176b1592-0208-11ed-b189-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Permanent camouflages only change the ship exterior and do not provide any economic or combat bonuses.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0590f9e-ffe9-11ec-a5d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
You can also find British Tokens in random bundles available in exchange for Doubloons. Permanent economic bonuses for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngIX Duncan and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngX St. Vincent, as well as https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Collingwood and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngIX Duncan, are available in the same bundles.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c4fb1d86-028c-11ed-8f47-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
If you already have permanent economic bonuses for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngIX Duncan or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngX St. Vincent, you'll receive compensation in the form of Doubloons.

notes.title: Guide to Separation of Exterior Visuals and Economic Bonuses
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/df3c3d1386547eac1905774dae475af963f25bc8.jpg
Our game was released almost 7 years ago. Since then, one of the crucial elements of World of Warships—its economy—hasn't changed much in its key aspects.

Over time, a lot of issues have emerged that are well worth tweaking or improving. Now, we're kicking off a major overhaul of the economic component of the game by separating visual customization from economic bonuses.

[table][tr][th]Goals of the New Changes
Key Changes
Changes to the In-Game Economy
Interface Changes
Other Changes
Armory
Transition to the New System[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Goals of the New Changes
In the process of making changes to the in-game economy, we committed to an important principle: Our players won't lose their earnings overall, and in certain cases, they will earn even more. We pursued several goals:
Offer an option to select economic bonuses and visual elements (camouflages) separately.
Provide an easier way to manage economic bonuses.
Enable a user-friendly transition from the old system to the new one.
Maintain the current state of the in-game economy, i.e., prices and earnings.
We have improved the interface, bonus management, Inventory display, and much more.
Key Changes
Economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. Camouflage patterns will change a ship's exterior only and will be used separately from these bonuses.

The new system will include the following expendable economic bonuses:
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/57d89d5e-01ed-11ed-b460-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Only one expendable economic bonus can be applied to each resource (Credits, Base XP, Free XP, and Commander XP) at the same time. This limitation serves to simplify the way the system works. The values of these bonuses are designed in such a way that they can cover even the most profitable combinations from the current system.

Permanent economic bonuses are purchased and used separately from permanent camouflages, and the effects of these bonuses are applied to a ship's economy on a permanent basis. Expendable bonuses can be used together with permanent bonuses.
After the release of the new update, all current economic signals and camouflages will be converted into the new economic bonuses.
We've made the following changes to the in-game economy:
New profitability of Tier IX–X ships.
New principles of earning Free XP and Commander XP.
Increased earning of Credits in Co-op Battles.
The bonus to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships will only be available from the Clan Naval Base.
The outcome is that camouflages are going to affect the aesthetics of ship exteriors only, so they are being stripped of all combat bonuses they previously offered. The bonus that provided a 3% reduction to detectability range by sea is now included in all ships' tech specs by default. We also removed the bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by 4%.
Changes to the In-Game Economy
XP
We've significantly increased bonuses that influence gaining Free XP and Commander XP. However, these values are no longer influenced by the bonus applied to Ship XP. The calculations are now simpler, and it will now be easier to understand how to use the system itself.
The base amount of earned Free XP has increased from 5% to 10%.
Bonus to the Reduction in the Cost of Servicing Ships
The expendable bonus to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships is a bonus to Credits by its nature. Its value greatly depends on the tier of a ship it is used with. Therefore, we decided to remove and substitute it. The system has become simpler, and the amount of earned Credits has increased.

Expendable bonuses to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships have been changed from signals or camouflages to a temporary resource that can be exchanged for other bonuses in the Armory.

Bonuses to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships provided by permanent camouflages have been replaced by an equivalent bonus to Credits. Note that it's significantly more beneficial for ships of Tier IX and below. The cost of servicing researchable Tier IX–X ships has been reduced, and the sum of Credits earned in Co-op Battles has been increased a little:
The base cost of servicing researchable ships has been reduced from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png120,000 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png115,000 Credits for Tier IX ships; from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png180,000 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png150,000 Credits for Tier X ships.
In Co-op Battles, the cost of ship servicing has been reduced by 13.3%, and the sum of earned Credits has been increased by 12.5%.
On average, the sum of earned Credits with a permanent bonus applied to Tier IX–X ships hasn't changed, and it has become even higher for ships of lower tiers. If you play with good combat performance, the sum of earned Credits will be much higher.

Changes to Basic Earnings
Since the very beginning, the XP and Credit reward system used a declining method to reward players for this or that action in the game, i.e., the first actions brought more reward than the following. This made it easier to earn small amounts of XP or Credits and hampered the gain of larger amounts. Starting from this update, we're increasing the amount that will be easier to obtain and slightly decreasing the threshold from which it'll be more difficult to obtain large amounts. For example, it'll be easier to earn a basic amount of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png200,000 Credits (i.e., Credits before using any modifiers) on Tier X ships. As a comparison, for a Tier X ship with a permanent camouflage:
Currently, in Version 0.11.5, the cost of the post-battle service is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png90,000 Credits, the profit is increased by 20%.
In the new system, after all the changes implemented in Update 0.11.6, the cost of the post-battle service will be {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png150,000 Credits, the profit will be increased by 50%.
Given {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png200,000 Credits, the profit will remain the same. However, if your earnings are higher than the amount above, the new system will be more effective. Given all the new changes, your average amount of earned Credits will remain the same or become even higher.
Interface Changes
Economic Bonuses Section
A new Economic Bonuses section has been added to the Ship Specifications section in the Port. It allows you to see all the economic bonuses applied to your ship.

Clicking the tab will open the Economic Bonuses section in the Port.

You can apply the best expendable bonuses all at once or remove them from the ship.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/068ad088-012b-11ed-863a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/069feeaa-012b-11ed-b5dc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/069f31fe-012b-11ed-a376-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/066fa0ba-012b-11ed-a8ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/067d7afa-012b-11ed-9596-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/065dd8d0-012b-11ed-ae2f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Both permanent and expendable bonuses can be applied to your ship simultaneously. In such cases, all bonuses stack up.
Level 1 and level 2 bonuses are available to purchase using Doubloons directly in the Economic Bonuses section.
Level 1 bonuses are available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png12 Doubloons; level 2 bonuses are available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png24 Doubloons. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68b1357a-012d-11ed-beb4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Auto-Resupply and Auto-Purchasing
These are two different entities that have been divided to facilitate the use of large numbers of bonuses. The auto-resupply option will always be enabled, allowing you to have the same bonus automatically applied to the ship after being used if this bonus is available. The use of this option doesn't require you to spend Doubloons.

You can enable the auto-purchase option at your discretion, and it will allow you to automatically purchase bonuses of the first two levels (for example, +20% and +40% Credits) and any camouflages that you expend.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/067b804c-012b-11ed-8b49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Large to Small Bonus Exchange
During the conversion process, we aim to provide the player with more large bonuses, but it may decrease the total number on your account compared to the number of signals and camouflages. If you want to use smaller bonuses more often than larger ones, in a few game updates, you will be able to to exchange them in the Inventory.

The exchange process ensures that the aggregate value of the bonuses is maintained. For example, a +7,200% to Free XP bonus can be divided into three +2,400% bonuses. Each of them can be further divided into four +600% bonuses, and each of them can be divided into two +300% bonuses. Bonuses can only be exchanged for those available in the new system. For example, you can't divide a +100% to XP bonus into two +50% bonuses.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b21f3eea-0138-11ed-a9a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
To mitigate potential inconveniences related to shifting to the new system, we'll grant you one bonus of every type and value, regardless of what you have at your disposal. Sixteen additional bonuses in total.
Exterior Section
Along with separating the economic bonuses, we've updated the Camouflages tab in the Exterior section.

Camouflages are divided by themed categories.

Players will always be able to obtain the majority of expendable camouflages, except special camos—co-branded; status; or especially rare, such as Recruiting Station, King of the Sea, or Gold. Available camouflages can be auto-purchased for Credits or obtained from the brand-new More Camouflages container. It will be available as a daily container, can be purchased for Community Tokens, or can be found in various bundles or combat missions.

Camouflages will cost from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png22,500 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png90,000 Credits, depending on their category:
Standard, e.g., Type 1 or European—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png22,500 Credits.
Single Color, e.g., Type 21 or Trophy—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png45,000 Credits.
Abstract, e.g., Ocean Soul or French Riviera—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png75,000 Credits.
Themed, e.g., Union Jack or Summer—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png90,000 Credits.
Some camouflages will become available under the tab as your account access level increases. To have the majority of them displayed, you'll have to obtain these camouflages from any source first. If an expendable camouflage was available on your account but its stock was completely spent before the release of Update 0.11.6, it will be available to obtain in the new system.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ccc1057e-0135-11ed-b17b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ccd18b74-0135-11ed-a64b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdb30630-0135-11ed-9a4a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cccd9744-0135-11ed-9e1e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
You can sell any of your camouflages, except special ones, in the Inventory. The option to sell special camouflage is going to be added to the game in one of upcoming updates.

The auto-resupply and auto-purchase options will also be available for camouflages.
Permanent Bonuses and Camouflages
Permanent camouflages and permanent economic bonuses can now be obtained separately. The cost of an economic bonus is a little lower than that of a permanent camouflage.
The first permanent camouflage that you purchase for a researchable ship in the Exterior section will be available at a discount if you didn't have a permanent camouflage for this ship before the release of Update 0.11.6. This discount will remain in place if you obtain the camouflage for this ship from another source after the release of Update 0.11.6.
The total combined cost of a bonus and the first camouflage is equal to the cost of a permanent camouflage prior to the update.
All subsequently obtained permanent camouflages for the same ship will have the same cost as before.
Let's take an example. If you have  X Yamato without permanent camouflages and economic bonuses, then:
Cost of a permanent economic bonus is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png4,800 Doubloons.
Cost of the first-purchased permanent camouflage is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png4,800 Doubloons lower. For example, the Scorpioid camouflage costs {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png3,200 Doubloons; Type 20—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png200 Doubloons.
The cost of the second and subsequently purchased permanent camouflages is the same as before. For example, Scorpioid camouflage costs {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png8,000 Doubloons; Type 20—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 Doubloons.
Thus, the value of already available permanent camouflages and economic bonuses remains the same. The first permanent camouflage can now be purchased at a much lower price.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c6fc4cea-0138-11ed-a92a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Permanent camouflages that weren't attached to a ship and could be used with any ship of a specific tier will be converted into two different entities:
Permanent economic bonus that corresponds to a standard bonus for the tier.
Permanent camouflage that only effects the visual exterior of the ship.
These entities do not necessarily have to be bound to the same ship. The camouflage can be bound to one ship and the bonus to another.

Combat Signals
Combat signal management is performed in the Equipment tab.

In addition to changes to the interface and in-game economy, we've also updated the icons for resources, signals, and camouflages.

The total number of combat signals, camouflages, and economic bonuses displayed in the game client includes those already attached to your ships. Now, you'll always be aware of the total sum of your stock—you'll see the total number of signals and camouflages on your account.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d5a7767a-0138-11ed-8300-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg [hr][/hr]
Other Changes
Updated Rewards
The large-scale updates and addition of a new entity have resulted in changes to all rewards in the game. Economic and special signals will be replaced by bonuses in combat missions, campaigns, Operations, and collections. The variety of camouflages has been increased, and some camouflages have also been replaced by bonuses.

The contents of all containers with signals or camouflages have changed.
After the release of the update, detailed information about the updated rewards will be available in the game client and on our website.
Clan Base Bonuses
Bonuses to Free XP and Commander XP are no longer related to ships' XP. Hence, the Naval Academy provides an XP bonus that doesn't influence other XP types. This has resulted in changes to Clan Base structures.
Bonuses to Free XP of all levels provided by the Design Bureau have been doubled. The completed structure will give you +50% Free XP for Tier I–X ships instead of 25%.
The bonus to Commander XP for every level in the Academy has been increased by 1%. The completed structure will give you +15% Commander XP instead of 10%.
Premium Account
Premium Account provides bonuses to all types of XP and Credits as it did prior to the changes to the system. However, note that XP bonuses no longer effect Free XP and Commander XP.

Just as it did prior to the update, Premium Account still increases the Base XP and Credits you earn. Premium Account will increase your Base XP and Credit earnings in a similar way to the old system.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8f6d0170-0138-11ed-a9a3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Bonus to XP for the First Victory
The bonus for the first victory of the day will give you +50% XP, +50% Free XP, and +50% Commander XP.

Missouri
All players who have a special combat mission for Missouri will obtain an improved permanent Credit bonus instead. Players will receive +40% Credits instead of +10%. This facilitates the bonus tracking process.

Daily Containers
In Update 0.11.6, the following daily containers will be available for all players:
More Economic Rewards, which replaces the More Credits container
More Signals
More Coal
Try Your Luck
Brand-new More Camouflages container
Expendable camouflages have been removed from all daily containers except the More Camouflages and Try Your Luck containers. Containers have been complemented with expendable economic bonuses.

Detailed information about contents of containers, their mechanics, and drop rates can be found here.

Access Levels
Apart from that, the following two account access levels are going to be added to support the upcoming changes:
Level 5, unlocking signals
Level 7, unlocking economic bonuses for ships
This means that we're increasing the total number of access levels to 17. At the same time, the total number of battles that need to be fought to unlock all access levels will remain the same. Players won't lose any progress in terms of unlocking access levels. They will receive all missed rewards.

You can read about the rewards for unlocking access levels and the required number of battles to unlock them in the game client.
[hr][/hr]
Armory
Customizations
In the Customizations section, economic signals and expendable camouflages have been replaced by bundles with expendable economic bonuses available for Coal.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/21af1a4c-0138-11ed-9a4a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Naval Community
After the release of Update 0.11.6, all permanent camouflages for researchable ships, all expendable camouflages, and the Signal Spoils bundle will cease to be available in the Naval Community section. The tab now holds bundles with economic bonuses and the brand-new More Camouflages container.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49f4db18-012e-11ed-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Coupons
In August, a new permanent coupon will be implemented in the game. It will provide a discount when purchasing economic bonuses for Coal. The coupon can be used four times until its next reset.

Economic Bonus Tokens
Service cost reduction bonuses from expendable camouflages and signals have been replaced by Economic Bonus Tokens. They can be exchanged in a special section of the Armory for other bonuses until the release of Update 0.11.8. Level 1 bonuses (for example, +20% to Credits) will cost 3 Tokens; level 2 bonuses—6 Tokens; level 3 bonuses—24 Tokens.
With the release of Update 0.11.8, these Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png6,000.
Exchange rate of bonuses for Tokens. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7f338964-012e-11ed-b899-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg [hr][/hr]
Transition to the New System
With the release of the update, economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. The rules for permanent camouflages, expendable camouflages, and signals are slightly different.

Permanent Camouflages
You will receive permanent bonuses with the best values available from those of your permanent camouflages for specific ships.
If you had worse bonuses than the standard ones for a tier, they will be improved accordingly.
The post-battle service cost reduction bonus is replaced by a Credit bonus: For every 2% of service cost reduction, you get +1% Credits.
What if a camouflage didn't apply a bonus to Free XP or Commander XP but applied a bonus to XP per battle? Then, you get not only a bonus to XP per battle but also bonuses to other types of XP.
The permanent camouflage for superships is an exception, and it will provide +200% XP, +200% Commander XP, and +100% Free XP. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74936832-01ea-11ed-bee9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
1 For researchable ships, permanent bonuses are available for purchase from Tier V. For Premium ships, permanent bonuses are active by default.
2 The base cost of servicing researchable Tier IX and X ships has been reduced with the release of Update 0.11.6.
3 The value of the bonus is lower because the basic Free XP earnings have been doubled with the release of the update. This means that all bonuses that were previously applied by supership permanent camouflages are higher in the new system.

In addition, there are a number of permanent camouflages with non-standard bonuses:
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b55098e2-01f7-11ed-8fb8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Expendable Camouflages
Camouflages will remain on your account, but they will only affect the look of your ships' exteriors. Moreover:
Combat bonuses have been removed.
The standard detectability range of all ships has been reduced by 3%.
Removed a bonus that increased shell dispersion by 4%.
Economic bonuses now act as individual in-game entities.
The bonuses you get depend on the specific camouflage. The general rules are:
A bonus to XP per battle is converted into either the same or the next larger one. For example, +100% will become a +100% bonus, and +125% will become +200%.
Bonuses to Commander XP are calculated from bonuses to this type of XP and XP per battle. For example, if a camouflage provides +50% XP per battle and +100% Commander XP, it will increase Commander XP by 150% in the current system. The nearest bonus in the new system is 200%, so exactly this bonus will be given.
Bonuses to Free XP are calculated from bonuses to this type of XP and XP per battle. Keep in mind that Free XP earnings are now twice as large.
What if a camouflage didn't apply a bonus to Free XP or Commander XP but applied a bonus to XP per battle? Then, you get not only a bonus to XP per battle but also bonuses to other types of XP. This is because the bonuses to different types of XP are no longer related to each other.
Bonuses to Credits will be converted into either the same or next larger one. For example, +30% to Credits will become a +40% bonus to Credits.
Signals
The system before the update made it possible to use several expendable bonuses of the same type at the same time, but the new system allows you to use only one to simplify things. However, we wanted to preserve the ability to achieve high bonus values, so the conversion will work like this:

Step 1
First, we check if a player has the maximum possible bonuses of a particular type on their account. For example, a complete "set" of special signals for Credits would be the Scylla, Leviathan, Basilisk, and Wyvern signals.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2221e11c-0138-11ed-842c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Step 2
One signal can fall within in several such sets. For example, Hydra provides a bonus to all types of XP. In this case, we count how many of the different sets the signals fall within. The number of received bonuses of each type is equal to the minimum number of signals required for the bonus. For example, if you have 100 Scylla, Leviathan, and Basilisk signals, but only 80 Wyvern signals, you will receive 80 bonuses to Credits.

Step 3
Bonuses from signals in sets are counted individually.

Example
Let's suppose an account has 250 Leviathan signals. Let's assume that, taking into account other signals, it participates in sets the following number of times:
[table][tr][th]XP[/th][th]Commander XP[/th][th]Free XP[/th][th]Credits[/th][/tr] [tr][td]100[/td] [td]80[/td] [td]50[/td] [td]150[/td][/tr][/table]
Subtract these values from the total number of Leviathan signals to get the number of bonuses of each type that will participate in further conversion:
[table][tr][th]XP[/th][th]Commander XP[/th][th]Free XP[/th][th]Credits[/th][/tr] [tr][td]250 — 100 = 150[/td] [td]250 — 80 = 170[/td] [td]250 — 50 = 200[/td] [td]250 — 150 = 100[/td][/tr][/table]
After calculating the number of bonuses for sets, the remaining signals are converted into bonuses according to the following table:
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2259a71e-0138-11ed-adff-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
* The bonus to Free XP is provided taking into account the bonus to XP and the doubling of Free XP earnings with the release of the changes.

Merging Bonuses
After the conversion, the bonuses received at the last step are merged according to the table below. This helps to take into account combinations of several signals from the old system that were not taken into account by full sets. Rounding up is applied if the bonuses are not sufficient in number. For example, if there are only two +200% XP bonuses, one +800% bonus will be given.

Bonuses for sets are not combined.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6cfdab0c-012f-11ed-b899-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Service Cost Reduction https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/218f04dc-0138-11ed-a64b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Flags
A small number of flags have economic bonuses. These are mainly flags for members of various volunteer programs, as well as for winners of the King of the Sea tournament. In the new system, these bonuses are not tied to the flags and are always active if they are available on an account.

There are three such "global" bonuses in total. The "For Personal Merits" bonus is always active.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/21ba04c0-0138-11ed-a2e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The winners of the latest King of the Sea tournament receive a level 3 bonus.
Those who have one flag with economic bonuses, except the King of the Sea flag, receive a level 1 bonus.
Those who have more than one flag with economic bonuses, except the King of the Sea flag, receive a level 2 bonus.
