Read through this article carefully, and keep your eyes peeled for a gift! Share this article with your friends and Clanmates so they can arm themselves with all the essential info for this update! [hr][/hr]
Pan-Asian Cruisers
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4b2a3a10-72c6-11ec-898b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The ships of the new branch have small-caliber guns with high rates of fire and powerful deepwater torpedoes, but they cannot boast of having high survivability.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e80da3fe-72ca-11ec-951d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03ec661e-7221-11ec-84df-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03d45aa6-7221-11ec-92e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04683b0e-7221-11ec-8eb5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/043fe320-7221-11ec-8d9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03d8898c-7221-11ec-a157-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Consumables
All ships in the branch are equipped with a variant of the Smoke Generator consumable with a reduced cooldown time.
The new Tier VI and higher cruisers have Defensive AA Fire.
The Tier VII and higher ships have the Torpedo Reload Booster consumable.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngIX Sejong and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngX Jinan are equipped with Repair Party.
Early Access
Rewards: Completing combat missions will earn you a new temporary resource—Pan-Asian Tokens—as well as ships https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Chungking and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngVII Chumphon for completing the second and fourth combat mission groups, respectively.

Pan-Asian Tokens can also be obtained from random bundles available for Doubloons, free daily bundles, and in exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.

https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_7c644d2bd3e7a71a90f1aed7ac9713ee597a33cd89aadb235cdd9e9e0647e798.png Pan-Asian Tokens are a new temporary resource that can be earned for completing combat mission groups. Moreover, Pan-Asian Tokens can be obtained from random bundles available for Doubloons, free daily bundles, and in exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.

Rewards for Pan-Asian Tokens: Sequential bundles with https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngVI Rahmat and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngVIII Harbin, Silk Sunrise permanent camouflages for researchable Pan-Asian Tier VII–X cruisers, plus other rewards.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/caa34958-7221-11ec-9ee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngX Jinan will become available for purchase in exchange for Doubloons after you obtain all the sequential bundles available for the Tokens.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngIX Sejong is available in random bundles for Doubloons.
The Dragon Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the Pan-Asian cruisers in Early Access.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8ee46f0c-721f-11ec-a157-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8df4e09a-721f-11ec-88c9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8dfeca88-721f-11ec-bb9d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
When Update 0.11.2 goes live, the Pan-Asian cruisers will become available for all players to research. [hr][/hr]

Asymmetric Battles
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a608d1e-72c6-11ec-973a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The last 2 weeks of the update will see the return of Asymmetric Battles—a temporary battle type with a different distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

Rules {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 03 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Thu. 17 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Format
First team
Tiers: IX and X
Number of ships: 6–8
Second team
Tiers: VII and VIII
Number of ships: 9–12
Asymmetric Battles are available only during a certain Prime Time period each day. This allows us to improve the balance of teams and reduce the number of bots in battle, as well as reduce their influence on the outcome of the battle. If there aren't enough players in the matchmaking queue, bots may be added to teams. Details will be available in the game client and in a dedicated article on our website.

https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_1_dabc836c60fdb1c87963eb0ab8242e01ac09f7b06b72d73affa0fc6a703a67f7.png Battle Tokens are a temporary resource that is required to enter battle playing Tier IX–X ships. You can earn these Tokens by participating in Asymmetric Battles playing Tier VII–VIII ships. When you first log in during Update 0.11.0, you will be credited enough Tokens to enter one battle playing a Tier IX–X ship.

You can earn Community Tokens by completing special daily and weekly combat missions during the event. [hr][/hr]

Rental Superships
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a96eef4-72c6-11ec-b5ac-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Superships and their mechanics have been of great interest to players so far, and these ships may one day become a full-fledged part of World of Warships. In the future, we want to continue the existing branches by adding superships. We consider this to be a logical step, and we are confident that superships do not fit into Tier X because of their superiority over their "predecessors" in terms of their performance characteristics.

This is a big and important decision for World of Warships. For this reason, we've planned thorough testing of the superships based on our previous experience.

We're carefully monitoring both the data we receive and your feedback. The current Ranked season has shown that superships fit into the current game concept and have been warmly received by players.

Therefore, starting from Update 0.11.0, the testing of superships will continue not only in Ranked and Co-op Battles but also in Random Battles.

Random Battles have a different format compared to Ranked Battles—12 vs. 12. It's important to test superships in these conditions because they significantly change the battle tempo and density, which means that the effectiveness of superships may change. The high popularity of Random Battles will allow us to collect the necessary statistics and get feedback for the further development of superships.

Only Tier IX and X ships will be able to participate in battles with superships, and the standard restrictions on the number of ships of certain types and tiers apply in battle.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3df683b6-7222-11ec-8d9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e99887c-7222-11ec-a157-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e1658ee-7222-11ec-bb9d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3ea1c870-7222-11ec-88c9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e978d06-7222-11ec-92e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e1645e8-7222-11ec-8eb5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
In Update 0.11.0, rental superships will be available from random bundles in the Armory. Each random bundle provides 6-day rental superships or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png100 Coal.
Changes to Yamagiri
We have added an alternative torpedo module. You can now choose one of two sets of torpedoes under the Equipment tab:
Type F3 (range 8 km) and Type 93 (range 20 km).
Type 93 mod. 3 (range 12 km) and Type 93 (range 20 km).
Detailed characteristics of torpedoes are available in the game client.
[hr][/hr]

Division Stars
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4b2b7be6-72c6-11ec-b598-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Division Stars, which are available during the update, are special bonuses issued for playing together with each Clanmate.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e4c191e0-72c7-11ec-b598-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
You can get a Division Star by playing in a Division with your Clanmates.
The Stars can be earned in all battle types, except for Training Battles.
Certain numbers of earned Stars unlock access to various rewards.
If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously received remain with you.
To see the roster of Clanmates who you can team up with in a Division, as well as the list of rewards you can get, navigate to the Division Star tab in the Clans section.

By playing together with each of your Clanmates, you can get a total of up to 3 Stars—one for each fulfilled condition:
Victory in battle.
Earning the General Offensive achievement.
Earning the Brothers-in-Arms achievement. [hr][/hr]

Submarines
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a64d1ee-72c6-11ec-8471-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Following the Public Test of Update 0.11.0, we realized that the changes we had planned do not lead to the desired results. Submarines continue to underperform compared to other ship types. Therefore, we decided to temporarily stop testing submarines on the Live Server so we can prepare additional changes.
From Update 0.11.0 until Update 0.11.2, submarines will not be available on the Live Server. We plan to resume testing submarines in Update 0.11.2, and additional mechanics improvements will be made ahead of that.
You can read more about the submarine test results on our Development Blog.
[hr][/hr]

Brawls
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4c255260-72c6-11ec-bbca-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Two Brawls await you in Update 0.11.0.

Seventh Brawl {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Mon. 24 Jan. 09:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Mon. 31 Jan. 02:00 CET (UTC+1)

Format: 3 vs. 3 playing Tier V ships

Restrictions: no more than two ships of each type per team

You can take part in the Brawl only during the time period specified for your server.

Eighth Brawl {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Mon. 07 Feb. 09:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Mon. 14 Feb. 02:00 CET (UTC+1)

Format: 2 vs. 2 playing Tier VII ships

Restrictions: no more than one battleship per team
You can take part in the Brawl only during the time period specified for your server.
Game Maps and Modes
Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Loop, Greece, Crash Zone Alpha, and Northern Waters with a reduced combat area in Domination mode.

Rewards
Up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png2,250,000 Credits; 80,000 Elite Commander XP; and 72 combat and economic signals.
You'll find detailed descriptions of the new Brawls in a dedicated article.
[hr][/hr]
Changes to Aircraft
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a417a0a-72c6-11ec-b089-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

For convenience in interacting with aircraft and maintaining the progression through ship tiers, we have standardized the characteristics of all carrier-based and patrol fighters, including those carried by Premium and special ships.

The changes will not affect the amount of HP of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVI Béarn fighters because powerful fighters with a small field of view are one of the features of this ship.

We have slightly reworked the aircraft camera performance during the preparation for an attack and during an attack of attack aircraft and torpedo bombers of the researchable Soviet aircraft carriers, as well as the https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVIII Chkalov torpedo bombers. These changes will improve the aiming experience without affecting gameplay.
[hr][/hr]

Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4b0f3dc8-72c6-11ec-a84b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Incomparable—a project of a very large and high-speed battlecruiser developed in 1915—will become available in the Armory when the update goes live.

She is armed with six powerful 508 mm main battery guns with a high rate of fire for a battleship, as well as two quadruple-tube torpedo launchers with a good torpedo range and tube-by-tube launching capabilities. The ship is capable of achieving high speeds and has decent AA defenses.

The battleship has a wide range of consumables at her disposal: Specialized Repair Teams; Short-Range Hydroacoustic Search; and Engine Boost, which is rarely found on ships of this type. She can also choose between the Fighter and Spotting Aircraft consumables. You can get her in exchange for 31,000 Steel.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1a5a1bc4-7223-11ec-8471-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The new Griffin permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Plymouth has been added and made available in exchange for 3 Clan Tokens.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1a50f4a4-7223-11ec-8d2c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The display of the number of upgrades, camouflages, and signals already available on player accounts has been added to the Armory.
[hr][/hr]

Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a6e9800-72c6-11ec-9427-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Changes to Containers
Battle of Jutland containers were renamed Battle of Jutland Premium containers.
A new Battle of Jutland container was added that drops one item from the following list:
A ship (battleship https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIII König Albert or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Agincourt) with a Port slot and Commander with 10 skill points, or a permanent camouflage ("To Honor Skagerrak" for König Albert or Jutland Veteran for Agincourt) — 1%
1x Battle of Jutland camouflage — 39%
4x signals of the same type (Zulu, Equal Speed Charlie London, Papa Papa, or Zulu Hotel) — 40%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png1,500 Free XP — 10%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png100,000 Credits — 10%    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ee1ab892-7223-11ec-84df-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Agincourt will also be available in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons.
Battle of Jutland Container Mechanics
The chances of obtaining a particular reward from a group are the same for all items in the group. If a container drops an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group, you will receive an item that you do not already have. The drop chances of a specific group don't change, regardless of how many items you already have from that group.

If you already have all the ships or permanent camouflages from the list and a Battle of Jutland container drops an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group, you will receive the Battle of Jutland camouflage.

Battle of Jutland containers have the guaranteed drop mechanic applied: If an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group does not drop after you open 249 Battle of Jutland containers, you are guaranteed to find an item from this group in the 250th container of this type.

Detailed information about the container mechanics and how to obtain them will be published later.

Starting with Update 0.11.0, for all standard Premium Ship containers, players will receive compensation in Credits if they already have all the ships that this container type can drop. The special version of the Premium Ship container will still compensate players in Doubloons.
Changes to Camouflages
An alternative color scheme was added for special permanent camouflages for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Tirpitz and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Scharnhorst.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/eeb9fe8e-7223-11ec-a363-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Tech Tree Changes in Update 0.11.1
Several months ago, we announced changes to the German and Soviet Tech Trees. With the release of Update 0.11.1,  X Grosser Kurfürst and  X Khabarovsk will be replaced with  X Preussen and  X Delny, respectively.

After this,  X Grosser Kurfürst and  X Khabarovsk will be added to the Armory and become available for Coal. Detailed information about the replacement of these ships is available in a dedicated article on our website.

Replacement Mechanics
If a player has  X Grosser Kurfürst and  X Khabarovsk in their Port when the replacement happens, they will receive compensation in the form of a sum of Credits equal to half of these ships' cost. At the same time, Grosser Kurfürst and Khabarovsk will remain on the accounts of their owners.
Compensation for  X Grosser Kurfürst is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png10,300,000 Credits.
If the 420 mm main battery guns were researched, the player will also receive compensation of 35,000 XP for this ship.
If the 420 mm main battery guns were purchased, the player will also receive compensation of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png2,500,000 Credits.
Compensation for  X Khabarovsk is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png9,400,000 Credits.
Thank you for being an attentive reader! Click "Collect Your Gift" to claim {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Warships Premium Account. The day of Warships Premium Account will start immediately after you click the button.

Other Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4aaa5714-72c6-11ec-a7ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The torpedo reticle brightness now increases automatically when sun reflections are visible in the background.
Added the wave rocking effect for boats on the Two Brothers, Hotspot, and Neighbors maps.
Updated the names of main, anti-aircraft, and secondary guns on French, American, British, and Commonwealth ships.
Added the ability to earn achievements when playing superships.
With the "Custom" sound setting enabled, the audio volume of fire can be adjusted with only the "Damage audio volume" slider.
Increased the working speed of the ship filter in the Port.
Added the wave rocking effect for the cargo ship in all Ports.
Fixed an error that caused the width of torpedo reticle spread to change with a delay on some ships.
Fixed an error that caused shells fired over long distances to travel with an incorrect velocity in some cases.
Fixed an error that caused the HP of aircraft to be displayed incorrectly if some aircraft within the attacking flight were damaged.
Fixed an error that caused an incorrect viewing range to be displayed in the ship characteristics and the Minimap when a ship entered a cyclone.
Fixed an error that caused the acceleration time on https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png Satsuma and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngX Yamato to not change if their engines were damaged.
Fixed an error that caused the notification about new Dockyard rewards to be displayed even after they had been received.
Fixed an error that caused a performance decrease in the game client when switching to the torpedo reticle.
Fixed an error that sometimes made it impossible to destroy secondary armament / anti-aircraft armament, torpedo launchers, guns, and other ship modules.  Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to Player Support.

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.11.0! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Balance changes to https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png Yamagiri were made. You can obtain superships on the Public Test Server for completing a special combat mission playing Tier X ships. More details are available in the game client.
You can earn Community Tokens for completing combat missions on the Public Test Server.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03e696143eeb99c0af7b460075b261d60d9aa6ed.jpg
Read on to learn about a new temporary event and the "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" collection.

[table][tr][th]New Year's Night
Rules
Missions
Personal and team progress
Earning Points
Rewards
Star Tokens
The "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" Collection[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=N4CotngUVmM;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
New Year's Night
The New Year's Night temporary event awaits you in festive Update 0.10.11. Magic stars brought three snow giants to life, and those snow giants now have the responsibility to prepare the festive celebrations. Each star entrusted its snow giant with an errand in preparation for the celebrations. Help them contribute to the celebration!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 23 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Thu. 20 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

New Year's Night is similar to the Battle of the Beasts and Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry events that took place in Updates 0.10.4 and 0.10.8, respectively. We have made minor changes to the interface only: The tooltips on the team selection screen and above the mission cards have been updated.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a733de0e-5e73-11ec-83e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a9ac47e8-5e73-11ec-947c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac90be6c-5e73-11ec-834f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af41c728-5e73-11ec-ac52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2ca8cc2-5e73-11ec-bf01-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]

Rules
The event will run until the release of Update 0.11.0 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week. Before starting each stage, you can choose one of three teams named after the magic stars:
Team Modus: The snow giant brought to life by the Modus star has been entrusted with creating a festive mood.
Team Sertum: The snow giant brought to life by the Sertum star has been entrusted with decorating the Holiday Tree with fairy lights and toys.
Team Munera: The snow giant brought to life by the Munera star has been entrusted with giving New Year gifts.
During the day, event participants will receive special missions that can be completed in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles. Completing the missions will advance you through the personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards. Your personal and team progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each new stage.

All players who have reached Access Level 8 can participate in the event.
[hr][/hr]
Missions
Three mission types, with a limited allotted time for each mission, will be available to you each day.

Missions are assigned sequentially once every 40 minutes. You will receive a total of 25 missions during the day. Each mission should be completed within 120 minutes.

After a mission expires, the next mission of the same type becomes available. Battles that end after a mission expires are counted toward the next mission. The only exceptions are the last missions of the day. The time for counting the results of these missions is extended by 20 minutes.
The missions are only available during a certain time period each day. More details are available in the game client.
[hr][/hr]
Personal and team progress
Completing the missions will earn you Points for both personal and team progress. When you reach specific personal and team milestones, you will receive rewards:
The reward for reaching each stage of personal progress is credited immediately.
The reward for team progress is credited if your personal progress is equal to or higher than the team progress.
During each stage, you can obtain up to 10 rewards—five for personal progress and five for team progress. To obtain all 10 rewards during the week, you need to earn 1,500 Personal Progress Points and 150,000 Team Progress Points.
[hr][/hr]
Earning Points
Each mission has four completion marks. Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points. In total, you can earn 80 Points in one mission. If you complete missions more efficiently than other players, then after completing the mission, you’ll receive from 10 to 25 additional Points, as well as see your position in the overall player standings.

The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings. A team is awarded 700; 900; or 1,200 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.
[hr][/hr]
Rewards
Advancing through the personal and team progress bars can earn you themed Commanders; https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Omaha, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngV Conte di Cavour, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngV Jaguar, each with the Snow and Stars permanent camouflage; a new temporary resource—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_2949a8a229f2246eaf7a90ca8e43e15593606e41c27ca88657864966a6b07d19.png Star Tokens, containers with elements of the Christmas and New Year in the Navy collection, as well as the New Year Sky expendable camouflages.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/90ae67e2-5290-11ec-b8a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/bfcf3c86-5290-11ec-88c5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

[hr][/hr]
Rental Superships in Random Battles in 0.11.0
As we've already mentioned, superships with special mechanics have the potential to become a full-fledged part of World of Warships, given the interest shown in them. In the future, we want to continue the existing branches with superships. In addition to the logic of this continuation of the branches, we also believe that due to the superiority of superships in terms of their performance characteristics over their "predecessors," they do not fit into Tier X.

This is a big and important step for our game. Based on our previous experience, we planned to test them thoroughly. We're carefully monitoring both the data we receive and your feedback. The current Ranked Season has shown that superships fit into the current game concept and have been warmly received by players.

Therefore, starting from Update 0.11.0, the testing of superships will continue not only in Ranked and Co-op Battles but also in Random Battles—the most popular battle type in the game. This will allow us to better assess the current state of superships and continue to refine the content that is important for the game development.

In addition, Random Battles have a different format from that of Ranked Battles—12 vs. 12. It's important to test superships in this battle type because this significantly changes the battle tempo and density, which means that the effectiveness of superships may change.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf4459e4-5cb8-11ec-87cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf575576-5cb8-11ec-b48b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf5d1826-5cb8-11ec-a574-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf54c6f8-5cb8-11ec-8d2c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf5f57e4-5cb8-11ec-b663-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf31ee12-5cb8-11ec-91b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
In Update 0.11.0, rental superships will be available from random bundles in the Armory. Only Tier IX and X ships will be able to participate in battles with superships, and the standard restrictions on the number of ships of certain types and tiers apply in battle.
[hr][/hr]
Asymmetric Battles
The update sees the return of Asymmetric Battles—a temporary battle type with a different distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

We've changed the tiers of ships you can helm into battle.

First team
Tiers: IX and X
Number of ships: 6–8
Second team
Tiers: VII and VIII
Number of ships: 9–12
If there aren't enough players in the matchmaking queue, bots may be added to teams.

To participate playing a Tier IX–X ship, a new temporary resource—Battle Tokens—is required. You can earn these Tokens for completing combat missions by participating in Asymmetric Battles playing Tier VII–VIII ships.
[hr][/hr]
Submarine Tweaks
We've updated the sonar ping and torpedo mechanics. A submarine can now simultaneously maintain sonar pings on several enemy ships.
Sonar pings that hit a ship are now either active or inactive.
After you launch torpedoes, they home in on an active ping hit sector and continue to home in on the sector if it becomes inactive. At the same time, torpedoes you release cannot be redirected to another target.
Only the last sonar ping that hits an enemy ship is considered to be active.
If a ship has an active ping hit sector and torpedoes are homing in on the sector, it will become inactive when the ping hits another ship.
If a ship has an active ping hit sector and torpedoes are not homing in on the sector, it will disappear when the ping hits another ship.
These changes will prevent submarines from changing the target their torpedoes are homing in on, but they will also give them the ability to efficiently counter multiple opponents at once.

Detectability Changes
Submarines at the operating depth can now detect ships in smoke from the assured acquisition range.
Ships in smoke can now detect submarines at the operating depth from the assured acquisition range.
Fixed a bug that caused submarines to be affected by a 20-second detectability penalty after using a sonar ping.
Fixed a bug that caused ships' detectability to increase for submarines after firing main battery guns while in smoke.We have also made a number of balance changes to submarines and anti-submarine weapons. The full details are available on our Development Blog.

Captains!

Recently, two bugs have been found on the main server:
some ship modules have become indestructible;
HP is incorrectly distributed to different parts of the ship when the Survivability Expert skill is active. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The fix for the issue will be deployed Fri. 17 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Expected downtime: ~1 hour.
Please be aware that because of this, cross-server Clan Battles will not be available on the days the patch is being applied.

Instead of reverting the mechanics, the fix will adjust how getting additional HP works in general (this covers such cases as Survivability Expert or, for example, HP buffs in Arms Race). Additional HP will be distributed among different parts of the ship proportionally instead of being put into the hull. As an example of what effect it might have, a destroyer with about 2,000–2,500 HP in the bow section and roughly 20,000 total HP, the increase of HP in the bow would be about 400 HP, which will not lead to a significant gameplay change. We understand that it won't be a full revert to how it was before, but we were planning to change this mechanic as it will help to improve the technical state of the game and keep the mechanics consistent.

As for the bug with indestructible modules — regrettably, the fix will only be deployed with the release of 0.11.0 due to the noticeable technical risk caused by applying it without sufficient testing, since it concerns the game's crucial damage dealing logic. We will also adjust the combat missions in the Dockyard which require destroying modules.

We apologize for this situation and would like to offer you a token of gratitude in the form of 3 WG containers — each dropping a day of Premium account — in each one which you will be able to claim by pressing the button below until the end of the year.

notes.title: Hot Fix: Testing and Bug Fixing
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c3c581e0739c9b5539b1ad4f1941411c15100dac.jpg
Anyone who plays video games encounters program errors sooner or later.

These types of errors have hindered players since the emergence of the gaming industry. We are used to them and not-so-affectionately nickname them "bugs." Bugs can be found everywhere, and World of Warships is no exception. Our project comprises millions of constantly updated lines of code, a huge amount of content, and a complex system of interactions between players' computers and our servers. All this creates a multitude of relationships in which mistakes can occur. Today, you will learn about how we reduce the number of bugs that reach the main server and how we fix those that are overlooked.

[table][tr][th]What Is a Bug?
How Is Testing Performed?
Occurrence of Bugs
Fixing
How to Report a Bug[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=ojnIAFJ_CzQ;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]

What Is a Bug?
The term "bug" is probably familiar to most gamers.

A bug is an error that causes the actual result of a program's operation to differ from the expected one.

In the early days of the game, we divided bugs into two main types: bugs in the game content and bugs in the code. Now, there are many more types.
[hr][/hr]

How Is Testing Performed?
Quality assurance (QA) teams are responsible for finding and fixing bugs in World of Warships.

QA departments exist in most World of Warships development teams. For example:
Content: Checking models, sounds, visuals, and more.
Game logic: Checking the correct operation of the game mechanics.
Server core: Checking the correct operation of the game servers.
QA's job is to understand how certain things are implemented in the game. To do this, they study the documentation and communicate with developers. After that, they develop testing processes and schemes that are used to check the program's compliance with its expected behavior.

Both negative and positive tests are carried out when testing the program:
Positive testing uses scenarios that match the normal, expected behavior of the program. For example, checking that a user can enter the game client upon entering the correct password.
Negative testing involves performing "incorrect" actions deliberately (abnormal scenarios). For example, checking if it is possible to log in to the game client by entering an incorrect password or leaving the password input field blank.
Other types of checks are carried out if deemed necessary: performance tests, user friendliness tests, and others.

In World of Warships, testing can be simplified into several main stages.

Internal testing:
Various types of functionality testing at all stages of functionality creation, such as:
Ideation
Design
Development
Integration testing, or checking that all the individual parts of the game work correctly when put together and added to the main game code.
Testing an assembled build for obvious defects before an external test.
A build is a specific version of the game client that can also be used for testing.

Tracking absolutely all relationships and their results in various elements of such a large project as World of Warships is not possible even for the largest QA teams.

Therefore, external testing begins in parallel with the final stages of internal tests:
Testing of a pre-release build of the game by a small group of volunteers (Supertest and Clan Test).
Public testing, which is open to everyone.
External testing also allows us to check the operation of the game on a wide variety of computer and software configurations.

The World of Warships development team is also involved in external testing. We have a mechanism called "Traffic lights" in the studio. This is a special page that all teams fill out after playing on the Public Test Server. On this page, staff can leave feedback about each new tested version feature, as well as give it an assessment that is later taken into account when summing up the testing results.

Based on the results of external testing, we fix the last identified errors in the current build of the game. If it is impossible to fix the errors, we may even have to remove certain features from the coming update.

This was the case with Asymmetric Battles in Update 0.10.9. A bug that led to incorrect operation of the mode and required additional time to fix was discovered during the Public Test stage. As a result, the mode was removed from the update.
[hr][/hr]
Occurrence of Bugs
Why do bugs occur on the Live Server? Bugs occur for a variety of reasons and at different development stages. From commonplace errors in the program code and the human factor to non-obvious interactions and errors at the stage of creating a design document for a new version.

An error may be present, for example, already at the stage of developing an idea and will still be considered a bug.

For example, the mechanics of temporary invulnerability of an aircraft carrier squadron immediately after an attack, which could earlier be used to overcome the enemy's air defense zone, can also be attributed to bugs. This particular use of the mechanic was not foreseen in the design stage of the aircraft carrier update and was later fixed.

To prevent similar situations, we try to start testing as early as at the stage of discussing new ideas.

In addition, game elements that work perfectly in isolation can "break" when combined with other game elements due to various interconnections and conflicts that arise.

For example, in one of the internal tests of the Ranked Battles update, we found that they caused errors in the operation of Clan Battles—players were not able to start a battle because matchmaking took an infinitely long time. The cause of this was not the most obvious relationship, but it was fortunately found and did not reach the Live Server.

Another cause of bugs—one that is rather difficult to track down—is the huge variety of our users' computer configurations, which, together with the complex client-server architecture, can lead to unexpected behavior of the game code on specific computers.

For example, in one update, due to the date format in Japan being different to the format used in Europe or America, the game code was not able to process this information, and the post-battle statistics were not displayed for some players.

What players consider to be a bug can sometimes not be a bug at all because the program behavior seen by players is actually the expected outcome. In such situations, it is important to analyze player feedback and, possibly, change something. The opposite can also be true—a bug can sometimes become part of the game and the decision not to fix it can be deliberate.

For example, the unique sound of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Shikishima's guns had an error in the audibility range setting (it could be heard at a greater range than was intended), and this error was fixed. However, you noticed that the sound lost its unique quality due to the fix, so we returned this "error" to the game.

Bugs can also be tentatively attributed to technical problems in data centers or Internet providers. Unfortunately, there is little that we can do in such situations, and we cannot always help players, regardless of whether we know the source of the problem.

It should be understood that it is impossible to track down absolutely all bugs. The result of the QA team's work is that a new functionality works as intended, without critical bugs and flaws, and that it can be released on the Live Server.
[hr][/hr]

Fixing
Why do some bugs take so long to fix? The required time period for correcting a particular error depends primarily on its nature. Some defects require a significant investment of time as early as the error analysis stage. Indeed, in order to correct an error, we need to reproduce it accurately and understand the reason or reasons why this error occurred.

For example, a recent bug caused torpedoes to launch incorrectly when the launching ship was turning. This was a mistake in the game logic, and any changes and fixes to the game logic are always very risky because they affect absolutely all players and affect the very basis of the game—its gameplay.

Therefore, to fix such an error, it is necessary to accurately analyze player complaints and various reports, find the cause of the problem, and develop and verify a solution. In special cases, it can be necessary to rewrite the game code to fix a bug or optimize it using new technology. This process is called refactoring. Despite the fact that nothing seems to change from the player's point of view, this process takes quite a long time.

In addition, the time frame for correcting errors depends on the ways in which fixes are delivered to players. For example:
To fix some bugs, it is enough to make small fixes to the server side of the game, which most players will not even notice.
The situation is more complicated when the error also affects the player's client or it is necessary to carry out server maintenance to fix the error. In this case, a small patch can be prepared and additional work performed on the server. The server is not available to players during this time.
Fixing some bugs requires so many changes in the code and additional tests that fixes can only be released with the release of the next major game update.
The decision on how to deliver each fix and the priority of bug fixing is determined by numerous factors:
Bug severity: Inoperable Random Battles should be fixed as soon as possible, but a typo in the ship's performance specifications can wait a bit.
Scale: Some errors affect all players; other errors occur for one player out of a thousand.
Risks and necessary fix tests: As mentioned above, sloppy fixes in the game logic can only make things worse.
Time spent on server maintenance and the update size: To fix an error, we will need to turn off the server for several hours, and players will need to download quite a big patch. In such cases, it is worthwhile to think again how important it is to fix an error immediately because many players will not be able to enter the game for a long time.
Unfortunately, despite all of our desires to fix all possible bugs, the resources of the World of Warships team are finite, so we focus on fixing the most critical and frequently encountered bugs.
[hr][/hr]

How to Report a Bug
You can always inform us about any errors you find via one of the following resources:
Player Support
Game forum
Official World of Warships Discord server
To help facilitate quicker and more efficient error fixing, please add the following to your report:
Error description.
Screenshot, video, replay, or any other visual confirmation of an error. If you attach a battle replay, make sure to indicate the timing of the error.
WGCheck file. Detailed information about this file is available in a separate article.
In today's article, we did our best to tell you about our "invisible front" in the fight against bugs in the simplest possible way. We want to thank you for your bug reports, feedback, participation in our tests, and playing World of Warships! Without your contribution, we would not have been able to quickly find and correct various errors that have occurred in the game.

notes.title: The Clydebank Dockyard: Construction of Marlborough
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d5154c48e24213ecf5547edf27d5baffc90df227.jpg
In Update 0.10.11, you will be able to start building new British battleship Marlborough at the Clydebank Dockyard, as well as obtain two other ships—Dreadnought and Repulse!

https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marlborough is based on a 1947 project with some of the design solutions borrowed from the Vanguard-class and King George V-class ships. Her primary feature is extensive but not particularly accurate artillery consisting of sixteen 356 mm guns housed in four turrets. While the battleship's armor is rather mediocre, this is compensated for by low detectability and numerous main battery guns that fire quite rapidly for her type and have a decent firing range.

Combat Missions
Rewards

Event Rules
While constructing https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marlborough, you can also obtain the famous https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIII Dreadnought and a new ship, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Repulse—one of the Renown-class battleships that fought during the First and Second World Wars. The ship is armed with six 381 mm guns housed in three turrets. The guns have a good reach and decent accuracy, and they reload quickly for a battleship. Repulse enjoys high speed and a large HP pool, but she is relatively poorly armored.
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 32 phases.
These shipbuilding phases can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,500 Doubloons to pass through each phase.
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: eleven shipbuilding phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,900 Doubloons and five shipbuilding phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,500 Doubloons.
You can complete combat mission groups throughout the entire duration of Update 0.10.11 and during the first 3 weeks of Update 0.11.0. The Dockyard will remain available until the end of Update 0.11.1.
In total, you can progress through 27 out of 32 shipbuilding phases by completing the Dockyard combat mission groups.

Completing other shipbuilding phases will bring you Santa's Gift, Santa's Big Gift, and Santa's Mega Gift containers; New Year Sky expendable camouflages; days of Warships Premium Account; Coal; Steel; Research Points; and other valuable rewards. Upon completing the 32nd shipbuilding phase, you'll receive https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marlborough in the War Paint camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, a Port slot, and a commemorative flag.

If you already have https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIII Dreadnought in your Port, you'll receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png5,250,000 Credits as compensation.

If you decide to complete the construction of https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marlborough by spending Doubloons, you'll still be able to progress through the Dockyard combat mission groups. In that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get 250 Steel for each completed phase. [hr][/hr]

Combat Missions
The new game event tasks you with completing 72 combat missions spread across eight groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.10.11, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis.

Completing each of the first five groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases—two for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group. Completing each of the remaining three combat mission groups will progress you through four shipbuilding phases—three for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group.

The Dockyard combat mission groups will be available throughout the entire duration of Update 0.10.11 and during the first 3 weeks of Update 0.11.0.

Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.
[hr][/hr]

Rewards

By finishing the first two combat mission groups, you can complete up to six shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:

1x Santa's Gift container and 1x Santa's Big Gift container
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png5 days of Warships Premium Account
10x New Year Sky expendable camouflages
5x expendable camouflages of each type: "Type 3 — New Year," Frosty Fir Tree, New Year, New Year Streamer, and Winter Strands
10x Basilisk special signals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png2,000 Coal
20,000 Elite Commander XP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png10,000 Free XP
1x Gift container https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e828d5de-5362-11ec-a7d4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
By completing the last two combat mission groups, you'll finish 27 shipbuilding phases and, in addition to the rewards specified above, receive one additional Santa's Big Gift container and ten of each of the following special signals: Ouroboros, Wyvern, Dragon, Scylla, Leviathan, Hydra, and Red Dragon.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e834b11a-5362-11ec-85c8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg [hr][/hr]

Completing Construction of the Ship
In order to complete phases 28–32, in addition to progressing through all the combat mission groups, you'll need to spend Doubloons to finish any five shipbuilding phases. This will reward you with:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal for completing phase 28
1x Santa's Mega Gift container for completing phase 29
4,000 Research Points for completing phase 30
2,000 Steel for completing phase 31
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marlborough in the War Paint camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, a Port slot, and a commemorative flag for completing phase 32 https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e80a9420-5362-11ec-a523-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs:
Eleven shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,900 Doubloons
Five shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,500 Doubloons
However, these packs will only be available for purchase prior to the point in time when you complete three shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions. Once you've purchased both Starter Packs or completed three shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions, you'll be able to purchase further phases individually for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,500 Doubloons each.
[hr][/hr]

New Year Fleet
Two weeks after the release of Update 0.10.11, five themed groups of the New Year Fleet combat missions will become available. To complete them, you need to obtain https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Repulse, which is a reward for finishing the 18th shipbuilding phase at the Dockyard.

The reward for the first group is the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier VIII ships. Completing groups two, three, and four will earn you https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.pngVI Weser, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVI Fubuki, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngVI Izmail, respectively. Each ship comes with the Snow and Stars permanent camouflage and a Commander with 6 skill points. The reward for completing the last combat mission group is https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_dd3112a12284f158a1e9d283ac7fa46d3beaa3d8698e70d99f28f6ade0286941.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngVI Kijkduin in the Snow and Stars permanent camouflage and Dutch Commander Sinterklaas with 10 skill points.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b78b213c-52ab-11ec-b37f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/793ec0f6-5291-11ec-9bc4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7930acaa-5291-11ec-b5fa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
All five combat mission groups will become available simultaneously. The first combat mission group can only be completed playing https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Repulse.

All details on the missions will be available in the game client.
