The Lighthouse auction will be held from October 7 through 11. Look for details about the auction rules, lots, their quantity, and starting bids in a dedicated article that will be published on our website later this week.

Personal Challenges
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fe05ddc-21db-11ec-bf48-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

A new temporary event called "Personal Challenges" will be available to you for the entire duration of Update 0.10.9. The goal of the event is to earn as much Base XP as possible while demonstrating your skills in battle playing ships of different types and nations.

The rules are similar to Naval Battles: a personal table of records will become available to you. This table displays all the available ship types and nations. After fulfilling one of the mission's requirements, you can move on to the next part of the table, which will offer a more difficult mission.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99b304b0-21fd-11ec-b933-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99e9d792-21fd-11ec-abd3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99e4545c-21fd-11ec-9234-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Key rules
You can take part in the event playing researchable ships of Tier V and higher, and you can also play Premium and special ships of Tier V–X if the nation has a researchable branch of that type.
Personal Challenges can be completed in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles.
You have an unlimited number of attempts.
The table of records is reset once a week.
Each mission you complete will reward you with https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_ed097dd16572a276eebe738ca1babcb606d77a47cbaf5479b8ad244a7e3e0859.png 15 German Tokens and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png50 Coal. It's possible to earn up to https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_ed097dd16572a276eebe738ca1babcb606d77a47cbaf5479b8ad244a7e3e0859.png 510 Tokens each week. After reaching the weekly limit, each completed task will bring only {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png50 Coal.
We come bearing gifts! Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this article and others on our website! You can exchange them for various items under the "Naval Community" tab of the Armory. Make sure to keep up to date with the news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!

Watch our official streams and participate in the Public Test and other activities to earn Community Tokens. In total, you'll be able to find up to https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png 1,510 Community Tokens on our website before the end of Update 0.10.9.
Halloween
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fe1906c-21db-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In the dark night that bridges October 31 and November 1, hordes of dismal evil creatures squeeze out of their shelters and creep all around the earth, set on conquering new lands!

Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness
We invite you to take part in Operations from previous years—save Transylvania and defend the waters of the Silver Spear Archipelago from invasion by the Forces of Darkness!

Both Operations can be completed while Update 0.10.9 is live. A Super Hard difficulty level is available in addition to the Normal and Hard difficulty levels.

The first completion of a Super Hard Operation with 3 Stars or more will bring you Jack-o'-Lantern Premium containers that have specific chances of dropping one of the permanent Halloween camouflages from previous years, as well as other rewards. These can include expendable camos, Doubloons, and Free XP. There is also the possibility that Halloween permanent camouflages might drop.
To complete the Operations, you will receive the following special ships on your account:  III Blade,  III Jackal, and  III Igor, as well as  VIII Urashima,  VIII Svyatozar, and  VIII Magnu-S.

Twilight Hunt
On the third week of the update, a new temporary battle type called "Twilight Hunt" will become available to you. Show your true courage in battles against the Twilight Fleet at the helms of these fantastic future ships.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Thu. 21 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 11 Nov. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

Key rules
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and the AI-controlled Twilight Fleet, led by the terrible Rasputin, on the gigantic Polygon map.
Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal opens up only some time after the start of each battle.
You start out alone, but you can form teams directly in battle.
It is now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. In order to coordinate their efforts, Division mates will need to locate each other on the map and create a team.
The Twilight Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal or when the battle time expires.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c17f86-21ea-11ec-84a7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c81fd0-21ea-11ec-8bcc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e905ebda-21ea-11ec-9912-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e90c872e-21ea-11ec-9f5b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
A temporary resource—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_65bc5d6f2e5b745981b237addbe95a8b0eab5f1e4be650cbe25135f0b2246955.pngBattle Points—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle.
The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle.
Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you earn.
The Twilight Hunt mode is divided into three stages. Each stage has a different difficulty level: Normal, Hard, and Super Hard.

Players can take part in the Twilight Hunt on one of nine ships, and each ship has her own style of gameplay. Apart from  IX Valkyrie,  IX Gale,  IX Heracles,  X Hector,  X Avenger, and  X Whirlwind—ships that you're probably already familiar with—you'll also be able to join the battle on monster ships  X Fangblade,  X Thornridge, and  X Lobster-Eyed. You must complete a special combat mission to obtain these ships.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2be75e20-21ff-11ec-aef8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2bf343d4-21ff-11ec-9948-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2bf063d0-21ff-11ec-87f5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Rewards
Earn Battle Points and complete daily and weekly combat missions. As a reward for completing them you'll receive Jack-o'-Lantern containers, Community Tokens, a new temporary resource called https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_09977141afe61c0ca2d00715ea4037b8306d808b4973171281587c5286c558a8.png "Twilight Tokens", and other rewards.

Twilight Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for themed Commanders with 10 skill points; Intanian Fleet permanent camouflages for  VIII Admiral Hipper,  VIII Hsienyang,  VIII Implacable,  IX Kitakaze,  IX Dmitri Donskoi, and  IX Iowa; Jack-o'-Lantern containers; and other items.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ec348da-21eb-11ec-9948-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
More details about the Twilight Hunt's rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated article on our website.
Submarines in Random Battles
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f09bdea-21db-11ec-9546-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Submarines have been present in Ranked and Co-op battles for almost 2 months now, and we're extremely grateful for the battles you've played, as well as your feedback. By participating and telling us your opinions, you helped us determine what the next steps in submarine development are going to be.

We've planned a number of future changes for the new ship type, based on the data we collected and player feedback. First, we're going to add anti-submarine weapons on all Tier V–X cruisers and battleships in Update 0.10.9, except for Dutch cruisers and hybrids.

We're aware that adding anti-submarine weapons on a large number of ships can have a significant impact on the effectiveness of submarines, so we've made a number of balance changes to the new ship type:
We've changed the characteristics of torpedoes—submarines now have tube-by-tube torpedo-launching capabilities. Tube-by-tube torpedo launching will allow for more dynamic gameplay and also allow better control over the number of torpedoes launched during an attack. To encourage submarine Captains to use sonar pings for better accuracy, the width of the torpedo launch sector has been increased
German submarines were weaker compared to American submarines in terms of damage they were able to deal. To make them even in terms of this parameter, we've increased the maximum damage and the chances of causing flooding of torpedoes launched by German submarines.
The torpedo tubes of German submarines are mostly located in their fore ends, which is great for attacking from longer distances. To shift German submarine gameplay toward long-range combat, we increased the range of their torpedoes.
American submarines, in their turn, can be quite effective in short- and medium-range battles, because their torpedo tubes are located in both their bows and sterns. To encourage American submarine Captains to embrace this style of combat, the range of American submarines' torpedoes has been reduced.
Reduced dive capacity depletion if the submarine is detected. The increase of dive capacity depletion in Update 0.10.8 significantly affected how comfortable it was to play submarines, and it also impacted their effectiveness. To make the detection of submarines impact their gameplay less, we've reduced the dive capacity depletion rates when submarines are detected.
Check out a detailed list of changes in a dedicated article on our website.

We’ve also changed the submarine settings in Co-op and Training battles. Now, submarines controlled by AI will take part in battles more actively. This change will prevent situations where the battle went on for far too long due to the process of searching for and destroying the last enemy submarine.

The next step in testing submarines is to add them to Random Battles. This will allow us to properly evaluate their state and gather feedback from a larger number of players.

For this reason, rental submarines will become temporarily available in Random Battles during Update 0.10.9.

Offering submarines in this way will help us keep an eye on how many of them are out on our seas and prevent extended queue times. We are going to keep a close eye on submarines in Random Battles, and we are able to take measures if their presence in Random Battles has an adverse impact on gameplay.

Interface Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9ec3cf56-21db-11ec-bfa6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.10.9, we've updated the way in which ship characteristics are displayed in battle: Changed the ship parameters screen that opens by pressing H. Any modifiers currently applied to the ship are now displayed in the pop-up window.

Apart from that, the battle interface has additional indicators for various temporary effects:
Added the display of active skills and temporary modifiers of talents above the armament panel.
Added a notification about changed parameters when Commander talents are activated.
Updated the display of destroyed and incapacitated modules, fires, and flooding.
Added a setting in the "Controls" section that allows timers on fires, flooding, and other modifiers to be permanently displayed when the adaptive full combat interface mode is enabled.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98da8498-2200-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94616184-21ec-11ec-bd7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98b7de48-2200-11ec-8fe4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/989973f4-2200-11ec-87f5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/989c9516-2200-11ec-b0d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fa454e0-21db-11ec-9044-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

World of Warships will see the addition of:
Two variants of German Battleships containers that have specific chances of dropping German ships  VIII Brandenburg,  X Max Immelmann,  VII Weimar,  VIII Gustav-Julius Maerker, and other rewards. Brandenburg will be also available in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons.
German Commander Johannes Meck-Leyne with a unique voiceover. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d26d32e-21ee-11ec-8bd2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Loyang, Giuseppe Verdi, Marlborough, Novorossiysk, and Flag of the Tsar of Muscovy commemorative flags. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e635e82e-21ef-11ec-a5d0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Regular Supplies container.
Especially for the King of the Sea tournament, we've added:
King of the Sea XIII Red and King of the Sea XIII Green expendable camouflages.
Commanders Edward Turner, Stepan Yermakov, Kenji Shiraishi, and Klaus Sternberger.
King of the Sea XIII commemorative flag.
Bane of the Seas permanent camouflage for  VIII North Carolina.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7abd4d54-1d0c-11ec-91f6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7b176c8a-1d0c-11ec-aa74-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1908f09c-21f1-11ec-b000-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/18cc1c58-21f1-11ec-a5d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Tech Tree Changes
In early 2022,  X Khabarovsk and  X Grosser Kurfürst are going to receive the status of "special" ships and leave the branch. They'll be replaced with Delny and Preussen, which better match other ships from the branch in terms of progression and gameplay.

Any players who own a permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngX Khabarovsk or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Grosser Kurfürst at the time when the ships are removed from the Tech Tree will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for Delny or Preussen, respectively.

Any players who had a permanent camouflage for  X Moskva on their accounts at the time when Update 0.9.5 was released will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for  X Alexander Nevsky within a week of Update 0.10.9 going live. Those who already have the Type 20 permanent camouflage will receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 Doubloons as compensation.
Details about the new ships, as well as details about the upcoming changes, can be found in a dedicated article on our website.

Armory
The "Naval Community" section will have several changes. Premium Ship V and Premium Ship VII containers, as well as the Restless Fire commemorative flag, will no longer be available for purchase.

The following ships will be available to purchase with Community Tokens:
 IV Ishizuchi for  10,000 Community Tokens.
 V Exeter for  15,000 Community Tokens.
 VII Leningrad for  20,000 Community Tokens.
The ships are credited with a Port slot and Commander with 3 skill points.
Apart from that, a bundle with a Supercontainer will become permanently available for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png 6,000 Community Tokens and without any purchase restrictions in the "Naval Community" section.

Other Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a0b735f0-21db-11ec-a00d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Upgrade Changes
Anti-Submarine Aircraft Modification 1 upgrade (4th slot)
Renamed Airstrike Modification 1.
Added for all Tier V–X battleships, researchable Tier V–X Dutch cruisers, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_dd3112a12284f158a1e9d283ac7fa46d3beaa3d8698e70d99f28f6ade0286941.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII De Zeven Provinciën.
Technical changes of ship armor
Changed the code that processed ship armor.

The update will allow for better interactions between shells and armor due to a more accurate calculation of the position of the shell in the ship's hull. For example, these changes allow us to avoid situations where a ship receives damage from penetration and overpenetration of the same shell at the same time. They also make it impossible to penetrate a ship's armor through various decorative elements on the deck.

The way in which the parts of a ship's armor are displayed will also change—it will be more detailed and uniform.
The transfer of ships to the new armor system will take effect gradually, starting from Update 0.10.10.
Other Changes and Improvements
Added the option to rent a Commander, similar to ship rental.
Fixed an error that caused the shell ballistics of  IX Missouri to be calculated incorrectly in some cases.
Fixed an error that caused torpedo range not to be shown in the characteristics of torpedo bombers in the Port.
Fixed an error that caused the Airstrike bomb penetration value to be incorrectly displayed for  X Gouden Leeuw.
Fixed an error that caused the Survivability Expert skill to increase aircraft HP by an incorrect value.
Other Improvements and Changes. For a complete list, please refer to Player Support.

notes.content:

Commanders! We've been thinking about what birthday gifts to give you, our players, for quite some time, and our bright idea is finally being brought to life!

Every year, you'll receive a gift in the game on the occasion of your birthday. What gift? Just have a look:

7 days of Warships Premium Account

2x Supercontainers

1x coupon that provides 100% cashback
This gift will be given to you on the day of your birthday, as long as you specify the date on the Account Management page and give us permission to send you mails with presents.
[table][tr][th]Asia[/th][th]Start receiving gifts[/th]

[table][tr][th]How to Start Receiving Gifts? ● Receiving Gifts ● More About the Coupon[/th][/tr][/table]
How to Start Receiving Gifts?
To start receiving birthday gifts in the game, you need to:
Specify your date of birth on the Account Management page (otherwise, how can we know, right?).
Link your account to your email address and confirm it (important for Steam users).
Give us permission to send you letters with presents to your specified email address.
Have at least one battle played in the last 365 days.
Please note: You can change the date of your birthday on the Account Management page once every 365 days.
Receiving Gifts
If all the requirements are met, you'll receive a congratulation letter on your birthday every year! To claim your gift, simply enter the game within a period of 7 days after your specified date of birth.
Congratulatory letters can be sent only once a day. It can happen on the next day from the date you've set before in case you've changed it recently.
More About the Coupon
Your birthday coupon will give you 100% cashback in Doubloons when purchasing an item in the Premium Shop. In other words, when you use this coupon to make a purchase, you'll receive both the purchased item and an amount of Doubloons that's equal to the cost of this item.
The maximum cashback amount provided by the coupon is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png50,000 Doubloons. There are almost no items that cost more than this in the Premium Shop.
You can use this coupon only once, and you must use it within 7 days of receiving it.
You can't transfer the coupon to another player or use it to purchase a gift for someone else.
The coupons have expiry dates. Each birthday coupon must be used within 7 days of receiving it.
Please note: Each coupon can be applied to a single item, not to the entire cart.

notes.title: Three Days of Premium Account as a Gift!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3b0ecd1ad60168951ec16ffd2578dff17a48c74d.jpg

Captains!

As you already know, Update 0.10.8 went live with several bugs, and the most annoying of them was the torpedo bug that appeared as a result of fixing an error that caused torpedoes to change trajectory if a ship was moving in a circle while launching torpedoes. You can read more about the situation here. 

We apologize for these issues. Fortunately, our team has already found solutions to these problems. The full details are available on our Development Blog. Thank you for your constructive feedback—it allowed us to quickly identify the existing problems and start to solve them.

We are giving all players 3 days of Warships Premium Account, and we hope you have a good time in the game!

Please claim your gift on your region’s World of Warships portal before October 5th 13:00 (UTC). If you are not sure what region you are playing on, press ESC in your Port and check the upper left corner.
EU
 CIS 
 NA 
 SEA  
Wargaming authentication is required.

If you do not have a WG account yet, please complete your registration in-game. More on this:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4174225702959905780
For the registration you will receive:

3x Steam containers
250 doubloons
1 day of Warships Premium Account

With a registered account you can also use all of the website features (bonus codes, gifts, coupons, etc.), and also link your account to Twitch to receive Twitch drops.

Action stations!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b34a49959b124f9874d3cf227d556ac1e3ae0e1.jpg

Commanders!

You'll be happy to hear that we've made it much simpler to participate in the Public Test—you can now log in using your main account. To do so, select Public Test in the Game Instance section of Wargaming Game Center.

The epic "German Battleships: Part 1" event, challenging Asymmetric Battles, spooky Twilight Hunt, and other new features await you! Take a look at the Developer Bulletin, and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!

Leave Feedback


Round 2 Schedule {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Thu. 23 Sep. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends:  Tue. 28 Sep. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.9! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Added the Depth Charge Airstrike armament for most Tier V-X cruisers and battleships that had no ASW armament. Balance changes were also made to submarines. More details are available in our Development Blog.
Balance changes to german battleships, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVI Béarn, and other test ships were made. More details you can find here.
Updated the recommended commander skills for several ships.
Added an option in the game settings to always display timers of fires, floodings and other modificators when choosing an alternate or full battle interface mode.
Fixed an issue which caused https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Missouri's shell ballistics to be counted incorrectly in some cases.
Fixed an issue which caused mouse input to be working incorrectly in some cases.
Fixed several issues with ships and bots in Twilight Hunt and festive Operations.
Fixed several interface issues with Asymmetric battles.
Fixed an issue which caused the penetration of the Airstrike bombs of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_dd3112a12284f158a1e9d283ac7fa46d3beaa3d8698e70d99f28f6ade0286941.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngX Gouden Leeuw to be displayed incorrectly.
Fixed an issue which caused some elements of superstructures or armament not displayed on the models of several ships.
Fixed several other issues.
Special Features of the Test
Asymmetric Battles and Twilight Hunt will be available on the Public Test Server between the following dates:

Asymmetric Battles {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start: Thu. 23 Sep. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)
End:  Sat. 25 Sep. 12:00 CEST (UTC+2)

Twilight Hunt {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start: Sat. 25 Sep. 12:00 CEST (UTC+2)
End: Tue. 28 Sep. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Combat Missions and Rewards
The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
The rewards are automatically credited to your account within a few days of the release of a new version.
You can earn Community Tokens for completing combat missions on the Public Test Server.

notes.title: Naval History in Photos: Crossing the Line
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5e6fc6bbcda64900a35a7486ab0834cc6e2ad087.jpg

The sailors of different navies have different line-crossing ceremonies. Together with the U.S. Naval Institute, we've prepared a selection of photos depicting crew rituals that have taken place when crossing the zero-degree latitude.


https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c199fdc-19ea-11ec-bf20-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The line-crossing ceremony is an initiation rite in various navies that commemorates a sailor's first crossing of the Equator. The tradition may have originated with ceremonies when passing headlands and become a "folly" sanctioned as a boost to morale. Sailors who have already crossed the Equator are nicknamed Shellbacks, Trusty Shellbacks, Honorable Shellbacks, or Sons of Neptune. Those who have not crossed are nicknamed Pollywogs, or Slimy Pollywogs.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c2e0e5e-19ea-11ec-8e24-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
World cruise of the US Navy, 1907–09. Crossing the Equator. Sailors wading in water aboard a ship.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c19f00e-19ea-11ec-9e77-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The "Royal Court" passes judgement during Shellback initiation as USS Rochester (CA-124) crossed the Equator.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3ca63050-19ea-11ec-a4e1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Neptune party aboard destroyer tender USS Black Hawk (AD-9) when crossing the Equator en route to the Dutch East Indies.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3ca620a6-19ea-11ec-8750-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
A Marine Corps officer undergoes the electric treatment during "Shellback" initiation ceremonies for "Pollywogs" as a transport bearing Marines to the South Pacific crosses the Equator.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c0996b4-19ea-11ec-8714-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Murray Wiener, Asst. Physician, crosses the Equator, but not before submitting to having the "Southern Cross" clipped across his chest, a ducking and other "tortures"; Ship's baker, Jack Gambole, washes the victim's mouth under Dr. Alfred B. Geyer's guidance.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c7b2a90-19ea-11ec-b504-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Crew members of USS Libra (AKA-12) perform a line-crossing ceremony.

All photos are courtesy of the U.S. Naval Institute Photo Archive. Looking for more thrilling shots related to naval history? Check the photo archive online here.

notes.title: Convoy: Defend or Destroy!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7d4686a11a570f5bc01fcfb92ff1a767c276994b.jpg

Captains!

Defending or destroying maritime shipping routes has always been one of the most important tasks of any navy, because large quantities of military equipment, fuel, and other strategically important cargo are often transported across the seas. Intercepting merchant and cargo ships was the primary objective of numerous raiders, and warring parties had to maintain considerable naval forces to protect their trade routes.

Update 0.10.8 invites you to participate in a new temporary battle type inspired by this historical practice—Convoy—in which you'll need to either defend or destroy cargo ships.

[table][tr][th]Rules ● Achievements ● Combat Missions[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=CB6ZiX1RfjI;full][/previewyoutube] 
Rules {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 23 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 07 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

Format
7 vs. 7, playing Tier VIII ships.

Restrictions
No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team.

Maps
The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Warrior's Path, Loop, and Labyrinth.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0d555c9c-16c8-11ec-b12f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0cecb4ee-16c8-11ec-aab3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0da29778-16c8-11ec-b302-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0da4d63c-16c8-11ec-8c71-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0ce863d0-16c8-11ec-b890-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division.

The defending team needs to escort a convoy of four AI-controlled cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d104acc4-1600-11ec-b1f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1a83664-1600-11ec-8834-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1026d4c-1600-11ec-814f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0ff5ddc-1600-11ec-8e5f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1a5dda6-1600-11ec-825d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0e7ef94-1600-11ec-9603-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0f395d8-1600-11ec-9201-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
On average, it takes the convoy between 10 and 12 minutes to complete the route. The convoy's route is visible to both teams on the Minimap. Moreover, at the beginning of each battle, the escorting team will see the position of the attacking ships on the Minimap, while the attacking team will only see the position of the transport ships themselves.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/870fa65a-1600-11ec-9201-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/87221d80-1600-11ec-b1f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/870c0e8c-1600-11ec-8834-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
The convoy consists of four Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor, but they can deploy smoke screens, as well as change speed and maneuver to dodge enemy torpedoes.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/cd07445e-16f2-11ec-89c4-8cdcd4b147d4.gif

Achievements
Your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements:
[table][tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b64626-1603-11ec-8bd7-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Living Shield[/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the enemy while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied transport.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b88620-1603-11ec-a7ff-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Neat Job[/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transports and without losing any allied ships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b59d5c-1603-11ec-ba28-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Safe Route[/td] [td]Win a battle and save all transports. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b53380-1603-11ec-888f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Nerves of Steel[/td] [td]Win and survive in a battle when the enemy has twice the number of warships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship. Can be completed while playing for any team.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b60d64-1603-11ec-814f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Raider[/td] [td]Destroy two transports in a single battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
Due to the specifics of the battle type, you can only earn these achievements in Convoy.
Combat Missions
You will also have access to combat missions that can be completed only in Convoy. Win and earn Base XP to obtain Community Tokens. During the first week, you'll also have access to a special mission chain that can be completed in Convoy playing cruisers; in the second week, you'll get another mission chain that can be completed playing destroyers. These chains will earn you Credits and More Resources containers.

Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.

The "6 Years of World of Warships" Collection
To celebrate the Sixth Anniversary of World of Warships, we offer you a chance to experience the most memorable moments of the past year once again. The "6 Years of World of Warships" collection looks like a big jigsaw puzzle and comprises 60 elements. The collection elements only drop from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. You can obtain these:
By completing a special combat mission chain.
By participating in the new Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry temporary event.
In exchange for Festive Tokens.

notes.title: Announcing Community Tokens: A Unified Currency for Community Activity
notes.content:
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6879d15c-c93e-11eb-8429-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg
Captains!
A new permanent tab will find its home in the Armory with the release of Update 0.10.5. Under it, you’ll be able to obtain exclusive rewards in exchange for a new currency—Community Tokens. These Tokens will not only functionally replace Recruitment Points, they will also become a major reward for participants of World of Warships activities outside of the game itself.

Concept
With the introduction of Community Tokens, we aim to both streamline the system of collecting rewards and diversify the content that can be earned by participating in community activities, including—but not limited to—the Recruiting Station, Public Test, Twitch Drops, sponsored tournaments, and live meetups.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac5c4b06-c93f-11eb-8d99-38eaa735f4cc.jpg
Earned Community Tokens will accumulate on your account like any other in-game currency. You’ll be able to spend them at any time in the new “Naval Community” permanent tab, which is going to appear in the Armory with the release of Update 0.10.5.

The main advantage of this reward system over the previous ones is that it enables you to choose the loot that suits you personally instead of receiving fixed rewards.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac1f1466-c93f-11eb-b619-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg
Community Rewards
The “Naval Community” Armory tab will be stocked with a sizeable amount of in-game content that can be obtained in exchange for Community Tokens. At launch, you’ll be able to purchase a number of rare ship customizations, containers, and even a Premium ship! The pool of available rewards may be partially refreshed from time to time, but some items, such as Recruiting Station containers, will be a constant fixture.

With the release of Update 0.10.5, the following rewards will be available for Community Tokens:

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fde7804f2a1111900d11ac112ad2a0337b3b821d.jpg
Early Access to the new ship branch, plus a new temporary event!

[table][tr][th]Soviet Aircraft Carriers ● Things to Know About Early Access ● Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/th][/tr][/table]
Soviet Aircraft Carriers
Soviet aircraft carriers https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngIV Komsomolets, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVI Serov, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVIII Pobeda arrive in Early Access.

What are the features of the new branch?
Small number of aircraft in squadrons. Squadrons consist of a single flight that carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once.
Starting from Tier VIII, aircraft are equipped with jet boosters. As with https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Ise and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Tone, the boosters kick in automatically during takeoff and provide a short-term increase in speed. You can jettison the boosters by pressing the S key.
Small HP pools and low cruising speeds.
Soviet aircraft carriers carry skip bombers instead of standard bombers. The skip bombers are armed with HE bombs.
The torpedo bombers are armed with torpedoes that have a long range and take longer to arm.
Starting from Tier VI, attack aircraft squadrons are armed with powerful HE rockets that are similar to the American "Tiny Tims."
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac4587ac-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac3d7a30-0c99-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac371a64-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
When Update 0.10.10 goes live, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngIV Komsomolets, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVI Serov, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVIII Pobeda, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngX Admiral Nakhimov will be available for all players to research.

Things to Know About Early Access
Soviet Tokens
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_7_33722423c774d6b0ffcc70c576e7538971637aefc907ec76bc1fabfef7d674bf.png Soviet Tokens are a new temporary resource that can be obtained:
By participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event—up to 1,500 Tokens.
From free random bundles—up to 100 Tokens.
From random bundles that are available in exchange for Doubloons—up to 2,600 Tokens.
In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory—up to 200 Tokens.
Rewards for Soviet Tokens
You can exchange Soviet Tokens for sequentially available bundles that include Soviet aircraft carriers https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngIV Komsomolets, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVI Serov, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVIII Pobeda along with the Forward Bound permanent camouflages for these ships, as well as for other rewards in the Armory.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/888f8286-0c9e-11ec-acfb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngIV Komsomolets, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngVI Serov, and permanent camouflages for Tier IV, VI, and VIII carriers can be obtained for free. The sum of Tokens that can be earned in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event and received from free daily bundles will be sufficient to achieve that.

With the release of Update 0.10.10, Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png6,000.

Sequentially Available Bundles https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d7d4ae8-0efd-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Other Rewards https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d74ed30-0efd-11ec-9a83-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Random Bundles
The Armory is offering free random bundles—Regular Supplies. Within them, you'll find Soviet Tokens, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Warships Premium Account, Doubloons, and other rewards.

The bundles will remain available until the end of Update 0.10.8. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d75726e-0efd-11ec-ac5e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip more than 2 weeks and still be able to collect all the rewards.

Random bundles for Doubloons https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7dff5056-0efd-11ec-a92b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Random bundles that can each be obtained for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,000 Doubloons have been added to the Soviet Aircraft Carriers section of the Armory. They can drop the Forward Bound permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.pngX Admiral Nakhimov; Soviet Tokens; special signals; and expendable camouflages such as Victory, Spring Sky, Mosaic, and Asian Lantern.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7e0767e6-0efd-11ec-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry
A new temporary event awaits you in Update 0.10.8—Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry. It's based on the history of Soviet naval aviation development and various research and development bureaus that worked on machines for the Soviet Navy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 09 Sep. 09:30 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 07 Oct. 03:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry is similar to the Battle of the Beasts event that took place in Update 0.10.4 but with small changes. The event has three teams instead of four, and a special pop-up window will remind you about the start of each new stage. The Port now displays your personal progress to the next reward instead of team progress. We've also updated the interface of the team selection screen and the window that displays personal and team progress.

A window displaying the event description and unique rewards for each team has been added to the team selection screen. It also shows which team you have selected for the previous stages and if you have unique team rewards. Unique rewards—team patches—are awarded for your personal progress, not for team progress. You can earn unique rewards even if your team hasn't reached the necessary progress milestone. If you haven't made any progress on specific missions, they will not be displayed on the mission screen.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9951d5f8-0efe-11ec-a344-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/994cf9b6-0efe-11ec-a663-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9975e0a6-0efe-11ec-ac5e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99bbfe6a-0efe-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e585ff0-0c92-11ec-8dc7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Rules of the Event
The event runs until the release of Update 0.10.9 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week. Before starting each stage, you can choose one of three teams:

The Polikarpov Bureau Team
[expand type=details]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ab475124-0eff-11ec-9cb7-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Nikolai Polikarpov was known as the "King of Fighters" because Soviet aces flew only his machines until the beginning of the 1940s. Moreover, the Polikarpov Experimental Design Bureau created the first attack aircraft for the Red Army Air Force.
[/expand]
The Chetverikov Bureau Team
[expand type=details]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/aae444bc-0eff-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Igor Chetverikov developed a successful series of long-range naval scouts. It was his Experimental Design Bureau that was tasked with creating a carrier-based torpedo bomber for the Soviet Navy Air Force, and the task was successfully completed.
[/expand]
The Kocherigin Bureau Team
[expand type=details]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/aae6c192-0eff-11ec-9107-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Sergey Kocherigin worked on a number of original fighters and scouts, but he achieved his greatest successes designing bombers.
[/expand]
During the day, event participants will receive special missions that can be completed in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as well as in the new temporary battle type—Convoy. Convoy will become available 2 weeks after the release of the update.

Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards. Your personal and team progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each new stage. All players who have reached Access Level 8 can participate in the event.

Missions
Three mission types, with a limited allotted time for each mission, will be available to you each day. Missions are assigned sequentially at specific times throughout the day—once every 40 minutes. There are 25 missions in total. Each mission should be completed within 120 minutes. The only exceptions are the last missions of the day—the time for counting the results of these missions is extended by 20 minutes.

After a mission expires, the next mission of the same type becomes available. Battles that end after a mission expires are counted towards the next mission. More details are available in the game client.

Personal and Team Progress
Completing the missions will earn you Points for both personal and team progress. When you reach certain personal and team milestones, you'll receive rewards:
The reward for reaching each stage of personal progress is credited immediately.
The reward for team progress is credited if your personal progress is equal to or higher than the team progress.
During the week, you can obtain up to 10 rewards: five for personal progress and five for team progress. To obtain all 10 rewards during the week, you need to earn 1,500 Personal Progress Points and 150,000 Team Progress Points.

Earning Points
Each mission has four completion marks. Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points. A total of 80 Points can be earned per mission. If you complete a mission with high efficiency, you’ll receive from 10 to 25 additional Points, as well as see your position in the overall player standings.

The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings. A team is awarded 700; 900; or 1,200 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b7e1a82-0eff-11ec-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b7ba5d6-0eff-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b69d2b6-0eff-11ec-ac5e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b6721ba-0eff-11ec-a344-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Rewards
Containers of the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection, Victory camouflages, Coal, Soviet Tokens, and themed patches with the team insignias.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7dc2fb60-0efd-11ec-a663-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can collect all the patches by selecting a new team each week.
If you already have a team patch, then when you select the same team again and reach the necessary personal progress milestone, you'll receive compensation of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png15,000 Credits instead of the patch.

[previewyoutube=tsRIJ1cMois;full][/previewyoutube]
World of Warships: 6th Anniversary! We've prepared lots of new things for you in Update 0.10.8 to celebrate the event:
The World of Warships Anniversary celebration, special battle performance bonuses, a themed collection, and much more!
Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event
Dutch cruisers leaving Early Access
Early Access to Soviet aircraft carriers
Convoy—a new temporary battle type!
[table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary ● Dutch Cruisers ● Soviet Aircraft Carriers ● Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry ● Convoy ● Armory ● Content Additions and Changes ● Other Changes and Improvements[/th][/tr][/table]
Read through this article carefully and keep your eyes peeled for a gift! Share the article with your friends and Clanmates so they can arm themselves with all the essential info for this update!
World of Warships Anniversary
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1962da5e-0c7e-11ec-809a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Festive Rewards
In Update 0.10.8, you can earn festive battle performance bonuses on all of your Tier V and higher ships. Win a battle or earn 300 Base XP to receive Supercontainers, a new temporary resource called https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_16266bfe10c9894a55b2a77a7945ff1688ccdd935f462d4788f4ae693c233078.png Festive Tokens, and Gift containers:
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5acab0a4-0bf5-11ec-8001-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Battle Performance Bonuses will be available
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png from: Fri. 17 Sep. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)
to: Thu. 04 Nov. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d867076c-0c98-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8720e96-0c98-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8651088-0c98-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The bonus for each ship can be earned only once in battles of any type, except for Training Battles.

In a special section of the Armory, Festive Tokens can be exchanged for containers of the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection; "6 Years of World of Warships" permanent camouflages for  VII Lyon,  VII Yorck,  VII Shchors,  VII Gadjah Mada,  VII Akatsuki, and  VII Zara; Gift and Distant Voyages containers; and World of Warships Anniversary expendable camouflages. The rewards section will be available from September 17, before Update 0.10.10 is released.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6d8fb63c-0c89-11ec-b59e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Each Gift container holds 5x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

You can only earn Festive Tokens from battle performance bonuses. With the release of Update 0.10.10, Festive Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png90,000.

The "6 Years of World of Warships" Collection
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04e3d61c-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04eacee0-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04f2e684-0c99-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
We're also celebrating our Anniversary with the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection, which is dedicated to the most notable events that happened in the game over the past year. The collection looks like a big jigsaw puzzle with 60 elements in it. The collection elements only drop from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. You can obtain these:
By completing a special combat mission chain that will become available on September 17.
By participating in the new temporary Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.
In exchange for Festive Tokens.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/978ae61a-0c88-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The reward for completing the collection is a Supercontainer, 6x Gift containers, and the "6 Years of World of Warships" commemorative flag.
[table][tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b98676d4-f07d-11eb-92e5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2fe7841a-e3b0-11eb-96b4-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c803a1c6-0c8b-11ec-b3e3-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td][/tr][/table]
The exchange rate for duplicates is 1:1.

The "6 Years of World of Warships" containers will be added to the Armory in one of the future updates. When that happens, you'll be able to obtain them in exchange for Coal.

To celebrate the Anniversary, the Designer's Table Port has also been updated—the ship model is now located in a bright and spacious room.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39e0eb20-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39d9e186-0c99-11ec-bb49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39cd97b4-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39d64148-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
We've also added some hidden festive achievements. Their requirements won't be announced or shown in the game client. If you achieve good results and have luck on your side, you'll earn them. Good luck!
Resetting Stars in Operations
With the release of update 0.10.8, any Stars earned in Operations will be reset. This means that the players who already received reward in Operation for a certain number of stars, can collect these stars again and receive corresponding rewards.

Dutch Cruisers
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5b274d50-0bf5-11ec-b7f5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

When Update 0.10.8 goes live, Dutch Tier I–X cruisers will become available for all players to research.
Soviet Aircraft Carriers
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5b17e8a6-0bf5-11ec-a375-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.10.8 brings Soviet aircraft carriers  IV Komsomolets,  VI Serov, and  VIII Pobeda to Early Access.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac4587ac-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac3d7a30-0c99-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac371a64-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Features of the Branch
Small number of aircraft in squadrons. Squadrons consist of a single flight that carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once.
Starting from Tier VIII, aircraft are equipped with jet boosters. As with  VI Ise and  VIII Tone, the boosters kick in automatically during take-off and provide a short-term increase in speed.
Small HP pools and low cruising speeds.
Instead of standard bombers, Soviet aircraft carriers carry skip bombers armed with HE bombs.
The torpedo bombers are armed with torpedoes that have a long range and take longer to arm.
Starting from Tier VI, attack aircraft squadrons are armed with HE rockets similar to the American "Tiny Tim" rockets.
Early Access
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_7_33722423c774d6b0ffcc70c576e7538971637aefc907ec76bc1fabfef7d674bf.png Soviet Tokens are a new temporary resource that can be obtained:
By participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.
From free daily bundles.
From random bundles available for Doubloons.
In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.
Rewards for Soviet Tokens: sequentially available bundles with ships  IV Komsomolets,  VI Serov, and  VIII Pobeda along with Forward Bound permanent camouflages for them, as well as other rewards. Komsomolets, Serov, and permanent camouflages for the Tier IV, VI, and VIII carriers can be obtained for free. The sum of Tokens you can earn in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event and receive from free daily bundles will be sufficient for that.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/888f8286-0c9e-11ec-acfb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Rewards from random bundles available for Doubloons: Forward Bound permanent camouflage for  X Admiral Nakhimov, Soviet Tokens, Victory expendable camouflages, and other items.

When Update 0.10.10 goes live,  IV Komsomolets,  VI Serov,  VIII Pobeda, and  X Admiral Nakhimov will be available for all players to research. Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png6,000.

Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5af027a8-0bf5-11ec-ad83-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.10.8, a new temporary event awaits you—Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry. It's based on the history of the development of Soviet naval aviation and the various research and development bureaus that worked on machines for the Soviet Navy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 09 Sep. 09:30 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 07 Oct. 03:30 CEST (UTC+2)

The Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event is similar to the Battle of the Beasts event from Update 0.10.4, but it has a few differences.

The main differences in comparison to the Battle of the Beasts are as follows
Three teams instead of four.
Unique rewards—team patches—will be awarded for personal progress, not for team progress. This means that you'll still be able to earn unique rewards if your team doesn't progress enough.
Updated team selection window interface, as well as personal and team progress window.
In the Port, personal progress till the next reward in now displayed instead of the team progress.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e585ff0-0c92-11ec-8dc7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Rules of the Event
The event runs until the release of Update 0.10.9 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week.
Once per week, you can select one of the three teams: Polikarpov Bureau Team, Chyetverikov Bureau Team, or Kocherygin Bureau Team.
During the event, you need to complete personal missions that are issued daily to all event participants. They can be completed during the day in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as well as in the new temporary battle type—Convoy.
Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards.
Rewards: "6 Years of World of Warships" containers, themed patches, Victory camouflages, Coal, and Soviet Tokens.
You can read more about the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event in a dedicated article.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf892e30-0c99-11ec-8b8b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf7c7dca-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf6ec482-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf6cedba-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Convoy
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5affd64e-0bf5-11ec-81fc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.10.8 brings players an opportunity to participate in a new temporary battle type—Convoy—which focuses on escorting (or sinking) transport ships. Historically, defending or disrupting cargo routes has been one of the key tasks of fleets: a timely supply of military equipment, ammunition, and provisions has always played a tremendous role in the success of combat actions.

Rules
The defending team is tasked with escorting a convoy of four bot ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire attacking team is destroyed.
The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can either play solo or as a member of the Division. 
On average, it takes the convoy between 10 and 12 minutes to complete the route.
Format: 7 vs. 7, playing Tier VIII ships Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team
Battles will take place on the following maps: The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Warrior's Path, Loop, and Labyrinth.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f43d7e84-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f43d8424-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f47b957a-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f4810758-0c99-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 23 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 07 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

During this time, you'll be able to complete special combat missions only for this battle type, and they'll bring you Community Tokens. Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.

Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5c09359e-0bf5-11ec-8253-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

 VIII Chkalov will become available when the update is released. She's based on the project of a large aircraft carrier armed with dual-purpose artillery, and she was named after the Soviet test pilot who made the first non-stop flight over the North Pole. Just like the researchable Soviet aircraft carriers, Chkalov's squadrons consist of a single flight that carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once. She carries squadrons of skip bombers and torpedo bombers, but instead of attack aircraft she has regular bombers. Chkalov has powerful AA defenses and good concealment, and all of her squadrons are equipped with jet boosters. Chkalov will be available for  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png12,300 Doubloons.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8894dcc2-0c9e-11ec-8dbf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Changed the rewards under the "Naval Community" tab:
Removed the bundle with  III Katori. However, this ship is still available to purchase in the Armory for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png2,550 Doubloons.
Added four bundles with combat and economic signals, available for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png 600 Community Tokens each.
Added a Supercontainer for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png 2,000 Community Tokens. It can be purchased only once.
With the release of Update 0.10.9, Premium Ship V and Premium Ship VII containers, as well as the Restless Fire commemorative flag, will no longer be available in exchange for Community Tokens. They'll be replaced by new rewards. The full details will be announced when the release of Update 0.10.9 is near.
With the release of Update 0.10.8, Summer Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,500, while Dutch Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png60,000.
Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5c03ab1a-0bf5-11ec-aabf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

New Content
As a part of our collaboration with Hasbro, the following items have been added:

Other Changes and Improvements

Game balance changes
We've made some changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and player feedback. This applies to submarines and anti-submarine weapons in particular. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

Changes to characteristics of all submarines
Dive capacity depletion when the submarine is detected increased from 2 to 4 points per second;
Dive capacity restoration rate increased from 0.3 to 0.5 points per second;
Detectability range by sea after using the Sonar Ping reduced from 4 to 2 km;
The time it takes the torpedoes to arm increased from 0.5 to 2 s;
Reduced the detectability after using the Sonar Ping in smoke:
 VI Cachalot: from 2.4 to 2 km;
 VIII Salmon,  X Balao: from 2.2 to 2 km;
 VI U-69,  X U-2501: from 2.1 to 2 km.
Changes of the Hydrophone consumable
Consumable action time reduced:
 VI Cachalot,  VIII Salmon,  X Balao: from 45 to 40 s.
 VI U-69,  VIII U-190,  X U-2501: from 60 to 40 s.
Consumable cooldown time reduced:
 VI Cachalot,  VIII Salmon,  X Balao: from 90 to 80 s.
 VI U-69,  VIII U-190,  X U-2501: from 90 to 60 s.
Reduced ship bearing distance and spotting range of submerged submarines:
 VI Cachalot: from 5.5 to 5 km;
 VIII Salmon,  VI U-69: from 6 to 5.5 km;
 X Balao,  VIII U-190: from 6.5 to 6 km;
 X U-2501: from 7 to 6.5 km.
VI Farragut, VI Monaghan, VI Icarus, VI Gallant, VI Guépard, VI Aigle, VI Ernst Gaede, VI T-61, IX Paolo Emilio, VI Fubuki, VI Hatsuharu. VI Shinonome, VI Gnevny, VI Juruá, VI Västerås, VII Skåne, VIII Öland, IX Östergötland, VI Huanghe, VI Fushun, VIII Siliwangi, VI Anshan, and VIII Fenyang
Number of depth bomb charges increased from 1 to 2.
Cruisers VIII De Zeven Provinciën, VIII Belfast '43, and VI Huanghe
Added the possibility to mount the Depth Charges Modification 1 upgrade (fourth slot).
German aircraft carriers VIII A. Parseval, X M. Richthofen, VIII Graf Zeppelin, and VIII Graf Zeppelin B
Adjusted the settings of bombers:
Increased the chance of two bombs hitting the ellipse at once.
American Tier X aircraft carrier X Franklin D. Roosevelt
Torpedo bomber parameters were changed:
Torpedo arming distance increased from 517 to 545 m.
Torpedo launch spread increased by 5%.
Bomber parameters were changed:
Maximum damage caused by a bomb has been reduced from 11,200 to 10,600.
HE bomb penetration reduced from 67 to 64 mm.
Chances of fire being caused by HE bombs reduced from 64 to 60%.
Soviet Tier X cruiser Alexander Nevsky
The Repair Party consumable now restores 33% of the damage dealt to the citadel instead of 10%.
Other Changes and Improvements
Fixed an error that caused torpedoes to deviate from the selected trajectory if the ship was circulating during their launch.
Fixed an issue that prevented the post-battle stats screen from being displayed for players after battles.
Fixed an error that caused the animations of torpedoes being launched, as well as the periscope going up and down, to be displayed incorrectly on certain submarines.
Fixed an error that prevented players from entering their login and password with the help of an on-screen keyboard at the login screen.
Fixed an error that caused the integral characteristics of AA guns to be calculated incorrectly when mounting upgrades and mastering skills that improve AA defenses.
Fixed an error that prevented rockets from dealing damage to parts of ships that were entirely destroyed.
Fixed an error that sometimes made it impossible to set a course for autopilot after colliding with an island.
Fixed an error that caused the ships to get stuck near one of the islands after appearing on the "Neighbors" map.
Fixed an error that caused the Depth Charge Airstrike armament to disappear from  IX Wujing and  VIII Pyotr Bagration.
Fixed an error that cased the number of depth charges on  VII Atlanta B not to match that on  VII Atlanta.
Fixed an error that caused  VIII Cleveland in her standard hull not to receive critical damage to her steering gears.
Fixed the maximum range of Airstrike on  VII Eendracht being 10 km instead of 11 km.
Fixed the incorrect rocket travel time of  VIII Kaga and  VIII Kaga B attack aircraft.
Maximum frame rate can now be set in preferences.xml. Setting it in engine_config.xml after each update is no longer necessary.
Due a technical error, we've temporarily disabled the possibility to switch the camera to torpedo tubes on all submarines when clicking the preview icon in the parameters.
Fixed an error that caused  IX Z-44 to have a slightly higher chance of fire on the ship.
Other Improvements and Changes. For a complete list, please refer to Player Support.
