The reward for completing each of the sections is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account.

The rewards for completing the entire collection include the Iron Cross permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVIII Gustav Julius Maerker and a commemorative flag.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b3c3eb40-a119-11eb-b67e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Elements of the collection can only be obtained from German Destroyers containers.
Auction
As part of Update 0.10.4, we’re adding a new method by which you can obtain in-game items. We call it the "Auction"—a place where you can find rare goodies. The Auction will feature rare collectibles, and offers another way of replenishing supplies of resources and other in-game valuables.

Key Rules
Each Auction has a limited duration.
It comprises the following stages:
[olist]A lot that is offered in an Auction is announced with details of its starting price and the number of possible bid winners.
The Auction begins, and bids can be placed.
The results of the Auction are summed up; bids are no longer accepted.
The Auction winners receive their rewards, while the other Auction participants receive their bids back.[/olist]
You can change your bid amount at any time, as long as bidding for that lot is still available.
Players will only be notified of the starting bid for a lot and the number of possible winners.
Depending on the lot, you can use various in-game resources for your bid.
The number of lots is limited; the highest bids win; the winning bids will be used as payments for the lots.
It's a no-risk adventure! Any bid that doesn't win will be returned to the bidder when the Auction closes.
For example, if there is a lot for 500 commemorative flags, the 500 players with the highest bids will receive one flag each.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/88e99578-a11e-11eb-b9d1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9cf4371a-a120-11eb-a740-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Changes to Commander Skills
In Update 0.10.4, we've enhanced the following skills:
Survivability Expert (cruiser skill)
Extra-Heavy AP Shells and Fearless Brawler (destroyer skills)
Enhanced Reactions (aircraft carrier skill)
Super-Heavy AP Shells (battleship skill)
The parameters of these skills were inferior to other "same-price" skills in terms of combat efficiency, which affected their popularity.

For battleships, the Dead Eye skill is replaced with the Swift in Silence skill, giving battleships a 10% increase in speed while the ship remains undetected. This way, we add more options for battleships in terms of positioning, allowing them to engage in combat or change position in a skirmish faster. When Update 0.10.4 goes live, all Commanders with the Dead Eye skill mastered will have their battleship skills reset free of charge. Skills related to the other ship types will not be reset.

The Next Steps
Further changes to Commander skills should be expected in autumn at the earliest, because it takes time for such enhancements to be designed and tested. We’re going to focus on balancing a number of skills as well. The least popular skills will either be improved or removed from the game entirely.

Once Update 0.10.4 and the changes it brings hit the servers, we'll continue monitoring the balance of specific ships that are most affected by the Commander skill changes, based on incoming statistics and your feedback. We'll make selective fixes if needed. When making these changes, we’ll make it possible for all players to reset Commander skills free of charge during the second stage of tweaks in autumn.

Updated Achievements Interface
We've updated the interface to make navigating through the Achievements section and tracking progress in the game more convenient:
Updated the appearance of the Achievements screen.
Added categories and updated the sorting of achievements.
Updated pop-up tooltips in the Port and for the post-battle statistics.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bb75fec-a11e-11eb-8a51-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/88b4e166-a11e-11eb-b37b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
We have disabled the rewards that were previously issued for earning achievements. On the Live Server, they will be replaced by special chains of combat missions for Base XP in victorious battles. You can complete the missions in Operations; Brawls; and Ranked, Random, and Co-op Battles. This means that you can replenish your stocks of signal flags in the majority of battle types. The mission conditions take into account the varying difficulty of their completion depending on which type of battle you choose. For example, you can be a frequent winner in Co-op Battles, but receive less XP per battle, or you can quickly obtain the rewards by earning more XP per battle in a smaller number of victorious Random or Ranked Battles. The available rewards include More Signals containers and Gift containers.

The updates to this section will allow us to add more achievements to the game in the future.

notes.content:

Episode 10 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Premieres: Mon. 26 Apr. 19:00 CEST (UTC+2)

This month we're trying out a new time slot for our historical talk show – join us on Twitch, YouTube or Facebook next Monday, April 26 at 19:00 CEST and tune in to our panel's discussion of the naval battles of Narvik. In April 1940, British and German destroyer forces engaged in brutal close-quarters combat in the claustrophobic confines of the Norwegian Fjords as both powers vied for the strategic control of the nordic country.

This month, our panelists are YouTuber Drachinifel, naval historian Dr. Alexander Clarke, and World of Warships' own Tuccy, and MrConway.
You can leave your questions and comments for our panel at our dedicated Discord server at the link below. If you're not a member of our server, you can join here. If you're already a member, you can follow the direct link below. You can also fill out the traditional question form if you're not comfortable with Discord.
Ask on Discord

Fill out the form

The Battles of Narvik
For months after Britain's and France's declaration of war against Germany, the world held its breath as neither side seemed to want to be the first to escalate the conflict. In this period, which came to be known as the 'Phoney War', faith in a diplomatic solution to the war still remained, and actual military actions were limited to a small scale. 

The balance was disrupted when in April 1940, Germany buckled and made an aggressive move to occupy Norway —Operation Weserübung— with the aim of gaining uninterrupted access to Swedish iron ore, as well as strategic ports in the British-controlled North Sea. This sudden campaign was costly in general for both sides, and for the Kriegsmarine in particular: heavy cruiser Admiral Hipper suffered damage after being rammed by destroyer HMS Glowworm on April 5, and her sister Blücher was sunk by Norwegian coastal defenses in Oslofjord on April 9.

While this was happening, a force of 10 German destroyers assaulted the sparsely defended northern port of Narvik and landed troops to garrison the city. Due to a delay in refueling, the German destroyer flotilla was forced on April 9 to stay another night in the frigid waters of Ofotfjord before retreating back South.

In the early morning of April 10, the first Royal Navy units slipped into the fjord, setting the scene for a spectacular end to the 'Phoney War'.

How did it play out? Join our stream next Monday and find out!

notes.title: Italian Battleship Branch Review
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b3cfc7acf12d63c6c8da6158ce95aa91623272e.jpg
Italian battleships Dante Alighieri, Conte di Cavour, Andrea Doria, Francesco Caracciolo, Vittorio Veneto, Lepanto, and Cristoforo Colombo are now available for everyone to research.

Read the article below to learn how to effectively play the newcomers.

[table][tr][th]Key Features of the Branch ● Tactics ● Upgrades[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=EUD-fpDZGus;full][/previewyoutube]
Key Features of the Branch
Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected ship parts, but do not cause fires and can ricochet.
Numerous main battery guns on Tier IX and X battleships.
Their main guns have short firing ranges, low accuracy, and long reload times.
Good protection thanks to their decent armor that ensures a high level of defense against high-explosive shells; as well as their good maneuverability.
Tier VIII–X ships have the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to hide from the enemy without having to reduce their speed.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/517e1860-9c56-11eb-b781-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/51a65960-9c56-11eb-859c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/518aa13e-9c56-11eb-9927-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5184ad24-9c56-11eb-86bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5184a75c-9c56-11eb-b75d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5184a3d8-9c56-11eb-a5d7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/518319dc-9c56-11eb-b737-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Tactics
Decent maneuverability and armor coupled with low accuracy and short firing ranges define the Italian battleships' gameplay—they are medium- and close-range fighters.

Thanks to their powerful semi-armor-piercing shells with high penetration and damage capabilities, the Italians can boast of having a heavy salvo weight. This applies to Tier IX–X battleships in particular, due to their large number of main battery guns. You can inflict considerable damage to cruisers, as well as the ends, superstructures, and even some of the better-armored casemates of battleships. As for destroyers, they take not more than 1/10 of the maximum damage dealt by a semi-armor-piercing shell. Moreover, semi-armor-piercing shells can ricochet—the "14.3 caliber rule" applies to them, which is something you also need to consider when choosing a target.

You can learn more about the "14.3 caliber rule" by watching a dedicated video.

Italian armor-piercing shells don't have the largest caliber—it's 381 mm for Tier VII–X battleships. However, unlike semi-armor-piercing shells that explode upon contact with armor, armor-piercing shells can strike a ship's citadel, even if it's protected by the casemate's armor belt or plating.

The Italians can enter battle more confidently thanks to the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which appears on high-tier battleships starting with https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Vittorio Veneto. It allows you to stealthily approach an enemy, escape focused fire even out on open water, or retreat entirely — all without even having to reduce your speed. Exhaust Smoke Generator can also give you the advantage of firing the first salvo, but keep in mind that afterwards you'll be most likely detected due to the high detectability of battleships after firing main battery guns even from within smoke.

Just like other battleships that specialize in fighting at close and medium ranges, the main role of the Italians is to define the attack direction of their team. Make sure to watch the situation on the battlefield carefully though. Despite the Italian battleships having decent armor that provides good protection against high-explosive shells, in case of heavy focused fire from several opponents, it's best to withdraw and change position. That's when Exhaust Smoke Generator and the ships' good maneuverability will come in handy. If the situation allows it, push forward using your numerous main battery guns and powerful semi-armor-piercing shells.

notes.title: Hamburg Dockyard: Construction of ZF-6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b528a2842e51772fcfca6285d02b2a42870ce1ce.jpg
In Update 0.10.3, you’ll be able to start building a new German destroyer, ZF-6.

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6 is one of the unfinished Le Hardi-class French destroyers that were captured by Germany when France capitulated in 1940. The project that was conceived to finish building the ship involved her complete rearmament with German-manufactured weapons. She has decent concealment; AP shells that can inflict significant damage and have enhanced ricochet angles; and the Engine Boost, Smoke Generator, and Defensive AA Fire consumables. When countering destroyers, the ship can take advantage of the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable. When it comes to heavily armored targets, her fast torpedoes that can inflict heavy damage and have a decent reload time may come in very handy, despite their quite high detectability.

[table][tr][th]Rules of the Event ● Combat Missions ● Rewards[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=HCQ-0eaOkZI;full][/previewyoutube]
Rules of the Event
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 22 phases.
These shipbuilding phases can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions, or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png2,200 Doubloons to pass through each phase.
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: eight shipbuilding phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png8,950 Doubloons and three shipbuilding phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 Doubloons.
The Dockyard combat missions span two updates—0.10.3 and 0.10.4. Players will be able to complete shipbuilding phases in exchange for Doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.5.
In total, you can progress through 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions.
The rewards for progressing through shipbuilding phases are Credits, Elite Commander XP, Free XP, Coal, Premium Account time, special signals, expendable camouflages, and Gift containers.
Upon completing the 22nd shipbuilding phase, you'll receive https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6 in the War Paint camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, a Port slot, and a commemorative flag.

The process of creating https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6's design drawings is the main new feature of the Dockyard in comparison with its previous iterations. The drawing process occupies the first four phases. Once you have progressed through them, the ship's construction begins.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c590b6d6-9c51-11eb-86bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c635c130-9c51-11eb-b781-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c97352fe-9c51-11eb-86ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5e07f36-9c51-11eb-9118-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c608b44c-9c51-11eb-bf1e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c635047a-9c51-11eb-b9a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Combat Missions
The new game event tasks you with completing 72 combat missions spread across eight groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.10.3, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis.

Completing each of the first five groups will progress you through two shipbuilding phases—one phase for accomplishing a specific mission, and one phase for finishing the entire group.

Completing each of the last three groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases—two for specific missions and one for finishing the group.
The Dockyard combat missions will remain available until the release of Update 0.10.5. Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.

By progressing through the Dockyard combat mission groups, you can complete 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.

We're here to tell you about Early Access to new German destroyers.

German Destroyers: Part 1
Features of the Ship Branch
Accurate main battery guns with a large caliber for this ship type—150 mm.
Powerful AP shells with decent penetration, damage, and enhanced shell ricochet angles. They are capable of dealing significant damage to cruisers.
Good armor for their type, which effectively protects against HE shells of most destroyers (unless they have mastered the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill), and large HP pools. Combined with effective artillery, this results in special gameplay for the new German destroyers. They are essentially agile ships that primarily focus on lone targets—light cruisers particularly.
The low damage per minute of their HE shells and their high detectability means that these new ships are quite ineffective when fighting for control of Key Areas.
The Smoke Generator consumable improves the already good survivability of the new ships even further. Starting from Tier IX, German destroyers have the Defensive AA Fire consumable, which allows them to confront enemy squadrons with greater confidence.
Their torpedoes deal heavy damage and have good range and a reload time that is quite standard for most destroyers, but they are rather slow.

Особенности ветки
Полубронебойные снаряды вместо фугасов. Они наносят высокий урон по слабо- и среднезащищённым целям и уязвимым частям корабля, но не вызывают пожары.
Большое количество орудий с невысокой дальностью стрельбы и не самой высокой точностью.
Неплохие манёвренность и бронирование.
«Дымогенератор полного хода» у кораблей VIII–X уровня, который позволит скрыться от противника, не снижая скорость. Стрелять из дымовой завесы при отступлении не рекомендуется, поскольку у линкоров высокая заметность при выстреле ГК в дымах.

Игроков ждёт возвращение на обновлённую Гамбургскую верфь, где они смогут построить новый немецкий эсминец https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6. Корабль обладает хорошей маскировкой, ББ-снарядами с улучшенными углами рикошета и высоким уроном, «Форсажем», «Дымогенератором» и «Заградительным огнём ПВО». В борьбе с эсминцами кораблю поможет «Ускорение перезарядки ГК», а против тяжелобронированных целей будут полезны торпеды с высокой скоростью и уроном, неплохим временем перезарядки, но высокой заметностью.

Всего за выполнение боевых задач Верфи можно получить 19 из 22 этапов строительства.

Особенности ветки
Точные орудия ГК с большим для класса калибром — 150 мм.
Мощные ББ-снаряды c хорошим пробитием, уроном и улучшенными углами рикошета, способные наносить высокий урон крейсерам.
Отличное для класса бронирование, которое эффективно защищает от ОФ-снарядов большинства эсминцев (если только у них не изучен навык «Инерционный взрыватель ОФ-снарядов»), и большое количество очков боеспособности. В сочетании с эффективной артиллерией это формирует особый геймплей новых немецких эсминцев: мобильные корабли с мощными ББ-снарядами, главным образом выцеливающие одиночные корабли, в первую очередь лёгкие крейсеры.
Низкий урон в минуту ОФ-снарядов и высокая заметность, из-за чего новички не очень эффективны в борьбе за точки.
Наличие снаряжения «Дымогенератор», усиливающего и без того неплохую живучесть новых кораблей. Начиная с IX уровня, у немецких эсминцев появляется снаряжение «Заградительный огонь ПВО», позволяющее им увереннее противостоять эскадрильям противника.
Торпеды с высоким уроном и отличной дальностью хода, стандартной для большинства эсминцев перезарядкой, но малой скоростью хода.

Улучшен эффект снежной бури при локальной погоде: играть во время бури станет комфортнее.
Изменена дистанция отрисовки выстрелов: теперь дым от залпа будет виден с большей дистанции.
Частота визуального эффекта снаряжения «Гидроакустический поиск» стала реже: 36 секунд вместо 20. Это позволит лучше концентрироваться на бое.
Исправлена ошибка, приводившая к отсутствию эффекта тряски при получении урона.
Уменьшена скорость течения воды, чтобы снизить дискомфорт некоторых игроков.
Улучшена видимость торпедного прицела кораблей на карте «Пролив».
Для повышения производительности оптимизирована система отрисовки эффектов.
Для некоторых карт добавлены элементы подводного мира.
Изменены настройки освещения и уменьшен эффект дымовой завесы.
Интерфейс окна командиров
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fc353356-9869-11eb-b2a5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Для более удобной навигации и большей информативности обновлён интерфейс окна «Навыки командира»:
Кнопка «Все навыки» заменена на кнопку https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7033fd4a-8b0f-11eb-8940-8cdcd4b147d4.png рядом с заголовком таблицы навыков. [table][tr][td]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09dbf2ce-9941-11eb-925d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/td]
[td]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ee49608c-9940-11eb-b96a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/td]
[/tr][/table]
Во всплывающие подсказки к навыкам добавлен блок со снаряжением, на которое этот навык влияет.
Во всплывающие подсказки к навыкам, у которых есть постоянный и активируемый эффекты, к постоянному добавлен поясняющий заголовок.
Добавлена строка «Распределено максимальное количество очков навыков» вместо счётчика свободных очков навыков у полностью обученных командиров.
Во всплывающих подсказках к командирам, имеющим таланты и персонализации, сначала отображаются таланты и персонализации, а под ними — навыки.
Убран счётчик очков навыков с портрета командира в окне «Навыки командира».
Индикатор доступных очков навыков командира перенесён под портрет командира.
При рекрутировании, демобилизации и прочих операциях с командирами сохраняется последний выбранный игроком вариант.
Всплывающие подсказки к персонализациям и талантам приведены в единый с навыками вид.
Добавлены отсутствующие звуки при операциях с окнами, связанных с командирами.
Исправлена ошибка, приводившая к тому, что карусель кораблей могла не отображаться в окне командиров.
Также обновлен интерфейс окна «Информация о навыках»:
Теперь вкладки классов кораблей в окне «Информация о навыках» озаглавлены текстом вместо иконок кораблей.    https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6f6bd5ee-9907-11eb-9bc6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Добавлена подсказка о необходимости назначить командира на корабль определённого класса для изучения навыков.
Иконки неизученных навыков стали значительно темнее.
Убраны индикаторы с количеством неизученных навыков.
Морское сражение
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/01430684-986a-11eb-9732-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Чтобы разнообразить игровой опыт в «Морском сражении» были сделаны следующие изменения:
Добавлена возможность получить дополнительные попытки, зависящие от активности игрока на этапе Подготовки.    https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/741bfa92-9907-11eb-a154-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Добавлена возможность просматривать результаты соперника на этапе Битвы.    https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77c2656e-9907-11eb-bc15-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Для удобства игроков все временные интервалы в календаре будут показываться по местному времени. Время начала каждого раунда изменится на 20 минут — он будет начинаться в 06:20 UTC.

В Порту обновлен баннер «Морских сражений».
Балансные изменения
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fc36916a-9869-11eb-8a52-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

В 0.10.3 мы изменили характеристики нескольких кораблей на основе анализа их боевой эффективности и отзывов игроков. Подобные правки необходимы, чтобы аккуратно корректировать баланс выбранных кораблей. Мы продолжим вносить изменения в следующих обновлениях при необходимости.

Британский линкор Thunderer
Дальность стрельбы орудий ГК уменьшена с 24,3 до 23 км.

Советский крейсер «Сталинград»
Время действия снаряжения «Поисковая РЛС» уменьшено с 30 до 25 секунд.

Итальянский линкор Dante Alighieri
Параметр сигма уменьшен с 1,6 до 1,5.

Итальянский линкор Conte di Cavour
Время перезарядки орудий ГК уменьшено с 33 до 31,5 секунд.

Итальянский линкор Andrea Doria
Максимальный урон ПББ-снаряда увеличен с 9100 до 9500.

Изменения модулей
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fc815c40-9869-11eb-9732-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Для облегчения исследования кораблей произведены следующие изменения:
VIII Mogami, V König, VI Ryūjō — убран корпус А, корпуса B и C переименованы в А и В соответственно.
V Furutaka, VII Myōkō, IX Izumo, IX Iowa — убраны корпуса А и В, корпус С переименован в В. Создан новый базовый корпус на основе корпуса С с изменённым составом ПВО.
V Omaha — убраны корпуса А и С. Корпус В переименован в корпус А. Создан новый исследуемый корпус В на основе старого корпуса В с изменённым составом ПВО.
Также базовые корпуса у V Émile Bertin, V New York, VI New Mexico, VII Colorado, VIII North Carolina, VI Bayern, VI Ranger, IX Fletcher, VII Минск, VIII Киев, VIII Огневой, IX Ташкент, IX Удалой заменены на новые, созданные на основе исследуемых корпусов с изменённым составом ПВО. Это сделано для того, чтобы повысить комфорт игры на этих кораблях в базовых корпусах.

Изменения орудий:
VIII Z-23 — орудия 150-мм/55 Tbts KC/36T в установке LDrh LC/38 удалены из игры. Также обновлены модели главного калибра.
При установке корпуса В изменится конфигурация артиллерии: носовая башня станет двухорудийной.
Удаление 150-мм орудий сильнее подчеркнёт различия между старой и новой веткой немецких эсминцев. У кораблей старой ветки будут только 128-мм орудия, у кораблей новой — 150-мм орудия.

Правила компенсации
Удаление модулей корпусов:
Если игроком был изучен корпус B, то ему будет начислен опыт корабля, равный стоимости исследования корпуса В.
Если игроком был исследован корпус С, то на корабль будет установлен новый корпус B. В остальных случаях на корабль будет установлен новый корпус A.
Если заменяющийся корпус приобретён игроком, ему будет начислена компенсация в размере стоимости его покупки в кредитах.
Изменения орудий VIII Z-23:
Если игроком были изучены орудия 150-мм/55 Tbts KC/36T в установке LDrh LC/38, игроку будет начислена компенсация 15 000 ед. опыта корабля.
Если заменяющиеся орудия приобретены игроком, ему будет начислена компенсация в размере стоимости их покупки в кредитах.
Прочие изменения и улучшения
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fc3a0976-9869-11eb-84af-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Улучшена производительность при переключении между кораблями, покупке корабля, сбросе веток и других операциях в Порту.
Улучшен процесс загрузки и выгрузки текстурных данных, что позволит оптимизировать потребление видеопамяти.
Возвращена отдельная настройка клавиш для выбора и запуска эскадрилий: теперь перенастройка выбора снаряда не влияет на настройку клавиш авиагрупп.
Порт «Полигон» больше не доступен для выбора в клиенте.
Исправлена ошибка, приводившая к некорректной работе обзорной камеры в бою у VIII Flandre.
Исправлена ошибка, приводившая к сбросу прогресса в прошедших ранговых сезонах.
И другие исправления и изменения. Полный список доступен в нашем Центре поддержки.

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.3! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Changed the settings of the "Axis vs Allies" battle type, and the automatic addition of bots to teams was switched off. In the second stage of the Public Test, these battles will be conducted in a "4 vs 4" format. The waiting screen will be showing not only the total number of players in the queue, but also their number on the alliance chosen by the player.
Made visual changes to torpedo trails, tracers, shells, smoke screen, and the effect from the "Hydroacoustic Search" consumable. The speed of waves was reduced on all maps.
Updated the videos and fixed several issues in the Dockyard.
Reduced the fog density and fixed visual issues in the Hamburg Port.
Fixed issues in the  "Daily Rewards" section.
Fixed a bug because of which it was impossible to check the armor layout when previewing a ship in the Armory.
Balance changes to several ships were made.
Fixed some other bugs.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.3
notes.content:
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b91b8bba-7e6b-11ea-85b6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]Hamburg Dockyard: ZF-6 ● German Destroyers: Part 1 ● Axis vs. Allies ● Italian Battleships ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
Hamburg Dockyard: ZF-6
Players will be able to return to the Hamburg Dockyard, where a new German Tier IX destroyer,  https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6, can be built. The ship has decent concealment; AP shells that can inflict significant damage and have enhanced ricochet angles; and the Engine Boost, Smoke Generator, and Defensive AA Fire consumables. When countering destroyers, the ship can take advantage of the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable. When it comes to heavily armored targets, her fast torpedoes that can inflict heavy damage and have a decent reload time, but also quite high detectability, may come in handy.

The rules of the event are similar to those of the previous Dockyards, but the number of shipbuilding phases and rewards are different.
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 22 phases.
The shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through the Dockyard combat missions or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png2,200 Doubloons to pass through each phase.
The combat missions of the Dockyard will span two updates—0.10.3 and 0.10.4. Players will be able to complete shipbuilding phases in exchange for Doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.5.
In total, you can pass through 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases by progressing through Dockyard combat missions.
For completing shipbuilding phases, you can earn Coal, Premium Account time, Elite Commander XP, and other rewards.
Upon completing the 22nd shipbuilding phase, you'll receive  https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6 in the War Paint camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, a Port slot, and a commemorative flag.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b8e40caa-8b01-11eb-992a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The first four shipbuilding phases involve the creation of  https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6's design drawings. Then the building of the ship begins.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b910434c-8b01-11eb-93aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bdd024ce-8b01-11eb-aca4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
If you complete the construction of  https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6 by spending Doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png3,000 Coal and 200 Steel.
The reward for completing the 22nd shipbuilding phase on the Public Test server is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png100,000 Coal instead of  https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX ZF-6.

German Destroyers: Part 1
Update 0.10.3 kicks off an event that places the new German Tier VII–IX destroyers right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.
Note: the new German destroyers can't be obtained on the Public Test server.

Features of the Ship Branch
Accurate main battery guns with a large caliber for this ship type—150 mm.
Powerful AP shells with decent penetration, damage, and enhanced shell ricochet angles. They are capable of dealing significant damage to cruisers.
Good armor for their type and large HP pools. Combined with effective artillery, this results in special gameplay for the new German destroyers. They are essentially agile mini cruisers with powerful AP shells that primarily focus on lone targets—light cruisers particularly.
The low damage per minute of their HE shells and their high detectability means that these new ships are quite ineffective when fighting for control of Key Areas.
The Smoke Generator consumable improves the already great survivability of the new ships even further. Starting from Tier IX, German destroyers have the Defensive AA Fire consumable, which allows them to confront enemy squadrons with greater confidence.
Torpedoes with a short reload time—quite standard for German destroyers—but average damage and range. They are effective against heavily armored targets.
Early Access
German Tokens are a new temporary resource. You can earn them by completing weekly chains of combat missions. They can also be obtained from random bundles available for Doubloons, free daily bundles, and bundles in exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory.

Rewards for German Tokens
Sequentially available bundles with https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVII Z-31; https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVIII Gustav Julius Maerker; Iron Cross permanent camouflages for the new German Tier VII, IX, and Tier X destroyers; and other rewards.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b9085b1e-8b01-11eb-b0c7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b8b901d6-8b01-11eb-bb80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The amount of Tokens that can be earned by completing chains of combat missions will be enough to obtain a sequentially available bundle with https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVII Z-31.

Rewards From the Random Bundles Available for Doubloons
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngIX Felix Schultz, German Tokens, Hunter and Black-White-Red expendable camouflages, and special signals.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b8e3cf38-8b01-11eb-afd4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The Port of Hamburg has been updated.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/38956f12-8b10-11eb-bd0d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39fa032c-8b10-11eb-9b49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3892d9aa-8b10-11eb-a774-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Axis vs. Allies
A new temporary battle type—Axis vs. Allies—which is inspired by historical naval battles, will become available to players. Battles in this mode will involve only ships that were actually built and their analogues. One of the teams will comprise only Axis ships, and the other one will only have Allied ships.

Teams will be formed based on the ships of certain nations:
Axis: German, Italian, and Japanese ships.
Allies: American, Soviet, French, British, Pan-Asian, and European ships.
The battles are held playing Tier VIII ships in a 8 vs. 8 format.

notes.title: Twitch Drops in 0.10.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/420c31c14f06928fe3c759a4c769a3b2515dfa14.jpg
Commanders!
Get ready to start earning new rewards just for watching World of Warships live streams on Twitch! This month...
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6b4bb136-8675-11eb-98e7-38eaa735f4cc.pngGet your hands on up to three Italian battleships containers—each with chances of dropping Italian Premium ships!
Show your loyalty to [strike]the old "GO NAVY!" event team of your choice: Team EAGLES, or[/strike] Team SHARKS, and fly their flag proudly!
Plus more!
In case you missed it, the way in which Twitch Drops work changed during the previous update. Make sure to skim the details in last month's article to be up-to-date on how to earn the most rewards.
Don't forget: you need to link your Twitch account to World of Warships in order to receive Twitch Drops. Doing so is easy! Just follow the instructions here.
[table][tr][th]Twitch rewards ● Where and How[/th][/tr][/table]
Twitch | Follow

Twitch rewards
This month, there are two types of Twitch Drops for World of Warships. All, except for the Official Channel Drops, can be obtained by watching any streamer on Twitch who is playing World of Warships with Drops Enabled.

On the first Thursday of the update, both types of rewards become available and remain claimable for a full week, until they are refreshed the following Thursday.
Join our official weekly English stream on Thursdays at 17:00 UTC so as not to miss out on any rewards!
Twitch Drops
https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2b5f8144-34ac-11eb-a15b-38eaa735f4cc_330x.png
A special Twitch container delivered straight to your Port when watching streams⁠—no strings attached! You can receive up to five of these during Update 0.10.2, with a new container becoming available each Thursday.

Exceptionally, two containers will be claimable during the fourth week of the update!

When opened, a Twitch container drops:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png100,000 Credits
Assorted signal flags
Twitch Challenges
When watching streams during Update 0.10.2, a combat mission will be unlocked directly in your Port every week.

Mission 1

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/51952bc8-81cf-11eb-a334-38eaa735f4cc.png

In a single battle, earn 1,703 base XP.

Reward: 4x Lá Fhéile Pádraig camouflages

Ship restrictions: British, Commonwealth, Tiers V–X

Battle type restrictions: Random and Ranked
[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
OR
[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/51952bc8-81cf-11eb-a334-38eaa735f4cc.png
Over any number of battles, deal 500,000 damage.

Reward: 4x Lá Fhéile Pádraig camouflages

Ship restrictions: British, Commonwealth, Tiers V–X

Battle type restrictions: Random, Ranked, Co-op and Scenarios

You can complete this combat mission only once.
[/expand]

notes.title: Big Hunt: the Raid Begins
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0667f8e147aed9e6f5645a5b3cfa7f20fa4248f1.jpg
Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type—Big Hunt. Demonstrate your skills in a futuristic exhibition competition by assuming command over ships representing three different corporations!

[table][tr][th]Things You Should Know ● Tips ● Rewards ● Big Hunt Rules ● Battle Points ● Combat Missions ● Ships and Armaments[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=tGyOTaqFNGI;full][/previewyoutube]
Things You Should Know
A new temporary battle type—Big Hunt—will be available to players in Update 0.10.2. It's a revamped version of the Key Battle mode from Update 0.9.10. Team up, fight, earn Battle Points, and exchange them for rewards in the Armory.

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a gigantic Polygon map.
Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal only opens up after a certain amount of time.
You start out alone, but you can form teams directly in battle.
It's now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player in the Division still starts the battle alone. In order to coordinate their efforts, Division mates will first need to locate each other on the map and create a team.
The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2457e88a-830f-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24523e58-830f-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/245fd8d8-830f-11eb-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
A temporary resource—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_saltpeter_65bc5d6f2e5b745981b237addbe95a8b0eab5f1e4be650cbe25135f0b2246955.pngBattle Points—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can upgrade your ship directly in battle.
Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new AI boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her will not be an easy task, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2445a206-830f-11eb-9d35-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle when you apply upgrades. You’ll keep the points you earned regardless of what happens, and you can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you earn.
Each of the six available ships offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay.
The Big Hunt's difficulty will intensify each week—the time it takes for the Portal to open and the monsters' HP and damage (as well as the amount of Battle Points earned by destroying them!) will increase. The maximum size of teams will also increase—from three players in the first week, to six players in the fourth week.
Tips
Try different combinations of modules and armaments—assemble a ship that's to your liking! Don't be afraid to experiment—you need to act unpredictably in the Polygon.
Try to assemble a team of your own or join one with other players. By fighting together with your allies, you'll increase your chances of escaping via the Portal.
Destroy the first monsters you encounter and upgrade your ship as quickly as possible. This will give you an advantage in the following engagements.
As you get closer to the center of the map, the monsters will become increasingly dangerous, but you'll also earn more Battle Points for destroying them.
Keep an eye on Aurora's arrival timer so that you can be in the right place and combat ready when she finally arrives. Defeating the boss ship will bring you and your team the most Battle Points.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0142a26c-857c-11eb-9302-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Rewards
Earned Battle Points can be spent in the Armory to purchase three types of random bundles that include, among other things, a special temporary resource—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_5e12273711a6fe3f2341957a1d21dcab0d260f39bfa09496ab09bb45bc76e934.png Corporation Tokens.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8f4ddea8-8597-11eb-8267-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Corporation Tokens can be exchanged for themed permanent camouflages for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVIII Akizuki, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Amagi, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVIII Öland (5 Tokens each), or for Credits.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/304251de-858b-11eb-98ed-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/305a0f54-858b-11eb-a0e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3047aac6-858b-11eb-9ccd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Apart from that, you can exchange Doubloons, Credits, and Free XP for bundles with Corporation Tokens and Coal in the Armory.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8ebd2dcc-8597-11eb-a84e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Corporation Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the end of Update 0.10.3. After that, they will be exchanged for Credits at the rate of 1 Corporation Token : {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,500,000 Credits. Battle Points can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the end of Update 0.10.2. After the end of the event, they will be exchanged for Credits at the rate of 1 Battle Point : {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png75 Credits.
Outstanding successes in the Big Hunt will be rewarded with special themed achievements.
[table][tr][td]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_MONSTER_59c64f12223f36b71c30ac17db70fc6033657a4c26105ad6a2e5cf10990f6a8c.png[/td] [td]Berserk — destroy 10 ships or monsters.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2020_PORTAL_866ff7f1ead8ded9dd2c0e882e0bddd2f307e1c3c1abba8ada1c5c84c5bc50fe.png[/td] [td]There's Always a Way Out! — exit through the Portal in the Raid game mode.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_MODULE_6f9adc7c22ede8112871c215770ec440424f51ad314f17e36dd5e92a2ecfb8bc.png[/td] [td]Engineer of the Future — research all ships and modules in the Big Hunt event.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_TOOLATE_4c8d24f2ee1582c0712542ac769d351e0f648978e3700fd3a2f82839d1a3097b.png[/td] [td]Breaking the Eighth Wall — visit the place of your past battles.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_GIANTSLAYER_db970c043818981e35da92a28e7674a8f40f2f9abebf7a38fb7cae1f52e0c550.png[/td] [td]Giant Slayer — destroy Aurora in the Raid game mode.[/td][/tr][/table]
Big Hunt Rules
To access the Big Hunt, you must have fought at least 21 battles in the available battle types.
All 16 players begin each battle on the Polygon map alone, facing other players and AI-controlled monsters.

But you don't have to fight alone—you can assemble a team directly in battle. To invite a player to your team, aim at them and press F. When you receive an invitation, the top of the screen displays who sent the invitation and how to accept or decline it.
You can also enter the Big Hunt in a Division. However, you still start the battle alone and need to locate each other on the map in order to team up. The possibility to place markers on the Minimap has been added. These markers will be visible to all team members and will help you coordinate your actions.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ff9821e2-8596-11eb-8484-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ff857ae2-8596-11eb-a0e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39a857b2-858d-11eb-af5c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
The main objective of the Big Hunt is to gather as many Battle Points as possible and exit the Polygon via the Portal. It's closed at the beginning of a battle and you'll only be able to enter it some time after the battle starts.

The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit via the Portal, or when the battle time expires. For this reason, it's better not to stay too long in the Polygon—the Portal won't stay open forever and, as the battle nears its end, AI-controlled ships of the Terra Corporation will start hunting down any remaining players.

Battle Points
You can earn Battle Points by destroying monsters and other players' ships. Aurora, the new boss ship created by the Terra Corporation, will bring you the most points. Be careful though, vanquishing Aurora and her escorts will not be easy, even with a team.

Having accrued enough Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. To select one of the two improvements, use Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2, or Ctrl + https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/095e93cc-8589-11eb-8f09-8cdcd4b147d4.png on the preferred improvement. You don't spend any Battle Points in the process of improving your ship, so make sure to reinforce your ship as soon as you're able! Any Points you earn can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory after the battle.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/001ab1c0-8597-11eb-9383-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
While you're part of the same team, you can't deal damage to your allies, and all earned Points are divided equally.

By exiting via the Portal, you'll double your earned Battle Points. If you don't escape the Polygon, you'll still get any Battle Points you've accrued in battle. In total, you can earn up to 10,000 Battle Points in a single battle.

Combat Missions
Battle Points can also be earned by completing special combat missions that are updated weekly. Moreover, players will have access to a daily combat mission that also brings Battle Points.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8eb14e08-8597-11eb-805d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Apart from that, another special combat mission will require you to deal damage to enemies in the Big Hunt. The reward for completing it comes in the form of XP that will be counted towards the daily container progress. This mission can be completed an unlimited number of times. Once the event is over, any XP earned while playing the special ships will be transferred to Tier I cruiser Orlan.

More details about the combat missions will be available in the game client when the Update has gone live.

Ships and Armaments
In total, six special ships for the Big Hunt will be available in Update 0.10.2. Each ship has access to a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay and your ship’s appearance.

Ships https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngIX Valkyrie, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngIX Gale, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngIX Heracles, which are probably familiar to you from the Key Battle, will be available in your Port immediately with all of their modules researched. Three powerful new ships—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Hector, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Avenger, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Whirlwind—will be unlocked once you complete corresponding combat mission chains.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/65ca2890-8595-11eb-8267-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/660127fa-8595-11eb-a7f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/65bda9d0-8595-11eb-b615-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
In addition to the new ships, completing combat missions will also unlock new hull modules, primary and auxiliary armaments, and a special module that changes the ship's consumables.

More details about ships and armaments will be available in the game client when the Update has gone live.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ffba2eb8-8596-11eb-a7f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Avenger
Her well-armored hull reliably protects her against enemy torpedoes, while she can be additionally equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a colossal damage radius.

Hector
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Hector is the first ship to be capable of diving underwater temporarily. [table][tr][th]Italian Battleships: Part 2 ● Big Hunt ● Visual Improvements ● Division Star ● Armory ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
Read this article until the end to claim a gift! Share the article with friends and Clanmates to help them stay tuned about the details of this update.

Italian Battleships: Part 2
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/499dbccc-823e-11eb-ab6f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

With Update 0.10.2, Italian battleships continue to shine bright in the dedicated event that takes center stage!

Features of the Ship Branch
Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells can deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and vulnerable ship parts, but do not cause fires.
A large number of guns with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
Tier VIII–X ships have access to the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to sneak away from enemies without having to reduce speed. However, shooting from within a smoke screen while retreating isn't recommended—battleships have high detectability when firing their main battery guns from within smoke.
Early Access
Italian battleships of Tiers IV–VI, as well as the Tier VIII and IX Italian battleships that hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.1, continue to be available in sequential and random bundles in the Armory.

In Update 0.10.2, Italian Tokens will only be obtainable from random bundles available for Doubloons in the Armory. Players can spend Italian Tokens until the end of Update 0.10.2. After Update 0.10.3 goes live, all Italian Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png2,250.
When Update 0.10.3 goes live, Italian Tier IV–X battleships will be available for all players to research.
Combat Mission Group Rewards
Italian Battleships containers, signals, Credits, and the Legion permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marco Polo.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0aa8ec46-830e-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
If you already own the Legion permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marco Polo, you will receive compensation in the form of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png6,000 Doubloons.

An Italian Battleships container may drop one of the following Premium ships: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVI Leone, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Duca degli Abruzzi, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Roma, or https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marco Polo, as well as special signals, Free XP, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, days of Warships Premium Account, and Doubloons.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed9acfbe-8314-11eb-a953-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Free Bundles
The Armory is offering free random bundles. Inside, you can find Italian Battleships containers, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account, Doubloons, and other rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The bundles are available until:  Mon. 05 Apr. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed999806-8314-11eb-a69b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The bundles will be available for 18 days. You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
Big Hunt
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d2e1bc-830b-11eb-85bd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type called "Big Hunt"—a revamped version of the Key Battle that went live in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills as you stand against foes in an engaging competition of the future by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal opens up only some time after the battle starts.
You start out alone, but you can gather a team directly in battle.
It’s now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. To coordinate their efforts, Division mates will need to locate each other on the map and build up their team.
The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2457e88a-830f-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24523e58-830f-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/245fd8d8-830f-11eb-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
A temporary resource—Battle Points—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her won't be smooth sailing, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2445a206-830f-11eb-9d35-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle.
Any Battle Points you earn won’t be lost or spent in battle. You can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you get.
Grab the helm of one of a total of six ships, and try your luck in the Big Hunt! Each ship has a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay.

The first three ships, which you are likely to already be familiar with from the Key Battle, are available immediately with all of their modules. The three new ships—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Hector, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Avenger, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Whirlwind—and all of their modules will become available after completing chains of combat missions.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/634348a8-8316-11eb-89ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63467abe-8316-11eb-b2ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63521298-8316-11eb-94b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Each ship is equipped with distinct types of weapons and consumables that can have a drastic impact on gameplay. https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Hector, for example, can dive underwater, where she has greater speed and maneuverability, and can also ignore enemy shells and torpedoes for a short period of time. https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Avenger can be equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a big impact zone. https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Whirlwind offers a wide selection of torpedo armament and is capable of regenerating HP by damaging her enemies.
More details on the Big Hunt rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated article on our website.
Visual Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d69820-830b-11eb-ba61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.10.2 ushers in a large-scale makeover of the in-game visual effects. All effects in the game—from shell tracers and fires on board ships, to gunfire, water splashes, and AA fire explosions—have been enhanced. New visual effects have been added for ricochets; fires on ships; citadel hits; incapacitated weapons; and active operation effects for the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca6cfbec-8310-11eb-a243-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca3ddb46-8310-11eb-9f40-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca186636-8310-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
More details about the visual effects enhancements are available in a separate article.

Division Star
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/82398886-830b-11eb-93f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Throughout Update 0.10.2, Clan members will have access to special victory bonuses in the form of a Division Star.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed3599f0-8314-11eb-94b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can get a Division Star by playing as part of a Division with your Clanmates.
A Star is issued to each member of a Division for the first victory gained by that Division during Update 0.10.2.
A Star can be obtained in Random, Co-op, and Clan Battles, as well as in Operations.
Earning a certain number of Stars unlocks access to various rewards.
If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously earned remain with you.
To see the roster of Clanmates who you can combine your efforts with in a Division, as well as the list of rewards you can get, navigate to the Division Star tab in the Clans section.    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ed41b500-8314-11eb-a4bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/820276b6-830b-11eb-968e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

New ships
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Austin, available for 29,000 Steel, is a U.S. cruiser that was designed at the end of World War II. The ship is armed with twelve dual-purpose 127 mm guns in six turrets, and carries two quintuple-tube torpedo launcher mounts. The cruiser has an unlimited number of charges for the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable, which reduces the reload time of her guns by 75% instead of the standard 50%. She also has the Hydroacoustic Search and Defensive AA Fire consumables in separate slots. Her AA defenses are efficient, and she’s armed with SAP shells instead of AP shells.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27dba80e-8312-11eb-9b58-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marco Polo, available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png228,000 Coal, is an Italian battleship that was designed in the 1930s. As a further development of the Vittorio Veneto-class battleships, Marco Polo is equipped with nine 406 mm guns in three turrets. Like her researchable Italian counterparts, Marco Polo relies on AP and SAP shells, but her guns are more accurate. Instead of being equipped with the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, she has a choice between Spotting Aircraft or Fighter in a single slot. The ship boasts good concealment and decent armor protection. This ship may also drop from Italian Battleships containers.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/277cd144-8312-11eb-a383-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
A permanent camouflage named "Eagle" for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngX Franklin D. Roosevelt is now available in the Armory in exchange for 10 Ranked Tokens.

With the release of Update 0.10.2, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Somers will cease to be available in the Armory. When Update 0.10.5 goes live, Erich Loewenhardt, Admiral Graf Spee will also cease to be available. The ships are being removed from the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of ship composition, these ships will cease to be available for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance. Any interested players still have time to steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.10.5 goes live in about 3 months' time.

Other Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81ddfd90-830b-11eb-96c0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

notes.title: Brawls in 0.10.1: The Next Step
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1018da4d32f18456e8fb5c78334819e833569bff.jpg
Brawl 1 will be held under an updated set of rules, utilizing a 1 vs. 1 format with Tier VIII ships. Face off against rivals for Credits, Coal, Free XP, and other rewards!

[table][tr][th]Updated Brawls ● Brawl 1 ● Rewards[/th][/tr][/table]
Updated Brawls
In Update 0.10.1, we've revamped Brawls to make them a separate battle type, with seasons spanning short periods of time and utilizing a smaller team format. You can participate either in a Division or solo, and you no longer need to be a member of a Clan in order to join in.

Other features
Each Brawl runs for only a few days. Brawls are available throughout each day, except for low activity periods.
If you're not playing in a Division, your allies are picked at random. Matchmaking takes the type and tier of your ship into account.
The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
All ships will be of the same tier.
Battles take place on maps with reduced combat areas.
You can't take part in a battle with opponents who you previously fought against in your last several battles.
Bonuses to XP for the first win of the day will not be available in Brawls.
