Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.2
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server. The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.
[table][tr][th]Big Hunt ● Italian Battleships: Part 2 ● Visual and Other Enhancements[/th][/tr][/table]
Big Hunt
Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type called "Big Hunt"—a revamped version of the Key Battle presented in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills as you stand against foes in an engaging competition of the future by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

Key Rules
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a huge map codenamed Polygon. Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/840e7ef8-72be-11eb-807b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/840b7000-72be-11eb-975e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/841e88e8-72be-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
You no longer need a key to achieve that, but be cautious, as the Portal opens up only some time after a battle starts, and access to it is heavily defended.

All players enter each battle solo, but can build up a team of their own or join other players to form teams as the battle unfolds.

It is now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. To play together, the Division mates will, therefore, need to locate each other on the map once they are spawned, and build up a team to coordinate their efforts. We've also added an option to place markers on the Minimap that are visible to all teammates to enable better cooperation in battle.

The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires. The new mode will not feature a final battle in the Octagon.

Battle Points
By destroying monsters and other players, you can earn a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. You don't spend any Battle Points in the process of doing that, and because improving your ship won't cost any Battle Points, reinforce your ship as soon as you are able!

Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her will not be an easy ride, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b50b626-72bf-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Successfully exiting the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.

Any Battle Points earned are transferred to the Port so that you can exchange them in the Armory on the Live Server for any of the three types of random bundles that offer different rewards. Among other items, players will be able to get a new temporary resource from those bundles—a Corporation Token—which can be exchanged for themed permanent camouflages for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Amagi, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVIII Akizuki, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngVIII Öland.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bb650e4-72bf-11eb-975e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b71f782-72bf-11eb-a820-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b5cc308-72bf-11eb-8560-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Ships
A total of six ships will be available to players.

The first three ships, which you are likely to already be familiar with from the Key Battle, are available immediately with all modules. The three new ships—Hector, Avenger, and Whirlwind—and all of their modules will become available after completing a chain of combat missions.

Each of the ships carries new types of weapons and consumables that can have a drastic impact on gameplay. Hector, for example, can go underwater and hence ignore enemy shells and torpedoes for a short spell of time. Avenger can be equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a big impact zone. Whirlwind offers a wide selection of torpedo armament, and is capable of regenerating HP by damaging her enemies.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/912aa174-72bf-11eb-a820-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b7126b8-72bf-11eb-a12a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bbbeac2-72bf-11eb-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Italian Battleships: Part 2
With Update 0.10.2, we're continuing the event that revolves around Italian battleships.

Early Access
Italian battleships of Tiers IV to VI, as well as Tier VIII and IX Italian battleships which hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.1, continue to be available in consecutive and random bundles at the Armory.
When Update 0.10.3 goes live, Italian Tier IV–X battleships will be available for all players to research.
Combat Mission Group Rewards
Italian Battleships containers, signals, Credits, and the Legion permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marco Polo.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b3601be-72bf-11eb-8f39-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
On the Live Server, an Italian Battleships container may drop one of the following Premium ships: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVI Leone, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Duca degli Abruzzi, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Roma, or https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Marco Polo, as well as special signals, Free XP, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, days of Warships Premium Account, and Doubloons.

Visual and Other Enhancements
Update 0.10.2 ushers in a large-scale makeover of the in-game visual effects. All effects in the game—from shell tracers and fires on board ships, to gunfire, water splashes, and AA fire explosions—have been enhanced and reworked to accommodate the new lighting system. New visual effects have been added for ricochets; fires on ships with the Fire Prevention Expert skill active; citadel hits; incapacitated weapons; and active operation effects for the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables. These changes, depending on individual computer configurations and game settings, will not affect performance, but at peak loads will improve it significantly.

The following rules apply for all maps:
Number of Key Areas: 3
Capture time: 40 seconds
Scoring of capture points: 3 points every 4 seconds
Season Features
The new season has a small, but very important change—we've added a system that allows ship limits to be set. We're working on making sure that each battle and game mode offers diverse and interesting gameplay. This change allows us to make the team compositions more varied and the battles more diverse.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of the season or for specific periods of time. For example, they can be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

Possible Restrictions
Limit on number of the same ships. For instance, the Division will not be able to join a battle if two or more of the same ships are selected.
Limit on number of specific ships. For example, the Division can have only one https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngIX Ibuki, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngIX Yūgumo, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Black.

notes.title: Twitch Drops Changes in 0.10.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/29bf3ad7c8781ea2ed1f6abb094345f8d70c04ed.jpg
Commanders!
The way in which Twitch Drops work has changed, so in Update 0.10.1 you can expect things to look a little bit different than what you've been used to. The most important thing is that you'll still be able to collect free loot—including the valuable Italian Tokens that are used to unlock Early Access Regia Marina battleships—just for watching World of Warships on livestreams!
Don't forget: you need to link your Twitch account to World of Warships in order to receive Twitch Drops. It's easy! Just follow the instructions here.
[table][tr][th]What changed? ● Twitch rewards ● Where and How[/th][/tr][/table]

Twitch | Follow

What changed?
Three new features will affect you as a viewer on Twitch:
User Interface update — the main feature of the changes implemented by Twitch to the Drops system is the implementation of a new sleek, comfortable, and informative UI. Now, you'll be able to track just how long you need to watch a stream for in order to get the next drop, thanks to a handy progress bar that will dynamically fill up as time passes. Once the bar is filled, you will get a notification right in your browser with a button to claim the reward*.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/59e50f54-7078-11eb-95d9-38eaa735f4cc.png
Sequential Drops — it will now be possible to have rewards drop in a specific order, e.g. in order to start progressing towards receiving reward Y, you must first have watched for long enough to receive reward X.
Removal of random-chance drops — with the new update, it is no longer possible to facilitate rewards that have random chances of dropping for viewers. Since this mechanic was the basis for our Twitch Epic Drops, these types of rewards will no longer be available in their past form for the time being.
As far as in-game changes go, there are another two points to keep in mind:
Log in to claim rewards — unlike in the previous system, where your Drops were credited instantly to your account if you had the game running in the background, it will now be necessary to log in to the game for the loot to hit your Port. If you receive a drop while you're logged in to World of Warships, you'll need to log out and log back in, or to restart the game.
In-game confirmation of rewards — if you want to make sure that you've received your Twitch Drop after logging in to World of Warships, you can click the “Info” button on the bottom-right of your Port screen, where the goodies will be displayed.
As this is only the first update with the new system, you can look forward to further changes and improvements in the months to come. Join us on-stream and let us know what you think!
* Due to the Twitch overhaul, all Drops—not just for World of Warships—must now actively be claimed on your Twitch account either by clicking the button on the pop-up notification in the stream interface or in your personal Twitch inventory. If you take no action, the reward will disappear 24 hours after the end of each campaign. Each Update will have 2 campaigns, each lasting 2 weeks. For more information, consult the All Campaigns tab in the Twitch interface.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/59fb5d68-7078-11eb-ade7-38eaa735f4cc.png

Twitch rewards
There are three types of Twitch Drops for World of Warships. All, except for the Official Channel Drops, can be obtained by watching any streamer on Twitch who is playing World of Warships and has Drops Enabled.

On the first Thursday of the update, all three types of rewards become available and remain claimable for a full week, until they are refreshed the following Thursday.
Be sure to join our official weekly English stream on Thursdays at 17:00 UTC so as not to miss out on any rewards!
Official Channel Drops
A total of four simple missions—one for each week of the update—that will only drop when watching streams on the official World of Warships channel. Completing the missions will reward you with some extra Early Access Italian Tokens to help you progress towards unlocking the new Italian battleships!

You can receive up to five of these during Update 0.10.1, with a new container becoming available each Thursday.

Exceptionally, two containers will be claimable during the fourth week of the update!

Each day, you can complete a chain of six missions.
You must earn a certain amount of base XP in order to complete a mission of the chain.
You must earn 250 base XP in a single battle in order to accomplish the first mission.
The second mission requires you to earn 500 base XP across several battles.
For missions 3, 4, 5, and 6: you need to earn 1,000; 1,100; 1,200; and 1,300 base XP in victorious battles, respectively.
All missions within a chain must be completed in successive order, playing Tier V–X ships in Random, Co-op, or Ranked Battles, or in Operations.
You'll receive any due rewards in your Port once you've completed the conditions of the missions.
After completing the entire chain, you'll obtain the final reward.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c45072dd71bb60d7eb4445896f72ac53b5391c2.jpg
Italian Tier IV–IX battleships have arrived in Early Access.

Italian Battleships: Part 1
What are the features of the new branch?
Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and ship parts, but do not cause fires.
A large number of guns with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
Tier VIII–X ships have the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to hide from the enemy without having to reduce their speed. Shooting from within the smoke screen isn't recommended while retreating, because battleships still have high detectability when using their main battery guns in this situation.

Italian Tokens
You can obtain Italian Tokens in the following ways:
By completing "Italian Battleships: Part 1" combat missions—up to 9,500 Tokens.
From free random bundles in the Armory—up to 500 tokens.
From random bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons in the Armory—up to 38,800 Tokens.
By completing combat missions from the official World of Warships streams—up to 1,000 Tokens.
In exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory—up to 1,000 Tokens.
For more details about the Recruiting Station, follow this link.

Italian Tokens can also be earned by completing an additional chain of combat missions that will become available on the first weekend after the update's release. The chain's difficulty and the number of Tokens you can earn will depend on your activity in the previous updates.
To unlock this chain, you need to have played at least one battle in Updates 0.9.12–0.10.0. With the release of Update 0.10.3, Italian Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png2,250.

Update 0.10.1 kicks off an event that places the new Italian Tier IV–IX battleships right in the spotlight!
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7fcfa5fc-6c64-11eb-9be1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f3f43f4-6c64-11eb-aedc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7fd3c9ac-6c64-11eb-9160-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f38526a-6c64-11eb-b872-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7fcf15a6-6c64-11eb-a383-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f5f64fe-6c64-11eb-8a61-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Features of the Ship Branch
Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and ship parts, but do not cause fires.
A large number of guns but with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
Tier VIII–X ships have the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to hide from the enemy without having to reduce their speed. Shooting from within the smoke screen isn't recommended while retreating, because battleships still have high detectability when using their main battery guns in this situation.
Early Access
Combat mission group rewards: a new temporary resource—Italian Tokens, Roman permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVI Andrea Doria, and special signals. Final reward for completing the last combat mission group: https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVII Francesco Caracciolo, a Commander with six skill points, and a Port slot.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f9c9e64-6c64-11eb-a298-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Italian Tokens can also be obtained by completing special chains of combat missions; from random bundles available for Doubloons, free random bundles, and bundles that are available in exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory; and by completing combat missions that can be activated by watching official World of Warships streams.

Rewards for Italian Tokens: sequentially opened bundles with  https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIV Dante Alighieri, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngV Conte di Cavour, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVI Andrea Doria, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Vittorio Veneto; the Roman permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVII Francesco Caracciolo; Legion permanent camouflages for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Vittorio Veneto, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Lepanto, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Cristoforo Colombo; and other rewards.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f865faa-6c64-11eb-a168-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The number of Tokens that can be earned by completing combat mission groups will be enough to obtain Italian Tier IV–VI battleships and the Roman permanent camouflage for the Tier VII battleship.

Rewards from random bundles available for Doubloons: https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Lepanto plus a Commander with 10 skill points and a Port slot, Italian Tokens, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, and other rewards.

Free Bundles
The Armory is offering free random bundles—Daily Gifts. Inside, you can find Italian Tokens, Warships Premium Account, Doubloons, and other rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The bundles are available until:  Mon. 08 Mar. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c7faf998-6c65-11eb-b4eb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
The Taranto Port has been updated.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6e1d26b8-6d22-11eb-b789-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6e227b36-6d22-11eb-bfe5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6f1c3b12-6d22-11eb-86fd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Clan Battles: Greece
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f38eeed6-6d49-11eb-987d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Wed. 24 Feb. 12:30 CET (UTC+1)
Ends:   Mon. 12 Apr. 04:30 CET (UTC+1)

Format
Tier IX ships in a 7 vs. 7 format.

Restrictions
Up to two battleships per team.

Rewards
Up to 11,000 Steel and other rewards.

No more than two mercenaries per Division.

The new season has a small, but very important change—we've added a system that allows ship limits to be set. We're working on making sure that each battle and game mode offers diverse and interesting gameplay. This change allows us to make the team compositions more varied and the battles more diverse.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of a season or for specific periods of time. For example, they could be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

Possible restrictions
Limit on the number of the same ships. For instance, a Division will not be able to join a battle if two or more of the same ships are selected.
Limit on the number of specific ships. For example, a Division can have only one https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngIX Ibuki, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngIX Yūgumo, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Black.
Restriction that makes certain ships ineligible for battle. For example, one cannot join the battle playing https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngIX Kronshtadt or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngIX Kitakaze.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c663a09a-6d22-11eb-bfe5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c66029ba-6d22-11eb-b789-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5ef7ff8-6d22-11eb-ae9c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Restrictions on the number of certain ships and banned ships are displayed in the Division window and in the tooltip in the window above the ship carousel when the "Clan Battle" battle type is selected.

Full details of the season will be revealed in a dedicated article nearer the start of the season.

Ranked Battles: The Second Season
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f910d144-6d49-11eb-a3d8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The Second Season of Ranked Battles kicks off together with Update 0.10.1. Its structure is different from that of the First (test) season. In terms of the available rewards, you can expect Steel, Doubloons, camouflages, and much more!

Main Changes
The duration of the season has been doubled. The duration of each Sprint is 2 weeks.
The Sprint rewards have also doubled on average.
The number of ranks in the Bronze and Silver Leagues has increased from seven to 10.
The number of Stars needed to reach the first rank and qualify has increased by 50% on average.
The Ranked Battles interface has also been updated.
In addition to the rank, the league is now displayed in the tooltip above the player's name.
After the qualification, the timer that shows the time remaining until the start of the next Sprint is shown in the tooltip above the next league.
The scrolling speed of the rank carousel has been increased.
Updated the descriptions of Jolly Roger achievements and tooltips, as well as some other descriptions.
Fixed some errors in the Ranked Battles interface.
Rewards
The rewards for each league will be refreshed and available again at the start of each new Sprint.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4422c302-6c48-11eb-b2d5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Reaching Rank 1 will reward you with Bronze, Silver, and Gold League containers.

A commemorative flag is awarded for achieving Rank 1 in the Bronze League.
Rules of the Second Season https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/87faf644-6c48-11eb-ad80-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
More details about Ranked Battles Season 2 can be found in a dedicated article.

Updated Brawls
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d497a554-6d49-11eb-987d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

For Update 0.10.1, we've updated Brawls and made them a separate battle type, the seasons of which are short and have a smaller team format. One can take part either in a Division or solo. It is possible to participate in Brawls without being in a Clan.

In Update 0.10.1, the first season of updated Brawls will take place in the following format:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Mon. 08 Mar. 09:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Mon. 15 Mar. 02:00 CET (UTC+1)

Format
Tier VIII ships in a 1 vs. 1 format.

Time
ASIA: 01:00 — 18:00 UTC
CIS: 06:00 — 23:00 UTC
EU: 08:00 — 01:00 UTC
NA: 16:00 — 09:00 UTC
You can take part in Brawls only during the time specified for your server.
Game maps and modes
Big Race, Shatter, Crash Zone Alpha, and Sleeping Giant in Domination mode; Two Brothers in the Epicenter mode.

Rewards
Up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png2,250,000 Credits; 80,000 Elite Commander XP; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal; and 4x signals of each type, except for special ones.

Other features of Brawls
Each Brawl lasts only for a few days. They are available throughout each day, except for low activity periods.
If you're not playing in a Division, your allies are picked randomly. Matchmaking takes the type and tier of your ship into account.
The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
Battles take place on maps with a reduced combat area. All ships will be of the same tier.
You can't take part in a battle with opponents who you fought against in several previous battles.
Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/87eec170-6c62-11eb-8cf1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Added unique Dasha Perova Commanders for Italian and European ships.

notes.title: Ranked Battles: The Second Season
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3384104de61a046fcbf2418626cfb71d356e82cb.jpg
Season 2 of the new Ranked Battles kicks off together with Update 0.10.1. If you haven't played Ranked Battles before, it's a great time to start!

Try out Ranked Battles, which are fought in a 7 vs. 7 format. The location of Key Areas and the rewards you can earn in Ranked Battles are different from those in Random Battles. Ranked Battles offer Doubloons and Steel as rewards! The more victories you earn, the greater the rewards you can expect.

[table][tr][th]The Second Season ● Rewards ● Bonus Combat Mission ● Key Features of the New System[/th][/tr][/table]
The Second Season
The new Ranked Battles season has different settings applied. We've doubled the duration of each Sprint and the entire season. The amount of Steel and Doubloons awarded for each Sprint has also been doubled. The number of Stars in leagues has been increased by 50% on average. In addition, the Bronze and Silver leagues now have 10 ranks each.

Rewards
The rewards for each league will be refreshed and available again at the start of each new Sprint.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4422c302-6c48-11eb-b2d5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Reaching Rank 1 will reward you with Bronze League, Silver League, and Gold League containers.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f4195a64-6c3e-11eb-95ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
A commemorative flag is awarded for achieving Rank 1 in the Bronze League. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac71ff6e-6bb1-11eb-a8bd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Bonus Combat Mission
A special combat mission will become available at the start of the season: earn 1,500 base XP in Ranked Battles to receive two Gift containers*.

*When opened, each Gift container will drop five special signal flags of one type.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The mission will be available until: Thu. 13 May 02:00 CET (UTC+1)

Key Features of the New System
In case you haven't familiarized yourself with the new Ranked Battles system yet, we would like to inform you about its basic principles:
Each season is divided into several Sprints. The duration of a single Sprint is approximately 1–3 weeks, and this may differ from season to season.
There are three leagues in each season: Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
In order to enter the next league, you need to reach Rank 1 in your current league and then qualify.
If you don't manage to qualify for the next league, you'll start the new Sprint in your current league at the lowest rank of this league. All the rewards will be available to collect again.
If you qualify for the next league, you'll start the new Sprint in that next league with the lowest rank of that league.
During a single Sprint, players can only progress through their current league and qualify for the next one.
Rewards are granted for achieving victories, reaching Rank 1, and qualifying.
Ranked Battles aren't available during low activity periods. This is necessary to ensure high-quality matchmaking.
You can find more details about all the features of the updated Ranked Battles system in a dedicated article.

Update 0.10.1 kicks off an event that places the new Italian Tier IV–IX battleships right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.

Features of the Ship Branch
Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and parts of the ship, but do not cause fires.
A large number of guns with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
Tier VIII–X ships have the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to hide from the enemy without having to reduce their speed. Shooting from within the smoke screen isn't recommended while retreating, because battleships have high detectability when using their main battery guns in this situation.

Italian Tokens can also be obtained by completing special chains of combat missions; from random bundles available for Doubloons, free random bundles, and bundles that are available in exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory; and by completing combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.

Rewards for Italian Tokens
Sequentially opened bundles with Tier IV, V, VI, and VIII Italian battleships; permanent camouflages for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVII Francesco Caracciolo, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Vittorio Veneto, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Lepanto, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Cristoforo Colombo; and other rewards.

The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.

Updated Brawls
In Update 0.10.1, we updated Brawls and made them a separate battle type, the seasons of which will be short and have a smaller team format. One can take part either in a Division or solo. It is possible to participate in Brawls without being in a Clan.

Other Features
Each Brawl lasts only for a few days. They are available throughout each day, except for low activity periods.
If you're not playing in a Division, your allies are picked randomly. The matchmaking takes the type and tier of your ship into account.
The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
Battles take place on maps with a reduced combat area. All ships will be of the same tier.
To access Brawls, you must have fought at least 130 battles in all available battle types.

You can try out this new battle type on the 0.10.1 Public Test server.

Clan Battles
Update 0.10.1 brings with it Clan Battles Season 12. It will be held in a 7 vs. 7 format, playing Tier IX ships.

The new season has a small, but very important change—we've added a system that allows ship limits to be set. We're working on making sure that each battle and game mode offers diverse and interesting gameplay. This change allows us to make the team compositions in Clan Battles more varied and the battles more diverse.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of the season or for specific periods of time. For example, they can be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to quickly react to the current state of a season without the need to create a large number of similar setups.

Either one or several restrictions can be set during a season.

The restrictions are displayed in the Division window and in the tooltip in the window above the ship carousel when the "Clan Battle" battle type is selected.

Possible restrictions
Limit on the number of the same ships. For instance, the Division will not be able to join a battle if two or more of the same ships are selected.
Limit on the number of specific ships. For example, the Division can have only one https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Yamato and one https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngX Des Moines.
Restriction that makes certain ships ineligible for battle. One of India's three national holidays is celebrated on January 26 to honor the date on which the Declaration of Independence of India was promulgated in 1930 and the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950.

To complete the chain of combat missions, you'll need to earn "Destroyed" and "Set on fire" ribbons, as well as win battles. As the reward, you can receive up to five Indian Tricolor camouflages.

Bonuses provided by the camouflage
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC076_IndiaCamo_84ce1e5c15e8db1c9b7ccbf194952e06f1b35848f5fd34244e1e925be59d2ece.png−3% to the ship's detectability range by sea
+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies at your ship
+75% Commander XP per battle
+100% XP per battle
+50% Free XP per battle
You can complete this chain of combat missions in Ranked, Random, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing Tier V–X ships.
Daily Missions
One chain will become available to you each day. Progressing through each chain will reward you with XP, signals, credits, Coal, and even Steel!

Rewards https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1c392038-ab24-11ea-b1c1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Complete daily missions in February, and the following rewards will be yours:
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3fef9652-5b04-11eb-9aa4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Research Bureau
Players with access to the Research Bureau will be able to earn even more Research Points by completing daily missions—400 Research Points for completing 25, 50, and 75 combat missions.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3fb76c32-5b04-11eb-b3f8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The conditions for completing the chains are as follows
Each day, you can complete a chain of six missions.
You must earn a certain amount of base XP in order to complete a mission of the chain.
You must earn 250 base XP in a single battle in order to accomplish the first mission.
The second mission requires you to earn 500 base XP across several battles.
For missions 3, 4, 5, and 6: you need to earn 1,000; 1,100; 1,200; and 1,300 base XP in victorious battles, respectively.
All missions within a chain must be completed in successive order, playing Tier V–X ships in Random, Co-op, or Ranked Battles, or in Operations.
You'll receive any due rewards in your Port once you've completed the conditions of the missions.
After completing the entire chain, you'll obtain the final reward.

Daily Shipments
During Update 0.10.0, enter the game in the period between January 20 and February 3, inclusive, to start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d549f4e-5738-11eb-8b0c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can get a total of 10 rewards throughout the 14 days that the shipments are available. That means you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.

Commander Skills Update
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/688e3c3e-5713-11eb-9766-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The Commander skills system will be changed in Update 0.10.0.

Main Changes
We've added new skills and changed some of the old ones.
Each Commander now has a separate skill section for each ship type. The skill section corresponding to the played ship type is active in battle.
As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of skill points available to one Commander has been increased from 19 to 21.
We've added a skill recommendation system, depending on the selected ship.
Commanders with less than 21 skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained per battle.
We've added a new method of obtaining Elite Commander XP—by dismissing unused Commanders.
We've revamped the interface of the Commander skill, recruitment, re-assignment, and dismissal system.
With the release of Update 0.10.0, all your commanders’ skills will automatically be redistributed using a recommendation system—this way, you'll get a skill build that's effective for each specific ship in the new system. You can take advantage of the opportunity to reset Commander skills free of charge in Update 0.10.0. Make sure to try out different combinations and find the ones that suit your playstyle!
After the release of the Update, additional balance corrections might be required. In case of significant changes going forward, we will provide additional opportunities to retrain your Commanders for free.

Ends:  Thu. 18 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

To help you get familiar with the new Commander skills system in Update 0.10.0:
Commander skills can be reset free of charge.
Upgrades can be demounted free of charge.
The cost in Doubloons to retrain commanders for different ships has been reduced by 90%—from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png500 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png50 Doubloons.
In addition, to help you experiment with retraining Commanders:
Players with Access Level 8 and above will receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png500 Doubloons when they first log in to the game during Update 0.10.0.
Update 0.10.0 features six special combat missions, one for each nation with more than one ship branch: the U.S.A; Japan; U.K.; the U.S.S.R.; Germany; and France. To complete each mission, you'll need to earn 1,100 base XP in any number of battles, playing a Tier VII–X ship in any battle type, except Training Battles. The reward for each one is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png100 Doubloons.
In total, you can obtain up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,100 Doubloons. These will be enough to perform Commander retraining 22 times in Update 0.10.0.
More details about the updated skill system are available in a dedicated article.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4588572732361222376

Kure Dockyard
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68c963d6-5713-11eb-acfb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen continues! Until the end of Update 0.10.0, you can complete Shipyard combat missions and progress through 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases. Purchasing phases for Doubloons will continue to be possible until the end of Update 0.10.1.

Clan Brawls
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68a5671a-5713-11eb-a2e6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.10.0 will see the 14th and 15th Clan Brawls fought in a 7 vs. 7 format. Brawls are open to all players, even if a player isn't currently in a Clan. To participate, apply via the "Create Division" menu near the "Battle!" button, then wait for an invitation to join a Division. Only the player who creates a Division for a Brawl is required to be part of a Clan; the other invitees do not have to belong to any Clan at all. The inviting player should have the rank of Clan Recruiter or higher.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7e0b8538-5738-11eb-812c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
You can play in the 14th and 15th Clan Brawls only during the Prime Time of your server.

Restrictions
No more than two battleships per team.
Aircraft carriers are not permitted.
Up to six mercenaries per Division.
Game maps and modes
The Islands of Ice, Mountain Range, Trident, Warrior's Path, and Sleeping Giant maps in the Arms Race mode.

Rewards for each Brawl
Up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png5,000 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png3,000,000 Credits, and 120,000 Elite Commander XP.
The Brawl rewards are divided equally between two chains of combat missions.
The second chain will succeed the first one: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png the 14th Brawl:  Sat. 30 Jan. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
the 15th Brawl:  Sat. 13 Feb. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)

Other Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68ce0aee-5713-11eb-994d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Check under the spoilers for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

Game balance changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68c61c26-5713-11eb-9098-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

We're making changes to some ships and parameters to better fit the new skills system. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

The secondary battery firing ranges of battleships and cruisers have been increased.

New ranges (km):

If a ship's standard secondary battery firing range was originally higher, it will not be decreased. A ship's detectability is another limiter—the maximum possible range of its secondary battery should not exceed its minimum possible detectability. Because of this:

German Tier VII–X battleships

Engine damage
When a ship's engine is critically damaged, it now continues to function at 20% efficiency instead of stopping entirely.

The different speeds of patrol fighters on researchable aircraft carriers, VI Ark Royal, VI Erich Loewenhardt, VIII Graf Zeppelin, and VIII Graf Zeppelin B have been increased to:
Tier IV—187 knots
Tier VI—221 knots
Tier VIII—235 knots
Tier X—266 knots
This change will improve the efficiency of fighters and prevent enemy planes from escaping. Later, we plan to accordingly increase the different speeds of all deck fighters.

The detectability of patrol fighters on all Tier VI, VIII, and X carriers has been increased to 7.5 km. This change will allow us to prevent a situation that might have been possible with the new skill system where patrol fighters could have appeared directly in front of a squadron, leaving no time for evasion.

The effects that increase a squadron's Engine Boost time no longer increase its recovery time.

Content Additions and Changes

Detailed information on how to obtain this ship will be published later.

Starting with the release of Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available to obtain: https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Georgia, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngIX Alaska, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Massachusetts, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Thunderer, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Småland.

The reason for the removal of these ships is a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain team diversity at an appropriate level, these ships will cease to be available for an indefinite period of time, but may return later.

Starting with the release of Update 0.10.2, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Somers will no longer be available to obtain from the Armory for an indefinite period of time. She’ll be replaced by another U.S. ship—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Austin.

We understand that accumulating resources to purchase a ship takes a long time, which is why we’re letting you know about the changes in advance. This will give players who are interested in these ships time to obtain them before Updates 0.10.1 and 0.10.2 go live in approximately one and two months, respectively.

Other Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68cc4574-5713-11eb-bac6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
With the release of Update 0.10.0, we're terminating support for Mac OS. We've made this decision due to the low popularity of the operating system with our audience. Supporting Mac OS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. More details are available in this article.
The video on the start-up screen now plays continuously while the game loads. You can skip it by pressing any key. The ability to automatically skip this video has been added to the Controls section of the Settings.
To make it more explicit, we've updated the display of Early Access ships in the Tech Tree, as well as the descriptions of their features.
Increased the range at which X Shikishima's main battery salvos can be heard.
Applied small fixes to the geometry and textures of ships such as X Khabarovsk, II Chikuma, VIII Anchorage, VIII Saipan, VI Gallant, IX Alsace, X Bourgogne, and VIII HSF Harekaze.
Updated the icons for the Main Battery Reload Booster, Torpedo Reload Booster, and Rapid Takeoff Spotter consumables, as well as several upgrades.
We've updated the interface for carrier armaments in the Port. All squadrons are displayed in the Armament group. Click on a squadron to view its consumables and armaments.
The segment split of torpedo bombers' reticles now depends on the number of aircraft in the attacking flight, rather than on the number of torpedoes.
Pressing the F key after the attack of the last flight in a squadron will skip the attack animation and move the camera back to the ship.
When a squadron takes off, the aircraft models no longer disappear from the deck of an aircraft carrier all at once, but rather disappear in turn.
The message about the return of a squadron to their carrier has been removed.
Fixed an error that caused the information about damage sustained by your aircraft carrier to be displayed incorrectly.

Fixed an error that resulted in VIII Saipan having 40mm Bofors Mk1 guns instead of 40mm Bofors Mk2 anti-aircraft guns. Continuous AA damage has been increased by 4 units per seconds.

notes.title: Commander Skills Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/af32ec95e69c37c37ca78f24e1d8e0977dfa1a45.jpg
World of Warships is constantly evolving. New mechanics and ships with unique gameplay appear in the game on a regular basis. To ensure that Commander skills correspond to the current state of the game, we're carrying out a large-scale update by adding new skills and changing the old ones.

Changing the Commander skill system will make it more flexible and convenient, and give you a choice between several effective loadout options instead of one ultimate go-to option. This will enable you to customize your ship to more precisely suit your playstyle. In addition to updating the Commander skills, we've revamped the interface and made it more comfortable to use the Commander system, as well as retrain and level up Commanders.
[previewyoutube=QIE84Q4Nm90;full][/previewyoutube]
[table][tr][th]Summary ● Reasons for the Changes ● Discounts and Bonuses in Update 0.10.0 ● Skills ● Elite XP, Retraining, and Recruitment[/th][/tr][/table]
Summary
We've added new skills and changed some of the old ones.
Each Commander now has a separate skill section for each ship type. The skill section corresponding to the played ship type is active in battle.
As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of Commander skill points has been increased from 19 to 21.
We've added a skill recommendation system depending on the selected ship.
Commanders with less than 21 skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained per battle.
We've added a new method of obtaining Elite Commander XP—by demobilizing unused Commanders.
We've revamped the interface of the Commander skill, recruitment, re-assignment, and dismissal system.
With the release of Update 0.10.0, all skills will automatically be redistributed using a recommendation system. This will give you a standard ship-specific skill build in the new system. You can take advantage of the opportunity to reset Commander skills free of charge in Update 0.10.0. Make sure to try out different combinations and find the ones that suit your playstyle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Free skill reset is available until: Thu. 18 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
If a Commander is in the process of retraining, their retraining will automatically be completed with the release of Update 0.10.0. If a Commander is not tied to a ship of their specialization, they will be assigned to a ship of their specialization with the release of Update 0.10.0. This only applies to researchable ships.
Reasons for the Changes
For many ships, there was often only one skill build that worked effectively. By adding new skills and changing the old ones, we want players to have a choice between several different effective builds to accommodate different playstyles.
Skills for all ship types were previously presented in the same skill tree. Because of this, some of them were ineffective for particular ships, or had different effects on different ship types. The new format allows us to create more specialized skills for each ship type and provides space for future development.
The old skill system interface was not very user-friendly. We're updating it by adding the following features:
A recommendation system that simplifies the selection of skills.
The ability to dismiss Commanders you no longer need in exchange for Elite XP.
The ability to select skills and evaluate their effect first, and only then approve your selection.

Discounts and Bonuses in Update 0.10.0
To help you get familiar with the new Commander skill system in Update 0.10.0:
Commander skills can be reset free of charge.
Upgrades can be demounted free of charge.
The cost in Doubloons of Commander retraining has been reduced by 90%—from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png500 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png50 Doubloons.
In addition, to help you experiment with retraining Commanders for different ships:
Players with Access Level 8 and above will receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png500 Doubloons when they first log in to the game during Update 0.10.0.
Update 0.10.0 features six special combat missions, one for each nation with more than one ship branch: U.S.A; Japan; U.K.; U.S.S.R.; Germany; and France. To complete each mission, you'll need to earn 1,100 base XP in any number of battles, playing a Tier VII–X ship in any battle type, except Training Battles. The reward is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png100 Doubloons.
In total, you can obtain up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,100 Doubloons. This amount will be enough to retrain your Commanders 22 times in Update 0.10.0.
Discounts and combat missions are available {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png From:  Thu. 21 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Until:  Thu. 18 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Skills
Almost all skills in the new skill system have been updated, and many new ones have been added. Among those are:

Special skills that are activated by fulfilling certain conditions. Among the activated effects are:
Close Quarters Expert: reduces the reload time of the battleship's main battery after an enemy has been spotted within the firing range of your ship's secondary battery. This skill is especially useful for specialized secondary battery battleships, but due to the increase in the secondary battery firing range in Update 0.10.0, the skill will also be suitable for other battleships.
Dead Eye: reduces the dispersion of the battleship's main battery shells if there are no visible hostile ships within your ship's standard detectability range. Complement this skill with Concealment Expert and Concealment System Modification 1 to make it even more effective.
Top Grade Gunner: reduces the reload time of the cruiser's main battery after an enemy has been spotted within your ship's standard detectability range.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/141199d0-5637-11eb-8bde-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Outnumbered: reduces the dispersion of the cruiser's main battery shells, and increases the ship's maximum speed if there are more visible hostile ships than allies within the standard firing range of your ship's main battery. The skill is useful both when pushing through the flanks and capturing Key Areas.
Swift in Silence: increases the destroyer's speed while she remains undetected. The skill is especially suitable for stealthy torpedo destroyers.
Fearless Brawler: reduces the reload time of the destroyer's main battery after the ship has been detected by the enemy. The skill is especially useful for artillery destroyers—French and Soviet—as well as when fighting for Key Areas.
If you know all the strengths and weaknesses of your ship and have fought dozens of battles playing her, consider applying skills that give you a large bonus along with a noticeable penalty, for example:
Superheavy AP Shells: increases the maximum damage of the battleship's armor-piercing shells by 5%, but also increases the fire extinguishing and flooding recovery time by 30%.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7233afb2-5637-11eb-b3a6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Heavy HE and SAP Shells: increases the damage of the cruiser's HE and SAP shells by 10%, but also increases the detectability of ships with a main battery caliber of 149 mm and above by 15%.
Special skills for aircraft carriers that enhance fighters:
Interceptor: the Patrol Fighters consumable is replaced by Interceptors. The aircraft called in are invulnerable to hostile fighters, do not attack hostile fighters, and do not spot hostile ships. Their patrol zone is increased by 10%. Thus, your fighters will only hunt enemy strike squadrons.
Enhanced Reactions: the fighters you call in attack hostile aircraft not after 5 seconds, but after 1 second spent in the patrol zone. However, it takes them longer to arrive at the patrol zone, and they stop their patrolling faster.
Use these two skills together: Interceptor will protect your fighters against enemy fighters and increase your patrol zone area, while Enhanced Reactions will speed up your fighters' reactions to enemy squadrons. When combined, these skills will enhance your ability to counter enemy aircraft and defend your allies.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/de8f1aa2-5637-11eb-b3a6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

We've also revamped the interface:
Click on a Commander, then click on the "Change Commander" button to view all available Commanders of a single nation. For this purpose, you can also select a ship without a Commander and click on the "Assign Commander" button. Commanders are divided into two lists— those assigned to ships and those in the Reserve.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/61af802a-5638-11eb-b52d-8cdcd4b147d4.gif
You can now first select skills and evaluate their effects in the parameters section, and only then approve your selection.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2a5ed1c0-5638-11eb-a0ce-8cdcd4b147d4.gif
Recommended skills—standard skill options for a particular ship—are marked with a special sign. These skills are selected based on the ship's strengths.
Click on the "All Skills" button to view skills for all ship types. You can distribute skills only for the ship type to which the Commander is assigned, but they are saved for each type separately.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbb7b22c-5638-11eb-b52d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Game Balance Changes
We're making changes to some ships and parameters to better fit the new skills system. With the release of Update 0.10.0:
Standard firing range of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Atlanta's main battery has been increased from 11.1 to 13.3 km
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Colbert's acceleration and deceleration dynamics have been improved
When a ship's engine is critically damaged, it now continues to function at 20% efficiency instead of stopping entirely.

The secondary battery firing ranges of battleships and cruisers have been increased.
New range (km):
[table][tr][th]Tier[/th][th]Standard Firing Range[/th][th][/th][th]Range With All Specific Upgrades and Skills[/th][/tr] [tr][th][/th][th]German/French[/th][th]Other[/th][th]German/French[/th][th]Other[/th][/tr] [tr][td]III[/td] [td]4[/td] [td]3.2[/td] [td]5[/td] [td]4[/td][/tr] [tr][td]IV[/td] [td]4.8[/td] [td]4[/td] [td]6[/td] [td]5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]V[/td] [td]4.95[/td] [td]4.3[/td] [td]7.5[/td] [td]6.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]VI[/td] [td]5.6[/td] [td]4.95[/td] [td]8.5[/td] [td]7.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]VII[/td] [td]6.3[/td] [td]5.6[/td] [td]9.5[/td] [td]8.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]VIII[/td] [td]7.6[/td] [td]6.6[/td] [td]11.5[/td] [td]10[/td][/tr] [tr][td]IX[/td] [td]7.95[/td] [td]6.95[/td] [td]12[/td] [td]10.5[/td][/tr] [tr][td]X[/td] [td]8.3[/td] [td]7.3[/td] [td]12.5[/td] [td]11[/td][/tr][/table]
If a ship's standard secondary battery firing range was originally higher, it will not be decreased. A ship's detectability is another limiter—the maximum possible range of its secondary battery should not exceed its minimum possible detectability.
We'll keep a close eye on all ships and on how the updated skill system affects them. We will pay special attention to https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Flint, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Smolensk, and secondary battery battleships.
Elite XP, Retraining, and Recruitment
Elite Commander XP
Elite XP can be used to level up Commanders, accelerate Commander retraining for other ships, and redistribute skill points, and can also be converted into Free XP by using Doubloons.

When dismissing a Commander, you can convert some of their Commander XP into Elite XP:
Up to 25% of the Commander XP, at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png10 Credits for 1 XP.
Up to 100% of the Commander XP, at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1 Doubloon for 110 XP.
For example, if a Commander has 10,000 XP, then upon dismissing this Commander, you can receive 2,500 XP for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png25,000 Credits, or 10,000 XP for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png90 Doubloons.

Commanders with less than 21 skill points will additionally bring you Elite XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained per battle. For Commanders with 21 skill points, any XP earned is converted into Elite XP; the additional 5% is not credited.

Retraining and specialization
The ability to accelerate Commander retraining in exchange for Credits has been removed from the interface, but now it is "built" into the game and has been made free of charge. The amount of XP required for retraining has been halved.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c7adbb0-5639-11eb-a29c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Skills will not work until a Commander's retraining is complete.
A Commander without a specialization for a ship can't be assigned to that ship without retraining. This rule doesn't apply to Premium and special ships.
The skill section for each ship type is redistributed separately from the others. The cost of redistributing skills remains the same.
You can enter battle playing a ship without an assigned Commander. In this case, Commander XP will not be credited to your account. This will allow you to receive combat performance bonuses without reassigning Commanders, or to try out a new ship without having to retrain a Commander for her.
Recruiting Commanders
The cost and number of skills for recruited Commanders will change so that, if necessary, a player will be able to recruit a Commander with more skill points.
Commander without skills: recruited free of charge.
Commander with 6 skill points: available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png900,000 Credits.
Commander with 10 skill points: available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,500 Doubloons.
Do you have a large number of Commanders and want to reset all their skills at once?
Starting from January 21, after Update 0.10.0 is released for all regions, you'll find a link to a special page here where you can automatically reset all of your Commanders' skills free of charge.

notes.content:

Captains!

New combat missions are available in Update 0.9.12! Numerous rewards await you, including https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg, Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, and other valuable items.

Happy New Year!

[table][tr][th]New Year Gifts ● Dockyard ● Campaigns and Strasbourg ● Ranked Battles ● Happy Shipmas! ● New Year—New Challenges ● Daily Missions[/th][/tr][/table]
New Year Gifts
Snowflakes
Following the good old tradition, ships of Tier V and above feature Snowflakes with holiday bonuses. In Updates 0.9.12 and 0.10.0, the first victory or earning 300 XP with a ship will yield you the respective rewards:
Tier V–VII ships: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png400–{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png750 Coal
Tier VIII–IX ships: 75 Steel
Tier X ship: Santa's Gift container
New Year Supplies {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The bundles are available until: Mon. 11 Jan. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)

Free daily bundles await you in the Armory. Within these bundles, you can find Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, festive camouflages (Frosty Fir Tree, Winter Strands, New Year Streamer, Type 3 — New Year, and New Year expendable camouflage), Coal, doubloons, and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account!
A total of 12 bundles will be available for a period of 20 days.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac4190e2-443b-11eb-a5be-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Dockyard
In Update 0.9.12, players will be able to start building a new Japanese Tier IX battleship, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen, at the Dockyard. By completing the Dockyard combat missions, you can complete 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases. Completing each phase will bring you valuable rewards, including destroyer https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana and cruiser https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi for the fifth and 15th phases respectively. Both ships come with the Winter permanent camouflages and Commanders with 6 skill points for these ships.

Completing the 20th shipbuilding phase will reward you with the New Year permanent camouflage that can be mounted on most of Tier IX ships. Among the other rewards, you'll find Santa's containers:
Santa's Gift for the third phase
Santa's Big Gift for the 10th and 22nd phases
Santa's Mega Gift the 24th phase
You can also complete shipbuilding phases by spending doubloons. When you finish construction, you'll obtain https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen with the War Paint permanent camouflage, a Port slot, 10-skill-point Commander, and commemorative flag.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9962e496-4371-11eb-966f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a93a0b2-4371-11eb-aecb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a9726ba-4371-11eb-a0c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99ffe110-4371-11eb-b7f1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
If you complete the construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen by spending doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions anyway—completing each phase will bring you 400 Research Points and 200 Steel. In total, you can earn up to 8,800 Research Points and 4,400 Steel.
Campaigns and Strasbourg
Take part in two new temporary campaigns during Update 0.9.12. The first mission of the "In Pursuit of Strasbourg" campaign is already available, and subsequent missions will be unlocked every week. Missions of the "Ships and Fates" campaign are already available for completion, but you need https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg to complete them.

For completing the first three missions of the "In Pursuit of Strasbourg" campaign, you'll receive 6-skill-point Commanders. As a reward for completing the fourth, final mission, you'll obtain https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg, which is required to complete missions of the "Ships and Fates" campaign, along with a Port slot and Winter Holiday camouflage.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac628f54-443b-11eb-ae11-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Completing six missions of the "Ships and Fates" campaign will reward you with ships adorned in their permanent camouflages, 6-skill-point Commanders, and Santa's Gift containers.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/acafd3a4-443b-11eb-9ee2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Ranked Battles
To complete a special combat mission, earn {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png500 base XP in a single Ranked Battle. As a reward, you'll get two special signals. One combat mission can be completed during each of the six sprints in this season.

Happy Shipmas! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Tue. 22 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Sat. 26 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

[table][tr][th]Daily Combat Mission[/th][/tr] [tr][td]
Besides these pleasant bonuses, a daily combat mission will be available to you. To complete each of three parts of the combat mission chain, you'll need to win and cause 50,000 damage in a single battle. Completing one part will reward you with the Winter Strands camouflage, and the final reward is 2x Type 59 camouflages.
You can complete this chain of combat missions in Ranked, Random, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing Tier V–X ships.
[/td][/tr][/table]
Bonuses provided by the camouflages
Type 59
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC042_Super_ECO_camo_9a140d83c8d35a06da16848225cb87304a5cd43b692beeff355fa16167cea47f.png−3% to your ship's detectability range by sea
+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies at your ship

Winter Strands
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC103_NewYear2021_466f2ed94ac9fea501c98b667f50bcf99b9a278c320d846e374801f8472a2d61.png−3% to your ship's detectability range by sea
+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies at your ship

+100% XP per battle
