New Year—New Challenges
Happy holidays! Onwards to new victories!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Sat. 26 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Sat. 02 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Discounts and Bonuses
+200% XP bonus for the first win of the day playing each ship, every day
You can convert Elite Commander XP at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1 doubloon for 25 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png35 Free XP
You can convert XP from ships at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1 doubloon for 25 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png35 Free XP
−50% doubloons to the cost of economic signals in the game client
−50% doubloons to the cost of Port slots
Win a battle in Ranked, Random, or Co-op Battles, or in Operations to get 3x Wargaming containers, with each holding {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account, 3x Papa Papa signals, and 3x Juliet Charlie signals.
[table][tr][th]Chain of Combat Missions[/th][/tr] [tr][td]
To complete the chain of combat missions, you'll need to earn "Destroyed" ribbons. As a reward, you'll receive the Winter Strands camouflages.
You can complete this chain of combat missions in Ranked, Random, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing Tier V–X ships.
[/td][/tr][/table]
Daily Missions
One chain will become available to you each day. Progressing through each chain will reward you with XP, signals, credits, Coal, and even Steel!

Rewards https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1c392038-ab24-11ea-b1c1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Want even more bonuses? Complete Daily Missions and the following rewards will be yours:
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c2cde492-c1f4-11ea-b6a2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Research Bureau
Players with access to the Research Bureau will be able to earn even more Research Points by completing Daily Missions—400 Research Points for completing 25, 50, and 75 combat missions.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e93bd2bc-bc66-11ea-a764-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The conditions for completing the chains are as follows
Each day, you can complete a chain of six missions.
You must earn a certain amount of base XP to complete a mission of the chain.
You must earn 250 base XP in a single battle in order to accomplish the first mission.
The second mission requires you to earn 500 base XP across several battles.
For missions 3, 4, 5, and 6: you need to earn 1,000; 1,100; 1,200; and 1,300 base XP in victorious battles, respectively.
All missions within a chain must be completed in successive order, playing Tier V–X ships in Random, Co-op, or Ranked Battles, or in Operations.
You'll receive any due rewards in your Port once you've completed the conditions of the missions.
After completing the entire chain, you'll obtain the final reward.

notes.title: Kure Dockyard: Build a Ship
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b7e52e9c02469d3db0f724754ea8a5a8ea35814.jpg
In Update 0.9.12, players will be able to start building a new Japanese battleship, Hizen.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen is a variant of a superbattleship project that preceded the development of the Yamato-class ships. The ship is armed with twelve 410 mm guns placed in four turrets. Having such an atypical number of guns for a high-tier Japanese battleship allows her to deal impressive damage per salvo.
[table][tr][th]Rules of the Event ● Combat Missions ● Rewards[/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=sCFXZ1gzLwI;full][/previewyoutube]
Rules of the Event
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 26 phases.
These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through the Dockyard combat missions, or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,950 doubloons to complete each phase.
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: ten shipbuilding stages in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,950 doubloons and four shipbuilding stages in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 doubloons.
The Dockyard combat missions span two updates—0.9.12 and 0.10.0. After that, you can still complete phases by spending doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.1.
In total, you can pass through 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases by progressing through Dockyard combat missions.
You'll receive https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi in the Winter permanent camouflage, 6-skill-point Commanders, and Port slots as rewards for completing the 5th and 15th shipbuilding phases respectively.
Completing the last four phases will reward you with {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal; one Santa's Mega Gift container; 2,000 Steel; and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen in the War Paint camouflage with a Port slot, Commander with 10 skill points, and commemorative flag.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9962e496-4371-11eb-966f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a93a0b2-4371-11eb-aecb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a9726ba-4371-11eb-a0c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99ffe110-4371-11eb-b7f1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Completing other phases will bring you Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships, the new Winter Strands expendable camouflages, and other valuable items.
If you already have https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana in your Port, then upon obtaining her again, you'll receive compensation in the form of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,425,000 credits; a Port slot; the Winter permanent camouflage for Tachibana, and a Commander with 6 skill points.
If you already have https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi in your Port, then upon obtaining her again, you'll receive compensation in the form of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png4,000 doubloons; a Port slot; the Winter permanent camouflage for Yahagi; and a Commander with 6 skill points.
If you complete the construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen by spending doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions anyway—completing each phase will bring you 400 Research Points and 200 Steel.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3757c680-4377-11eb-966f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/37587d6e-4377-11eb-b08e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/37b1149c-4377-11eb-bd18-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/363c28c2-4377-11eb-9cde-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Combat Missions
The new game event tasks you with completing 56 combat missions spread across seven groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.9.12, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis.
Completing each group, except for the last one, will progress you through three shipbuilding phases:
Two shipbuilding phases are completed by accomplishing specific missions in a group.
One shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the entire group.
Completing the last group will progress you through four shipbuilding phases— two for specific missions and two more for finishing the group.
The Dockyard combat missions will remain available until the release of Update 0.10.1. Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.
Rewards
By progressing through the Dockyard combat mission groups, you can complete 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.
By finishing the first two combat mission groups, you can complete up to six shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana with a Port slot, the Winter permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points
1x Santa's Gift container
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png2,000 Coal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Warships Premium Account
10x Winter Strands camouflages
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f956d92-4377-11eb-90ee-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Finishing five out of seven combat mission groups will allow you to complete up to 15 shipbuilding phases and obtain:
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi with a Port slot, the Winter permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana with a Port slot, the Winter permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points
1x Santa's Big Gift container
1x Santa's Gift container
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png2,000 Coal
40x special signals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png10,000 Free XP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png2 days of Warships Premium Account
15x Winter Strands camouflages
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fb82c6a-4377-11eb-9cde-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
By finishing all the combat mission groups, you'll complete 22 shipbuilding phases and obtain:
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi with a Port slot, the Winter permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana with a Port slot, the Winter permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points
2x Santa's Big Gift containers
1x Santa's Gift container
1x New Year permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png2,000 Coal
80x special signals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png10,000 Free XP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png2 days of Warships Premium Account
25x Winter Strands camouflages
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9faf30b0-4377-11eb-b08e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
In order to complete the shipbuilding process entirely, in addition to progressing through all the combat mission groups, you'll need to spend doubloons to progress through any four shipbuilding phases.
The reward for completing the 23rd shipbuilding phase is {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal.
The 24th phase brings you a Santa's Mega Gift container.
The 25th phase—2,000 Steel.
By completing the 26th shipbuilding phase, you'll earn https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen in the War Paint camouflage, together with a Port slot, Commander with 10 skill points, and commemorative flag.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f9f2706-4377-11eb-ab98-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
If you decide to complete the construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen by spending doubloons, you can still continue progressing through the Dockyard combat missions. Instead of construction progression, you'll get 400 Research Points and 200 Steel for each completed phase.
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, two Starter Packs are available to purchase:
Ten shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,950 doubloons

notes.title: All the New Year's Rewards and Gifts in One Article!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8137cf8a87ad3555107357edc28b1c9e61b28e79.jpg
New Year would be nothing without gifts.

We're here to tell you about all the bonuses that you can enjoy during the holidays.
[previewyoutube=A-aV76DmzWs;full][/previewyoutube]
Gifts in Brief [table][tr][th]Discounts and Bonuses[/th][/tr][tr][td]From December 22—26: +100% XP for the first victory, discounts on many researchable ships, as well as Commander retraining.
From December 26 to January 2: +200% XP for the first victory; discounts on Free XP and Elite XP conversion, as well as economic signals, in the game client .[/td][/tr] [tr][th]Coupons for the Armory[/th][/tr][tr][td]Coupons that grant 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% discounts when obtaining ships in exchange for doubloons will be available to you during the week before and week after New Year's Day. Don't miss your chance to use them![/td][/tr] [tr][th]Snowflakes[/th][/tr][tr][td]Winning a victory or earning 300 base XP playing a ship will bring you Coal, Steel, or a Santa's Gift container, depending on your ship's tier.[/td][/tr] [tr][th]New Year Supplies[/th][/tr][tr][td]The Armory is offering daily random bundles. Within these, you'll find Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, as well as other items.[/td][/tr] [tr][th]Dockyard[/th][/tr][tr][td]Complete the Dockyard combat missions to receive rewards, including https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi, Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships, and many other desirable items. You'll also progress the construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen![/td][/tr] [tr][th]Campaigns[/th][/tr][tr][td]Complete the "In Pursuit of Strasbourg" campaign to receive https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg, along with the New Year Commanders of Pan-Asia, Italy, and France. Completing the missions of the Ships and Fates campaign will bring you even more Santa's Gift containers, six Tier V ships with Winter permanent camouflages, and special Commanders![/td][/tr][/table]
Now that we've briefly mentioned the main holiday rewards, let's take a closer look at them. Check the section that interests you the most.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/76efe620-407e-11eb-a027-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Battle Performance Bonuses
Ships of Tier V and above feature battle performance bonuses—traditional Snowflakes. During Updates 0.9.12 and 0.10.0, winning the first victory or earning 300 base XP playing ships in all types of battles, except Training Battles, will bring you the corresponding rewards:
Tier V–VII ships: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png400—{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png750 Coal
Tier VIII–IX ships: 75 Steel
Tier X ship: Santa's Gift container
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0dc1d00a-3fb6-11eb-91bc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/770141b8-407e-11eb-a2c5-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Kure Dockyard
In Update 0.9.12, players will be able to start building a new Japanese Tier IX battleship, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen, at the Dockyard. By completing the Dockyard combat missions, you can complete 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases. Completing each phase will bring you valuable rewards, including destroyer https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana and cruiser https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi for the fifth and 15th phases respectively. Both ships come with the Winter permanent camouflages and Commanders with 6 skill points for these ships.

Completing the 20th shipbuilding phase will reward you with the New Year permanent camouflage that can be mounted on most Tier IX ships. Among the other rewards, you'll find Santa's containers:
Santa's Gift for the third phase
Santa's Big Gift for the 10th and 22th phases
Santa's Mega Gift for the 24nd phase
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, two Starter Packs are available to purchase:
Ten shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,950 doubloons
Four shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 doubloons

Completing the ship's construction requires you to progress through at least four phases by spending doubloons. By doing so, you'll obtain https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen with the War Paint permanent camouflage, a Port slot, 10-skill-point Commander, and commemorative flag.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5c555330-4093-11eb-bfcf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The Starter Packs will only be available to purchase prior to the point in time when you complete four shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions.  Once you've purchased both Starter Packs or completed four shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions, you'll be able to purchase further phases individually for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,950 doubloons each.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/770638ee-407e-11eb-91a0-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Rewards for the Campaigns
Take part in two new temporary campaigns during Update 0.9.12, and you'll receive numerous rewards, including French battleship https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg!

In Pursuit of Strasbourg
The first mission of this campaign is already available, and those that follow will be unlocked each week. Completing the first three missions will reward you with special New Year Commanders with 6 skill points. Completing the final, fourth mission will bring you https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg with a Port slot and the Winter Holiday camouflage.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f71654c-404b-11eb-b63f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Ships and Fates
Obtaining battleship Strasbourg will enable you to complete the missions of the Ships and Fates campaign, which are already available to you. Completing six missions will bring you ships with permanent camouflages, Commanders with 6 skill points, and Santa's Gift containers.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0fd3a0a4-404b-11eb-b2ee-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/77009024-407e-11eb-b3fa-8cdcd4b147d4.png
New Year Supplies {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The bundles are available until: Mon. 11 Jan. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)

The Armory is offering free daily bundles. Within them, you'll find Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, holiday camouflages (Frosty Fir Tree, Winter Strands, New Year Streamer, "Type 3 — New Year," and the New Year expendable camouflage), as well as Coal, doubloons, and 1 day of Premium Account!
A total of 12 bundles will be available for a period of 20 days.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f7f67aa-404b-11eb-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/770880fe-407e-11eb-9295-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Santa's Gift Containers
You can claim your Santa's Gift containers right now:
One container when you enter the Armory and one container when you open the in-game Premium Shop.
One container awaits you on a special Santa's Gifts page.
Happy New Year!

Santa's Mega Gift https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/58888a76-358d-11eb-a75f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Santa's Mega Gift containers have the highest chances of dropping ships.
Santa's Big Gift https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1183e652-358d-11eb-a397-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Santa's Big Gift containers have higher chances of dropping ships than Santa's Gift containers.
Santa's Gift https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/36efa99e-358d-11eb-b79c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Compensation Rules
If a ship that you already have in your Port is dropped, the Santa's Gift container will be replaced by a supercontainer. It will drop another ship from the list along with a Port slot and Commander with 10 skill points. More information about the available compensation can be read here.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7738e6c2-407e-11eb-af3f-8cdcd4b147d4.png
Discounts and Bonuses
Traditional Christmas discounts await you. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Tue. 22 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

[previewyoutube=OQRKU4AYLRQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The New Year preparations are in full swing! We've prepared a lot of gifts and New Year activities for you: two New Year's campaigns, the Dockyard, battle performance bonuses, New Year's gifts, New Year's horns, and much more!
[table][tr][th]New Year in World of Warships ● Kure Dockyard ● Snowflakes: Battle Performance Bonuses ● New Year Campaigns ● Updates to the Ranked Battles System ● Armory ● Content Changes ● Game Balance Changes ● Technical Changes ● Support of Mac OS[/th][/tr][/table]
New Year in World of Warships
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40d2acac-3fad-11eb-8a5f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
New Year's gifts
Head to the Armory to receive a free Santa's Gift container on the main page.
Collect a second Santa's Gift container by opening the in-game Premium Shop.
Another Santa's Gift container awaits you on a special New Year's website.
The Armory and Premium Shop are also offering bundles with three types of Santa's Gift containers. Within them, you'll find doubloons, days of Premium Account, Coal, Free XP, expendable camouflages, signals, or even one of 107 Premium ships.

Free bundles
The Armory is offering free random bundles—New Year Supplies. Within them, you'll find Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, as well as other valuable rewards.
The bundles will be available {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png From:  Tue. 22 Dec. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
Until:  Mon. 11 Jan. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)

You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 8 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f7f67aa-404b-11eb-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Kure Dockyard
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/409d0d40-3fad-11eb-b610-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.12, players will be able to start building a new Japanese battleship, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen. The ship is a variant of a super battleship project that preceded the development of the Yamato-class ships. She's armed with twelve 410 mm guns placed in four turrets. Having such an atypical number of guns for a high-tier Japanese battleship allows her to deal impressive damage per salvo.

Rules of the Dockyard
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 26 phases.
These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through the Dockyard combat missions, or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,950 doubloons to pass through each phase.
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,950 doubloons, or 4 shipbuilding phases in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 doubloons.
The combat missions of the Dockyard will span two updates—0.9.12 and 0.10.0. Players will be able to complete shipbuilding phases in exchange for doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.1.
In total, you can pass through 22 out of 26 shipbuilding phases by progressing through Dockyard combat missions.
Completing the 5th and 15th shipbuilding phases will reward you with https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi in the Winter permanent camouflages, Commanders with 6 skill points, and Port slots.
Completing the last four phases will reward you with {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal; one Santa's Mega Gift container; 2,000 Steel; and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen in the War Paint camouflage with a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.
Completing the other phases will bring you Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers, the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships, new Winter Strands expendable camouflages, and other valuable items.
If you already have https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngII Tachibana in your Port, then upon obtaining her again, you'll receive compensation in the form of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,425,000 credits; a Port slot; the Winter permanent camouflage for Tachibana; and a Commander with 6 skill points.
If you already have https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngV Yahagi in your Port, then upon obtaining her again, you'll receive compensation in the form of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png4,000 doubloons; a Port slot; the Winter permanent camouflage for Yahagi; and a Commander with 6 skill points.
If you complete the construction of https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen by spending doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you 400 Research Points and 200 Steel.

The Port of Kure will be added to the game. The designs for the Port and Dockyard were inspired by Kure harbor in Japan.

Snowflakes: Battle Performance Bonuses
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40a8586c-3fad-11eb-8fb4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.12, ships of Tier V and above will feature New Year bonuses for battle performance—Snowflakes. Depending on the ship's tier, you'll receive Coal, Steel, or Santa's Gift containers.

The mechanics of receiving the rewards for bonuses have been updated. You can now obtain a reward by gaining a victory or earning 300 base XP. Claim bonuses by playing your favorite battle type!

List of rewards
Tiers V–VII: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png400/{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png500/{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png750 Coal
Tiers VIII–IX: 75 Steel
Tier X: Santa's Gift container
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0dc1d00a-3fb6-11eb-91bc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Please note: you can get the battle performance bonus for each ship only once during Updates 0.9.12 and 0.10.0 in battles of any type, except Training Battles.
New Year Campaigns
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40b726d0-3fad-11eb-b374-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.9.12 features two temporary campaigns—"In Pursuit of Strasbourg" and "Ships and Fates."

In Pursuit of Strasbourg
The first New Year temporary campaign comprises 32 tasks in four missions. Each mission tells part of the story of the French Navy, using the example of https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg and her famous sister ship—battleship https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Dunkerque.

Completing the missions will bring you unique New Year Commanders of Pan-Asian, Italian, and French ships. Completing the Campaign will reward you with https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg, adorned in the Winter Holiday permanent camouflage.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f71654c-404b-11eb-b63f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
If you already have https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg in your Port, completing the Campaign will reward you with a Port slot; the Winter Holiday permanent camouflage; and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png9,500 doubloons.
The first mission will become available with the release of Update 0.9.12, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Ships and Fates
Please note: to complete this Campaign, you'll need https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg, which can be obtained as a reward for completing the "In Pursuit of Strasbourg" campaign, though if you’re short on time, you can also get her in the Armory in exchange for doubloons, or in the Premium Shop.
The second New Year temporary campaign comprises 36 tasks in six missions. Each mission tells the story of a specific ship: cruisers https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngV Furutaka, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngV Hawkins, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngV Kotovsky; destroyers https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngV T-22 and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngV Visby; as well as battleship https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngV New York.

Completing the missions will reward you with these ships, as well as unique New Year Commanders, Winter permanent camouflages, and Santa's Gift containers.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0fd3a0a4-404b-11eb-b2ee-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
All six missions of the Ships and Fates campaign will become available with the release of Update 0.9.12.

Both campaigns will remain available until the release of Update 0.10.0. As with all campaigns, you can complete the tasks of each mission multiple times. This will allow you to earn Stars, but you'll receive the reward for completing each task for the first time only.

Updates to the Ranked Battles System
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4098fa2a-3fad-11eb-89c1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.9.12 sees a large-scale update of the Ranked Battles system and gives start to a test Season of the new Ranked Battles.

Key features of the new system
Ranked Battles seasons are now going to be held on a regular basis with short breaks between each one. This will mean that you can choose between Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as the latter battle type will be more regularly available.
Each season is divided into several sprints. The duration of a single sprint is approximately 1–3 weeks, and this may differ from season to season.
During a single sprint, players can only progress through their current league and qualify for the next one.
Demonstrate your skills in the qualification, during which you'll fight against players from the next league to determine whether you'll progress to the next league or stay in your current one.
The leagues are more tailored to your preferences:
You can progress through the Bronze League at a smooth and leisurely pace.
The Silver League offers bigger rewards, but will require more effort.
The Gold League is the best option for the most experienced players who want to collect the most impressive haul of rewards.
Ranked Battles aren't available to play during the hours of least activity. This is necessary to ensure high-quality matchmaking.
Rewards in brief
The rewards are refreshed and updated for each new sprint and can be collected again—fight in your preferred league over and over again, and you'll collect rewards every time.
Rewards are granted for achieving victories, reaching Rank 1, and qualifying.
Steel hasn't gone anywhere: achieve victories, reach Rank 1, and accrue it to spend on items you desire in the Armory.
Doubloons are granted as a reward in each league—the higher the league, the more doubloons you can get.
New themed camouflages and achievements in each of the leagues.
Ranked Tokens are awarded each time you reach Rank 1 in the Gold League. In Update 0.9.11, the cost of permanent camouflages available in exchange for Ranked Tokens has changed, and the number of Tokens on player accounts has increased by a factor of four.
Test Season https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/060b5fb0-4052-11eb-8cc3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

EU: 08:00 — 01:00 UTC

7 vs. 7
Tier VIII in the Bronze League
Tiers IX–X in the Silver League
Tier X in the Gold League
Season structure
Six sprints, each lasting 1 week. Each next sprint starts immediately after the end of the previous one.

During the Season, you can participate in no more than six sprints in the Bronze League, or five in the Silver League, or four in the Gold League.

Sprint rewards
Bronze League: up to 400 Steel; up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png200 doubloons; up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png1,000 Coal; up to 5x Bronze camouflages; and up to 5x "Type 3 — Ranked" camouflages.
Silver League: up to 500 Steel; up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png300 doubloons; up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png3,000 Coal; up to 3x Bronze camouflages; up to 3x Silver camouflages; and up to 10x "Type 3 — Ranked" camouflages.
Gold League: up to 600 Steel; up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png400 doubloons; up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png5,000 Coal; up to 3x Bronze camouflages; up to 3x Silver camouflages; up to 8x Gold camouflages; and one Ranked Token.
This Season is the test Season for the new Ranked Battles system. We'll keep an eye on how it goes and monitor your feedback. Following the test Season, additional changes may be made to the new Ranked Battles system in order to improve it. In future seasons, the format, rewards, combat missions associated with Ranked Battles, and other details may differ from the current ones.
You can learn more details about the updated Ranked Battles system and the first Ranked Season in a dedicated article.

Armory

As a New Year's gift, we've added four single-use coupons that grant 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% discounts when obtaining ships in exchange for doubloons. The coupons will become available on December 25 and remain active until January 8.

Content Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40e80732-3fad-11eb-8c0b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will also no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

From Update 0.10.2, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Somers will cease to be available in the Armory for an indefinite period of time. She will be replaced by another American ship—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Austin.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Updates 0.10.1 and 0.10.2 go live in about 2 and 3 months' time.

Game Balance Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.12, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

Kansas
Sigma parameter increased from 1.6 to 1.7
Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 3.5%
Minnesota
Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 4%
Tallinn
Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 12.5%
Admiral Hipper
Main battery reload time reduced from 11.5 to 11 s
Hōshō
Number of torpedo bombers in a squadron reduced from 6 to 5
Size of an attacking flight of torpedo bombers decreased from 2 to 1
Number of torpedo bombers on the deck reduced from 9 to 8
Torpedo bomber restoration time increased from 59 to 71 s
Torpedo damage increased from 5,400 to 5,800
Langley
Torpedo damage reduced from 4,233 to 3,500
Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes reduced from 33% to 30%
Manfred von Richthofen
The area of the reticle ellipse of bombers has been increased
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0f9be858-404b-11eb-a1c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Fixed an issue that resulted in excessive deceleration when Engine Boost was used. The value has been adjusted to match the standard one.
Implacable
Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,300 to 5,600
Chances of bombs causing fire on a target increased from 30% to 32%
Audacious
Number of rockets carried by standard attack aircraft reduced from 12 to 10
Number of rockets carried by researchable attack aircraft reduced from 14 to 12
Maximum bomb damage increased from 6,000 to 6,400
Chances of bombs causing fire on a target increased from 35% to 36%
Technical Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0d992ae-3fb2-11eb-8a73-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

As part of the game server component optimization, we’re reducing the maximum number of unopened containers on player accounts to 100. If you have more than 100 unopened containers at the time of the release of Update 0.9.12, the containers that you obtained earliest will be opened automatically.

Support of Mac OS
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/409361c8-3fad-11eb-9d23-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

We plan to cease support for Mac OS in January 2021. We made this decision due to the low popularity of this operating system among our audience. Supporting Mac OS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. You can find more details in this Player Support article.

One Wargaming container provides {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account.

Starting Bonuses
At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, as well as one Commander of each nation with 21 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
Research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.9.11, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png500,000,000 credits; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png30,000 doubloons; and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png90 days of Premium Account.
50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.

If you played at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.9.6–0.9.11 Public Tests, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.

How to Enter
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.0
Updates to the Commander skill system, Clan Brawls, Lunar New Year, and other new features.
IMPORTANT! Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.
Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]Commander Skills Update ● Brawls ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
Commander Skills Update
World of Warships is constantly evolving. New mechanics and ships with unique gameplay appear in the game on a regular basis. To ensure that Commander skills correspond to the current state of the game, we're carrying out a large-scale update by adding new skills and changing the old ones. Changing the Commander skill system will make it more flexible and convenient, and give you a choice between several effective loadout options instead of one ultimate go-to option. This will enable you to customize your ship to more precisely suit your playstyle. In addition to updating the Commander skills, we've revamped the interface and made it more comfortable to use the Commander system, as well as retrain and level up Commanders.

Skills
Each Commander now has separate skill sections for each ship type. Skill points in each section are distributed independently of each other.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d2979120-3936-11eb-b817-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d283af48-3936-11eb-9b52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d28684c0-3936-11eb-96cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d286395c-3936-11eb-b6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The skill section corresponding to the chosen ship type is active in battle.
As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of Commander skill points has increased from 19 to 21.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13540882-3938-11eb-9b52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Elite Commander XP
Commanders who don't have the maximum number of skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained.
For Commanders with 21 skill points, any XP earned is converted into Elite XP; the additional 5% is not credited.
When dismissing a Commander, you can convert some of their Commander XP into Elite XP:
Up to 25% of the Commander XP, at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png10 credits for 1 XP.
Up to 50% of the Commander XP, at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1 doubloon for 150 XP.

For example, if a Commander has 10,000 XP, then upon dismissing this Commander, you can receive up to 2,500 XP for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png25,000 credits; or up to 4,950 XP for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png33 doubloons.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/133c67d6-3938-11eb-b14b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Retraining and Specialization
The ability to accelerate Commander retraining in exchange for credits has been removed, but the amount of XP required for retraining has been halved.
Skills will not work until the Commander's retraining is complete.
Each skill section is reset separately from the others.
A Commander without a specialization for a ship can't be assigned to that ship without retraining. This rule doesn't apply to Premium and special ships.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13435fd2-3938-11eb-b6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Other Changes
The cost and number of skills for recruited Commanders will change so that, if necessary, a player will be able to recruit a Commander with more skill points.
Commander without skills: recruited free of charge.
Commander with 6 skill points: available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png900,000 credits.
Commander with 10 skill points: available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 doubloons.
You can enter battle playing a ship without an assigned Commander. In this case, you will not earn Commander XP.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/135c4b00-3938-11eb-b817-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
You can learn more details about the changes to the Commander skill system on the Development Blog.
Brawls
The upcoming Update ushers in two Brawls with a 7 vs. 7 format:
From January 26 to February 1 for Tier VIII ships.
From February 9–15 for Tier X ships.
Battles will be fought in the Arms Race mode without aircraft carriers and with a limit of two battleships per team. To participate in these Brawls, it's enough for only the Commander to be a member of a Clan: up to six mercenaries can be invited to the team.

Other Changes
Please note: new ships, camouflages, and Commanders will not be available on the Public Test Server.
We've added special content dedicated to the Lunar New Year: Wujing and Sanzang in the Sha Wujing and Tang Sanzang permanent camouflages, together with themed Commanders; Fen Yang with the Lunar New Year permanent camouflage; and two types of the "Journey to the West" containers. To mark the celebrations, we've updated the Dragon Port.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13862434-3938-11eb-83d8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
To make it more explicit, we've updated the display of Early Access ships in the Tech Tree, as well as the description of their features.
The segment split of torpedo bombers' reticles now depends on the number of aircraft in the attacking flight. This fixes an issue that prevented the display of some of lines in the reticle.
Pressing the F key after attacking with the last flight in a squadron will skip the attack animation and transition you to controlling the ship.
When a squadron takes off, the aircraft models no longer disappear from the deck of an aircraft carrier all at once, but rather disappear in turn.
We've updated the interface for carrier armaments in the Port.
The message about the return of a squadron to their carrier has been removed.
The game now loads while a video is played on the loading screen.

notes.title: Updates to Ranked Battles
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5eacd59e53e80c4b91827bb21939dbcc28bb5480.jpg
Update 0.9.12 is going to see large-scale changes to the Ranked Battles system.
[previewyoutube=ebYTnp71oW8;full][/previewyoutube]
[table][tr][th]Season Structure ● Rewards ● Other Features ● Test Ranked Season[/th][/tr][/table]
Key features of the new system
Ranked Battles seasons are now going to be held on a regular basis with short breaks between each one. This will mean that you will always be able to choose between Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles in the Port screen, as the latter battle type will be more regularly available.
The higher the league, the better the rewards. You can progress through the Bronze League at a smooth and leisurely pace. The Silver League will require more effort, but offers bigger rewards. Seasoned sea wolves will be able to collect the most impressive haul of rewards in the Gold League.
Demonstrate your skills in the qualification, during which you'll fight against players from the next league to determine whether you'll progress to the next league or stay in your current one. Please note: if you qualify for the next league, you won't be able return to the previous one until the end of the season.
Rewards are granted for achieving victories, reaching Rank 1 in a league, and qualifying for a new league.
Ranked Battles aren't available at night. This is necessary to ensure high-quality matchmaking.
Season Structure
Each season is divided into several sprints. The duration of a single sprint is approximately 1–3 weeks, and this may differ from season to season.
There are three leagues in the first Season: Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1389c03a-3ea1-11eb-bec8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
In order to enter the next league, you need to reach Rank 1 in your current league and then qualify.
During a single sprint, players can only progress through their current league and qualify for the next one.
If you don't manage to qualify for the next league, you'll start the new sprint in your current league at the lowest rank of this league. All the rewards will be available to collect again.
If you qualify for the next league, you'll start the new sprint in that next league with the lowest rank of that league.
After achieving Rank 1 in the Gold League, you can continue fighting only in the next sprint in the Gold League. You will start with the lowest rank and be able to collect all the rewards again.
Qualification is a special rank. To qualify and move up to the next league, you need to collect a certain number of Stars. You cannot drop to the preceding ranks during qualification.
Battles in a particular league are fought between only the players in that league. However, during the qualification, battles are fought according to the rules of the next league, and involve those who are trying to qualify for the higher league and the Captains of that higher league.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/13167f44-3ea1-11eb-829b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Rewards
The rewards are refreshed and updated for each new sprint and can be collected again—fight in your preferred league over and over again, and you'll collect rewards every time.
Steel hasn't gone anywhere: achieve victories, reach Rank 1, and accrue it to spend on items you desire in the Armory.
Doubloons are granted as a reward in each league: the higher the league, the more doubloons you can get.
The Bronze, Silver and Gold expendable camouflages are granted as rewards in the corresponding leagues.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8bad5ea-3ea1-11eb-977f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a95d60d0-3ea1-11eb-829b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8d7b728-3ea1-11eb-84b3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The “Jolly Roger—Bronze League,” “Jolly Roger—Silver League,” and “Jolly Roger—Gold League” achievements are granted once per season for achieving Rank 1 in the corresponding leagues.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fae44638-3e21-11eb-a77a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
A commemorative flag is awarded at the end of each season for achieving Rank 1 in the Bronze League.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2fa8ee8c-3e22-11eb-a03e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Ranked Tokens are awarded for achieving Rank 1 in the Gold League. You can earn four Ranked Tokens during the first Season. The cost of permanent camouflages available in the Armory in exchange for Ranked Tokens has been increased from 3 to 10 Tokens. The number of Ranked Tokens that players have at their disposal has been increased by a factor of four.
Other Features
Maps, ship tiers, and the number of players per team may differ from league to league, depending on the season.
Team lineups are always strictly mirrored in terms of ship types and tiers. Divisions aren't allowed in Ranked Battles.
The player with the most base XP in a team doesn't lose a Star upon their team’s defeat.
Ranked Battle emblems remain unchanged. A unique Star is a Star that's obtained for the first time in a season. If the league is played again in the same season, the Stars will not be counted.
Season achievements aren't inherited from previous Ranked seasons, and won’t transfer to those that follow.
The Ranked Battles interface and statistics in the profile have been updated.
Unusual modes, for example, 1 vs. 1 or 3 vs. 3, are going to become part of the updated Brawls. These can be played without being a member of a Clan. More details about this will be published later.
To access Ranked Battles, you must have fought at least 23 battles in the available battle types.

Captains!
We've prepared something interesting for you—a historical cinemarathon! Together, we'll watch a series of documentaries that have been prepared jointly with the Russian Geographical Society’s Underwater Research Center. Join our festive event and expect gifts!
The first episode goes live on December 14—be sure to watch it!

[previewyoutube=AQq6n4f5v9E;full][/previewyoutube]

  Subscribe to the channel

Curious about the gifts? Subscribe to our channel in order to claim your well-deserved reward—if we get the required number of subscribers prior to the start of each next episode, its viewers will be shown a bonus code that unlocks a special chain of combat missions.
Completing all parts of the chain will reward you with {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,000,000 credits and one Santa's Gift container.
In total, you can get up to four bonus codes—one for each episode.
If we get the specified number of subscribers for all episodes, completing the combat missions will bring you a total of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png4,000,000 credits and four Santa's Gift containers!
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/212f7368-3ae3-11eb-86e1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Previous Episodes of the Marathon
Underwater Research Center
The Underwater Research Center is a special research unit of the Russian Geographical Society that has been set up to study underwater spaces and objects. The research center has absorbed the best professional expertise of specialists from the ranks of the Russian Emergencies Ministry, the Navy, the Defense Ministry, and the National Underwater Research Center. Fitted with specialized equipment, the Underwater Research Center—since the very first years of its existence—has become a core organization in Russia in the field of underwater research.

In addition to expeditionary activities to study sunken objects and underwater spaces, the research center pays close attention to educational and awareness-raising projects. Since 2017, together with the Orlyonok Russian children's center, the Underwater Research Center has been implementing the Oceanautica program. The organization also hosts exhibitions and produces documentaries. One of the most important missions of the Underwater Research Center is to create a 3D interactive map of all Russian underwater terrain and sunken objects thereon.

Dates: 27/11/2020 — 06/12/2020
Qualifications — Key Rules
Participate in our special Clan battles season, place among the top four teams on your server and we will invite you to participate in the tournament and have a shot at the grand prize pool of $30,000!
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6f9dbf7a-22a4-11eb-9d4a-d89d6715223c.jpg
Qualifications run from: 27/11/2020 — 29/11/2020 — Friday, Saturday and Sunday
Format: 9 vs. 9 playing Tier VIII ships

Restrictions: Up to two battleships per team, up to five cruisers per team, up to four destroyers per team and no aircraft carriers

Times
Asia 10:00 — 16:00 UTC
CIS 14:00 — 20:00 UTC
EU 16:00 — 22:00 UTC
NA 22:30 — 4:30 UTC

Rewards
10,000 doubloons per clan for Top 25 clans (globally)
5,000 doubloons per clan for clans ranked 26th -100th (globally)
An invitation to the Verizon Warrior’s Championship for the top 4 clans of each region

Maps: North, Islands of Ice, Mountain Range, Warrior’s Path, Sleeping Giant, Greece, Northern Waters
The qualification season will be held in the standard clan battles setup with alpha and bravo ratings, there will however be only one league. Any amount of divisions from the same clan can play together.
The Mercenaries feature will be disabled during the qualification season.
How to Participate
Participate in our special qualification clan battles season and place among the top four clans in your region.
Clan commanders of the top four teams in each region will be contacted via the e-mail address linked to their account and invited to participate in the tournament.
Note: Due to the short time frame between qualifications and the tournament, you will have only 24 hours to respond and provide us with a full roster of participating players from your clan.
Tournament Rules and Information
Dates
Regional Playoffs: 05/12/2020

Times
ASIA 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
CIS 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
EU 16:00 — 20:00 UTC
NA 16:00 — 20:00 UTC

International Playoffs: 06/12/2020

Times
All regions 14:00 — 19:00 UTC

Note: All teams must be available to play during the specified time frames. Detailed match times will be communicated to Clan Commanders following a successful qualification. If a team fails to show up, it will be disqualified.

Logistics
Invitations
Clan Commanders of the top-4 clans from each region will be contacted via the E-mail linked to their accounts by December 1st and are required to respond to this invitation within 24 hours. This response needs to include:
Username, In-Game Player ID and Real Name of each participating player.
Note: A player may only be a member of one team, regardless of region.
Commanders may nominate between 9 and 12 players to participate.
Note: Nominated players must be part of the qualifying clan when this information is sent.
A team logo

Note:  In case this response is not sent in the allotted 24-hour time frame, the tournament organizer will contact the next-placed team and the qualifying clan will forfeit their qualification for the tournament. The same rules apply for the next-placed team when contacted.

Restrictions
Players or Clans are ineligible to participate in the tournament if:
They are suspended in-game due to a violation of the game rules at the time of the nomination.
They have been previously warned for the use of forbidden modifications according to paragraph 8 of the Game Rules.
They have an inappropriate nickname / clan name that violates paragraph 4 of the Game Rules or in any way disparages the developers, tournament organizers, tournament sponsors or participating teams.
They have an ineligible clan logo that violates the Game Rules or the restrictions set out in the Contest Rules document.
There is any indication that they were violating the Game Rules or EULA during the qualification stage, including sharing accounts with other players or allowing other players access to their accounts.
Should an ineligible player be submitted as part of the roster, the clan commander will be required to nominate a replacement that is eligible within 24 hours.

Server
All tournament games are to be played on the EU server.
Regional qualifiers are played on regional servers.

Appropriately fitted out tournament accounts will be sent to teams to ensure all teams can compete on an equal footing. Players can decide whether they want to use the designated tournament account or their private account.

Note: Tournament accounts may only be used in training rooms and any violation of the Game Rules with these may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account. Tournament accounts may only be used by their assigned player, as communicated by the Clan Commander. Violations of this rule may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account.

Communication
The language of the tournament is English. As such, the clan commander needs to be able to communicate in English, or nominate a team spokesperson who is able to handle communications for the team.
Clan commanders and team spokespeople (where applicable) are required to join a dedicated discord server which will be used for all communication related to the running of the tournament, picks/bans, disputes and questions.

Format
Structure
The top 4 teams from each region will play a single elimination tournament during regional playoffs.
Round 1 — Best of 3:
Game 1: 1st placed team vs. 3rd placed team
Game 2: 2nd placed team vs. 4th placed team

Round 2 — Best of 3:
Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2


The winners of each regional qualifier will play a double-elimination tournament during International playoffs.
Round 1 — Best of 3:
Game 1: Winner ASIA vs. Winner CIS
Game 2: Winner EU vs. Winner NA

Round 2 — Mixed:
Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2 — Best of 5
Loser Game 1 vs. Loser Game 2 — Best of 3


Ships
All games will be played with 9 players and Tier 8 ships in the following configuration:
0-2 Battleships
3-5 Cruisers
2-4 Destroyers
0 Aircraft Carriers

Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for ship selection prior to each series.
For the purposes of the pick/ban process, the tournament organizer will select a random team to go first.

Each team will ban one ship (this can be the same ship)
In case a ship with an alternate version is banned, the alternate version is also considered as banned. (i.e. https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Massachusetts and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Massachusetts B or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Atago and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII ARP Takao)

Map Pool
North
Islands of Ice
Mountain Range
Warrior’s Path
Sleeping Giant
Greece
Northern Waters

All maps will be played in the Clans Domination game mode.

Picks/Bans
Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for the map pick prior to each series. If a team is not ready to start the pick/ban process at least 10 minutes before the round’s scheduled start time, random picks and bans will be chosen for that team.
For the purposes of the pick/ban process, the tournament organizer will select a random team to go first.
Each team will ban one map (this can be the same map)
Each team will choose one map and spawn
For the Best of 5, teams will alternate picking two maps each.
The tournament organizer will select a random map as the final map, with a random spawn allocated to each team.

Prizes
1st place — $15,000 (fifteen thousand US dollars)
2nd place — $10,000 (ten thousand US dollars)
3rd place — $5,000 (five thousand US dollars)

Note: The amounts of the Prizes are specified per winning team and will be divided in equal parts among all the team members. Please make sure to check the detailed information on the payouts in the Contest Rules.

Disputes
The tournament organizers have final say in regards to any and all disputes and complaints.
In case a team wants to submit a complaint, they must do so on the dedicated discord server, immediately after the action in question has taken place.

Restarts
During each game series, each clan commander has the right to ask for one game to be restarted, if no more than 2 minutes of game time have elapsed, for the following reasons:
A player was disconnected
A player experienced a client crash
The training room’s settings were configured incorrectly

In case a game has restarted, players have to ready up as soon as possible with the same ships, loadout and captain skills as they started the game with initially.

Note: When asking for the restart, the reason has to be provided and approval has to be given by the tournament organizer or his designated representative on discord.

Modifications
Players may only use modifications from the official World of Warships ModStation.

Tiebreaking
In the unlikely event of a tie during the tournament, the teams will be required to play an additional deciding match on a random map with random spawns.

Check out the Verizon Branches Challenge!
On December 5th and 6th, veterans from the United States military will face off on the high seas to raise money for charity. Tune in to our coverage of this Verizon Branches challenge and find out which branch of the US military has what it takes to stand victorious.
