notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/067037fa7d3de90b518b9ff8c5fd50cb32ddff0d.jpg
U.S. battleships Kansas, Minnesota, and Vermont have become available for all players to research.

Read our article below to learn how to effectively play these new steel giants.
[previewyoutube=6XuH_8HG03A;full][/previewyoutube]
[table][tr][th]Key Features of the Branch ● Tactics ● Commander Skills and Upgrades[/th][/tr][/table]
Key Features of the Branch
Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
Great maneuverability for battleships, but they are rather slow.
Good anti-torpedo protection, but https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota have rather mediocre armor.
Powerful AA defenses and the availability of the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56a0d252-3305-11eb-8dc1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55485740-3305-11eb-911c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/569f2146-3305-11eb-a370-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Tactics
Due to their great firing range, the new U.S. battleships feel most comfortable at combat distances over 15 km.

At the beginning of a battle, the most important thing to do is take up a suitable position. Despite these battleships having relatively good maneuverability, it will still be difficult to quickly change the direction of your attack or escape from focused enemy fire due to their low speeds.

Their great firing ranges (more than 30 km for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Vermont!), in combination with their weighty salvos, will enable you to keep the enemy at a distance. However, each salvo must be carefully prepared, as the ships of the new sub-branch have rather long reloading times.

Effective air defenses, additionally reinforced with the Defensive AA Fire consumable, will help you fend off enemy aircraft.

If possible, you should avoid approaching the enemy. https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota lack good armor, and furthermore, all the new ships have long main battery reloading times. However, if you can't avoid a close quarters engagement, your advantage will be the weighty salvo of your numerous guns. The ships' decent anti-torpedo protection will reduce the damage they take from torpedoes.

Commander Skills and Upgrades
For a Commander with 10 skill points we recommend:

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_PriorityTargetModifier_ffcc52036d210f6f22c4ea7ad44db3baf8ec256b54f5a471c3b342e852599a59.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_LastChanceModifier_08c69996db12c0caa1dacc5aa9c2c9dc1139371a3248c9d0c98a79822ec3b103.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_SuperintendentModifier_377444942b28914f815944fd2a86e21a23387d4b743827a79ac2813d8011282a.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_FireResistanceModifier_86b3ffe44c6181777d392cb8c57fc9729873b56cd8d13cd1c77d2688c85de18f.png
Priority Target
Adrenaline Rush
Superintendent
Fire Prevention
For a Commander with 19 skill points, we recommend choosing the most appropriate skills for your playstyle. Consider applying the following variants:

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_AutoRepairModifier_c4564b2e8d0944294af4a54b0f1b11c55b80adb7831ab8e14685f32c2218423c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_VisibilityModifier_59d3bb84996e8f66039e6103dd58dccad99fa0c607b3e3375afcfc35fbb9fe71.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_MainGunsRotationModifier_125e4abed09610d4bcc97a38186af839794303af8eda2488acac96f129790809.png
Basics of Survivability
Concealment Expert
Expert Marksman
The following upgrades will be useful:

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM030_MainWeapon_Mod_I_bb1e79efbcc73dfa03a6dd5ae173566ee691b77e3a6587389d6f7ea07eb03588.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM020_DamageControl_Mod_I_bbc708467bc8f1e6264ac88fb8999ea40660e4b0b94b59ab7b3f1a8b60539ed8.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM028_FireControl_Mod_I_US_c5594545cedeb1f273aecbd98d18c8dbbcc7b0edc9b5e1b8184eacb443991cb5.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM023_DamageControl_Mod_II_3c6aea0c5bccc94f1d8f1fa52662232afa007d784638ce6e981c8ad3457c63fa.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM027_ConcealmentMeasures_Mod_I_bda1386ab237032301b6273e655a1998de5bfb50e2c8e59124c8a93d73093f0a.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM029_FireControl_Mod_II_US_35db21691559a7acc1af802e9a0fdcaf9bd6f56a5a0ddff720997643eec8b75d.png

notes.title: World of Warships Advent Calendar
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/afdf11007a6fe75a968aafc256d8d3f47846cbac.jpg
Captains!

Starting December 1, you'll receive some nice New Year and Christmas presents—the World of Warships Advents Calendar is here! Recall your battle merits, collect gifts, and get additional rewards—including Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers—for completing quests! Make sure to share the Calendar with your friends—let no one remain without a present.

[table][tr][th]Asia[/th][th]Open the Calendar[/th]
[/tr][tr][th]CIS(Ru)[/th][th]Open the Calendar[/th]
[/tr][tr][th]EU[/th][th]Open the Calendar[/th]
[/tr][tr][th]NA[/th][th]Open the Calendar[/th][/tr][/table]
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f01cfca-3317-11eb-b3a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Daily Presents
Each day, you'll have an opportunity to open a card that offers some interesting info about your own game statistics and receive a present—various types of flags or camouflages.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b80d67d6-33ae-11eb-be7b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The Advent Calendar will be active between December 1 and 31. You'll have 1 week to collect each present. If you miss more than 7 days, you'll lose an opportunity to open a card.
Additional Rewards
By visiting the Advent Calendar and opening its cards every day, you'll get guaranteed gifts and be given opportunities to complete special quests that offer additional rewards. Having finished each simple task, don't forget to press the "Complete the Quest" button.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b7ff9804-33ae-11eb-a25a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b834c24a-33ae-11eb-bed2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b829c7a0-33ae-11eb-ba5a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Each special quest will not be considered complete until you press the button!
For completing 6, 12, 18, and 24 of such quests, you'll receive doubloons and 1 day of Premium Account, as well as Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers.

[table][tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46458056-33af-11eb-be7b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/td]
[td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46030014-33af-11eb-a25a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/td]
[/tr][/table]
To complete some of the tasks, you'll be required to log into your personal account, launch the game, or perform another similar action. The detailed requirements will be described on the cards.
Happy holidays, Captains!

[table][tr][th]American Battleships ● Winter Trophies ● Brawls ● Armory ● Single Game Client ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
American Battleships
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b1a565b0-32d7-11eb-ac8e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

American battleships https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Vermont will become available for all players to research.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59963166-fe56-11ea-a399-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/58b76ac6-fe56-11ea-b102-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd348f8e-32e4-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Features of the Branch
Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
Great maneuverability for battleships and effective anti-torpedo protection, but rather a low speed.
Decent AA defenses that can be reinforced with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
Winter Trophies
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b12b4744-32d7-11eb-8b11-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.9.11 brings you the first batch of gifts and festive New Year activities.

Free random bundles in the Armory
The bundles are available between December 4–22, 05:00 UTC
You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b23de712-32d8-11eb-98b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
We'll give you some indicators to jog your memory about claiming your rewards by highlighting the Armory banner with a color, as well as attaching a special icon and text notification to it.
New Year Gifts
Gear up for the time of gifts in World of Warships! From December 4, bundles that include three types of Santa's containers are scheduled to become available. Exchanging doubloons for them in the Armory is one of several ways in which they can be obtained.

Each festive container holds a reward: doubloons, days of Premium Account, Coal, Free XP, expendable camouflages, signals—or one of the 107 Premium ships!

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c82cbac-32e5-11eb-ad6e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c7fe810-32e5-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c24dc5e-32e5-11eb-821f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Combat Mission Groups: Winter Trophies
The new game event tasks you with completing 21 missions spread across three combat mission groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.9.11, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. The final reward for completing the last group is the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier VIII ships.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/347d257c-32e7-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The combat mission groups will be available until the release of Update 0.9.12. More details about the completion criteria for the missions are available in the game client.
Advent Calendar
The Advent Calendar festivities kick off on December 1 and run until December 31. Open cards, get rewards, and complete missions to get even more rewards! More details about the Advent Calendar will follow in a dedicated article.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2885081624995503857
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f01cfca-3317-11eb-b3a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Battle Performance Bonuses
An alternative option is opening up for you to get Research Points for resetting ship branches, as well as temporary victory bonuses. All you need to do now is earn 300 base XP. Claim bonuses by playing your favorite battle type!

Victory Bonuses have been replaced with "Battle Performance Bonuses" across all descriptions in the game client.

Brawls
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e9d0fc-32d7-11eb-8039-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Due to technical issues the Ranked Battles system update has been delayed to a later update.
Update 0.9.11 ushers in Clan Brawls 12 and 13. Brawls are now open to all players, even if a player isn't currently in a Clan. To participate, apply via the Create Division menu near the "Battle!" button, then wait for an invitation to join a Division. Only the Commander who creates a Division for a Brawl is required to be part of a Clan; the other two invitees do not have to belong to any Clan at all.

Clan Brawl 12 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Wed. 09 Dec. 12:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends:  Mon. 14 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Prime Times:
ASIA 11:00 — 16:00 UTC
CIS 15:00 — 20:00 UTC
EU 17:00 — 22:00 UTC
NA 00:00 — 05:00 UTC
Format: 3 vs. 3, playing Tier IX ships

Restrictions:
A maximum of one ship of each type per team
No more than two mercenaries per Division
Maps and modes: Crash Zone Alpha; Shatter, in Domination mode; Two Brothers, in Epicenter mode

Rewards: up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png2,500 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,500,000 credits; and 60,000 Elite Commander XP

Clan Brawl 13 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Wed. 16 Dec. 12:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends:  Mon. 21 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Prime Times:

A maximum of two cruisers per team
Up to four mercenaries per Division
Maps and modes: Big Race; New Dawn; Sleeping Giant, in Domination mode

Rewards: up to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png2,500 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,500,000 credits; and 60,000 Elite Commander XP

Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0f79afc-32d7-11eb-98b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

American Tokens and Battle Points can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the end of Update 0.9.10. After that, American Tokens and Battle Points will be converted into credits at the rates of 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,000 and 1:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png75, respectively.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The possibility to make these exchanges will be available until:  Thu. 03 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

The following ships will become available with the release of the Update:
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Z-44, a Type 1936B destroyer, armed with two quintuple-tube torpedo launchers that reload their long-range torpedoes quickly. The ship excels at conducting torpedo attacks from a distance. Unlike the researchable German destroyers, Z-44 doesn't have access to the Hydroacoustic Search consumable. The ship is available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png228,000 Coal, as well as in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Plymouth, based on one of the draft designs that preceded the creation of the Edinburgh-class cruisers. The ship's distinctive features include sixteen 152 mm guns placed in four turrets. Like the researchable British light cruisers, she carries AP shells only. The ship is equipped with the Surveillance Radar, Smoke Generator, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables, but has a short firing range and weak armor. You can get her in exchange for 27,000 Steel.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Neustrashimy, the first Soviet destroyer that was designed and built after World War II. She boasts one of the best concealment values at her tier, coupled with effective torpedo armament and a large HP pool. The destroyer has access to a wide range of consumables, including Specialized Repair Teams and Defensive AA Fire. You can get her in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png296,000 Coal.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Flint, an American cruiser with powerful artillery, good AA defenses, and high maneuverability. Twelve dual-purpose 127 mm guns with a high rate of fire that fire shells along arcing trajectories. Take shelter behind an island, then rain a barrage of shells down upon your enemies. Flint boasts decent torpedo armament and a favorable set of consumables: Smoke Generator with a long smoke dispersion time, Hydroacoustic Search, or Defensive AA Fire in one slot. You can get the ship for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png168,000 Coal.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Flint and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Neustrashimy were previously available for Steel—a valuable resource that's primarily earned in competitive game modes. We wouldn't like to diminish the value of those ships for their owners, which is why their prices are higher than the prices of other same-tier ships in Coal.

Duke of York carries HE shells that are notable for delivering increased damage and having higher armor-penetration capabilities. They can deal consistent damage to enemy battleships and cruisers, even at long ranges where AP rounds are less efficient. To successfully counter destroyers, Duke of York has access to Hydroacoustic Search—a rare consumable for this ship type. You can get the ship in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png101,000 Coal.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Lazo, a Soviet Project 68 light cruiser, has large dimensions and carries a formidable main battery of twelve 152 mm guns. She's well suited to long-range engagements. She excels at exchanging fire over a distance of 20 km due to the trademark features of the Soviet artillery and the specific parameters of her Spotting Aircraft consumable. You can get her in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png83,000 Coal.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngV Hill is an American destroyer flotilla leader that was designed at the end of World War I. Her guns can be aimed quickly and she has comfortable torpedo launching angles, as well as decent AA defenses for her ship type and tier. You can get her for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png38,000 Coal.

We've added containers from the "German Navy" and "Shipbuilding" collections, with each container available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png1,000 Coal. This presents a good opportunity to complete the two collections if you haven't done so already.

The reward for completing the sections and the entire "German Navy" collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships. The reward for completing the "Shipbuilding" collection is a Santa’s Big Gift container.

In connection with the forthcoming update to Ranked Battles, we've made the following changes:
The cost of permanent camouflage patterns for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Flint, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Black, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Stalingrad, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Bourgogne, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Shikishima has been increased from three to 10 Ranked Tokens.
The number of Ranked Tokens that each player has accrued has been increased fourfold.
We've added the Predator permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Somers, available for 10 Ranked Tokens.
Starting from Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available: IX Georgia, IX Alaska, VIII Massachusetts, X Thunderer, and X Småland. Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.10.1 goes live in about 3 months' time.

Other Changes
Changes to banners in the Port
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/857e5130-32ec-11eb-9dd2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The banners of the Armory and Premium Shop will now announce the arrival of new items, coupons, and temporary specials.

We've added pop-up windows to the Dockyard banner to give players status reports on the current shipbuilding phase.

Game Balance Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.11, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

Soviet Tier X destroyer Khabarovsk, and Japanese Tier X destroyer Harugumo
Loss of HP after being hit by an AP or SAP shell with a caliber of 280 mm and above will now not exceed 10% of the maximum damage that such a shell can cause.
British Tier VIII aircraft carrier Implacable
Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,100 to 5,300
Chances of a bomb causing fire on target increased from 29% to 30%
American Tier VIII battleship Kansas
Sigma parameter increased from 1.5 to 1.6
Japanese Tier IX destroyer Kitakaze
Detectability range by sea increased from 7.56 to 7.76 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly.
Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0f8c90e-32d7-11eb-992d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: IV Dante Alighieri, V Conte di Cavour, IX Lepanto, IX Marco Polo, X Vampire II, and VIII Fen Yang.

The Gothic permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Bismarck is now available in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 doubloons via the Exterior tab.

The exterior setting of the Naval Base Port has been reverted back to its initial design.

Other Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e520ac-32d7-11eb-85e9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In January 2021, we're going to cease support for macOS. We've made this decision due to the low popularity of the operating system among our audience. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. More details are available from Player Support.
We've added sound effects for some animations in the Port for the following themed permanent camouflages from the Transformers universe: Freedom Fighter for X Montana, Gold Bug for X Gearing, Messenger of Oblivion for X Großer Kurfürst, and Crush ’n’ Destroy for X Khabarovsk.
Added an option to disable screen shaking from incoming damage and when using Engine Boost for squadrons with a new "Camera feedback when damage is taken" setting in the Controls tab.
The Key Battle ships have been removed from player accounts. Any XP earned playing those ships has been transferred to I Erie.
We've removed the option to set an Autopilot course by clicking a square on the Minimap.
Removed Naval Legends audio files from the res/userMusiс folder. You can listen to all of our podcasts here.
When previewing camouflage patterns in the Armory, a block will be displayed with the ship's tech specs adjusted for the effects and bonuses of the camouflage being previewed.
Added an option to launch replays without pop-up notifications about opening files of such a format in Windows.
Fixed an issue that caused the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable to work incorrectly.
Fixed an issue that, when locking onto a target with main battery guns, set an incorrect angle for the torpedo launchers. As a result, torpedoes could be sent in the wrong direction or the launchers could malfunction entirely.
Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard but before the ship being built had appeared in it.
Fixed an issue that caused aerial torpedoes to arm at incorrect distances from the target.
Fixed an issue that caused the game client to freeze on the login screen.
Fixed an issue that disabled the display of certain indicators (distance to aiming point, detectability, and shell flight time) for aircraft in battle with the alternative battle interface mode enabled.
Fixed an issue that caused Andrew Cunningham's "Lightning Fast" talent to provide an incorrect bonus to the speed of aircraft.
Fixed an issue that caused a screenshot from the previous battle to pop up before displaying the battle results.
Other improvements and changes. The full list is available from Player Support.
Attentive readers can expect a reward! All you need to do is click the "Get Reward" button, and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account will be yours! Please note: your day of Premium Account starts immediately after clicking the button, so make sure to dive straight into the game and make best use of it.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9276/World_of_Warships__3_Ships_Pack/
Steam Awards Nominations — choose the games you love and complete tasks to improve your Steam profile level.
World of Warships has changed significantly since the launch on Steam at 15th of November 2017 which had opened it for new audiences hungry for a unique blend of naval action that is easy to get into but hard to master, allowing to command the biggest war machines in the history of mankind, both built and planned ones.

We love our wonderfully dedicated and passionate community, and the game is the Labor of Love for us. We'll keep on giving no matter what — the plans for the next year are large as a battleship— but we'll be very grateful for your vote! If we win — let's celebrate together with something special!

Good luck on conquering the seas and stay tuned for more news very soon.

For completing stages of the chain, you'll earn X-Ray Papa Unaone and Sierra Bravo signals. The final reward comes in the form of Commander Kirishima with a unique voiceover and 6 skill points.

ARPEGGIO OF BLUE STEEL -ARS NOVA-
The anime and manga are set in the near future, at a time when the mysterious Fleet of Fog has seized control over the World Ocean. An enigmatic and invincible squadron is made up of the reincarnations of legendary ships from the first half of the 20th century, with Kongō, Kirishima, and Takao being among them.

Equipped with a mysterious superweapon, and led by battleship Yamato, the new masters of the oceans block the humans from accessing the seas—destroying anything that dares to move offshore. Many corners of the earth, including Japan, find themselves isolated and cut off from the rest of the world.

Ships of the Fleet of Fog are commanded by their human-like Mental Models. Iona, the Mental Model of Japanese submarine I-401, chooses to defect across to the humans in a bid to turn the tide of the war against the Fleet of Fog.

notes.title: We're Celebrating Our Third Anniversary on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5d712d42af895e20ca6896670686c7212dc14881.jpg
Captains!

Three years have passed since World of Warships first appeared on Steam! We're happy that so many players have revealed their talents for conquering in our epic naval battles during this time. Keep up that spirit!

For the anniversary, you'll receive some special combat missions. Completing them will grant you access to unique branded items such as a container, camouflages, and a Steam flag. For that to happen, simply enter battles playing Tier V ships and higher, and earn 10,000 total XP and 20,000 Commander XP.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ensign/PCEE167_Steam_Flag_177ea27ee1c7aa65f1ad073104aaeb95949bb4fffc3f117a735e25d57fd22a13.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC044_Steam_Camo_a5629d1decbee0c66e8be5e0bc2dabf048535cd3ce993bdbcb1b8e85066343d0.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/13766787543624b65d07d1c3de1a00e2d962d752.png
The Steam container includes economic signals and one of the following items: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png10,000 Free XP; 5x Steam camouflages; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account; or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png250 doubloons.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Fri. 13 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends: Mon. 30 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
You can complete the chain of combat missions playing Tier V–X ships in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations.
Still haven't upgraded to a Tier V ship? Then the special DLC that includes Texas will help you complete the combat missions—you will be able to stand at her helm for 3 days after downloading the expansion from the link.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/934640/World_of_Warships__Rental_Texas_3_Days/
The countdown starts once you've added the DLC to your library and entered the game.

Are you new to World of Warships or do you have fewer than eight battles under your belt? Then simply finish two battles playing a Tier III ship or higher and you will receive Tier V battleship Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya in a rare Victory Day permanent camouflage, a Commander with 6 skill points, and some unique branded items—Steam boxes, Steam camouflages and a Steam flag!

notes.title: Verizon Warrior's Championship – Get Ready for Battle!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fd1788087ca80781165b4d9fad40fb6a30511b15.jpg

We’ve joined forces with Verizon to invite players from all realms to participate in a special tournament with a grand prize pool of $30,000 and the Verizon Branches Challenge — an exhibition tournament featuring four teams of U.S. Army, Navy, Marines and Airforce veterans competing to support their charity of choice.
Dates: 27/11/2020 — 06/12/2020
Qualifications — Key Rules
Participate in our special Clan battles season, place among the top four teams on your server and we will invite you to participate in the tournament and have a shot at the grand prize pool of $30,000!
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6f9dbf7a-22a4-11eb-9d4a-d89d6715223c.jpg
Qualifications run from: 27/11/2020 — 29/11/2020 — Friday, Saturday and Sunday
Format: 9 vs. 9 playing Tier VIII ships
Restrictions: Up to two battleships per team, up to five cruisers per team, up to four destroyers per team and no aircraft carriers
Rewards
10,000 doubloons per clan for Top 25 clans (globally)
5,000 doubloons per clan for clans ranked 25th -100th (globally)
An invitation to the Verizon Warrior’s Championship for the top 4 clans of each region
Maps: North, Islands of Ice, Mountain Range, Warrior’s Path, Sleeping Giant, Greece, Northern Waters

How to Participate
Participate in our special qualification clan battles season and place among the top four clans in your region.
Clan commanders of the top four teams in each region will be contacted via the e-mail address linked to their account and invited to participate in the tournament.
Note: Due to the short time frame between qualifications and the tournament, you will have only 24 hours to respond and provide us with a full roster of participating players from your clan.

Tournament Rules and Information
Dates
Regional Qualifiers: 05/12/2020

Times
ASIA 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
CIS 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
EU 16:00 — 20:00 UTC
NA 16:00 — 20:00 UTC
International Playoffs: 06/12/2020

Times
All regions 14:00 — 19:00 UTC
Note: All teams must be available to play during the specified time frames. Detailed match times will be communicated to Clan Commanders following a successful qualification. If a team fails to show up, it will be disqualified.
Logistics
Invitations
Clan Commanders of the top-4 clans from each region will be contacted via the E-mail linked to their accounts by December 1st and are required to respond to this invitation within 24 hours. This response needs to include:
Username, In-Game Player ID and Real Name of each participating player.
Note: A player may only be a member of one team, regardless of region.
Commanders may nominate between 9 and 12 players to participate.
Note: Nominated players must be part of the qualifying clan when this information is sent.
A team logo
Note:  In case this response is not sent in the allotted 24-hour time frame, the tournament organizer will contact the next-placed team and the qualifying clan will forfeit their qualification for the tournament. The same rules apply for the next-placed team when contacted.
Restrictions
Players or Clans are ineligible to participate in the tournament if:
They are suspended in-game due to a violation of the game rules at the time of the nomination.
They have been previously warned for the use of forbidden modifications according to paragraph 8 of the Game Rules.
They have an inappropriate nickname / clan name that violates paragraph 4 of the Game Rules or in any way disparages the developers, tournament organizers, tournament sponsors or participating teams.
They have an ineligible clan logo that violates the Game Rules or the restrictions set out in the Contest Rules document.
There is any indication that they were violating the Game Rules or EULA during the qualification stage, including sharing accounts with other players or allowing other players access to their accounts.
Should an ineligible player be submitted as part of the roster, the clan commander will be required to nominate a replacement that is eligible within 24 hours.
Server
All tournament games are to be played on the EU server.
Regional qualifiers are played on regional servers.
Appropriately fitted out tournament accounts will be sent to teams to ensure all teams can compete on an equal footing. Players can decide whether they want to use the designated tournament account or their private account.
Note: Tournament accounts may only be used in training rooms and any violation of the Game Rules with these may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account. Tournament accounts may only be used by their assigned player, as communicated by the Clan Commander. Violations of this rule may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account.
Communication
The language of the tournament is English. As such, the clan commander needs to be able to communicate in English, or nominate a team spokesperson who is able to handle communications for the team.
Clan commanders and team spokespeople (where applicable) are required to join a dedicated discord server which will be used for all communication related to the running of the tournament, picks/bans, disputes and questions.

Format
Structure
The top 4 teams from each region will play a single elimination tournament during regional playoffs.
Round 1 — Best of 3:
Game 1: 1st placed team vs. 3rd placed team
Game 2: 2nd placed team vs. 4th placed team
Round 2 — Best of 3:
Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2

The winners of each regional qualifier will play a double-elimination tournament during International playoffs.
Round 1 — Best of 3:
Game 1: Winner ASIA vs. Winner CIS
Game 2: Winner EU vs. Winner NA
Round 2 — Mixed:
Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2 — Best of 5
Loser Game 1 vs. Loser Game 2 — Best of 3

Ships
All games will be played with 9 players and Tier 8 ships in the following configuration:
0-2 Battleships
3-5 Cruisers
2-4 Destroyers
0 Aircraft Carriers
Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for ship selection prior to each series.
For the purposes of the pick/ban process, the tournament organizer will select a random team to go first.
Each team will ban one ship (this can be the same ship)
In case a ship with an alternate version is banned, the alternate version is also considered as banned. (i.e. https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Massachusetts and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Massachusetts B or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Atago and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII ARP Takao)

Map Pool
North
Islands of Ice
Mountain Range
Warrior’s Path
Sleeping Giant
Greece
Northern Waters
Picks/Bans
Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for the map pick prior to each series. If a team is not ready to start the pick/ban process at least 10 minutes before the round’s scheduled start time, random picks and bans will be chosen for that team.
Each team will ban one map (this can be the same map)
Each team will choose one map and spawn
For the Best of 5, teams will alternate picking two maps each.
The tournament organizer will select a random map as the final map, with a random spawn allocated to each team.
Prizes
1st place — $15,000 (fifteen thousand US dollars)
2nd place — $10,000 (ten thousand US dollars)
3rd place — $5,000 (five thousand US dollars)

Note: The amounts of the Prizes are specified per winning team and will be divided in equal parts among all the team members. Please make sure to check the detailed information on the payouts in the Contest Rules.
Disputes
The tournament organizers have final say in regards to any and all disputes and complaints.
In case a team wants to submit a complaint, they must do so on the dedicated discord server, immediately after the action in question has taken place.
Restarts
During each game series, each clan commander has the right to ask for one game to be restarted, if no more than 2 minutes of game time have elapsed, for the following reasons:
A player was disconnected
A player experienced a client crash
The training room’s settings were configured incorrectly
In case a game has restarted, players have to ready up as soon as possible with the same ships, loadout and captain skills as they started the game with initially.
Note: When asking for the restart, the reason has to be provided and approval has to be given by the tournament organizer or his designated representative on discord.
Modifications
Players may only use modifications from the official World of Warships ModStation.
Tiebreaking
In the unlikely event of a tie during the tournament, the teams will be required to play an additional deciding match on a random map with random spawns.

American Battleships: Part 2

The game event in Update 0.9.10 is presented by combat missions, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the U.S. Navy.

For the purposes of standardization, Directives have been renamed "combat mission groups."

Please note: American Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the event ends. After the end of the event, they will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1:1,000.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The possibility to make this exchange will be available until:  Thu. 03 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Combat mission groups {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start:  Thu. 29 Oct. 06:15 CET (UTC+1)
End:  Tue. 01 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Rewards for completing the missions and groups: signal flags, camouflages, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, and Always Courageous containers.

Always Courageous containers
How to get the containers
Up to 27 containers—by completing combat mission groups.
Up to 4 containers—from Daily Shipments.
Up to 10 containers—by completing special combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ad70767a-153f-11eb-90b0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Each Always Courageous container includes:
An element of the Always Courageous collection.
1x special signal (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan), or 1x Stars 'n' Stripes camouflage.
One of the following: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png600 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png500 Free XP; 1,500 Elite Commander XP; 3x signals of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London, India Bravo Terrathree, Zulu Hotel); or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png50,000 credits.
You can purchase Always Courageous Premium containers, which offer more rewards, in the Premium Shop, or obtain them in exchange for doubloons in the Armory. The rewards are as follows:
An element of the Always Courageous collection.
15x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan), or 12x Stars 'n' Stripes camouflages.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png3,400 Coal; or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png8,500 Free XP; or 3x Type 59 camouflages.
The "Always Courageous" collection
The newly added "Always Courageous" collection comprises four sections, with four elements in each. It will educate you about the main batteries of battleships, admirals, and medals for service in both World Wars, as well as the main uniform types of enlisted men of the U.S. Navy during World War II.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d86a974-1540-11eb-8e52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Reward for completing the sections: 5x Stars 'n' Stripes expendable camouflages; Wings, Stars, and Stars 'n' Stripes patches.
Reward for completing the collection: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma in the Military permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82791656-1540-11eb-9384-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma is a Nevada-class battleship, the unique feature of which is her ten 356 mm main caliber guns placed in two twin turrets and two triple turrets. The guns are accurate, have a decent firing range, and cause significant damage per salvo, but take rather a long time to reload. In close quarters, the battleship can make use of her accurate secondary battery guns.

The exchange rate for duplicates is 4:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section, then confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.
Elements of the collection can only be obtained from event-related containers. In Update 0.10.5, we're planning to add Always Courageous containers to the Armory. They will be available in exchange for Coal. Thus, you'll still be able to complete the collection and obtain https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma if you haven't managed to do so in Update 0.9.10. The exact cost of the containers will be announced later.
Daily Shipments
During Update 0.9.10, enter the game in the period between October 29 and November 12, inclusive, to start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40edcc9a-153b-11eb-b828-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
When Update 0.9.11 goes live, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Vermont will leave Early Access and become available for all players to research.

Key Battle
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e6c0a78-153d-11eb-8481-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
A new temporary battle type—Key Battle—has been added in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills in a futuristic competition by assuming command over a ship representing one of three corporations!
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
You start out alone, but you can gather a team of up to three ships directly in battle.
For destroying monsters and other players, you'll get a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can also reinforce your ship directly in battle.
The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle. You can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
You'll find a monster with a key closer to the center of the map. If you destroy it, the monster will drop a key that will allow you to escape via the Portal.
Once all the keys have been used or the Portal is closed, the remaining ships will be transported to a special area—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. The last surviving ship will leave the Polygon successfully.
Successfully escaping the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.
Each of the three available ships offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on the gameplay.
The new themed Port inspired by the Polygon will ensure that you soak in the event's atmosphere before you enter battle.

Clan Missions
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e282934-153d-11eb-93a5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Some missions related to Clan development have been added to the Clans section of the menu. Oil is the main reward given for completing these missions, but two of them will deliver Coal to the Clan Treasury. In total, you can earn up to 32,100 Oil and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png11,000 Coal. You can also earn the "Formidable Fleet" achievement.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/66fbb18e-1754-11eb-aa7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The missions reward Clans for growing in size, participating in the Naval Battle, active playing of the Clan members, and fighting in Clan Battles. More details about the missions are available in the game client.

Aircraft Carrier Interface
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e6555ac-153d-11eb-bb7f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

We've made some changes that will ensure you receive useful information about the status of your ship while controlling a squadron in the air.
A new marker pointing at your aircraft carrier has been added. It changes to indicate your ship's status: risk of collision, ship detected by the enemy, approaching torpedoes, etc.

We've added the possibility to skip the attack animation and proceed directly to operating a squadron. The aircraft invulnerability period will be reduced by the duration of the skipped part of the animation.

Armory

The new Samurai permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Shikishima has been added and made available in exchange for three Ranked Tokens.

notes.title: Big Hunt: The Key to Victory!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1d190c4518bb2d17468bfa55279277b472c0e4ef.jpg
Update 0.9.10 delivers a new temporary battle type—Key Battles—to the game. Demonstrate your skills in a futuristic competition by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

The event's atmosphere can be felt even before entering the battle in the new themed Port.

[table][tr][th]Major Things You Should Know ● Tips ● Rewards ● Key Battle Rules ● Ships and Armaments[/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=2hmYEYhq_nY;full][/previewyoutube]
Major Things You Should Know
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
You start out alone, but you can gather a team of up to three ships directly in battle.
For destroying monsters and other players, you'll get a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points in one battle, you’ll unlock the ability to reinforce your ship directly in that battle. However, upgrading your ship in battle will not actually spend Points—all earned Points will appear in your Port regardless of any upgrades made in battle.
The Battle Points you accrue can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory.
As you get closer to the center of the map, you'll find a specially marked monster with a key. After destroying the monster, you'll receive its key. This will allow you to exit the map via the Portal.
When all the keys have been used or the Portal is closed, the remaining ships will be transported to a special area—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. The last surviving ship will also leave the Polygon successfully.
Successfully escaping the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.
Each of the three ships offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42c0f118-1438-11eb-98de-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42842eea-1438-11eb-add3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42a3db5a-1438-11eb-b9cb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42c37532-1438-11eb-a54c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Tips
Try different combinations of modules and armaments—you can assemble a ship that's to your liking. Don't be afraid to experiment—you need to act unpredictably on the Polygon.
Destroy the first monsters you encounter and upgrade your ship as quickly as possible. This will give you an advantage in encounters with other players.
It's not necessary to immediately attack players—the reward you would receive for attacking them at the beginning of the battle is minimal.
As you get closer to the center of the map, the monsters will become more dangerous, but you'll also receive more Battle Points for destroying them.
If you don't have enough keys for the entire Division, be prepared for the fact that your new comrades are highly likely to become enemies as you try to head for the Portal.
Divisions are also active in the final battle in the Octagon. But the winner will be the last ship afloat.
Rewards
The Battle Points you earn in battle can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/47be1d1105fc5e4572feed98da77bed8742a45ff.jpg
In addition, new Commanders with 10 skill points and bundles with Commanders from the Halloween events of previous years can be obtained in in the Armory in exchange for doubloons.

Please note: Battle Points can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory only until the end of the Key Battle event. After the end of the event, they will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1 Battle Point : 75 credits.

Key Battle Rules {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Thu. 29 Oct. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
Ends:  Thu. 03 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)
To access Key Battles, you must have fought at least 21 battles in the available battle types.
Instead of the usual rectangular Minimap, the new battle type features a round one with the player's ship at its center. It displays everything within the spotting range of your ship.

For destroying monsters and other players' ships, you earn a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. To select one of the two improvements, use Ctrl+1 or Ctrl+2. You don't need to spend any Battle Points to make your selection, and because improving your ship won't cost any Points, don't delay installing an upgrade—do it as soon as you can. After the end of the battle, Battle Points can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34de6450-143c-11eb-9fb8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

You can earn additional Battle Points by exiting through the Portal in the center of the map. To do that, you need to destroy one of the special monsters and get a key. The number of available keys is limited. The Portal opens some time after the start of a battle, remains open for a few minutes, and then closes.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/876a8064-143c-11eb-9efa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

After the last key has been used or the Portal has closed, the remaining ships will be transported to a special arena—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. Ships constantly receive damage when situated outside the boundaries of this zone. The last surviving ship will successfully leave the Polygon and receive additional Points.

Players are not allowed to enter Key Battles in Divisions, but you can assemble a team of up to three ships directly in battle. To invite a player to your team, aim at them and press F. When you receive an invitation, the top of the screen displays who sent the invitation and how to accept or decline it. While you are on the same team, you cannot deal damage to each other, and all Points earned are divided equally.

However, only one player can use one key, which is why you'll face a choice—go all the way with your allies, or turn your guns against them and escape as a lone wolf via the Portal. When you decide to leave the Division of allies, hold Tab and open the Team Members tab. Under this tab, you can view the weapons and consumables of your temporary allies, as well as choose to leave the Division.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/47009e30-143e-11eb-b085-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46bf3ae4-143e-11eb-accc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46aae9a4-143e-11eb-9efa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
If your ship gets destroyed or you escape through the Portal, you don't need to wait for the end of the battle to enter a new one—your ship will be immediately ready for the next battle.
Ships and Armaments
Three ships in total are available for Key Battles in Update 0.9.10. Each of them offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on the gameplay and ships' exteriors.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/45646d1c-143f-11eb-a623-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The first ship, Valkyrie, is available immediately with the start of Key Battles.

In addition to the new ships, completing combat missions will also unlock new hull modules, primary and auxiliary armaments, and a special module that changes the ship's consumables. More details are available in the game client.
Please note: Commander skills, camouflages, and signals are disabled in Key Battles.
Valkyrie
The first available ship is well-suited to trying out the new battle type. Her main armament doesn't differ much from the usual guns, and her stock hull increases the effectiveness of ramming with the ship's bow. For experienced Key Battle players, Valkyrie can offer mortars that deal damage with HE shells, even when landing in the water near the target, as well as a special consumable that provides temporary invulnerability.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e37a81a0-176c-11eb-b2e3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0e9814d2-176e-11eb-a321-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b2a36ba-176e-11eb-bfed-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/470794aa-176e-11eb-af30-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Gale
To obtain Gale, you need to complete a special combat mission playing Valkyrie. The mission will become available with the start of the event.

Instead of consumables, Gale uses energy distribution mechanics that improve the ship's parameters. Select the desired bonuses and then reroute energy to them using the appropriate keys. If you activate two or three bonuses at the same time, an equal amount of energy will be supplied to each of them.

The ship's main armament is torpedoes. The stock torpedoes don't offer any surprises. However, among the weapons that are unlocked by completing combat missions, there are special torpedoes that can temporarily disable enemy weaponry, as well as plasma torpedoes. Plasma ammunition heats up the target's armor and temporarily increases the damage dealt by subsequent hits of plasma shells and torpedoes to the same area.

Gale's auxiliary armament is an effective secondary battery with a small firing sector.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b1e63288-176c-11eb-8e40-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4c963054-176c-11eb-aec3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9fe1af0e-176c-11eb-a9e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7102a99a-176c-11eb-8e40-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Heracles
To get Heracles, you must complete a special combat mission playing Valkyrie or Gale. The mission will be available from November 13.

The ship's main battery utilizes wavecasters or lasers. The larger the area of the ship that's hit by the wave is, the more damage that's dealt. Waves can also destroy torpedoes and neutralize other waves. Lasers fire with a delay—taking the necessary lead on the target might take some getting used to for newcomers to Key Battles. They hit the target instantly and with perfect accuracy, inflicting heavy damage.
Heracles's consumables enable you to select, for example, auras with bonuses for allies; an immediate 180-degree turn (U-turn); or emitting a circular wave, similar to that of wavecasters.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27f28288-176d-11eb-bec3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f8e8d86-176d-11eb-af30-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/da2dc372-176d-11eb-aec3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a66ffcd0-176d-11eb-a9e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
