notes.title: The Dockyard: Build Anchorage
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/02d13ee6219fcbf6f3e39c91d575189317827ece.jpg
One of the new features of Update 0.9.8 is the Dockyard, where you'll be able to construct Anchorage.

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage is a multipurpose heavy cruiser that performs best when fighting at short and medium ranges. The ship is armed with twelve 203 mm guns mounted in four triple turrets, making her capable of unleashing a weighty salvo. Anchorage's AP shells have enhanced ricochet angles like those of the researchable American heavy cruisers. The Hydroacoustic Search consumable and torpedo armament she carries enable Anchorage to perform effectively in close quarters combat, while her Smoke Generator—a feature not typically found on American heavy cruisers—will help her escape situations where she finds herself under concentrated enemy fire.

[table][tr][th]Rules of the Event ● Directives ● Rewards[/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=RW_xZq31_TU;full][/previewyoutube]

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e70ffac-ec61-11ea-b1d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e6fc4d4-ec61-11ea-99db-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e714ad4-ec61-11ea-a9b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4db8a2d6-ec61-11ea-afb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg


Rules of the Event
The rules of the new Dockyard are similar to those of the Hamburg Dockyard:
The shipbuilding process is divided into 20 phases.
These phases can be completed by progressing through Directives of the event, purchasing discounted Starter Packs, or exchanging {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 doubloons for each phase.
The Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by progressing through Directives. Two of the 20 phases must be completed by spending doubloons.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completion of the 20th phase.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97950540-ec50-11ea-a4b5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/979989bc-ec50-11ea-b7af-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97930088-ec50-11ea-8a44-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97986f50-ec50-11ea-8f8b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Directives https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/407480fc-ecfe-11ea-ab62-38eaa735f4cc.jpg
The new game event has 48 missions spread across six Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.8, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Completing each Directive will progress you through three shipbuilding phases:
Two shipbuilding phases are completed by accomplishing specific missions that form part of the Directive.
One shipbuilding phase is completed by finishing the entire Directive.
Detailed information about the Directives is available in the game client.
Rewards
By progressing through missions of the Directives, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.

By accomplishing the first two Directives, you can complete up to six shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png7,500 Coal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Warships Premium Account
2x Gift containers, holding five special signals each
10x Stars'n'Stripes camouflages
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a696a3b2-ec61-11ea-9db6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Completing four out of the six Directives will progress you through up to twelve shipbuilding phases and grant you even more valuable rewards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png100,000 Free XP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png7,500 Coal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png4 days of Warships Premium Account
10x signals of each of the following types: Wyvern, Dragon, and Scylla
2x Gift containers
15x Stars'n'Stripes camouflages
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a64f4e5e-ec61-11ea-9715-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Accomplishing all Directives of the event will progress you through 18 shipbuilding phases and grant you all the available rewards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png100,000 Free XP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png7,500 Coal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png4 days of Warships Premium Account
10x signals of each of the following types: Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, Leviathan, Dragon, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, and Wyvern
7x Gift containers
15x Stars'n'Stripes camouflages
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a649aea4-ec61-11ea-99db-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, in addition to progressing through all the Directives, you'll need to spend doubloons to pass through any two shipbuilding phases.
Reward for completing phase 19: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal
Final reward: https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage in the National camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, Port slot, and a commemorative flag
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a65fdae4-ec61-11ea-afb6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
If you would rather not wait, you can complete all the shipbuilding phases in exchange for doubloons and thus obtain all the available rewards immediately. If you decide to complete construction of the ship at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. In that case, you'll get 600 Research Points for each completed phase instead of the standard rewards. Thus, you can earn up to 10,800 Research Points in total. If you haven't yet accessed the Research Bureau, you'll gain access to it immediately with the first Research Points you earn. At the same time, you'll receive 10,000 Research Points as a one-time reward and unlock the possibility to earn Research Points by completing Daily Missions.

If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase two Starter Packs:
Two shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png3,000 doubloons
Eight shipbuilding phases for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png8,000 doubloons
Please note: you can purchase the Starter Packs only before you complete the first four shipbuilding phases by progressing through Directives of the event.

notes.title: Update 0.9.8: the Anniversary
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9995db307b5f653237cd3f0c89b3573758d24df6.jpg
Please note that the servers will be temporarily unavailable due to the release of an update. The schedule is available below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.pngMaintenance times are tentative and subject to change. Please accept our apologies for any inconveniences.

The new update will go live some time after it's been downloaded because the client and server sides are updated separately. While the client begins to update immediately, it takes time for the servers to be updated across all regions.

If there are problems with downloading or launching the update—please perform files integrity check. 
[table][tr][th]🛠[/th][/tr][/table]
Subtitles can be enabled in the video player separately.
[previewyoutube=rc4AXC4PRAo;full][/previewyoutube]

[table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary ● Asymmetric Battles ● Dockyard ● Armory ● Ranked Battles ● Visual Improvements ● Content Additions and Changes ● Other Changes and Improvements[/th][/tr][/table]
World of Warships Anniversary
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7514a99a-eb82-11ea-831e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

With Update 0.9.8, World of Warships is celebrating its Fifth Anniversary! The festive Update offers a bunch of gifts and in-game activities: a permanent Campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy," plus a collection of the same name; fresh first-win bonuses, a revamped Designer's Table Port, and a new battle type—Asymmetric Battles.

Permanent "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2e1ac68-e93f-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you'll need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission.
Reward for finishing the Campaign: Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

"Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55568bba-e93d-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the history of shipbuilding.

Only "Five Epochs of the Navy" containers drop collectibles.
The reward for completing the entire collection: Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2cd7342-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The Epoch permanent camouflage can be mounted on any Tier IX ship, except for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX AL Sov. Rossiya. Once mounted on a ship, the camouflage remains assigned to that ship. Another copy of the camouflage can be assigned to a different ship.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

Victory Bonuses
During Update 0.9.8, you can expect a festive bonus for your first victories of the Update with certain ships. It can be secured on ships starting from Tier V:
Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns
Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
Tier X: 1x supercontainer
Asymmetric Battles
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754588f8-eb82-11ea-8e7d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:   Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 17 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of five to seven Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of nine to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI.
To enter battle with Tier VII–VIII ships, you'll need to spend a new temporary resource—Battle Tokens. The cost of entering a battle playing Tier VII–VIII ships is 500 Battle Tokens.
Battle Tokens can be earned in Asymmetric Battles:
Tier V: 250 Tokens per battle
Tier VI: 150 Tokens per battle
Tier VII: 200 Tokens per battle
Tier VIII: 25 Tokens per battle
You'll receive 1,000 Tokens each day upon logging in to the game.
Tokens are earned irrespective of the battle results, but players will not be awarded them if they are inactive.

Please note: Battle Tokens are only used to participate in Asymmetric Battles. With the release of Update 0.9.9 all Battle Tokens will be converted into credits at a rate of 1:50. Asymmetric Battles become available after reaching Access Level 12.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

Dockyard
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7571f4d8-eb82-11ea-9630-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Another new feature of Update 0.9.8 is the Dockyard, where you'll be able to construct https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png100,000 Free XP.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94edaef8-eb8f-11ea-a8f7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 doubloons per phase.
The Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
You can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by accomplishing Directives. In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, in addition to completing all the Directives, you'll need to purchase any two shipbuilding phases by spending doubloons.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.
The full details will be published in a dedicated article.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96fdae8a-eb87-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74dc091e-eb82-11ea-9a23-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.8, the customary Daily Shipments will be replaced with free daily random bundles in the Armory:
You can only obtain one bundle per day.
A total of 15 bundles will be available during the period of three weeks, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8045936-eb8c-11ea-973b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Bundle contents
1 day of Warships Premium Account—1x bundle
50,000 credits—5x bundles
50 doubloons—1x bundle
3x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns—4x bundles
1x Gift container—3x bundles
1x King of the Sea container—1x bundle
Ranked Battles
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754bd94c-eb82-11ea-96a6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Wed. 16 Sep. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends:  Tue. 13 Oct. 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Format: 8 vs. 8 playing Tier X ships.
Rewards: up to 5,500 Steel and many additional rewards.
Maps and modes: North, Sea of Fortune, and Greece in Domination mode; Sleeping Giant and Warrior's Path in Arms Race mode; and Tears of the Desert in Epicenter mode.
The Season's details will be published in a dedicated article.

Visual Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/756285de-eb82-11ea-a1c3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

[table][tr][td]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f103a0c0-eb86-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/td]
[td]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f0faf240-eb86-11ea-bcb7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/td]
[/tr][/table]

Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74e81bd2-eb82-11ea-a21d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In collaboration with Hasbro and Takara Tomy, the following items have been added:
Freedom Fighter permanent camo for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Montana, Gold Bug permanent camo for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngX Gearing, Messenger of Oblivion permanent camo for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Großer Kurfürst, and the Crush’n’Destroy permanent camo for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngX Khabarovsk.
Decepticon Disguise and Autobot Ark expendable camouflage patterns.
Commanders with special voiceovers: Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, Megatron, and Rumble.
Cybertronian containers.
Themed patches and flags.
Details about the ways in which you can obtain content dedicated to "Transformers: Generation 1" will be announced later.
In honor of the holiday, the Mid-Autumn Festival permanent camouflage pattern for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Warspite, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVI Dunkerque, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVIII Kaga, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Prinz Eugen has been added, as well as the following unique Commanders:
Chang’e with a specialization for Pan-Asian and Japanese ships
Hou Yi with a specialization for Pan-Asian ships
Kaguya with a specialization for Japanese ships
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/256745be-eb88-11ea-a1c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8714ad2-eb8c-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The Anniversary commemorative flag and the For Meritorious Service patch have been added into the game.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25576ac2-eb88-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Details on how to get these items will be published later.
To make the process of researching ships simpler, the following changes have been made to https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngVIII Admiral Hipper's modules:
Hull A has been removed from the game.
Hulls B and C have been renamed "A" and "B," respectively.
If you have already researched Hull B, you'll receive compensation in the amount of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png22,000 ship XP.
If you have already researched Hull C, the new Hull B will be mounted on your ship instead. In other cases Hull A will be mounted on the ship.
If you've already purchased one of the replacement hulls, you'll receive compensation in the amount of credits you paid for it.
The stock hull of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngV Königsberg has been replaced with a new one, created on the basis of the researchable hull with a changed composition for the AA and secondary guns.

English-language audio for Naval Legends has been added into the game client:
To listen to Naval Legends directly in battle, you need to enable the "Listen to your own music" option in the sound settings.
If you already use your own music as background sound, then Naval Legends will be added to your playlist.
In case you opt to remove Naval Legends from your playlist, you need to remove the respective audio files from the bin//res/userMusiс folder in the game client.
Ships https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Belfast '43 and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma have been added for testing by developers, volunteers, and community contributors.

Other Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/756595d0-eb82-11ea-8246-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Occurrence of a synchronization error has been reduced. This bug caused the incorrect display of ships' positions in battle.
Thunderstorm Front and Snowstorm are available in the game again.
Plus other improvements and changes. The full list is available from Player Support.

notes.title: World of Warships Anniversary!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bbfe0431e8147b2066f88d6e761ae1422cac5892.jpg
With the release of Update 0.9.8, World of Warships begins its Fifth Anniversary celebration!

The festive Update is inspired by the history of shipbuilding and will bring many new features to the game: the revamped Designer's Table Port, the “Five Epochs of the Navy” permanent Campaign and collection of the same name, a new battle type, and fresh first-victory bonuses.

[table][tr][th]Anniversary ● First-Victory Bonuses ● “Five Epochs of the Navy” Campaign ● "Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection ● Asymmetric Battles ● Marathon with Gifts and a Festive Stream[/th][/tr][/table]
Anniversary {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Wed. 30 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

As we cross the threshold of our fifth year, we're marking the occasion by offering you an array of gifts and fresh in-game activities.

Join the celebrations by entering the updated Designer’s Table Port, which has changed a lot over the past year and become even more festive—we've added a cake, postcards, confetti, and ribbons creatively scattered on the table. The collection of ship models has also been updated with new representatives!

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aec9b5c-e93f-11ea-b9bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aed4e3a-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1a984d72-e93f-11ea-8952-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

First-Victory Bonuses
Be sure to take a careful look at your ship carousel. Ships with a first-victory bonus applied will be marked with a special symbol. During Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victories playing specific ships in Random, Co-op, Ranked, and Asymmetric Battles, as well as in Operations.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/12d9c834-e941-11ea-b467-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

List of Rewards
Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflages
Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
Tier X: 1x supercontainer
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2367fa60-e93a-11ea-a195-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
A Gift container holds five special signals of the same type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a1e60c4e-e93d-11ea-9d07-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
You can receive the first-victory bonus for each ship only once during Update 0.9.8. The bonuses will also be applied to ships purchased, bought back, or dropped from containers during Update 0.9.8.
“Five Epochs of the Navy” Campaign
The new permanent Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you'll need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission. Most of the tasks must be completed playing certain ships related to the history of the navy. For example, some of the tasks of the first mission are inspired by the development of battleship building technologies and should be completed playing battleships of this era, such as https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIII South Carolina, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIII Kawachi, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIV Gangut, or https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIII Dreadnought—all of which contributed to the adoption of the name given to this period of naval history.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2e1ac68-e93f-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

However, you can complete the Campaign, collect all the containers of the new collection, and obtain the final reward by completing the first three tasks of each mission playing any ships of the relevant tiers.

The reward for completing the Campaign is an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be mounted on any one Tier IX ship, except for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX AL Sov. Rossiya.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b26a26ba-e93b-11ea-85f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2cd7342-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The first mission will become available with the release of Update 0.9.8, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.
Please note: you can complete tasks of each mission multiple times. This will allow you to continue earning Stars with each completion, but you'll receive the reward for completing the task for the first time only.
"Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection
Update 0.9.8 ushers in the "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection, which comprises five sections with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the naval history of the first half of the 20th century—from ships of the dreadnought era to those of World War II and the post-war years. Having completed the entire collection, you'll have learned about the construction history, design features, and fates of prominent representatives of each shipbuilding epoch.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55568bba-e93d-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The reward for completing each section is 1 day of Warships Premium Account. The reward for completing the entire collection is an Epoch permanent camouflage. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/50407412-e940-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the containers of the same name. The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 1:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.

You can obtain 30 "Five Epochs of the Navy" containers by completing tasks of the same-name Campaign. You can also obtain containers for participating in the official World of Warships streams! To do so, activate bonus codes given during the streams and then complete special combat missions.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f8919f7e-e93b-11ea-b355-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
A "Five Epochs of the Navy" container includes:
One element of the "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection.
1x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage.
One of the following items: 2x signals of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London or India Bravo Terrathree); or 500 Free XP; or 50,000 credits.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fd8d0f36-e940-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Asymmetric Battles {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start: Wed. 02 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
End: Wed. 16 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

We invite you to take part in Asymmetric Battles—a new temporary battle type with teams of different sizes and tiers.

The new battle type is inspired by actual historical battles, which usually took place with an unequal number of ships on each side.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/138d4f0e-e940-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Asymmetric Battles Rules
A team of 5–7 Tier VII–VIII ships will fight against a team of 9–12 Tier V–VI ships in Domination mode. The types and numbers of ships are matched in such a way that the forces of both teams in battle are as equal as possible.
Battles will be fought on the following maps: Ultimate Frontier, Naval Station Newport, and Killer Whale.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca2bcba0-e940-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca313edc-e940-11ea-b9bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca2797f6-e940-11ea-9f0e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

To enter battle playing Tier VII–VIII ships, you'll need 500 Battle Tokens—a new temporary resource.
The Tokens are earned in Asymmetric Battles, regardless of the battle results. However, you won't receive the Tokens if you are inactive in battle.
Tier V: 250 Tokens per battle
Tier VI: 150 Tokens per battle
Tier VII: 200 Tokens per battle
Tier VIII: 25 Tokens per battle
You'll receive 1,000 Tokens each day upon logging in to the game.
If the waiting time spent by the first player in the queue exceeds 3 minutes, the teams in Asymmetric Battle can be complemented with bots.
You cannot form Divisions in Asymmetric Battles.
There will be no battle achievements in Asymmetric Battles.
Please note: Battle Tokens are only used to participate in Asymmetric Battles.
A special combat mission is available for Tier V–VI ships. Completing the mission will reward you with four Gift containers. You'll find the details in the game client.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/13902fda-e940-11ea-9f0e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Marathon with Gifts and a Festive Stream
We invite you to watch the best episodes of the Naval Legends series and enjoy some gifts in the process!

Be on the lookout for bonus codes shown in each episode of the historical marathon. As with the in-game Daily Shipments, all gifts are revealed in advance! Each bonus code will unlock a chain of combat missions. Complete all of them to get four containers of the new "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,000,000 credits!

Want even more gifts? If we manage to get the indicated number of new subscribers by the time each video is published, the reward of credits will be replaced with Сoal. If we get the specified number of subscribers on all episodes, completing the combat missions will bring you {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png10,000 Coal in total!

The first episode goes live on September 7—be sure to watch it! We'll publish all the conditions of the cinemarathon and gifts in a dedicated article on September 5!
Join our festive stream in honor of the project’s Fifth Anniversary on September 17! Let’s celebrate this special event together! Many gifts, interesting guests, and an ocean of positivity await you! We look forward to seeing you out on our virtual seas!

If you like reading our news on Steam, it’s likely that you’ve already subscribed. But if you haven’t yet — there’s an even more pleasant reason to do so now!

Each month our subscribers will get some goodies, and they might be different each time! We’re going to send out a Steam container today(for those already subcribed) and at the end of the month too, which contains:
[olist]In the first slot:
5x Steam camouflage patterns:
+75% ship XP per battle
+75% Commander XP per battle
+75% Free XP per battle
–3% to the ship's detectability range by sea
+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by the enemy at your ship
or 10,000 Free XP
or 1 day of Warships Premium Account
or 250 doubloons
In the second slot: 5x signal flags (Zulu, Zulu Hotel, or Papa Papa)
In the third slot: 5x signal flags (Juliet Charlie or November Foxtrot)[/olist]

We’re going to use Steam inventory items for distribution, so you won't miss it when the item arrives—a notification will appear to let you know! After receiving a notification, log in via the Steam client to receive the goodies on your account.

To subscribe, click the "Follow" button
either on the store page
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f4d6db34e2a4b50896a54196175cd63f54e1a5f8.png
or the community hub
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e64a074bd20d6b4b20fbbfaf804fe376d7702152.png
Please note: the item can't be added automatically after subscribing to the game. It will be distributed on the specified days, and there may be delays of up to 24 hours.

Follow the Wargaming publisher page if you want to know when new games are released.
Join the official Steam group chat to find some good company.

Developer Bulletin 0.9.8
The World of Warships Anniversary, new Dockyard, Season 18 of Ranked Battles, and other features!
IMPORTANT! Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.
[table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary ● Ranked Battles ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
World of Warships Anniversary
With the release of Update 0.9.8, World of Warships passes the threshold of its fifth year!

This time, the festive frenzy is inspired by naval history. The game will feature plenty of new and engaging content to mark the occasion, including a revamped Designer's Table Port, a permanent campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy" plus a collection of the same name, a new Dockyard, and fresh first-win bonuses. You can also try out a new battle type—Asymmetric Battle!

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46204f10-dbdb-11ea-9ae3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The collection and new permanent campaign are both dedicated to the history of shipbuilding.

The Five Epochs of the Navy permanent campaign features 50 tasks spread across 5 missions.

Reward for completing the campaign: an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.
The Five Epochs of the Navy collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific era in the history of shipbuilding. Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the same-name containers. The exchange rate of duplicates for missing elements is 1:1.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09d523c8-dbd6-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Five Epochs of the Navy containers will be available during the campaign of the same name. Each container will drop an element from the Five Epochs of the Navy collection, as well as other rewards.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a6118892-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Reward for completing the collection: an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4138024-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Asymmetric Battle
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1e357130-dbd9-11ea-a5ba-8cdcd4b147d4.pngDuring the first two festive weeks of the World of Warships Fifth Anniversary, you can try out a new temporary battle type—Asymmetric Battle—with a differing distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41dc5988-dbd8-11ea-b2c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Historically, encounters at sea have typically involved opposing sides with an unequal number of ships on each side. The new battle type offers a new gameplay experience in near-real naval combat conditions.

In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of four to six Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of eight to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI. Helming Tier VII–VIII ships in an Asymmetric Battle will require a new temporary resource called Battle Tokens.

Battle Tokens can be obtained by participating in Asymmetric Battles. The number of Tokens you get from each battle depends on the tier of ship you helm—the lower the tier, the more Tokens you can get.

This way, you'll be able to participate in an Asymmetric Battle with lower and higher-tier ships for a more immersive experience in the new battle type.

Dockyard
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to build a new U.S. Tier VIII cruiser—https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png100,000 Free XP.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4172ed90-dbd8-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 doubloons per phase.
Event Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by finishing Directives.
Anchorage and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46384e12-dbdb-11ea-9d9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

If you decide to complete shipbuilding at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. However, in that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get 600 Research Points for each completed phase. If you have not yet opened the Research Bureau, you'll get access to it immediately with the first Research Points you earn.

Victory Bonuses
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victory in the Update, secured on every ship starting from Tier V.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/461007d6-dbdb-11ea-8ee6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

List of Rewards
Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflages
Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
Tier X: 1x supercontainer
Gift Container
A Gift container holds five special signals of one type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

Ranked Battles
Update 0.9.8 kicks off a new Season of Ranked Battles. You can expect to play Tier X ships in an 8 vs. 8 format.

Other Changes
The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8690630-dbd6-11ea-bb82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Naval Legends audio recordings have been added to the pool of in-battle soundtrack options.

notes.title: Collections: Completion and Rewards
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/dfdec718a346cae3115c477c924c51dbe9abbbc6.jpg
[table][tr][th]Why Should I Complete Collections? ● How Can I Complete Collections? ● What Collections and Rewards are Available?[/th][/tr][/table]
Why Should I Complete Collections?
Collections are an excellent way to discover some interesting historical facts and obtain some desirable rewards along the way in the form of permanent camos, Commanders, and other desirable in-game items and abilities.

Our collections are designed to educate about the history of naval forces, significant operations, and famous historical figures. Sometimes “unhistorical” collections appear in the game as well. They are sometimes dedicated to collaborations with other brands (for example, the collection inspired by the popular High School Fleet anime series), or focus on the World of Warships game itself.

Collections are made up of various elements: coats of arms of warships and combat units; items dedicated to renowned personalities; weapons, ships and aircraft; insignias; and much more. Each image is accompanied by a detailed description. For players’ convenience, elements are divided into thematic sections. When each collection section is completed, an additional reward is unlocked. When all the elements of a collection or section are in place, a window informing the player about the associated reward will be displayed. The collection will then be marked with an icon stating that it’s "Complete," which means that you can return to it anytime to read the information about its elements.

How Can I Complete Collections?
Where can I find my collections?
In the Profile section of the Port. You gain access to each collection after obtaining its first element.

Please note: the Collections tab won't be visible if you have no collection items.

Where can I get collection items?
In most cases, you'll find collection items in containers that share the same name as the collection. Clicking on a collection item that was dropped from a container will transfer you to the screen of the corresponding collection. But there are exceptions—for example, items from a collection dedicated to the Anniversary of World of Warships in 2017 were issued for special achievements earned in battle.

What is a subscription?
You can subscribe to some of the collections. This way, you can choose which large collections you want to actively collect. You can obtain the first elements of these collections in special containers. By activating a subscription, you’ll be able to find the rest of the collectibles in the following containers: More Credits, More Signals and Camouflages, More Resources, and Try Your Luck. You can only subscribe to one collection at a time under the Profile tab.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f24f4dda-d4d9-11ea-a93e-8cdcd4b147d4.gif

What is a duplicate?
When completing a collection, it’s possible to obtain an item you already have—this is called a “duplicate.” When you have a certain number of duplicates from the same collection, you can exchange them for any item you might still be missing. To do that, you need to select a vacant slot in an album and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for this missing item in the window that appears. The cost of such an exchange depends on the collection, but it’s usually 2–5 duplicates per item. Once a collection is complete, any remaining duplicates of that collection are automatically exchanged for credits. The exact exchange rate depends on the specific collection. Thus, you can decide whether you want to obtain the main reward for collecting all the elements as soon as possible, or prefer to get more duplicates to earn more credits.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/575cd020-d2b0-11ea-b165-8cdcd4b147d4.gif

What Collections and Rewards are Available?
There are currently 16 collections available in the game. The items of these can be obtained from containers that share the same name as the collections in the Armory in exchange for Coal. Exceptions: Yamamoto Isoroku, "Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes,” “King of the Sea,” and "Five Epochs of the Navy."

It consists of 40 elements, such as the personal belongings of the Marshal Admiral; the uniforms of naval senior officers and sailors of the Japanese Navy; battle merit decorations; and a variety of military equipment related to Yamamoto Isoroku. You can obtain the first collectible in a container that is issued for accomplishing the final mission of the Yamamoto Isoroku Campaign, or from a specific container in the Premium Shop.

The reward for completing the sections is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on Japanese ships.

notes.title: More Rewards for Twitch Prime Members!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7026be82d5db1c93ef12cc7b9672dabc9ddcb29b.jpg
Ahoy, Captains! This month kicks off the second month of Twitch Prime loot in World of Warships. Prime members are set to get a shipton of great stuff!

This month, from July 24 through August 20, Twitch Prime members will get a special combat mission that will reward them with an in-game container themed around the popular Azur Lane game! 
Complete this mission to get 1x Azur Lane container!
Inside an Azur Lane container, you’ll find the following rewards to aid you in naval battles:
One of eight new Azur Lane Commanders with special voiceovers: Azuma, Baltimore, Roon, Jean Bart, Littorio, Shokaku, Yat Sen, or Sovestskaya Rossiya.
10x special signals of one of the following types: Basilisk, Wyvern, Hydra, Dragon, Red Dragon, Leviathan, Scylla, or Ouroboros.
5x Azur Lane – Siren camouflage patterns
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cb0778e-cd08-11ea-8b0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
If you missed the first month, jump in now to get the following set of rewards:
Commander Ashley Violet, available only to Prime users
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png500 doubloons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png3 days of Premium Account
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png1,000,000 credits
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6038c9be-bab0-11ea-be6d-38eaa735f4cc.jpg
Commander Ashley Violet can helm only U.S. ships.

Redemption instructions
[olist]Create a Twitch Prime account.
If you do not have an Amazon account yet, sign up and then upgrade to a Twitch Prime account.
Create and link your World of Warships account to your Amazon account.
You can create a World of Warships account and link it after.
Click on the Crown Icon on Twitch.tv and then click “Claim Now” on the World of Warships loot.
You can Try Twitch Prime here.
Log in to the game and redeem your items![/olist]

If you play World of Warships on the Steam or Microsoft Store platforms, first you’ll need to link your account to a Wargaming.net Account, then create a Twitch Prime account (If you don’t already have one) and link it to your Wargaming.net one as well. Your next actions are the same—claim the World of Warships offer from the Twitch homepage, log in to the game and redeem your loot.

Please be aware: after you claim the offer and connect your accounts, you need to log in to the game, redeem the items, and complete the mission before the offer expires.

There are more rewards to come! Starting from August 20, Twitch Prime members will get even more loot! Stay tuned!

German carriers are now available for all players to research! The new ships carry high-speed aircraft that have small HP pools. Their armament includes armor-piercing rockets and AP bombs, as well as fast torpedoes.

The reward for completing the collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships.

You can find the first element of the collection in German Navy containers, which in turn can be obtained by progressing through Directives or picked up from Daily Shipments.  You can continue collecting elements from daily containers by activating a subscription on the collection page. Another container can be obtained by clicking the button in an article about the collection that will be published next week.

Setting the Order of Consumables

An option to set a custom order of the consumables for each ship has been added. Any customizations are saved on the server, so you won't need to set them again if you play on different computers.

Unique Upgrades
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0bec608-d59f-11ea-b1ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

New unique upgrades for X Daring, X Kléber, X Harugumo, X Kremlin, X Audacious, X Midway, and X Hakuryū have been added to the "Research Bureau" tab of the Armory. They are each exchangeable for 19,200 Research Points. The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount upgrades with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with the regular upgrades.

New upgrades
Daring (fifth slot)
−10% to the torpedo tube reload time
+15% maximum torpedo damage

X Daring is currently a versatile ship with a slight focus on artillery. With the upgrade, the destroyer can stay some distance away from a Key Area and focus on torpedoes and attacks from within a smoke screen.

Kléber (sixth slot)
−20% to the ship's detectability range by sea
+80% to the main battery reloading time

The unique upgrade provides an alternative to artillery focused gameplay. When mounted, X Kléber becomes a torpedo-carrying destroyer for close quarters combat with her high speed, fast reload time, and detectability that's equal to that of other same-tier destroyers. The upgrade allows for more effective torpedo attacks at the cost of losing a significant amount of potential artillery damage per minute.

Harugumo (fifth slot)
+30% smoke screen dispersion time
+100% Smoke Generator action time
+1 charge for consumables

This unique upgrade offers some improvements for gameplay that involves the use of smoke screens, at the cost of detectability and reduced effectiveness in battles for Key Areas. Thus, the ship can escape at ¼ speed while setting a smoke screen and reach the optimal distance for firing.

Kremlin (sixth slot)
−18% to the main battery reloading time
−12% maximum main battery firing range
−1 charge for consumables

The upgrade allows for a more aggressive gameplay style, with the ship sacrificing her survivability in return for a bonus applied to her main battery firing rate.

Audacious (sixth slot)
−15% to the ship's detectability range by sea
+20% Engine Boost action time
−50% to the time it takes to reach full power when accelerating
−30% rudder-shift time

The upgrade allows the ship to get close to an opponent and thus increase the frequency of her aircraft attacks. At the same time, the risk of being detected by the opponent, as well as the risk falling under heavy fire, increases.

Midway (sixth slot)
+10% bomber cruising speed
+5.5% bomber minimum speed
−4.5% bomber maximum speed
+10% HE bomb damage

Instead of generally increasing the power of squadrons of all types, this upgrade offers gameplay with a focus on bombers with increased damage and speed.

Hakuryū (sixth slot)
+15% aircraft maximum speed
−20% engine boost action time

The upgrade provides the biggest effect when you're starting an attack approach. It significantly increases the speed of the aircraft and reduces the time they spend within the enemy's AA defense range. At the same time, the overall distance travelled with engine boost remains the same.

We are continuing to update the existing unique upgrades. These changes will balance their effectiveness, and at the same time, preserve the unique gameplay of each ship. Their names and icons have also been updated.

Updates to the existing upgrades
Z-52 (fifth slot)
Added a bonus that reduces the detectability range of torpedoes by 10%.

The upgrade will make X Z-52 a more capable torpedo destroyer, but at the same time make her less effective in Key Areas due to the reduced bonus to concealment compared with the concealment upgrade.

Grozovoi (sixth slot)
The penalty applied to her torpedo tube reload time increased from +10% to +20%.

The upgrade offers improvements for main battery gun-focused gameplay. It was too effective, and reducing the traverse speed of her main battery guns didn't affect it significantly because of the already high base value. For this reason, the penalty applied to her torpedo tube reload time was increased instead.

Moskva (sixth slot)
The bonus that reduces the maximum dispersion of her main battery shells was reduced from –11% to –7%.
The penalty applied to her main turret traverse speed increased from –13% to –20%.

The changes offer a choice between the unique upgrade with its bonus to accuracy, and the standard bonuses to the guns' reloading time or firing range.

Minotaur (fifth slot)
Removed a bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by 10%.
Added a bonus that reduces the reload time of ship consumables by 10%.

The upgrade allows the ship to stay in a smoke screen for an extended period of time when moving at ¼ speed. The bonus to the reload time of consumables will increase the overall survivability and effectiveness of the ship, and will be useful with any equipment.

Zaō (sixth slot)
Removed a bonus that reduced her rudder-shift time by 20%.

The upgrade was too versatile and improved the ship in many ways. In the current state, it's effective when playing in open waters and engaging from long distances.

Yamato (sixth slot)
Removed a bonus that reduced the main battery reload time by 6%.
The penalty to the main turret traverse speed was reduced from –19% to –13%.

The upgrade was too effective because it provided two bonuses at once—greater damage per minute and accuracy. After the changes, the upgrade offers a choice between these two parameters.

Naval Base
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0ee0aa8-d59f-11ea-aaa8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Added improvements for the Treasury that will allow Clan leaders to regularly exchange Oil for Clan rewards.
The Research Center, which provides a bonus to the amount of received XP, has been renamed "War College." A new building named "Research Institute" has been added. It increases the amount of Research Points a Clan receives.
To show the result of the Clan's activity, the water area of the base will fill up with warships and auxiliary vessels, with their number depending on the number of battles played. The more Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles that have been fought by Clan members over the last month, the more vessels that will appear in the waters of their Naval Base. The number of warships depends on the number of Clan Battles played over the last 3 months.

Read more>>>

Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/42f5474a-d5a1-11ea-84be-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Added two new battle signals, which can be obtained in exchange for credits, Coal, and Research Points.
X-Ray Papa Unaone: increases the action time of Smoke Generator by 15%.
Sierra Bravo: increases the action time of Hydroacoustic Search by 10% and reduces the cooldown period of Defensive AA Fire by 10%.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9efd6252-d5a6-11ea-9578-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
They will be added to the "More Signals and Camouflages" daily container at a later point in time.

The following bundles will become available with the release of the Update:
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Pommern for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png228, 000 Coal, and from bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons. Pommern is a variant of the H-class battleship project that's armed with twelve 380 mm guns. Decent armor, powerful secondary armament, the Hydroacoustic Search consumable, and torpedoes allow the ship a high degree of confidence in close quarters engagements.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f0bfe52-d5a6-11ea-a8bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVI Erich Loewenhardt in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons. Her bombers, unlike the aircraft of researchable German aircraft carriers, are armed with HE bombs, and her torpedoes have a longer range but lower speed.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ed14064-d5a6-11ea-945f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Slava for 63,000 Research Points. She was an implementation of a battleship project that was developed after the end of World War II to counter the American Iowa- and Montana-class ships. Due to the high accuracy and excellent armor-penetrating capabilities of her AP shells, Slava is most efficient in artillery duels over greater distances. Her armor is not strong enough to be effective in close quarters combat.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ec9b394-d5a6-11ea-8c73-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Unique British historical Commander Andrew Cunningham with 10 skill points for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png175,000 Coal. The Commander possesses unique talents that increase the speed of his ship and aircraft, provide an additional charge for the ship's consumables, or increase the reload speed of the armament.

Ships https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Pommern and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVI Erich Loewenhardt will also be available in the Premium Shop.

Other Changes
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

Game Balance Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0e843e8-d59f-11ea-b8cf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.7, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow, should they be required, in future updates.

Attack aircraft on Hermes, Furious, Ark Royal, Implacable, Indomitable, Audacious, Graf Zeppelin, Graf Zeppelin B, Hōshō, Ryūjō, Shōkaku, Kaga, Hakuryū, Lexington (with Tiny Tim missiles), Saipan, Midway (with Tiny Tim missiles)
The missile crosshair was rotated 90 degrees, and is now stretched horizontally.

This change will unify all missile crosshairs and will allow the destroyers to stick to a set of common tactics to avoid the attacks of attack aircraft.

Tier V–X U.S. destroyers Nicholas, Farragut, Mahan, Benson, Fletcher, and Gearing
The bonus to continuous AA damage provided by the Defensive AA Fire consumable increased from +75% to +100%.

Tier X Italian cruiser Venezia
Main battery reload time increased from 20.5 to 21s.
Rudder-shift time increased from 12.6 to 13.6s.

Tier IX British destroyer Jutland
Main battery reload time increased from 4.3 to 4.5s.

Tier VII battleships Colorado and Nagato
The Fighter consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.

Tier IX cruisers Buffalo, Saint-Louis, and Ibuki
The Spotting Aircraft consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.

Cruisers Danae, Duguay-Trouin, Karlsruhe, Kuma, Svietlana
The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.

Tier IV U.S. cruiser Phoenix
The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can now be mounted on both hull A and B.

This change allows for a more consistent transition from her standard hull to the researchable variety.

Tier VIII French battleship Richelieu
The Engine Boost and Spotting Aircraft/Fighter consumables were swapped for her standard hull.

Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c07cc082-d59f-11ea-adcd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Added the Blazing Tropics permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVII Atlanta.
Added the Summer expendable camouflage.
Added nine patches with symbols of countries.

The details on how to obtain these items will be published a bit later.

Ships https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngVIII Kansas, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngIX Minnesota, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Vermont, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Florida, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Kitakami were added for testing by developers, volunteers, and community contributors.

Other Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0d03db6-d59f-11ea-8fcc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Thunderstorm front temporarily disabled due to the technical reasons.

Changed the research cost of aircraft carriers of all nations:
Decreased from 68,000 to 40,000 XP at Tier VI.
Increased from 158,000 to 161,000 XP at Tier VIII.
Increased from 330,000 to 355,000 XP at Tier X.

Progressing through the aircraft carrier branches will now happen in a similar way to other ship types. The time it takes to research Tier VI aircraft carriers will be reduced. At the same time, the research cost of all ships of the branch remains the same.

If you've already researched a Tier VI aircraft carrier, but haven't researched a Tier VIII carrier of the same branch, the Tier VI carrier will receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png28,000 XP. If you've already researched a Tier VIII aircraft carrier, but haven't researched a Tier X carrier of the same branch, the Tier VIII carrier will receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png25,000 XP.

Other Changes
When entering the game for the first time after the Update, a short video will play back. It can be skipped by double-pressing any keyboard button. Another video will play back on the login screen. This video can be paused.
To make the process of familiarizing players with the game easier, the possibility for new accounts to start the tutorial battle without the need to first enter the Port was added.
Minor improvements to the geometry and textures of the following ships: VIII Lenin, VI Weser, VIII Kii, IX Izumo, VIII Amagi, X Yamato, VI Ryūjō, X Shimakaze, V Raimondo Montecuccoli, X Kléber, X Goliath, VIII Albemarle, V Mutsuki, X Großer Kurfürst, VII California, VIII Amalfi, VIII Roma, VIII Massachusetts, VIII August von Parseval, VIII Odin, IV Langley, and X Hindenburg.
Updated the name of the airborne torpedoes of IV Rhein, as well as the bombs of VI Weser and VIII August von Parseval.
Bombers of IV Rhein, VI Weser, VIII August von Parseval now gain altitude more smoothly during takeoff.
Updated the upgrade icons.
XP earned on a ship is now again displayed in the ship parameters in the Port.
Updated the names of the Soviet, American, and German ships' armaments.
Updated the description of VIII Pyotr Bagration.
Updated the "Over-penetration" ribbon for armor-piercing bombs.
Improved the loading time for previewing camouflages in the Armory.
Fixed an error that caused the "Equipment" screen to be shown as "Modules" when achieving Access Level 9.
Fixed an error that caused the French Navy permanent camouflage for X Kléber to not be shown in the list of camouflages.
Fixed an error that caused the date when the victory bonus for Research Points expired to be displayed in a pop-up tip.
Updated the equipment icons in tactical hints on the battle loading and "Help" screens.
Fixed a bug that caused tooltips to disappear when switching to the Tech Tree tab.
Fixed an error that caused the sound not to play back when clicking the marker with information about the branches in the Tech Tree.
Fixed an error that caused the "Battle!" button to still be active when there was a ship in the Division that didn't match the requirements of the selected battle type.
Fixed an error that caused the "Assign Commander" text to blink when hovering over the "Commander unavailable" text.
Fixed an error that caused text to overlap the borders of the drop-down list when purchasing a slot.
Fixed an error that caused the game client to crash when switching to another window from the battle results screen.
Fixed an error that caused the rank icons to be displayed for bots on the battle results screen.
Fixed an error that caused the timer in Operation Aegis to be shown above the final point.
Fixed an error that caused the camera to freeze when observing an aircraft carrier in Spectator Mode and switching to the allied squadron.
Fixed an error that caused the frames from the center of the map to be shown before the loading screen when loading the replay or reconnecting to the battle.
Fixed an error that caused the shadows to disappear in the New York Port with medium graphics settings applied.
Fixed an error that caused weather effects not to be shown.
Fixed an error that caused incorrect text to be displayed in the quick commands menu in battles with weather effects.
Fixed an error that caused the turrets of VIII Albemarle to receive critical damage from HE shells without taking armor into account.
Fixed an error that caused the "Commander Retraining" window to instantly close when they were assigned to another ship.
Fixed an error that caused the message about the lack of places in Reserve to overlap the text field borders.
Fixed an error that caused the price of a permanent camouflage to be displayed when the camouflage was already on the account.
Fixed an error that cause islands to be poorly shown on the Tactical Map during blizzards.
Fixed an error that caused the "In battle" player status not to be shown in the chat header.
Fixed an error that caused patches of sunlight to disappear in certain camera positions.
Fixed an error that caused the text of pop-up descriptions of various elements of the collection to have different indentations.
Fixed an error that caused the game client to crash when changing the resolution with the "Clans" tab open.
Fixed an error that caused incorrect armament to be shown in the "Equipment" tab on the ship selected in the Port when clicking the ship in the Tech Tree.
Fixed an error that caused the cost of the post-battle service of VIII Graf Zeppelin and VIII Graf Zeppelin B to be 60,000 credits instead of 52,500.
Fixed an error that caused the gun elevation angle of allied and enemy ships not to change.
Fixed an error that allowed IX Siegfried to be sold.
Fixed an error that prevented a Division comprised of different ship tiers with a Division Commander on a ship of a lower tier from entering a Tier I–V Random Battle.
Fixed an error that caused the “New” marker not to disappear after opening the combat missions category for the first time.
Operation Narai has returned to the rotation, with a technical error having been fixed.

The branch of German carriers is scheduled to exit Early Access with the launch of Update 0.9.7!

The new ships are equipped with fast-but-fragile aircraft that carry armor-piercing bombs and rockets, and fast torpedoes. We're here to tell you all about the rules of the new game event of Update 0.9.7!

[table][tr][th]The “German Navy” Collection ● Directives ● German Navy Containers ● Kriegsmarine Containers ● Daily Shipments[/th][/tr][/table]

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b4065ea-d2ae-11ea-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The “German Navy” Collection
Update 0.9.7 welcomes the “German Navy” collection, comprising six sections with six elements in each. Build the collection to learn about the history of the German Navy during the first half of the 20th century—ships and aircraft; personalities and emblems; awards and uniforms. Having completed the entire collection, you'll learn about the German carrier-based aircraft projects; the story of Karl von Müller, the commanding officer of cruiser Emden; the specifics of the House Order of Hohenzollern; and much more!

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0654b93a-d2ac-11ea-b165-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The reward for completing the sections and entire collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships, with completed sections unlocking these possibilities for different ship types.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/32f160d0-d4da-11ea-a93e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 4:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/575cd020-d2b0-11ea-b165-8cdcd4b147d4.gif

You can find the first element of the collection in German Navy containers, which in turn can be obtained by progressing through Directives or picked up from Daily Shipments. You can continue collecting elements from daily containers by activating a subscription on the collection page. Another container can be obtained by clicking the button in an article about the collection that will be published next week.

https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f24f4dda-d4d9-11ea-a93e-8cdcd4b147d4.gif

Directives {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start: Thu. 06 Aug. 07:15 CEST (UTC+2)
End: Tue. 01 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

The new game event tasks you with completing 32 missions spread across four Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.7, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Rewards for completing the missions: up to 10 German Navy containers, as well as credits and signals.

Rewards for completing the Directives: up to five Kriegsmarine containers, which have specific chances of dropping https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Pommern, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Mainz, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVII Z-39, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.pngVIII Admiral Hipper, or other desirable rewards.

Final reward: Iron Cross permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Pommern.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8e038524-d2b0-11ea-97f2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Pommern is a variant of the H-class battleship project that's armed with twelve 380 mm guns. Decent armor, powerful secondary armament, the Hydroacoustic Search consumable, and torpedoes allow the ship a high degree of confidence in close quarters engagements. With the release of Update 0.9.7, Pommern will be available in the Armory for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png228,000 Coal and from bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons, as well as in the Premium Shop.

German Navy Containers
How to get the containers
Up to 10 containers—by completing Directives.
Up to two containers—from Daily Shipments.
Up to five containers—by completing special combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/121890563ca58b2a6dd78db8123f8c1693c97e00.jpg
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that World of Warships is partnering up with Transformers in a brand-new collaboration! Autobots and Decepticons will be introduced for a limited time as themed ship skins and commanders in a much-anticipated update planned for this September.

As for now, take a look at trailer for collaboration, comic page and beautiful renders below.
[previewyoutube=UnGP42M6Dig;full][/previewyoutube]
Four iconic Transformers characters will be released initially as unique ship skins and commanders with recognizable phrases and voiceovers. Optimus Prime and Bumblebee will set the stage for the heroic Autobots, with Megatron and Rumble to be available as their eternal foes — the Decepticons.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6b5403c-d573-11ea-9751-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
